question: Ariel controls [Forerunner of the Empire] with a +1/+1 counter and casts [Polyraptor]. If they always chooses to deal the damage with Forerunner of the Empire's trigger, how many Polyraptors will end up on the battlefield?
answer_gold: 11. One damage is dealt to the Forerunner of the Empire and Polyraptor. That creates a second Polyraptor, which deals one damage to each Polyraptor and Forerunner of the Empire. The first trigger to create a Polyraptor resolves and its damage trigger puts three more Polyraptor triggers onto the stack, for 4 in total. The first of those triggers resolves, dealing 1 damage to each of the 4 Polyraptor on the battlefield and putting 4 more triggers onto the stack, for 7 in total. This kills Forerunner of the Empire, so the remaining 7 Polyraptor triggers resolve without causing any more triggers.

question: Nico controls [Tsabo's Web]. Does Aya's [Desert of the Mindful] untap during their untap step?
answer_gold: No.

question: Aubrielle controls [Drought] and [Derelor]. How many Swamps would they have to sacrifice in order to cast a [Glyph of Doom]?
answer_gold: 1. The mana cost of a spell doesn't change, regardless of what was paid for it.

question: Aspen controls [Drought] and [Edgewalker]. How many Swamps would they have to sacrifice in order to cast a [Nameless Inversion]?
answer_gold: 1. The mana cost of a spell doesn't change, regardless of what needs to be paid for it.

question: Nico controls [Drought]. How many Swamps would Adelynn have to sacrifice in order to cast [Beckon Apparition]?
answer_gold: 1. Hybrid mana symbols are the colors of their constituent mana symbols.

question: Nico controls a [Drought]. How many Swamps would Ariel have to sacrifice in order to cast a [Surgical Extraction]?
answer_gold: 1. Phyrexian mana symbols are a mana symbol of that color.

question: Nico controls [Psychic Battle]. Amirah casts [Magma Burst]. Neither player has any cards in their library when the trigger resolves. What happens?
answer_gold: Neither player revealed a card with the highest mana value, so neither of them may change the targets of the spell.

question: Arielle controls [Soul-Scar Mage] and casts [Annihilating Fire] targeting Nixon's [Squire]. What zone does it move to?
answer_gold: The graveyard. Soul-Scar Mage replaces the damage with putting that many -1/-1 counters on the Squire. No creature was "dealt damage this way".

question: Aryana has taken control of an [Ahn-Crop Crasher] from Noe with [Tibalt, the Fiend-Blooded], which Aryana exerts. After Aryana ends their turn, will it untap during Noe's untap step?
answer_gold: Yes. A player exerting a permanent only causes it to not untap during that player's next untap step, not any untap step that would untap it.

question: Ariel controls [Desecrated Tomb] and casts [Skaab Goliath] from their hand, exiling creature cards from their graveyard. How many Bat tokens do they create?
answer_gold: One. The total cost to cast a spell consists of all of the individual costs. The individual costs may be paid in any order relative to each other, but all components of each individual cost must be paid at the same time. Ariel may pay the mana and then exile the creature cards or exile the creature cards and then pay the mana, but the creature cards will all be exiled at the same time. Desecrated Tomb is looking for the event of "some number of creature cards being exiled from the graveyard", so it will only trigger once.

question: Ainsley casts [Metamorphic Alteration], targeting a crewed [Weatherlight]. As it resolves, they choose to copy a [Barktooth Warbeard]. What happens at the end of the turn?
answer_gold: The effect making Weatherlight a creature ends. Metamorphic Alteration is still enchanting it and the effect making it a copy of Barktooth Warbeard still exists. It's a Barktooth Warbeard.

question: Antoine controls [Dream Halls] and activates [Soul Sculptor], targeting [Confessor]. Antoine casts [Hill Giant], discarding [Hulking Devil] to pay for it. Does Confessor trigger?
answer_gold: No. The final step of casting a spell is when the spell becomes "cast", and that is when Soul Sculptor's effect ends. Discarding Hulking Devil is a cost to cast the spell, which happens earlier.

question: Aisha activates [Soul Sculptor], targeting their [Mona Lisa, Ever Adaptable]. After that resolves, they cast [Orazca Frillback]. Does Mona Lisa, Ever Adaptable trigger?
answer_gold: Yes. The final step of casting a spell is when the spell becomes "cast", and that is when Soul Sculptor's effect ends. Triggered abilities are checked immediately after the event occurs to see if they trigger. At that time, Mona Lisa, Ever Adaptable has its abilities.

question: Ainsley controls [Lantern of Insight] and the top card of their library is an [Obsidian Battle-Axe]. Ainsley casts [Ancient Stirrings]. If they chooses to take the Obsidian Battle-Axe, what happens?
answer_gold: Ainsley doesn't change the order of the 5 cards on top while looking at them. If the top card moves to their hand, they reveal the next card down. Then they put the rest on the bottom of their library.

question: Autumn casts [Tasseled Dromedary]. Nikolai controls a [Baral, Chief of Compliance] and casts [Mystic Confluence], choosing "Counter target spell unless its controller pays {3}." all three times. Autumn does not pay any mana as Mystic Confluence resolves. How many times does Baral, Chief of Compliance trigger?
answer_gold: Once. If a player chooses the same mode on a spell multiple times, the instructions of those modes are followed in sequence. To counter a spell means to move it from the stack to the graveyard. Once that has been done the first time, the Tasseled Dromedary is in the graveyard and is no longer a legal target for Mystic Confluence. It will not be countered again.

question: Adaline controls [Solemnity] and casts [Propeller Pioneer]. What happens if Adaline chooses to not create the Servo tokens?
answer_gold:
This can't happen as described. Adaline must create the Servo tokens.

Fabricate means "When this permanent enters the battlefield, you may put N +1/+1 counters on it. If you don’t, create N 1/1 colorless Servo artifact creature tokens." ([702.123a]) Propeller Pioneer can't get counters, so Adaline can't choose to put counters on it.

question: Amaris controls a [The Flame of Keld] with 2 lore counters on it and [Soul-Scar Mage]. Amaris puts the third lore counter on The Flame of Keld and resolves its final chapter ability. Amaris then casts [Shock], targeting Nico's [River Kaijin]. How many -1/-1 counters are placed on the River Kaijin?
answer_gold: There are two replacement effects trying to apply to the damage being dealt, so Nico chooses which one to apply first. If they apply The Flame of Keld's effect first, Soul-Scar Mage's effect will then apply afterwards, and 4 -1/-1 counters will be placed on the River Kaijin. If they apply the Soul-Scar Mage's effect first, the The Flame of Keld's effect will no longer be applicable and the River Kaijin will only receive 2 -1/-1 counters.

question: Amelie controls a [Metallic Mimic] naming "Dragon" and casts a [Voracious Dragon]. If Amelie chooses to devour the Metallic Mimic, how many +1/+1 counters does the Voracious Dragon enter the battlefield with?
answer_gold: Voracious Dragon will enter the battlefield with 2 counters, regardless of any choices made by Amelie. As Voracious Dragon enters the battlefield, Amelie can choose which of the two replacement effects to apply first, devour or Metallic Mimic's effect. Even if Amelie applies the devour effect first, that action is not performed yet- the game simply knows that that effect should be considered for the purpose of determining how Voracious Dragon will be affected by other replacement effects. The Metallic Mimic is still on the battlefield, so its effect will apply and give Voracious Dragon an additional +1/+1 counter.

question: Nickolas controls [Dryad Arbor]. Aniya casts [Overwhelming Splendor], enchanting Nickolas. After it resolves, can Nickolas tap the Dryad Arbor for {G}?
answer_gold: No. It has the ability to tap for {G} due to its basic land subtype, and it loses it in layer 6.

question: Alvaro controls two [Forest], a [Phyrexian Altar] and a [Hostage Taker] that exiled their [Grid Monitor]. Can they cast [Wretched Gryff], sacrificing the Hostage Taker to Phyrexian Altar for the {U} and sacrificing the Grid Monitor to emerge?
answer_gold: No. Emerge reduces the cost of the Wretched Gryff by the sacrificed creature's mana value. ([702.119a]) The total cost of the Wretched Gryff must be determined before any costs are paid or mana abilities are activated, so the creature to be sacrificed must be chosen before that point. ([601.2b], [702.119c]) It isn't on the battlefield yet, so it can't be chosen.

question: Nickolas's commander is [Isamaru, Hound of Konda], which Anna has taken control of with [Abduction]. Nickolas currently has 20 life and has been dealt 20 combat damage by Isamaru, Hound of Konda over the course of previous turns. Anna attacks with Isamaru, Hound of Konda. Does Nickolas lose the game?
answer_gold: Yes. A player that's been dealt 21 or more combat damage by the same commander loses the game. It doesn't matter who controls or owns that commander.

question: Nico has 9 poison counters. Andres attacks with a [Priests of Norn], and Nico casts [Angel's Grace] before damage is dealt. What happens?
answer_gold: Nico is dealt 1 damage and gets 1 poison counter. They can't lose the game however, so nothing else happens. When Andres ends their turn, Nico loses the game during the cleanup step.

question: Abdullah casts [Hellkite Hatchling], choosing to devour [Kozilek's Channeler] as it resolves. Does their [Emperor Crocodile] trigger?
answer_gold: No. The Kozilek's Channeler is sacrificed at the same time as Hellkite Hatchling enters the battlefield.

question: Armando controls a [Tempting Licid]. They activates its first ability targeting itself. What happens?
answer_gold: Tempting Licid becomes an Aura enchantment with enchant creature. It cannot become attached to itself because it is no longer a creature. When state-based actions are checked, it will be put into the graveyard.

question: Nico controls [Teysa, Envoy of Ghosts]. Allen casts [Ulamog, the Infinite Gyre]. Can they target Teysa, Envoy of Ghosts with Ulamog, the Infinite Gyre's abliity?
answer_gold: No. Protection from creatures applies to creature cards in any zone, and prevents abilities from a creature source from targeting the Teysa, Envoy of Ghosts.

question: Alex controls [Hurloon Minotaur] that's enchanted with 2 [Soul Link]. Alex attacks, and Nico declares no blockers. How much life does Alex gain?
answer_gold: 4. Each Soul Link gives Hurloon Minotaur a separate triggered ability. They will each trigger and resolve independently.

question: Andy controls [Bloodline Keeper] and 4 2/2 Vampire creature tokens. They activate Bloodline Keeper's ability to transform it into [Lord of Lineage]. In response, Natalee casts [Sonic Seizure] targeting the Bloodline Keeper. In response, Andy activates the transform ability again. After everything has resolved, is the Bloodline Keeper/Lord of Lineage alive?
answer_gold: Yes. The top ability on the stack will resolve first, transforming Bloodline Keeper. Then the Sonic Seizure will resolve. When the second transform ability resolves, it does nothing since Bloodline Keeper has already transformed since the ability was put onto the stack.

question: Aitana has [Felhide Minotaur] and two [Ichorid]s in their graveyard. On their upkeep, they resolve the trigger of the first Ichorid, exiling the second Ichorid. As the second trigger resolves, can Aitana choose to exile the Felhide Minotaur? If so, what happens?
answer_gold: No. If Ichorid isn't in the graveyard when the trigger begins to resolve, it is removed from the stack.

question: Nathan controls [Charmed Pendant]. Addison casts [Take Possession] targeting the Charmed Pendant. Can Nathan activate it in response?
answer_gold: Yes. Charmed Pendant's ability is a mana ability. Split second does not prevent mana abilities from being activated. "Activate only as an instant" simply means that Nathan must have priority, not that Nathan could actually cast an instant at that time.

question: Alfred currently has 10 life, and Nico has 8 life. Alfred casts [Duplicant], exiling Nico's [Death's Shadow]. What are the power and toughness of the Duplicant?
answer_gold: 13/13. Death's Shadow's ability only functions on the battlefield, so in exile it is a 13/13. Duplicant only gains the power, toughness, and creature types of the exiled card, not its abilities.

question: Astrid attacks with [Prophetic Flamespeaker] and exiles [Liar's Pendulum] as its trigger resolves. Neymar casts [Public Execution] targeting the Prophetic Flamespeaker. In the postcombat main phase, Astrid casts [Endless Obedience] to return the Prophetic Flamespeaker back to the battlefield. Can Astrid cast the Liar's Pendulum?
answer_gold: Yes. Being allowed to cast the Liar's Pendulum is a part of the resolution of the Prophetic Flamespeaker's trigger. It doesn't matter if the Prophetic Flamespeaker is on the battlefield or not.

question: Aminah controls [Carpet of Flowers]. Nico controls no Islands and controls [Leovold, Emissary of Trest]. Can Aminah choose to add 0 mana during their first main phase in order to not have Carpet of Flowers trigger again in their second main phase?
answer_gold: No. Aminah can choose to add 0 mana the first time the trigger resolves, but when the second main phase begins, Aminah has not "added mana with this ability", so it will trigger again.

question: Addilynn controls [Village Survivors] and [Vorstclaw] and has 6 life. Noe controls [Norn's Annex]. If Addilynn attacks with Vorstclaw, paying 2 life, will it become tapped?
answer_gold: Yes. Tapping creatures to attack is done before paying any costs to attack.

question: Ares controls [Gaea's Cradle] and no creatures. Nico controls a [Contamination]. If Ares taps the Gaea's Cradle, what mana is produced, if any?
answer_gold: No mana is produced. Gaea's Cradle is not producing any mana, so Contamination's replacement effect doesn't apply.

question: Ainsley controls a [Gaea's Cradle] enchanted by a [Market Festival] and no creatures. If Ainsley taps the Gaea's Cradle, how much mana is produced?
answer_gold: No mana is produced. Gaea's Cradle's activated ability is not producing any mana, so Market Festival doesn't trigger.

question: Alex controls [Bassara Tower Archer] and [Phantom Centaur]. Neil controls [Raging Bull] enchanted by their [Parasitic Impetus]. Alex casts [Sudden Disappearance] targeting Neil. When the trigger resolves at the beginning of the next end step, what can Parasitic Impetus enchant?
answer_gold: Just Bassara Tower Archer. Phantom Centaur has protection from black, so it can't be enchanted by anything black. Raging Bull isn't on the battlefield when Neil chooses what to enchant. Hexproof doesn't prevent an Aura from becoming attached to the Bassara Tower Archer.

question: Augustine controls a token that's a copy of [Golgari Brownscale] due to [Mirrorweave]. They cast [Decree of Pain] to destroy Golgari Brownscale. Can Augustine dredge the token for Decree of Pain's card draw? If so, what happens?
answer_gold: No, Augustine may not dredge the token. The effect making it a copy of Golgari Brownscale ends when it leaves the battlefield, so it does not have dredge in the graveyard.

question: Autumn controls [Bridge from Below] and [Silvercoat Lion]. They cast [Hour of Revelation]. Do they create a Zombie token?
answer_gold: No. Leaves-the-battlefield triggers care about the state of the game immediately before the event in question. Bridge from Below was on the battlefield at that time, and won't trigger.

question: Avery attacks with [Dragon-Style Twins]. Nico blocks with [Lady Orca] and a [Spell Queller] that exiled a [Spider Umbra]. Can Avery kill the Spell Queller first and enchant Dragon-Style Twins with the Spider Umbra in order to kill the Lady Orca?
answer_gold: Yes. Creatures with double strike deal damage in two separate combat damage steps. Avery can deal 3 damage to the Spell Queller in the first combat damage step and then cast the Spider Umbra before the second combat damage step begins.

question: Alex casts [Fires of Undeath] from their graveyard for its flashback cost and Nelson exiles it with [Spell Queller]. If Spell Queller dies later in the turn, can Alex cast the Fires of Undeath? If so, what zone will it move to as it resolves?
answer_gold: Alex can cast it. It was exiled by Spell Queller's ability- flashback doesn't affect that. It's a different object from when it was previously on the stack, so flashback's replacement effect doesn't apply to it anymore. It will be put into the graveyard when it resolves.

question: Aspen controls an [Angel's Tomb] and casts [Druid's Familiar]. Can they pair the Druid's Familiar with the Angel's Tomb that's now a creature?
answer_gold: No. Soulbond only triggers if Aspen controls another unpaired creature when Druid's Familiar first enters the battlefield.

question: Avery controls [Sylvok Explorer]. Nolan controls [Gaea's Cradle] and no creatures. If Avery taps the Sylvok Explorer, what type(s) of mana can they produce?
answer_gold: None. Gaea's Cradle couldn't produce any mana, so neither can Sylvok Explorer.

question: Addison controls [Grizzly Bears] paired with [Nearheath Pilgrim] and an unpaired [Elgaud Shieldmate]. They cast [Man-o'-War] and targets Grizzly Bears with its triggered ability. What are the legal pairings after all triggers have resolved?
answer_gold: Either no pairings or Man-o'-War with Elgaud Shieldmate. Nearheath Pilgrim's soulbond ability didn't trigger and when Elgaud Shieldmate's ability resolves, it can only be paired with the creature that caused it to trigger.

question: Ashley owns 2 [Rift Bolt] in exile that each have a time counter. Nikolai controls a [Vryn Wingmare]. During Ashley's upkeep, can they cast the first Rift Bolt (paying {1}) to kill the Vryn Wingmare and then cast the second one for free?
answer_gold: Yes. Ashley casts each Rift Bolt as its suspend trigger resolves. The second trigger doesn't resolve until the first Rift Bolt has left the stack.

question: Ariel controls [Mana Reflection] and [City of Traitors]. Nico controls [Damping Sphere]. If Ariel taps the City of Traitors for mana, how much mana is produced?
answer_gold: Either {C} or {C}{C}, Ariel's choice. As the ability resolves, there are two replacement effects attempting to modify it. Ariel chooses which one to apply first. If they apply Mana Reflection first, the event will become "Add {C}{C}{C}{C}" when Damping Sphere then replaces with "Add {C}". If Ariel applies Damping Sphere first, the event becomes "Add {C}", which Mana Reflection then replaces with "Add {C}{C}".

question: Abby has cast 3 creature spells this turn, then attacks with [Vengevine], which dies in combat. If Abby casts another creature spell, will Vengevine return to the battlefield?
answer_gold: No. Vengevine triggers when the second creature spell of a turn is cast, not the 4th.

question: Andy begins to suspend a [Nihilith]. Nico would like to sacrifice a [Rocky Tar Pit] in response so that a time counter is not removed from Nihilith. Can they?
answer_gold: No. Suspending a card this way is a special action, and does not go on the stack. Once Andy has priority and begins to take the action, Nico doesn't have a chance to do anything until it's completed and Nihilith is in exile.

question: Amber controls a [Spellbinder] that exiled [Guardian Angel]. Nico controls a [Meddling Mage] that named "Guardian Angel". As Spellbinder's second ability resolves, what happens?
answer_gold: Amber copies the Guardian Angel in exile. Amber can't cast the copy, so it remains in exile. It ceases to exist as soon as Spellbinder's ability finishes resolving.

question: Alanna controls [Aether Rift]. While resolving its ability, they discard a [Nightshade Assassin]. What happens to it?
answer_gold: It is discarded into exile. Any player may pay 5 life. If no player does, nothing happens, since the Nightshade Assassin is in exile and can't be returned to the battlefield from the graveyard. When the madness trigger resolves, Alanna can cast the Nightshade Assassin. If they don't, it is put into the graveyard.

question: Ariel attacks with [Frenzied Goblin]. Noe controls [Dromoka Warrior] and [Dune Beetle]. Can they pay {R}{R} to make both of Noe's creatures unable to block?
answer_gold: No. Frenzied Goblin has a triggered ability, and it only triggers once when it attacks. Ariel chooses whether or not to pay {R} as the trigger resolves.

question: Avery activates [Merieke Ri Berit]'s ability, targeting Nataly's [Silverback Ape]. Before that ability resolves, Avery untaps Merieke Ri Berit with [Thousand-Year Elixir] and then taps it again targeting [Goblin Piker]. What happens to Silverback Ape and Goblin Piker?
answer_gold:
Avery will gain control of Silverback Ape and Goblin Piker. Neither of them will be destroyed.

Merieke Ri Berit's ability creates a delayed trigger that triggers when Merieke Ri Berit becomes untapped. When Merieke Ri Berit became untapped its ability hadn't resolved yet, so there was no delayed trigger to destroy the Silverback Ape.

question: Augustine controls [Butcher Ghoul] enchanted by their [Unhallowed Pact]. They attack with it and Nico blocks with [Scaled Wurm]. Will Butcher Ghoul have a +1/+1 counter when it returns to the battlefield?
answer_gold: It's Augustine's choice. There are two triggers when Butcher Ghoul dies, so Augustine can choose the order to put them onto the stack. The first one to resolve will return the Butcher Ghoul to the battlefield, and the second one will do nothing.

question: Ayaan controls [Goblin Arsonist] enchanted by Natasha's [Glistening Oil]. When Goblin Arsonist dies at the beginning of Ayaan's upkeep, does it deal its damage with infect?
answer_gold:
This can't happen as described. Glistening Oil triggers at the beginning of Natasha's upkeep, not Ayaan's.

When it dies in Natasha's upkeep, it will deal its damage with infect, since the game looks at how it last existed on the battlefield.

question: Aurora controls [Summit Prowler]. Nickolas casts [Crippling Chill] targeting Summit Prowler. Before it resolves, Aurora casts [Momentary Blink] targeting the Summit Prowler. What happens to the Summit Prowler? Does Nickolas draw a card?
answer_gold: The stack resolves from the top down, so the Summit Prowler is exiled and returned to the battlefield first. This causes the Summit Prowler to become a completely new permanent, unrelated to what it was before. It's no longer being targeted by the Crippling Chill, so when Crippling Chill begins to resolve, it will not resolve due to having no legal targets. Nickolas will not draw a card.

question: Annie controls [Treacherous Pit-Dweller] enchanted with [Shade's Form]. They attack with it and Nico blocks with [Scoria Elemental]. What happens to the Treacherous Pit-Dweller?
answer_gold: When Treacherous Pit-Dweller dies, Annie controls both triggers to return it to the battlefield, so they can choose which one to have resolve first. The other trigger will do nothing, since Treacherous Pit-Dweller is no longer in the graveyard when it resolves. Regardless of which trigger returned it to the battlefield, it entered the battlefield from a graveyard, so Nico will gain control of it.

question: Ava controls a [Vesuvan Shapeshifter] that is currently face down. They pay {1}{U} to turn it face up and choose to copy a face-up [Skinthinner]. Does Vesuvan Shapeshifter's "when Skinthinner is turned face up" trigger trigger?
answer_gold: Yes. "When Skinthinner is turned face up" really just means "When this permanent is turned face up". Even though Vesuvan Shapeshifter didn't have that ability before it was turned face-up, triggered abilities are checked to see if they trigger immediately after the event occurred, and at that point Vesuvan Shapeshifter did have the ability.

question: Addisyn controls [Gibbering Descent] and an [Undiscovered Paradise] that they tapped for mana during their last turn. Addisyn has no cards in hand as they begin their turn. Do they skip their upkeep?
answer_gold: No. Undiscovered Paradise is returned to Addisyn's hand during their untap step, at the same time as they untap their permanents. Addisyn's hand is not empty as the upkeep begins, so it is not skipped.

question: Alonso controls a [Containment Priest] and has a [Gluttonous Slime] in their graveyard. They cast [Resurrection], targeting the Gluttonous Slime. Can Alonso devour the Containment Priest and have Gluttonous Slime enter the battlefield?
answer_gold: No. Alonso can choose to devour the Containment Priest before applying its effect. However, that action is not performed yet- the game simply knows that that effect should be considered for the purpose of determining how Gluttonous Slime will be affected by other replacement effects. The Containment Priest is still on the battlefield, so its effect will apply and exile the Gluttonous Slime.

question: Aspen controls [Master Biomancer] and casts [Voracious Dragon]. If Aspen chooses to devour Master Biomancer, how many +1/+1 counters does Voracious Dragon enter the battlefield with? Does Aspen have any choice in the matter?
answer_gold:
Voracious Dragon will enter the battlefield with 3 +1/+1 counters, regardless of any choices made by Aspen.

As Voracious Dragon enters the battlefield, Aspen can choose which of the two replacement effects to apply to the event first, devour or Master Biomancer's effect. Even if Aspen applies the devour effect first, that action is not performed yet- the game simply knows that that effect should be considered for the purpose of determining how Voracious Dragon will be affected by other replacement effects. (The game can only perform an event once it knows what event that is. As such, the process for applying replacement effects in [616.1] is carried out in full before anything actually occurs in the game. "Apply" in this context means to apply the modification to the event, not to actually carry out any actions.) The Master Biomancer is still on the battlefield after applying Voracious Dragon's effect, the game simply knows now that it will be sacrificed as Voracious Dragon enters the battlefield, which hasn't happened yet. Master Biomancer's effect is still around immediately before Voracious Dragon enters the battlefield, so it will apply and give Voracious Dragon the additional +1/+1 counters.

question: Arielle has a [River's Grasp] in hand but has no blue mana. Can they cast it with {B}{B}{B}{B}, targeting Nick's [Labyrinth Guardian] in order to make them sacrifice it?
answer_gold: Yes. River's Grasp only checks to see if {U} was spent upon resolution, and only returns the targeted creature to its owner's hand if it was. Choosing a target is done as the spell is cast, regardless of what mana is paid.

question: It is currently Addison's cleanup step, and Nola cast an [Emrakul, the Promised End] last turn, taking control of Addison's current turn. Who chooses what cards to discard to hand size?
answer_gold: Nola does. Cards are discarded to hand size before "this turn" and "until end of turn" effects wear off. Emrakul, the Promised End's effect is not a "this turn" or "until end of turn" effect in any case, so it lasts for the entire turn.

question: It is currently Aspen's cleanup step, and Nova cast [Worst Fears] last turn. Aspen discards [Worldspine Wurm] and [Emrakul, the Aeons Torn] to hand size. Which player chooses in what order to put the triggers onto the stack?
answer_gold: Nova does. Only effects worded as "this turn" or "until end of turn" wear off in the cleanup step. Nova controls Aspen during the entire turn.

question: Aydin controls a [The Gitrog Monster] and discards a land to hand size as their turn ends. What happens?
answer_gold: The trigger to draw a card is put onto the stack and resolves. Then another cleanup step begins.

question: Nash cast [Sphinx's Decree] last turn. Ashley moves to their cleanup step and discards a [Dread] to hand size. Can they cast an instant during their cleanup step?
answer_gold: No. While Ashley does get priority during the cleanup step, the effect of Sphinx's Decree is not a "this turn" or "until end of turn" effect, so it lasts until the turn ends.

question: Aspen attacks with [Aurelia, the Warleader]. Immediately after the trigger resolves, they casts [Time Stop]. Is there an additional combat phase? If so, when?
answer_gold: There is no additional combat phase. When Aurelia, the Warleader's trigger resolves, it adds the phase to the structure of the current turn. When Time Stop resolves, it skips all remaining steps and phases until the cleanup step.

question: Annabel controls [Vedalken Orrery]. In their draw step, they casts [Fury of the Horde]. What happens?
answer_gold: There is no "this main phase" to add the combat step after, so no additional phase is created. The turn proceeds as normal.

question: Ariya controls [Vedalken Orrery]. In Nico's end step, Ariya casts [Waves of Aggression]. What happens?
answer_gold: All creatures that attacked this turn are untapped. There is no "this main phase" to add the combat step after, so no additional phase is created. The turn proceeds as normal.

question: Ashley controls [Hypersonic Dragon]. In Noah's postcombat main phase, Ashley casts [Relentless Assault]. What happens?
answer_gold: All creatures that attacked this turn are untapped. A new combat phase is created after that main phase, during which Noah can attack again.

question: In Aspen's draw step, they tap [Vault of Catlacan] for 8 blue mana and cast [Time Stop]. Aspen discards a [Guile] to hand size. Can they use the two remaining {U} to cast an instant?
answer_gold: No. The mana was removed from the mana pool when the draw step ended.

question: Ariel moves to the cleanup step and discards a card to hand size. Can Nasir cast [Dream Salvage] afterwards to draw a card?
answer_gold: No. By default players do not receive priority during the cleanup step.

question: Adrienne controls an [Avizoa] that they activated once already. They move to their end step and discard a [Guile] to hand size. Can they activate the Avizoa again during the cleanup step?
answer_gold: No. While Adrienne does get priority during the cleanup step, the "activate this ability only once each turn" instruction of Avizoa is not a "this turn" or "until end of turn" effect, so it lasts for the entire turn.

question: Nico has [Pull from Tomorrow] and no other cards in their hand, and they haven't drawn any other cards previously this turn. They cast Pull from Tomorrow to draw and then discard a card. The card they draw is [Revenge of the Hunted]. Can they cast it for its miracle cost?
answer_gold: No. Nico may reveal Revenge of the Hunted as it's drawn, but then it's discarded. The miracle trigger is only put onto the stack after Pull from Tomorrow has finished resolving, and the Revenge of the Hunted isn't in Nico's hand to be cast when it resolves.

question: Audrey casts [Enlarge] targeting [Goblin Piker], and then attacks with the Goblin Piker. Nico blocks it with a [Baron Sengir], which has gained infect due to their [Grafted Exoskeleton] and indestructible due to their [Withstand Death]. What happens at the end of the turn?
answer_gold: The effect from Enlarge wears off, but the -1/-1 counters on Goblin Piker remain. Goblin Piker dies. It was dealt damage that turn by Baron Sengir, so Baron Sengir triggers.

question: Aubrey controls a [Necromancy] that was cast during their declare blockers step. During Aubrey's end step, Nikolai activates [Duskmantle Guildmage]'s first ability. Does Aubrey lose 1 life when the Necromancy is sacrificed?
answer_gold: Yes. Duskmantle Guildmage creates a delayed triggered ability. The existence of that ability is not a continuous effect, so it still exists during the cleanup step.

question: Aubrey controls a [Leaden Myr] with a +1/+1 counter. They cast [Rise of the Dark Realms], putting [Dracoplasm] and [Thief of Blood] onto the battlefield. Aubrey would like to sacrifice the Leaden Myr to Dracoplasm's ability. What are the power and toughness of both creatures after they have entered the battlefield?
answer_gold: Both Dracoplasm and Thief of Blood are 2/2. Since they are both entering the battlefield at the same time, their replacement effects take place at the same time. Thief of Blood removes the +1/+1 counter from Leaden Myr at the same time as Dracoplasm sacrifices it. Thief of Blood sees that 1 counter was removed and so enters the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter, while Dracoplasm looks at the Leaden Myr's last known information and sees that it was a 2/2 immediately before it left the battlefield.

question: Alma casts [Virulent Wound], targeting Nico's [Bronze Sable]. In response, Nico casts [Brute Strength] on the Bronze Sable. What happens at the end of the turn?
answer_gold: The effect from Brute Strength wears off, but the -1/-1 counter remains. Bronze Sable dies. The delayed triggered ability created by Virulent Wound is not a continuous effect, so it still exists during the cleanup step, and will trigger due to Bronze Sable dying. Nico gets a poison counter.

question: Nico controls [Grafdigger's Cage]. Amaya controls [Renegade Demon] and has [Golden Hind] in their graveyard. Amaya casts [Living Death]. What happens?
answer_gold: The Living Death resolves normally. Grafdigger's Cage only prevents creature cards from entering the battlefield from the graveyard or library. Living Death puts them onto the battlefield from exile.

question: Addison controls a [Seal of the Guildpact] with "Blue" and "Red" chosen. How much does it cost them to cast an [Odds]?
answer_gold: {U}{R}. Seal of the Guildpact only reduces the generic mana components of spells by {2}, not the colored mana.

question: Alannah has a [Myr Superion] and 2 [Elvish Spirit Guide]s in their hand. Can they exile the two Elvish Spirit Guides to cast the Myr Superion?
answer_gold: No. Myr Superion can only be cast with mana produced by "creatures", and an Elvish Spirit Guide in a player's hand isn't a "creature", it's a "creature card". Creatures only exist on the battlefield.

question: Ariel controls an [Arcane Adaptation] naming "Rebel". Nelson controls a [Brutal Suppression]. Does Ariel have to sacrifice a land in order to cycle [Disciple of Law]?
answer_gold: No. Disciple of Law is a rebel, but Brutal Suppression only affects Rebels on the battlefield, not in any other zone.

question: Aubrey has already played a land this turn and casts [Flash]. Can they put [Dryad Arbor] onto the battlefield? If so, how much do they have to pay in order to not sacrifice it?
answer_gold: Putting a land onto the battlefield due to some effect is not "playing" a land, so Aubrey may put the Dryad Arbor onto the battlefield. It has no mana cost, so Aubrey can't pay its mana cost. The Dryad Arbor will be sacrificed.

question: Angelina controls [Ice Cauldron]. Noel controls [Suppression Field]. Angelina activates Ice Cauldron's first ability with X=1, paying {C}{C}{C}. On Angelina's next turn, they activate Ice Cauldron's second ability. How much mana do they add?
answer_gold: Just {C}. The activation cost of Ice Cauldron's first ability is "{X}, {T}". The additional cost imposed by Suppression Field is not part of the activation cost, and the mana spent on it isn't noted when the ability resolves.

question: Abel controls a [Mirage Mirror] that, two turns ago, become a copy of [Angel of Condemnation] and exiled [Coral Eel] with its second activated ability. This turn, Abel activates Mirage Mirror targeting [Undiscovered Paradise] and taps it for mana. On Abel's next turn, will the Coral Eel return to the battlefield? If so, can it attack?
answer_gold: It will return to the battlefield, but it can't attack. Any time an object refers to itself by name, it just means "this card", so Mirage Mirror will return to Abel's hand during their untap step, and the Coral Eel will return to the battlefield. During the combat phase of that turn, Coral Eel has not been on the battlefield since the turn began, so it will not be able to attack.

question: Alison controls [Duskwatch Recruiter] enchanted by [Infinite Reflection]. Alison also controls a [Convicted Killer] which is currently a copy of Duskwatch Recruiter. No spells were cast last turn. At the beginning of their upkeep, what happens to the Duskwatch Recruiter and Convicted Killer?
answer_gold: Both Duskwatch Recruiter and Convicted Killer transform. Convicted Killer's back face remains a copy of the front face of Duskwatch Recruiter.

question: Ariel controls [Bastion Inventor] and an [Oblivion Ring] that exiled Noelle's [Ghostly Possession]. Noelle casts [Serene Offering] targeting Oblivion Ring. What happens as the Ghostly Possession returns to the battlefield?
answer_gold: It enchants Bastion Inventor. Auras entering the battlefield from a zone other than the stack must enchant a legal object. It doesn't target anything, so hexproof doesn't matter.

question: Alisson turns their [Mirage Mirror] into a copy of [Old Man of the Sea] and takes control of Nathaniel's [Those Who Serve]. At the end of the turn when Mirage Mirror stops being a copy of Old Man of the Sea, will Those Who Serve return to Nathaniel's control?
answer_gold: Yes. Mirage Mirror has no power, so the game uses 0 instead. Those Who Serve has greater than 0 power, so the control-changing effect ends.

question: Ainsley controls [Everlasting Torment] and casts [Soul Burn] with X = 2 targeting Nixon's [Forest Bear]. (Spending {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.) How much life does Ainsley gain?
answer_gold: 0. The instructions of the spell are carried out in order. By the time Ainsley would gain life, the creature's toughness has been reduced to 0 by the -1/-1 counters, so they can't gain more than 0 life.

question: Arianna casts [Embolden], targeting [Loxodon Line Breaker] and [Moriok Reaver]. When do they have to choose how much damage to each creature will be prevented? As the Embolden is cast, as it resolves, or as the damage is dealt?
answer_gold: As the Embolden is cast. Any time a spell divides or distributes an effect among multiple targets, that decision is made as it's cast.

question: Andy controls 3 artifacts and casts [Rusted Relic]. Neriah controls [Imposing Sovereign]. Does Rusted Relic enter the battlefield tapped or untapped?
answer_gold: Tapped. To determine what replacement effects apply to a permanent as it enters the battlefield, the game looks at the permanent as it would exist on the battlefield. On the battlefield Rusted Relic would be a creature, so Imposing Sovereign's effect will apply to it.

question: Arlo controls 3 [Nylea's Disciple]s. Nico controls [Authority of the Consuls]. Arlo casts [Genesis Wave], putting [Nylea, God of the Hunt] and [Ravenous Gigantotherium] onto the battlefield. They choose to devour all 3 of the Nylea's Disciples. Does Nylea, God of the Hunt enter the battlefield tapped? Does Authority of the Consuls trigger for it?
answer_gold:
It enters tapped, but Authority of the Consuls does not trigger for it. The Nylea, God of the Hunt and Ravenous Gigantotherium enter the battlefield at the same time as the Nylea's Disciples leave the battlefield. Nylea, God of the Hunt was entering the battlefield as a creature immediately beforehand, so it enters tapped. There are no choices involved for Arlo (other than which creatures to devour), since the two replacement effects are applying to different objects.

Once Nylea, God of the Hunt is on the battlefield it is not a creature, so Authority of the Consuls does not trigger.

question: Arthur casts [Show and Tell]. As it resolves, Nico wants to put [Throne of Eldraine] onto the battlefield. Do they know what Arthur is putting onto the battlefield while making the choice for Throne of Eldraine's replacement effect?
answer_gold: Yes. Show and Tell puts both permanents onto the battlefield at the same time. Before they change zones, both players look at each card.

question: Ace controls [Elspeth, Storm Slayer], [Flamerush Rider], and [Axegrinder Giant]. They attack with Flamerush Rider and Axegrinder Giant, targeting Axegrinder Giant with Flamerush Rider's ability and creating two tokens. Do they both get exiled at the end of combat, or only one?
answer_gold: Both. The "the token" refers to tokens created by the original ability, regardless of number.

question: Aylin controls [Phyrexian Hulk] and [Lifeline]. They cast [Feaster of Fools] and choose to devour the Phyrexian Hulk as it enters the battlefield. Does Lifeline trigger?
answer_gold: Yes. The Feaster of Fools enters the battlefield at the same time as Phyrexian Hulk leaves the battlefield. Lifeline checks to see if it should trigger immediately afterwards, at which point Feaster of Fools is on the battlefield.

question: Addilynn controls [Flailing Manticore] enchanted by Nolan's [Lost in Thought]. Addilynn exiles 3 cards from their graveyard in order to ignore the effect from Lost in Thought. Can Nolan activate Flailing Manticore's ability?
answer_gold: No. Only Addilynn ignores the effect. Nolan still treats "its activated abilities can't be activated" as true.

question: Ally controls [Brood Keeper] enchanted by [Frenzied Rage]. They cast [Aura Finesse] targeting Frenzied Rage and Brood Keeper. Does Brood Keeper trigger?
answer_gold: No. Frenzied Rage was already attached to Brood Keeper, so it can't "become" attached again.

question: Naomi controls [Rhystic Study]. Ariel casts [The Day of the Doctor]. As Rhystic Study's trigger resolves, who makes their choice first? Does Naomi choose whether or not to draw a card, and if yes, Ariel may pay the mana to prevent it? Or does Ariel choose to pay the mana first, and if they don't, Naomi has the choice to draw a card?
answer_gold: Ariel chooses first.

question: Autumn and Nico are beginning the game and have just drawn 7 cards. Nico has a [Serum Powder] in their hand. Does Nico get to know whether Autumn is going to mulligan before deciding whether to use Serum Powder's ability?
answer_gold: Yes. Nico exiles their hand and draws 7 cards at the time they would normally declare if they are going to take a mulligan, which is after Autumn has made that decision.

question: Ashley controls [One with the Multiverse]. The top card of their library is [Duskrider Peregrine]. Can they suspend it?
answer_gold: No. A card can only be suspended from the hand.

question: Nico has 6 life and controls [Abyssal Persecutor]. Ace has 0 life and attacks with 2 [Panther Warriors]. Nico blocks one of them with Abyssal Persecutor. Who wins the game?
answer_gold: Ace wins the game. Immediately after combat damage is dealt, both players have 0 life and Abyssal Persecutor has 6 damage marked on it. When state-based actions are checked, Abyssal Persecutor dies at the same time as Nico loses the game. This causes Ace to win the game, so state-based actions aren't checked again and they never have a chance to lose.

question: Addison controls [Possibility Storm] and casts [Horned Turtle]. Nylah counters it with [Wizard Replica]. What happens as the Possibility Storm trigger resolves?
answer_gold: Addison doesn't exile the Horned Turtle in their graveyard, since it's a new object. However they do exile cards from the top of their library until they exile a card that shares a card type with Horned Turtle and resolve the rest of the ability normally.

question: Aubrey controls [Mairsil, the Pretender] and has [Celestial Enforcer] in exile with a cage counter on it. They activate [Quicksilver Elemental], targeting Mairsil, the Pretender. Does Quicksilver Elemental gain the activated abilities of Celestial Enforcer? If so, can they be activated more than once that turn?
answer_gold: Quicksilver Elemental does gain the activated abilities of Mairsil, the Pretender, but they can only be activated once per turn. Mairsil, the Pretender's instruction of "You may activate each of those abilities only once each turn" is an activation instruction that's added to each ability it gains, and Quicksilver Elemental retains all activation instructions on each ability that it gains.

question: Achilles casts and resolves [Approach of the Second Sun]. The game is then restarted with [Karn Liberated]. Achilles casts and resolves Approach of the Second Sun again. Do they win the game?
answer_gold: No. The restarted game is a completely new game.

question: Angela controls [Gavony Unhallowed] and [Rocco, Cabaretti Caterer], which is their commander. Angela sacrifices Rocco, Cabaretti Caterer to [Trading Post] and chooses to put it into their command zone. Does Gavony Unhallowed trigger?
answer_gold: Yes. Commanders do move to the graveyard when sacrificed. They may be put into the command zone when state-based actions are checked.

question: Nasir controls [Brisela, Voice of Nightmares]. Can Alex cast [Red Sun's Zenith] with X = 3?
answer_gold: Yes. While on the stack, the mana value of an object treats X as its actual value. Alex is allowed to begin casting Red Sun's Zenith and choose X's value as "3" during that process, even though Red Sun's Zenith's mana value in their hand is 1.

question: Alvaro controls [Oracle of Mul Daya]. They plays 2 lands, then cast [Momentary Blink] targeting Oracle of Mul Daya. After it resolves, can Alvaro play a third land?
answer_gold: No. Land plays are not linked to any specific permanent, the game just looks at how many lands Alvaro has played and how many Alvaro is allowed to play in total.

question: Alex controls a token that was created as a copy of [Panglacial Wurm] and [Archmage Ascension] with 6 quest counters on it. Nina casts [Oblation] targeting Panglacial Wurm. As Alex is searching their library, can they cast the token copy of Panglacial Wurm from it?
answer_gold: No. The token does continue to exist in the library until state-based actions are checked after Oblation resolves. However, a token in a zone other than the battlefield can't change zones, so Alex can't put it onto the stack in order to begin casting it.

question: Amira controls a token that's a copy of [Greater Mossdog] created by [Quasiduplicate]. They cast [Dregs of Sorrow] to destroy Greater Mossdog. Can Amira dredge the token? If so, what happens?
answer_gold: The token is put into the graveyard just like any other permanent, and it has dredge while it's there. However Greater Mossdog can't leave the graveyard, so Amira can't choose to dredge it.

question: Aleah, Bo, and Clay are playing a multiplayer game. Aleah controls [Extractor Demon] and Bo controls [Fugitive Wizard]. Aleah attacks Bo with Extractor Demon and Bo loses the game. Does Extractor Demon trigger?
answer_gold: Yes.

question: Andres controls [Strionic Resonator] and plays [Clive's Hideaway]. They activate Strionic Resonator targeting the hideaway trigger, exiling 2 cards. On their next turn, they activate Clive's Hideaway's ability to cast the exiled card. What happens as it resolves?
answer_gold: Assuming Andres meets the stated condition, they may cast one or both exiled cards.

question: Ariyah controls [Sarkhan's Unsealing] and 6 [Mountain]s. They cast [Maraxus of Keld] tapping those Mountains. Does Sarkhan's Unsealing trigger?
answer_gold: No. Maraxus of Keld's ability is a characteristic-defining ability and applies in all zones. Tapping lands to cast a spell comes before the game checks to see if Sarkhan's Unsealing should trigger.

question: Ariel casts [Uncharted Voyage] and sees [Blood Operative] while surveilling. They choose to put it into the graveyard. Does it trigger to return to Ariel's hand?
answer_gold: Yes. Triggered abilities are checked to see if they triggered immediately after the given event has occurred. Blood Operative was in the graveyard immediately after the surveil, so it triggers.

question: Azaria attacks Nico with [Kaalia of the Vast]. As its trigger resolves, they put [Master of Cruelties] onto the battlefield. What happens?
answer_gold: Nico loses the game. The ability "Master of Cruelties can only attack alone." isn't relevant here- it's being put onto the battlefield already attacking. Even though it never attacked, its trigger of "Whenever Master of Cruelties attacks a player and isn't blocked" will still trigger. Nico's life total becomes 1, and then Kaalia of the Vast deals 2 damage to them.

question: Alyson casts [Harm's Way], choosing [Caldera Lake] as the source of damage and Nixon as the target. After it resolves, Alyson taps Caldera Lake for {R}. Is Nixon dealt 1 damage?
answer_gold: Yes. The damage is redirected to Nixon. It doesn't matter that it's coming from a source Alyson controls.

question: Aubrey controls [Traveling Philosopher] equipped with [Glaive of the Guildpact] and no Gates. Does it have vigilance and menace?
answer_gold: Yes. The only thing that Gates affect is how much Traveling Philosopher's power is increased.

question: Nico controls [Alms Collector] and [Nekusar, the Mindrazer]. Ariyah is beginning their draw step. Does Nico draw a card?
answer_gold: No. Alms Collector's replacement effect only applies to an opponent drawing two or more cards at a time. It does not apply to drawing a card as a turn-based action and then drawing one later as the result of Nekusar, the Mindrazer's triggered ability.

question: Abril controls [Underrealm Lich] and [The Gitrog Monster]. They cast [Weave Fate]. While resolving Weave Fate, all 4 cards that are put into Abril's graveyard are lands. How many times does The Gitrog Monster trigger?
answer_gold: Twice. The Gitrog Monster triggers when an event places one or more land cards are put into the graveyard, it doesn't matter how many. Each card draw for Weave Fate happens one at a time, so there are 2 instances of 2 land cards being put into the graveyard.

question: Arthur controls [Divine Visitation] and [Parallel Lives]. They cast [Mouth]. How many tokens are created, of what types?
answer_gold: Two 4/4 Angels are created. There are two replacement effects attempting to apply to the same event, so Arthur must choose one to apply first, and the other will be applied second. Once one effect has been applied to the event, it can't be applied again. Arthur can either double the tokens and then turn them into Angels or turn the token into an Angel and then double it, but the result is the same either way.

question: Adrien casts [Chaos Warp] targeting Nico's commander. Nico chooses to put it into the command zone instead of the library. Is Nico's library shuffled? Do them reveal the card of their library and put it onto the battlefield if it's a permanent card?
answer_gold:
Nico does shuffle their library.

Nico does reveal the top card. Chaos Warp doesn't care where the target moves to as it resolves, it simply instructs Nico to do so.

question: Amani controls [Leyline of the Void] and casts [Hypnotic Cloud] to have Nicolas discard a card. Nicolas discards [Loxodon Smiter]. Does it end up on the battlefield or in exile?
answer_gold: Whichever Nicolas prefers. There are two replacement effects applying to Loxodon Smiter going to the graveyard. Nicolas is the controller of the affected object, so they choose where it ends up.

question: Amani casts [Smallpox]. Can Nick discard [Loxodon Smiter] as their card to discard putting it onto the battlefield, then sacrifice it as their creature?
answer_gold: Yes. Spells resolve in the order they're written.

question: Ainsley attacks with [Chambered Nautilus]. Nyla declares no blocks and then casts [Dazzling Beauty] targeting Chambered Nautilus. Does Chambered Nautilus trigger?
answer_gold: Yes. "Blocked" in this context refers to the state of being a blocked creature. Chambered Nautilus went from being an unblocked creature to being a blocked creature, so it "became blocked".

question: Aubrey controls [Hazezon Tamar] and casts [Crib Swap] targeting Hazezon Tamar. Before it resolves, Natalia casts [Unlicensed Disintegration] targeting Hazezon Tamar. After everything has resolved, what zone is Crib Swap in?
answer_gold: The graveyard. "Exile all Sand Warriors" only refers to Sand Warriors on the battlefield.

question: Ariel activates [Warped Landscape]. Before that resolves Noe casts [Aven Mindcensor]. When Ariel is resolving Warped Landscape's ability, they find [Panglacial Wurm] in the top four cards of their library. Can they cast it?
answer_gold: Yes. Aven Mindcensor's ability is a replacement effect that replaces searching a library with searching only the top four cards of that library. However for the purposes of Panglacial Wurm's effect, it still qualifies as "searching a library".

question: Alexis controls [Muldrotha, the Gravetide], [Ashnod's Altar], and has a [Headless Horseman] in their graveyard. Alexis would like to sacrifice Muldrotha, the Gravetide to Ashnod's Altar to pay for Headless Horseman. Can they do this?
answer_gold: Yes. The game checks to see if casting the spell would be legal as part of putting it on the stack, and after all choices for the spell have been made. At both of these points Muldrotha, the Gravetide is still on the battlefield. A few steps later the game asks Alexis to activate mana abilities to pay for the spell, which is where Alexis will sacrifice Muldrotha, the Gravetide. The game doesn't re-check the legality of the spell afterwards.

question: Aspen controls [Mole Man, Moloid Master]. Can they cast [Zoetic Cavern] from their graveyard face down?
answer_gold: No, they can't. Morph does function in the graveyard, since Zoetic Cavern could be played from there. However, as the first step to determine if Zoetic Cavern can be cast for its morph cost, it is turned face down. A face-down Zoetic Cavern is a creature card, not a land card, so Mole Man, Moloid Master no longer gives Aspen permission to play it.

question: Nico controls [Yixlid Jailer]. Achilles uses [Past in Flames] to give [Deadly Complication] in their graveyard Flashback. Is Achilles able to cast Deadly Complication from their graveyard to destroy Yixlid Jailer?
answer_gold: Yes. Both Yixlid Jailer and Past in Flames are applying a continuous effect to Deadly Complication, and both are being applied in layer 6. Since there is no dependency between the two effects, they are applied in timestamp order; Yixlid Jailer removes all abilities from Deadly Complication, which is then given flashback by Past in Flames.

question: Addilynn controls [Hexplate Golem] and [Winding Constrictor]. Nicolas casts [Cannibalize] targeting them both. When it resolves, they choose to exile Winding Constrictor and to put +1/+1 counters on Hexplate Golem. How many +1/+1 counters are placed on Hexplate Golem?
answer_gold: 2. Spells resolve in the order printed on the card. Winding Constrictor is exiled before placing the counters on Hexplate Golem.

question: Nico controls [Ertai's Familiar]. Anabella casts [Dragonlord Silumgar] and takes control of Ertai's Familiar. During Anabella's next untap step Ertai's Familiar phases out. Nico then casts [Tidy Conclusion] targeting Dragonlord Silumgar. When does Ertai's Familiar phase in, and who will control it?
answer_gold: Ertai's Familiar will phase in during Anabella's next untap step, since they were the player who controlled it last. Since the duration on Dragonlord Silumgar's continuous effect that was giving Anabella control of Ertai's Familiar has expired, Anabella no longer has any reason to control Ertai's Familiar. It will phase in under Nico's control.

question: Avery casts [Beacon Bolt] targeting [Spined Karok] controlled by Nia. If Avery owns no other instant or sorcery cards in their graveyard or exile, how much damage will Beacon Bolt deal?
answer_gold: Zero. Beacon Bolt remains on the stack until it's finished resolving.

question: Aspen controls [Watchwolf] enchanted by [Lignify], [Figure of Destiny] that's had its third ability activated, and [Swab Goblin]. They casts [Pack's Favor] targeting Swab Goblin. After that resolves, they casts [Mirrorweave] targeting Figure of Destiny. What are the characteristics of Swab Goblin and Watchwolf?
answer_gold:
Watchwolf is a 0/4 Treefolk with no abilities. Swab Goblin is a 4/4 Kithikin with Figure of Destiny's printed abilities (not flying or first strike).

Mirrorweave confers Figure of Destiny's copiable values to the other cards. This doesn't include the type and text-changing effects that are currently applying to it. Watchwolf will become a 1/1 in layer 1 but then will have its power and toughness changed in layer 7. Swab Goblin is in a similar situation, copy effects will be applied in layer 1. Pack's Favor will be applied later in layer 7c.

question: Allison controls [Dralnu's Crusade] and [Leopard-Spotted Jiao]. Allison then casts [Conspiracy] naming "Goblin". What are the creature types of Leopard-Spotted Jiao and does it get +1/+1?
answer_gold: Leopard-Spotted Jiao is a black Goblin Zombie in addition to its other types and does get +1/+1. Dralnu's Crusade is dependent on Conspiracy, because applying Conspiracy first changes the set of permanents Dralnu's Crusade would apply to. Because of this, Conspiracy's effect is applied first, and then Dralnu's Crusade's effect.

question: Nick casts [Lightning Bolt] targeting Aspen, who is at 2 life. Before it resolves, Aspen casts [Selfless Squire], and then [Angel's Grace]. What happens when Lightning Bolt resolves?
answer_gold:
Selfless Squire prevents the damage and triggers. Angel's Grace never applies, since the damage was never dealt. Aspen remains at 2 life and Selfless Squire gets +1/+1 counters equal to the damage prevented.

(Angel's Grace's effect is not a prevention effect, it's a replacement effect that modifies how the damage is dealt.)

question: Ashley controls [Maelstrom Nexus] and evokes [Wavesifter]. They begin to reveal cards from the top of their library and reveals [Atraxa, Praetors' Voice]. Can they cast it?
answer_gold: Yes. Cascade exiles cards until it exiles a nonland card with a lesser mana value than the spell with cascade. Casting a spell with evoke follows the same rules for casting spells with alternative costs, which don't change the mana value of the spell.

question: Ainsley controls [Amulet of Vigor] and plays [Rupture Spire]. Can they pay for the trigger with Rupture Spire?
answer_gold: Yes. When Ainsley plays Rupture Spire, it and Amulet of Vigor both trigger simultaneously. Ainsley can choose the order these go on the stack and have Rupture Spire untap before they is required to pay for Rupture Spire's ability.

question: Nicole controls [Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite]. Aubrey controls two [Tablet of Discovery]s and casts [Arcbound Ravager]. Can they sacrifice the Tablet of Discoverys to Arcbound Ravager to keep it alive?
answer_gold: No. Elesh Norn, Grand Cenobite has a static ability that gives all of Aubrey's creatures -2/-2. This ability functions at all times, Arcbound Ravager enters the battlefield as a-1/-1, and before Aubrey has a chance to do anything the game will check state-based actions and it'll die.

question: Autumn controls a [Phantom Beast]. Autumn casts [Wispweaver Angel]. Will Phantom Beast be sacrificed?
answer_gold: Yes. Wispweaver Angel's ability goes on the stack when it enters the battlefield, and part of putting the ability on the stack involves choosing legal targets for the ability. Even if Autumn has no intention of exiling Phantom Beast, they don't make that decision until the ability starts resolving.

question: Aislinn controls two [Bramblewood Paragon]s and casts [Thunder-Thrash Elder]. What is the maximum amount of counters Thunder-Thrash Elder can enter the battlefield with?
answer_gold: Eight. Both Bramblewood Paragon and Thunder-Thrash Elder have replacement effects that modify how Thunder-Thrash Elder enters the battlefield. While Thunder-Thrash Elder is entering the battlefield the game checks which replacement effects to apply, and sees that there are two Bramblewood Paragons that want to place an additional +1/+1 counter on Thunder-Thrash Elder as well as a Devour ability. If Aislinn chooses to devour the Bramblewood Paragons, they will place an additional six +1/+1 counters on Thunder-Thrash Elder.

question: Ainsley casts [Hymn of Rebirth] targeting Catherine's [Whiptail Wurm] in their graveyard and passes the turn. On Beckham's turn they cast [Annihilating Fire] targeting Catherine, reducing them to 0 life. What will happen to Whiptail Wurm when Catherine dies?
answer_gold: Whiptail Wurm will leave the game. When Catherine loses the game all cards owned by them will leave the game, even if they are controlled by another player.

question: Adrien uses [Geth, Lord of the Vault] to bring back [Highborn Vampire] from Breanna's graveyard. Carroll then takes control of Highborn Vampire using [Traitorous Greed]. If Adrien loses the game while Carroll controls Highborn Vampire, what happens to it?
answer_gold: Nothing happens to it immediately. When Traitorous Greed's effect ends and Highborn Vampire tries to return to Adrien's control, it will be exiled.

question: Aylin controls [Teferi, Mage of Zhalfir]. Can they play [Dryad Arbor] during Nico's turn?
answer_gold: No. Even though Dryad Arbor has flash, lands can't be played during another player's turn. (The second rule takes precedence over the definition of flash due to [101.2].)

question: Averi controls a [Stratus Dancer] with a +1/+1 counter on it. Averi casts [Collected Company] and chooses to put two [Avatar of the Resolute] onto the battlefield. How many counters will each Avatar of the Resolute enter the battlefield with?
answer_gold: Each Avatar of the Resolute will enter with one +1/+1 counter. The Avatar of the Resolutes are entering the battlefield simultaneously, and Avatar of the Resolute's replacement effect does not take into account other permanents entering at the same time.

question: Anderson controls [Omniscience]. Without paying any mana, can they cast [Ertai's Meddling] targeting [Mox Diamond]?
answer_gold: No. When casting a spell without paying its mana cost, X must be 0. Since 0 isn't a legal choice for Ertai's Meddling, it can't be cast this way.

question: Nathanael controls [Worms of the Earth], and Ariel has [Heart of Yavimaya] in their graveyard. Ariel uses [Profound Journey] to attempt to return Heart of Yavimaya to the battlefield. What happens?
answer_gold: Nothing. Worms of the Earth says that lands can't enter the battlefield, so Heart of Yavimaya's replacement effect will never apply.

question: Ainsley controls [Kalonian Tusker]. Ainsley casts [Heat Shimmer], copying Kalonian Tusker. After that resolves, Ainsley casts [Horncaller's Chant] choosing to populate the token created by Heat Shimmer. Will the token created by Horncaller's Chant be exiled at the beginning of the next end step?
answer_gold: Yes. Heat Shimmer creates a token that's a copy of Kalonian Tusker except it has haste and "At the beginning of the end step, exile this permanent." These are part of the copiable values of the token, and therefore when the token is copied, it will also have those abilities.

question: Ari casts [Runed Halo]. Can they name the Bird tokens created by Nickolas's [Gwaihir, Greatest of the Eagles]?
answer_gold: No. The token's name is "Bird Token", which is not a card name.

question: Alex controls [Sliver Construct] which is enchanted with [Spirit Shackle] and has a +0/+2 counter on it. Alex attacks with Sliver Construct. After the combat phase has ended, what counters are on Sliver Construct?
answer_gold: A +0/+2 counter and a -0/-2 counter. The rule that causes +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters to cancel out only refers to those specific types of counters and not any other type of counter.

question: Ari attacks with [Suntail Hawk]. Nayeli casts [Vault Skyward] to give [Brimaz, King of Oreskos] flying until end of turn and blocks Suntail Hawk. Will the token created by Brimaz, King of Oreskos also be blocking Suntail Hawk?
answer_gold: Yes. The only time the game checks to see if the declaration of blockers is illegal is as Nayeli declares blockers. A creature that's put onto the battlefield blocking isn't declared as a blocker and isn't affected by requirements or restrictions that normally alter what a player is allowed to declare as a blocker.

question: Alex activates [Mindslaver] targeting Beatrice. After that resolves, Cannon activates Mindslaver also targeting Beatrice. When Alex passes their turn, who will control Beatrice's turn?
answer_gold: Cannon will control Beatrice's turn. Cannon's player-controlling effect resolved most recently, and overwrites the player-controlling effect created by Alex.

question: Avery controls [Rest in Peace] and [Fresh Volunteers]. They cast [Hour of Revelation]. After that resolves, where will each card be?
answer_gold: Rest in Peace and Fresh Volunteers will be in exile and Hour of Revelation will be in the graveyard. Rest in Peace is creating a replacement effect that causes cards that would go to the graveyard to be put into exile instead. After Hour of Revelation has destroyed Rest in Peace, Hour of Revelation is put into the graveyard.

question: Abdullah controls [Doubling Season] and activates the +2 ability of [Ajani, Wise Counselor]. How many loyalty counters are put on Ajani, Wise Counselor?
answer_gold: Just 2 loyalty counters. Doubling Season only cares about counters being placed by effects, not costs. Since the counters put on Ajani, Wise Counselor are part of its activation cost, Doubling Season will not affect them.

question: Alaina has seven cards in their hand and controls [Recycle]. They cast [Trusted Advisor]. After that resolves, what is Alaina's maximum hand size?
answer_gold: Four. Recycle sets the maximum hand size to two, and Trusted Advisor then modifies that maximum hand size by adding two to it.

question: Aryan splice [Evermind] onto [Barrel Down Sokenzan]. Can they target [Phyrexian Crusader] with the spliced spell?
answer_gold: No. Evermind has a color indicator that makes it blue, and that will not be spliced onto Barrel Down Sokenzan because it's not a part of its text box.

question: Ashley controls [Firesong and Sunspeaker] and casts [Aurelia's Fury] targeting Nash's four [Ferocious Zheng]s with one damage each. How many times will Firesong and Sunspeaker's second ability trigger?
answer_gold: Firesong and Sunspeaker will trigger once. Firesong and Sunspeaker grants Aurelia's Fury lifelink, which will cause Ashley to gain 4 life when it resolves. However this happens simultaneously and is all derived from the same source (Aurelia's Fury). Therefore it will only trigger Firesong and Sunspeaker once.

question: Axton controls [Wild Cantor] and cast [Selfless Safewright]. Can Axton tap Wild Cantor for convoke in addition to sacrificing it for mana to cast Selfless Safewright?
answer_gold: No. Mana abilities must be activated before the costs for the spell are paid, which is where Wild Cantor must be tapped for convoke.

question: Andi and Nico are in a subgame created by [Shahrazad]. Andi is at 3 life and controls [Tolarian Drake] that is currently phased out. Nico casts [Ember Shot] targeting Andi. When the subgame ends, what happens to Tolarian Drake?
answer_gold: It gets shuffled back into the main game library.

question: Apollo has [Venser's Sliver] and [Body Double] in their graveyard. Apollo casts [Rise of the Dark Realms], can they have Body Double enter the battlefield as a copy of Venser's Sliver?
answer_gold: Yes. Body Double has a replacement effect that modifies how it enters the battlefield. The game checks for any replacement effects that modify how an object will enter the battlefield before the object has changed zones. Therefore while Apollo is choosing a creature for Body Double to copy, both it and Venser's Sliver are still in their graveyard, making Venser's Sliver a legal choice for the ability.

question: Avah controls [Rest in Peace] and [Grenzo, Dungeon Warden]. What will happen if they activate Grenzo, Dungeon Warden and the bottom card of their library is [Shorecomber Crab]?
answer_gold: Shorecomber Crab will be put into exile and then onto the battlefield. Grenzo, Dungeon Warden doesn't care whether Shorecomber Crab actually went to the graveyard, it only cares that its power is less than two. If it is, it takes it from whatever zone it moved to.

question: Alexandra controls [Riot Devils] enchanted with [Black Ward]. Nikolai controls [Teysa, Envoy of Ghosts]. Alexandra attacks with Riot Devils and it isn't blocked. After combat damage has been dealt, does Teysa, Envoy of Ghosts's ability trigger and destroy Riot Devils?
answer_gold: Yes. After combat damage has been dealt Teysa, Envoy of Ghosts's ability triggers, and when it resolves it will destroy Riot Devils. The protection granted by Black Ward doesn't prevent destruction. Protection means that the permanent can't be damaged, targeted, enchanted, or blocked by anything with the quality protection refers to.

question: Addison controls [Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet] and [Anafenza, the Foremost]. Addison casts [Unholy Hunger] targeting Niko's [Regathan Firecat]. What will happen to Regathan Firecat after Unholy Hunger resolves?
answer_gold:
Regathan Firecat will be exiled and Niko chooses whether Addison creates a Zombie token.

Both Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet and Anafenza, the Foremost are attempting to apply a replacement effect to the same event (Regathan Firecat dying). In these scenarios, the controller of the affected permanent chooses which one will apply first. Niko therefore chooses whether to apply Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet or Anafenza, the Foremost first, after which the other effect no longer applies.

question: Ariel controls [Chains of Mephistopheles] and has [Necroplasm] in their graveyard, and has one card in their hand. During their first main phase they cast [Concentrate]. What will happen when Concentrate resolves?
answer_gold: Chains of Mephistopheles is creating a replacement effect that applies to the draw from Concentrate. However Necroplasm also has a replacement effect that Ariel can choose to apply to the draw. If they chooses to replace the draw with Necroplasm, Chains of Mephistopheles will not do anything. However if they chooses not to dredge, then Ariel must discard a card to Chains of Mephistopheles. Afterwards they can replace the draw from Chains of Mephistopheles by dredging. Ariel will then repeat this process for each subsequent draw from Concentrate.

question: Avianna controls two [Chains of Mephistopheles] and casts [Resupply] during their first main phase with seven cards in hand. What happens as Avianna begins to draw a card?
answer_gold:
As Avianna resolves Resupply and attempts to draw a card, they choose which replacement effect to apply first. 

Drawing a card is replaced with discarding a card and then drawing a card. The second Chains of Mephistopheles will then replace that card draw with also discarding a card and then drawing a card. The first Chains of Mephistopheles will not replace this draw since it has already modified this event and will not continue to invoke itself on the same event.

question: Adrien controls [Possessed Portal] and [Tomorrow, Azami's Familiar]. What happens during Adrien's draw step?
answer_gold: During Adrien's draw step, they will choose which replacement effect to apply to their draw. If they choose to apply Possessed Portal they won't draw a card. If they choose to apply Tomorrow, Azami's Familiar they'll follow the instructions on Tomorrow, Azami's Familiar.

question: Alexis controls [Hardened Scales] and [Master Biomancer], and they cast [Arcbound Mouser]. How many counters does it enter the battlefield with?
answer_gold: Four. All three cards have replacement effects. As Arcbound Mouser enters the battlefield the game will check to see if any of them are applying to it, which they are; it's getting a +1/+1 counter from its own effect and is also getting two +1/+1 counters from Master Biomancer. This results in counters being placed on Arcbound Mouser therefore Hardened Scales also applies and adds another +1/+1 counter. Alexis can apply the replacement effects in any order, but each one will only apply once, and the outcome is the same either way.

question: Nico casts [Assert Authority] targeting Ainsley's [Blightsteel Colossus]. What happens as Assert Authority resolves?
answer_gold: Blightsteel Colossus will be countered and exiled. Because Assert Authority has a self-replacement effect, it has to be chosen first before Blightsteel Colossus's replacement effect. Because Blightsteel Colossus is no longer going to the graveyard, its replacement effect can no longer apply.

question: Alia has [Dearly Departed] and [Femeref Scouts] in their graveyard. Alia then casts [Ever After] to return both Dearly Departed and Femeref Scouts from the graveyard to the battlefield. Will Femeref Scouts enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it?
answer_gold: Yes. The game checks to see what replacement effects apply before the creatures have changed zones, at which point both Dearly Departed and Femeref Scouts are still in the graveyard. Therefore the game will see the replacement effect that Dearly Departed generates that will apply to Femeref Scouts and grant it a +1/+1 counter.

question: Aubrey and Niko are playing a subgame as part of resolving [Shahrazad] and each have 10 life. Aubrey casts [Squall Line] with X=10. Which player loses half of their life in the main game?
answer_gold: Both of them. Both players simultaneously lost the game, which results in a draw. Neither player won the game, and therefore both players are players who "didn't win the subgame".

question: Aubrey controls [Whiskervale Forerunner] and casts [Growth Cycle] to give it +3/+3. Before it resolves, Aubrey casts [Cooperate] choosing to copy Growth Cycle and changes the target to another creature. Does Whiskervale Forerunner trigger again?
answer_gold: No. When copying spells that allow the copies controller to change the target, the targets are changed before the spell is put onto the stack. There is never a point in time where the spell is targeting Whiskervale Forerunner before the targets are changed.

question: Avery casts [Brainstorm] using the ability of [Wrexial, the Risen Deep]. Nickolas casts [Spell Crumple] and counters Brainstorm. Where does Brainstorm go?
answer_gold:
Avery's library.

Two replacement effects are trying to replace the same event. Since Spell Crumple's effect is a self-replacement effect, it applies first. Once it's applied, Brainstorm is moving to the library and Wrexial, the Risen Deep's effect no longer applies.

question: Abigail casts [Ancient Stirrings]. Can they reveal a [Dryad Arbor] to put into their hand?
answer_gold: No. Dryad Arbor is green.

question: Aspen, Brycen, and Collins begin a multiplayer game. In Aspen's upkeep, they use [Leyline of Anticipation], several [Simian Spirit Guide]s and [Desperate Ritual]s, and [Goblin Charbelcher] to kill Brycen. Does Aspen draw a card for the turn?
answer_gold: Yes. The game began with more than 2 players, so it is a multiplayer game, regardless of the current number of players remaining.. Aspen will draw a card during their draw step.

question: Alexandria, Brett, and Clay started playing a multiplayer game. Clay lost the game, and then Alexandria cast [Shahrazad]. Will Clay be in the subgame?
answer_gold: No. Only the players in the game when the subgame began are a part of the subgame.

question: Ayaan, Bailey, and Charli started playing a multiplayer game. Charli lost the game, and then Ayaan cast [Shahrazad]. Will Ayaan draw a card on the first turn of the subgame?
answer_gold: No. The game began with 2 players, so it is a two-player game.. Ayaan will skip their draw step.

question: Addison, Brixton, and Collins started playing a multiplayer game. Collins lost the game, and then Addison restarted the game with [Karn Liberated]. Will Addison draw a card on the first turn of the restarted game?
answer_gold: No. The game began with 2 players, so it is a two-player game.. Addison will skip their draw step.

question: Avery casts [Slum Reaper]. Does Nathan know which creature Avery is sacrificing when making their choice?
answer_gold: Yes. If multiple players must make choices at the same time, the choices are made in turn order, starting with the active player.

question: Ashlyn controls no creatures and casts [Slum Reaper]. Nico controls no creatures. What happens as the trigger resolves?
answer_gold: Ashlyn must sacrifice Slum Reaper.

question: Aniyah casts [Martyrdom], targeting their [Douser of Lights]. After it resolves, Nico takes control of Douser of Lights with [Act of Aggression]. Can Nico activate the ability it gained from Martyrdom?
answer_gold: Yes. "Only you may activate this ability." is an activation instruction for the ability, and it is part of the ability gained by the Douser of Lights. "You" therefore refers to the permanent's current controller.

question: In a two-player game, Ally casts [Rushblade Commander]. Can they attack with it this turn?
answer_gold: Yes. In a two-player game, "your team" means "you".

question: Ariella casts [Shahrazad]. As the subgame begins, Ariella wins the die roll. Can Ariella choose to play second?
answer_gold: No. The starting player in a subgame is determined randomly.

question: Addison and Neil are beginning a two-player game. Addison wins the die roll. Can Addison choose to play second?
answer_gold: Yes.

question: Aubrey and Nathaniel are starting a two-player game. Aubrey is going first and has [Serum Powder] in their starting hand, which they would like to use. Do they have to declare that they're using it before Nathaniel chooses whether to mulligan?
answer_gold: Yes. Serum Powder's ability must be declared at the same time as Aubrey would declare if they are mulliganing. Aubrey must announce that decision before Nathaniel does.

question: Ari and Neymar are starting a game. Neymar puts a [Leyline of the Meek] onto the battlefield. Can Ari now choose to put a [Leyline of the Void] onto the battlefield?
answer_gold: No. Each player, in turn order, gets one chance to take any opening hand actions they would like to take. After the second player in turn order has made their choice, the first player does not get another opportunity.

question: Ameer has restarted the game with a [Karn Liberated] that exiled [Architect of the Untamed]. Ameer chooses to begin the restarted game with a [Gemstone Caverns] on the battlefield. Does Architect of the Untamed trigger?
answer_gold:
This can't happen as described. Ameer is taking the first turn, so they can't use Gemstone Caverns's ability.

(If it were Nico instead, the answer would be no. Cards exiled with Karn are put onto the battlefield after opening hand actions have already been taken.)

question: Ashley has restarted the game with a [Karn Liberated] that exiled an [Ajani's Chosen]. Ashley chooses to begin the restarted game with a [Leyline of Anticipation] on the battlefield. Does Ajani's Chosen trigger?
answer_gold: No. Leyline of Anticipation is put onto the battlefield before the Ajani's Chosen is.

question: Alisson controls [Quickening Licid], [March of the Machines], and [Mycosynth Lattice] that entered the battlefield in that order. They activate Quickening Licid's ability targeting itself. What happens?
