answer_gold: Quickening Licid becomes an Aura enchantment with enchant creature. It cannot become attached to itself because it is no longer a creature. When state-based actions are checked, it will be put into the graveyard.

question: Nehemiah controls a [Skullbriar, the Walking Grave] with 2 +1/+1 counters on it. Ari casts [Bishop of Binding], exiling the Skullbriar, the Walking Grave. When Ari attacks with Bishop of Binding on their next turn, what will X equal in Bishop of Binding's triggered ability?
answer_gold: 3. +1/+1 counters on cards in exile do affect their power and toughness. X is determined only once, as the effect begins to apply, so it does take into account the final power of the exiled card.

question: Nico controls [Grafdigger's Cage] and has a [Barbary Apes] in their graveyard. Ariel casts [Ghastly Conscription], targeting Nico. What happens to the Barbary Apes?
answer_gold: It is exiled face down, then manifested onto the battlefield. Grafdigger's Cage only prevents creature cards entering the battlefield from graveyards or libraries, not from exile.

question: Nico has a [Pillarfield Ox] and a [Skullbriar, the Walking Grave] with 3 +1/+1 counters in their graveyard. Arjun casts [Ghastly Conscription], targeting Nico. What happens to the counters on the Skullbriar, the Walking Grave? Will Nico know which manifested card is which?
answer_gold: When in the graveyard, Skullbriar, the Walking Grave had the ability that allowed it to keep its counters, so it is exiled and shuffled with 3 +1/+1 counters. When it's moved to the battlefield, it's face down and no longer has that ability, so the counters cease to exist. It had the counters immediately before entering the battlefield however, so Nico will know which face-down permanent is the Skullbriar, the Walking Grave and which is the Pillarfield Ox.

question: Neriah controls a [Containment Priest] and has a [Knotvine Mystic] in their graveyard. Alan casts [Ghastly Conscription], targeting Neriah. What happens to the Knotvine Mystic?
answer_gold: Rather than entering the battlefield, it is exiled. It was turned face down before it was put onto the battlefield, but it then becomes a new object with no relation to its previous existence. It will remain in exile face up.

question: Niko has a [Skullbriar, the Walking Grave] in their graveyard with 2 +1/+1 counters on it. Ashley controls [Containment Priest], and casts [Ghastly Conscription], targeting Niko. What happens?
answer_gold: In order for counters to remain on Skullbriar, the Walking Grave, it needs to have that ability immediately before it changes zones. It did have that ability in the graveyard, so it is exiled face down with the +1/+1 counters remaining on it during that change. It then attempts to enter the battlefield, but remains in exile instead due to Containment Priest. Since it becomes a new object, it will be face-up in exile. However it didn't change zones, so the counters will remain on it in exile.

question: Nico controls [Fathom Feeder] and 3 [Spined Wurm]s. Arthur casts [Alpha Brawl], targeting Fathom Feeder. Which creatures survive?
answer_gold: None of them. Fathom Feeder has deathtouch, and so kills all of the Spined Wurms. The Spined Wurms deal enough damage to the Fathom Feeder that it dies as well.

question: Aubrey controls a [Rotted Hystrix]. They cast [Artful Dodge], targeting the Rotted Hystrix. After it resolves, can they flash it back, again targeting the Rotted Hystrix?
answer_gold: Yes. The only restriction on what Artful Dodge targets is that it must be a creature. It doesn't matter if the spell resolving wouldn't do anything useful.

question: Avalynn controls a [Trusty Machete] and a [Goblin Cavaliers]. Nixon controls a [Null Rod]. Can Avalynn equip their Trusty Machete to their Goblin Cavaliers?
answer_gold: No. Equip is an activated ability.

question: Nehemiah controls [Yixlid Jailer] and has [Oran-Rief Invoker] in their graveyard. Angelique controls [Havengul Lich] and activates its ability targeting the Oran-Rief Invoker. Can Angelique cast the Oran-Rief Invoker? If they can and do, can they activate the ability on Havengul Lich that it gained from the Oran-Rief Invoker?
answer_gold: Havengul Lich doesn't give Oran-Rief Invoker an ability, it just allows it to be cast, so Angelique may do so. If they do, Havengul Lich will not gain any abilities. Havengul Lich's ability is referring to the card in the graveyard. By the time the game checks if it has any abilities, the card is on the stack and not in the graveyard, so the game uses its last known information. The Oran-Rief Invoker in the graveyard had no abilities, so Havengul Lich has nothing to gain.

question: Anabella controls a [Beguiler of Wills] and 2 [Dakmor Scorpion]. They activate it targeting Nicholas's [Southern Elephant]. In response, Nicholas casts [Swat], targeting the Beguiler of Wills. What happens to Beguiler of Wills's ability?
answer_gold: The ability on the stack is unaffected by the removal of Beguiler of Wills. However when it begins to resolve, the target is no longer legal. (Anabella only controls 2 creatures.) It is removed from the stack and has no effect.

question: Addison casts [Past in Flames]. Does Nathalie have an opportunity to exile it from Addison's graveyard with [Fade from Memory] before Addison can flash it back?
answer_gold: No. The Addison receives priority first after the Past in Flames resolves, and can cast it from the graveyard at that time. Nathalie doesn't get a chance to cast the Fade from Memory until they receives priority afterwards.

question: Alex has a creature card in their graveyard and activates [Moorland Haunt]. In response, Nasir activates [Crook of Condemnation] to exile all cards in Alex's graveyard. Will Alex create a Spirit token?
answer_gold: Yes. The creature card is exiled from Alex's graveyard as a cost to activate Moorland Haunt, and is already in exile when the Crook of Condemnation is activated. The Moorland Haunt's ability will still resolve normally.

question: Nico controls a [Withengar Unbound] (the front face of which is [Elbrus, the Binding Blade]). Allie casts [Assassin's Strike] targeting the Withengar Unbound. In response, Nico casts [Undying Evil] targeting the Withengar Unbound. What happens to the Withengar Unbound?
answer_gold: It dies and then returns to the battlefield on its front face with a +1/+1 counter on it.

question: Ainsley activates [Sorin, Lord of Innistrad]'s third ability, targeting Nathaniel's [Relentless Dead]. What happens to it?
answer_gold: Sorin, Lord of Innistrad's ability resolves fully before any triggers are put onto the stack. Relentless Dead will enter the battlefield under Ainsley's control. When its trigger resolves, Relentless Dead is no longer in the graveyard, so nothing happens.

question: Anakin activates [Golden Guardian]'s ability, targeting [Dralnu, Lich Lord]. As the ability resolves and Dralnu, Lich Lord would be dealt 4 damage, they choose to sacrifice the Golden Guardian and 3 other permanents instead. Will the Golden Guardian return to the battlefield?
answer_gold: No. Spells and abilities carry out their instructions in the order written, so the fight occurs first, then the delayed trigger to return it to the battlefield is created. Normally Golden Guardian would die as state-based actions were checked after the ability finished resolving, so the trigger to return it to the battlefield would already be in existence. However since Dralnu, Lich Lord replaces the damage with sacrificing permanents, Golden Guardian dies as the fight occurs. The delayed triggered ability to return it to the battlefield is only created after the Golden Guardian has already died, so it will never have a chance to trigger.

question: Alex controls an [Archdemon of Greed] and no other creatures. During their upkeep, they cast [Carrion], sacrificing the Archdemon of Greed. What happens as its triggered ability resolves?
answer_gold: Alex can't sacrifice a Human, so Archdemon of Greed deals 9 damage to them. (It can deal damage even though it's no longer on the battlefield.)

question: Ariel casts [Mask of the Mimic], targeting an [Illusion] creature token created by [Meloku the Clouded Mirror]. Can Ariel find the Illusion half of the split card [Illusion // Reality]? If so, what happens?
answer_gold: This can't happen as described. Mask of the Mimic can only target nontoken creatures.

question: Annabella attacks with a [Nightveil Specter] and exiles a [Gore Swine] as its trigger resolves. Still during combat, Nicolas casts [Terminate] targeting the Nightveil Specter. In their postcombat main phase, Annabella casts [Fearsome Awakening] to return the Nightveil Specter back to the battlefield. Can Annabella cast the Gore Swine?
answer_gold: No. "Cards exiled with Nightveil Specter" just refers to cards exiled with that specific Nightveil Specter, not any Nightveil Specter. When Nightveil Specter dies and returns to the battlefield, it becomes a new object with no relation to its previous existence.

question: Aaron controls a [Havengul Lich] and has a [Kozilek's Translator] in their graveyard. They activate the ability of Havengul Lich twice, targeting the Kozilek's Translator both times. After Aaron casts the Kozilek's Translator, how much {C} could they add?
answer_gold: 3. Each time Havengul Lich's activated ability resolves, it creates a delayed trigger that gives it the abilities of the card that was cast. Since 2 of those triggers resolved, Havengul Lich gains 2 instances of those abilities. Each of them can be activated once this turn. The ability of the Kozilek's Translator can also be activated once, for {C}{C}{C} in total.

question: Atticus controls a [Skinshifter] and activates it to turn it into a 4/4 with trample. After that resolves, can they turn it into a 2/2 with flying?
answer_gold: No. Skinshifter's ability is modal, but it is still one ability. Atticus can't activate that ability more than once per turn, regardless of which mode was chosen.

question:
Adelaide controls [Forbidden Orchard]. Nicolas controls [Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth]. Adelaide activates the ability that 
Forbidden Orchard gained from Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth to add {B}. Does Nicolas create a Spirit token?
answer_gold: Yes. Forbidden Orchard has a trigger that triggers whenever it's tapped for mana. It doesn't matter which ability was activated.

question: Avery controls [Mana Reflection] and [Deathrite Shaman]. They activate Deathrite Shaman's first ability, exiling a [Havenwood Battleground] from Nolan's graveyard. How much mana is produced?
answer_gold: Just 1. Deathrite Shaman's ability is not a mana ability, and activating it is not "tapping it for mana".

question: Ari controls a [Sakashima the Impostor] that is a copy of a [Loyal Cathar]. It dies. What happens?
answer_gold: Sakashima the Impostor isn't a transforming double-faced card, so it can't enter the battlefield transformed. It remains in the graveyard.

question: Ariel attacks with a [Wicker Witch]. Nelson blocks it with a 1/1 white Spirit creature token, then casts [Acrobatic Maneuver], targeting the Spirit token. What happens?
answer_gold: The token is exiled, but does not return to the battlefield. Wicker Witch remains blocked, and does not deal any damage to Nelson.

question: Alex controls a [Phantasmal Image] that's a copy of [Elvish Warrior]. There are no creatures other than Phantasmal Image on the battlefield. Alex casts [Wispweaver Angel]. Do they have to sacrifice Phantasmal Image?
answer_gold: Yes. Choices such as "you may do [thing]" are made upon resolution. Alex still has to choose a legal target for Wispweaver Angel's triggered ability and put it onto the stack.

question: Allison controls [Parallel Lives] and casts [Call the Skybreaker]. In response, Nicolas casts [Gather Specimens]. Who creates how many tokens?
answer_gold: Nicolas creates 2 tokens. There are two replacement effects trying to apply to the same event. Parallel Lives is trying to apply to the creation of the tokens, while Gather Specimens is trying to apply to them entering the battlefield. Entering the battlefield is a part of creating the tokens, so Parallel Lives's effect must be applied first, followed by Gather Specimens.

question: Nyla controls [Rest in Peace]. Aubrey casts [Predict] targeting themselves and names "[Snow-Covered Plains]" when Predict resolves. They reveal Snow-Covered Plains from the top of their library and puts it into exile. How many cards does Aubrey draw from Predict?
answer_gold: 2. Predict doesn't care whether the revealed card went to the graveyard or not, only that it was what Aubrey named.

question: Nancy controls [Anointed Procession]. Aden casts [Giantbaiting]. In response, Nancy casts [Crafty Cutpurse]. Who creates how many tokens?
answer_gold: Nancy creates 2 tokens. After the effect from Crafty Cutpurse is applied, Anointed Procession's effect becomes applicable as well.

question: Nicole controls a [Doubling Season]. Aspen casts [Chatter of the Squirrel]. In response, Nicole casts [Gather Specimens]. Who creates how many tokens?
answer_gold: Nicole creates 2 tokens. At first there is no effect that modifies how the tokens are created, so the effect from Gather Specimens that modifies how they enter the battlefield is applied. Now that they are entering under Nicole's control, Doubling Season's effect becomes applicable and modifies how they are created. It doesn't matter that Doubling Season applies to the creation of the tokens while Gather Specimens applies to them entering the battlefield- it's still the same event.

question: Amira casts [Tidal Wave]. In response, Nico casts [Gather Specimens]. In response, Amira casts [Crafty Cutpurse]. Who gets the token?
answer_gold: Amira does. There is only one replacement effect applying to the original event, (Gather Specimens's) so it's applied. That causes Crafty Cutpurse's effect to become applicable, and the token goes back to being created under Amira's control. Gather Specimens won't apply again. It doesn't matter that Crafty Cutpurse applies to the creation of the tokens while Crafty Cutpurse applies to them entering the battlefield- it's still the same event.

question: Anya controls [Primal Vigor] and a [Progenitor Mimic] with a +1/+1 counter. They cast [Stolen Identity] targeting the Progenitor Mimic to create two tokens. Can Anya choose a different creature for each token to copy, or must each token copy the same creature?
answer_gold: Each token may copy something different. There are two replacement effects trying to apply to the original event of creating a Progenitor Mimic: Progenitor Mimic's own effect and Primal Vigor's effect. Progenitor Mimic's effect applies to it entering the battlefield however, while Primal Vigor's effect applies to it being created, so Primal Vigor's effect must be applied first. After that is applied the original Progenitor Mimic's effect doesn't exist anymore, but each of the new Progenitor Mimics entering the battlefield has its own copy effect, which can now be applied individually.

question: Aspen controls [Parallel Lives] and a [Caldera Hellion]. They cast [Rite of Replication] targeting the Caldera Hellion. Can Aspen apply the devour replacement effect before the Parallel Lives replacement effect, sacrificing 1 creature to have each token enter with a +1/+1 counter?
answer_gold: No. There are two replacement effects trying to apply to the original event of creating a Caldera Hellion: Caldera Hellion's own effect and Parallel Lives's effect. Caldera Hellion's effect applies to it entering the battlefield however, while Parallel Lives's effect applies to it being created, so Parallel Lives's effect must be applied first. After that is applied the original Caldera Hellion's effect doesn't exist anymore, but each of the new Caldera Hellions entering the battlefield has its own effect, which can now be applied individually.

question: Ainsley and Nataly each control a [Dromoka Warrior]. Ainsley casts [Unnatural Aggression] and targets both Dromoka Warriors. In response, Nataly casts [Carbonize] targeting Ainsley's Dromoka Warrior. What happens as the Unnatural Aggression attempts to resolve?
answer_gold: Unnatural Aggression still has at least one legal target, so it will resolve. However there is nothing for the remaining Dromoka Warrior to fight, so nothing happens.

question: Aydin casts [Crystalline Crawler], paying {W}{U}{G} as the colored mana in its total cost. Aydin then casts a [Clone], paying {U}{R} as the colored mana in its cost and chooses to copy the Crystalline Crawler as it resolves. How many +1/+1 counters does it enter the battlefield with?
answer_gold: 2. Clone's copy effect copies only the base characteristics of the Crystalline Crawler, not any counters on it or the colors of mana spent to cast it. Crystalline Crawler's ability cares about the colors of mana spent to cast that card, regardless of whether it changed name.

question: Alvaro casts [Foe-Razer Regent], and chooses to target [Tolarian Scholar] with its triggered ability upon entering the battlefield. Before that ability resolves, Naomi casts [Primal Boost] targeting Tolarian Scholar. Does Foe-Razer Regent die as its ability resolves?
answer_gold: Only if Alvaro chooses to have it fight. Only the target is chosen when the ability is put onto the stack, the choice of whether to fight is made as the ability resolves.

question: Apollo casts [Barrier of Bones], and while surveilling, puts a [Blood Operative] from their library into their graveyard. Can they pay 3 life to return the Blood Operative to their hand?
answer_gold: Yes. Triggered abilities are checked to see if they trigger immediately after the event in question. At that time, Blood Operative is in the graveyard. ([603.10]

question: Aspen controls an [Ajani's Pridemate] and attacks with 2 [Rhox War Monk]s. How many times will Ajani's Pridemate trigger as damage is dealt?
answer_gold: Twice. While there was only 1 damage event, Ajani's Pridemate's trigger treats it as two lifegain events.

question: Aubrey controls [Grand Arbiter Augustin IV] and wants to cast [Beacon Bolt] from their graveyard. How much does the Beacon Bolt cost to cast?
answer_gold: {U}{R}. Grand Arbiter Augustin IV's effect applies to any spell Aubrey casts, regardless of what zone it's being cast from. It can only reduce the spell's cost by {1}, not any colored mana.

question: Alfonso controls [Bridge from Below] and [Minotaur Warrior]. They cast [Austere Command], choosing to destroy all enchantments and all creatures with mana value 3 or less. Does they create a Zombie token?
answer_gold: Yes. Modes of a resolving spell or ability are carried out in the order they are written. Bridge from Below is already in the graveyard by the time Minotaur Warrior dies.

question: Ariel controls [Those Who Serve] and a token that's a copy of [Bridge from Below]. They cast [Planar Cleansing]. Do they create a Zombie token?
answer_gold: No. Leaves-the-battlefield triggers care about the state of the game immediately before the event in question. Bridge from Below was on the battlefield at that time, and won't trigger.

question: Ashlyn controls [Dromoka Warrior] and a token that's a copy of [Bridge from Below]. They cast [Austere Command], choosing to destroy all enchantments and all creatures with mana value 3 or less. Does they create a Zombie token?
answer_gold: No. Even though Bridge from Below is a token, it still moves to the graveyard when it's destroyed. It will only cease to exist after Austere Command has finished resolving. Modes of a resolving spell or ability are carried out in the order they are written, so Bridge from Below is already in the graveyard by the time Dromoka Warrior dies. However Bridge from Below's trigger has an intervening if clause, so it will check again if Bridge from Below is in the graveyard when the trigger attempts to resolve. The Bridge from Below has ceased to exist by that point, so no trigger is created.

question: Alicia attacks with [Goblin Banneret], [Sunhome Stalwart], [Tajic, Legion's Edge], [Wojek Bodyguard], [Barging Sergeant], and [Light of the Legion]. They put the mentor triggers on the stack in the following order: Sunhome Stalwart targets Goblin Banneret, Wojek Bodyguard targets Sunhome Stalwart, Tajic, Legion's Edge targets Goblin Banneret, Light of the Legion targets Wojek Bodyguard, and Barging Sergeant targets Tajic, Legion's Edge. How much damage will be dealt to Nico in total?
answer_gold:
23. In order:

Barging Sergeant's trigger gives Tajic, Legion's Edge a +1/+1 counter
Light of the Legion's trigger gives Wojek Bodyguard a +1/+1 counter
Tajic, Legion's Edge's trigger gives Goblin Banneret a +1/+1 counter
Wojek Bodyguard's trigger gives Sunhome Stalwart a +1/+1 counter
Sunhome Stalwart's trigger gives Goblin Banneret a +1/+1 counter

The final powers of the creatures (in order) are 3, 3, 4, 4, 4, and 5.

question: Aubrey controls [Emmara, Soul of the Accord], a [Plains], and 2 [Forest]s. Can they cast [Nissa's Expedition] by tapping the 3 lands, the Emmara, Soul of the Accord, and the token created by Emmara, Soul of the Accord?
answer_gold: No. The cost to cast Nissa's Expedition must be paid as it's cast. The token is only created when the trigger resolves, after the Nissa's Expedition has been cast.

question: Alondra has 3 [Undead Servant]s in their graveyard and casts another Undead Servant. After it enters the battlefield but before its trigger resolves, Nico activates [Tormod's Crypt] to exile all cards from Alondra's graveyard. When Undead Servant's ability resolves, how many tokens will be created?
answer_gold: 0. The number of tokens to create is determined when the ability resolves, by which point the graveyard has no creatures in it.

question: Abraham and Nico each control an [Exotic Orchard]. If Abraham taps their Exotic Orchard, what type(s) of mana can it produce?
answer_gold: None. Nico's Exotic Orchard couldn't produce any mana, so neither can Exotic Orchard.

question: Avery controls a [Squandered Resources] and a [Sapseep Forest]. Nikolai controls [Blood Moon]. If Avery sacrifices Sapseep Forest to Squandered Resources, what type(s) of mana can it produce?
answer_gold: Just {R}. Squandered Resources cares about what colors of mana it could produce on the battlefield.

question: Aurora controls [Star Compass] and [Temple of Malady]. If Aurora taps Star Compass, what type(s) of mana can it produce?
answer_gold: None. Temple of Malady isn't a basic land.

question: Arden controls [Naga Vitalist] and a [Deathrite Shaman] that's currently a land due to [Xenograft] (naming "Saproling") and [Life and Limb]. Neither player has any land cards in their graveyards. If Arden taps Naga Vitalist, what type(s) of mana can it produce?
answer_gold: Any color. Naga Vitalist checks to see what mana Deathrite Shaman could produce if any of its abilities were to resolve at that time. If Deathrite Shaman's first ability were to resolve now it would produce any color of mana. It doesn't matter that it has no legal targets and couldn't resolve, since the check in [106.7] takes it resolving as a premise.

question: Aryan controls [Naga Vitalist] and [Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx]. If Aryan taps Naga Vitalist, what type(s) of mana can it produce?
answer_gold: {C} or {G}. Naga Vitalist checks to see what mana Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx could produce if any of its abilities were to resolve at that time. If Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx's first ability were to resolve now, it could produce {C}. If the second ability were to resolve now, it could produce {G}.

question: Aubrey controls [Exotic Orchard]. Nikolas controls [Crumbling Vestige]. If Aubrey taps Exotic Orchard, what type(s) of mana can it produce?
answer_gold: Any color. Exotic Orchard checks to see what mana Crumbling Vestige could produce if any of its abilities were to resolve at that time. That includes triggered abilities.

question: Ashley casts [Phage the Untouchable]. In response, Nicholas casts [Gather Specimens]. What happens when Phage the Untouchable resolves?
answer_gold: Nicholas didn't cast it from their hand, so they lose the game.

question: Aylin casts [Reanimate] targeting [Undergrowth Scavenger] in their graveyard. Assuming there are no other cards in any graveyards, how many +1/+1 counters will Undergrowth Scavenger enter the battlefield with?
answer_gold: One. Undergrowth Scavenger has a replacement effect that modifies how it will enter the battlefield. The game needs to know how Undergrowth Scavenger will enter the battlefield, and must do that before it enters the battlefield. At that point it will be in the graveyard and will count itself.

question: Adriel controls [Skill Borrower]. The top card of their library is a [Quirion Ranger]. Adriel activates Skill Borrower's ability, then casts [Brainstorm]. As Brainstorm resolves, they draw Quirion Ranger and then put Quirion Ranger back on top of their library. Can Adriel activate Skill Borrower's ability again?
answer_gold: Yes. The Quirion Ranger that's now on top of the library is unrelated to the Quirion Ranger that was there previously. Skill Borrower has a new ability that just has the same text as the ability that was activated earlier.

question: Ashley controls [Skill Borrower] and [Sensei's Divining Top]. The top card of their library is a [Putrid Leech]. Ashley activates Skill Borrower's ability, then activates Sensei's Divining Top's first ability, choosing to put Putrid Leech second from the top. Then they activate Sensei's Divining Top again, putting Putrid Leech back on top. Can Ashley activate Skill Borrower's ability again?
answer_gold: Yes. Putrid Leech stopped being revealed for a time, so it is no longer the same object that it was before. Skill Borrower has a new ability that just has the same text as the ability that was activated earlier.

question: Azariah, Beckham, and Caelan are playing a multiplayer game. Beckham controls [Stalking Leonin]. Azariah casts [Worst Fears] to take control of Beckham's next turn. After Beckham begins their turn, can Azariah see which player was chosen for the Stalking Leonin?
answer_gold: No. The choice was made as Stalking Leonin entered the battlefield, which already happened- it's no longer visible to Beckham. Azariah can choose to activate the ability (at which point all players will know who was chosen), but otherwise the choice is not visible to any player.

question: Aspen has no cards in their library and controls a [Keranos, God of Storms] and [Platinum Angel]. When they begin their draw step, what happens?
answer_gold: Aspen can't draw a card, so no card is revealed and none of Keranos, God of Storms's triggered abilities trigger. Aspen will continue with their turn.

question: Ainsley controls [Spectral Gateguards] paired with a [Tobias Andrion]. They cast [Wingcrafter]. What can they pair it with?
answer_gold: Nothing. Neither soulbond ability triggers.

question: Ari controls [Mana Reflection] and [Looming Spires]. Nicole controls [Damping Sphere]. If Ari taps the Looming Spires for mana, how much mana is produced, and of what type(s)?
answer_gold: {C}. As the ability resolves, Mana Reflection replaces "Add {R}" with "Add {R}{R}". Damping Sphere then applies and replaces that with "Add {C}". Mana Reflection won't apply again.

question: Andres controls [Snow-Covered Forest] enchanted by [Overgrowth]. Nico controls [Damping Sphere]. If Andres taps the Snow-Covered Forest for mana, how much mana is produced, of what type(s)?
answer_gold: Andres adds the same amount and types of mana that they would have without the Damping Sphere. Damping Sphere only affects a permanent being tapped for more than one mana, and Snow-Covered Forest only adds 1 mana. Overgrowth's triggered ability adds the rest.

question: Alexzander controls a [Thought Reflection] and casts [Enter the Infinite]. What happens as it resolves?
answer_gold: Alexzander attempts to draw cards equal to twice the number of cards in their library, and can't do so, so they only draw the number of cards in the library. Alexzander then puts one back on top. Unless their library contained 0 cards before resolving Enter the Infinite, they will lose the game after Enter the Infinite has finished resolving.

question: Ariel controls [Goblin Arsonist] enchanted by Nolan's [Glistening Oil]. When Goblin Arsonist dies at the beginning of Nolan's upkeep, does it deal its damage with infect?
answer_gold: Yes. The Goblin Arsonist does not exist when it needs to deal damage, so the game uses its last known information. When it was last on the battlefield, it had infect.

question: Anaya activates the second ability of [Jarad, Golgari Lich Lord], sacrificing [Meng Huo's Horde]. In response, Nikolas casts [Sudden Spoiling], targeting Anaya. How much life does Nikolas lose?
answer_gold: Four. Meng Huo's Horde is sacrificed as a cost to activate Jarad, Golgari Lich Lord's ability and is not on the battlefield when Sudden Spoiling resolves. Jarad, Golgari Lich Lord checks the power of Meng Huo's Horde when it was last on the battlefield.

question: Anakin has [Terrus Wurm] in their graveyard. Anakin activates the scavenge ability of Terrus Wurm targeting [Plated Wurm]. In response, Nathalia activates [Deathrite Shaman] targeting Terrus Wurm. What happens?
answer_gold: This can't happen as described. Exiling Terrus Wurm is part of the costs associated with activating the scavenge ability. Once Anakin announces their intent to scavenge, Nathalia doesn't have a chance to respond until Terrus Wurm has already been exiled from the graveyard.

question: Amia controls [Sanctuary Cat], and Nico controls [Glacial Chasm] and [Ral Zarek]. Amia attacks Ral Zarek with Sanctuary Cat. Is damage to Ral Zarek prevented?
answer_gold: No. Ral Zarek is not Nico.

question: Norah controls [Treasure Vault]. Aubrey activates [Pernicious Deed] for X = 0. Will Treasure Vault be destroyed?
answer_gold: Yes. Pernicious Deed specifies that it destroys artifacts. It doesn't care if the card has other types as well, only that it has one of the named types. Treasure Vault has mana value 0, and therefore falls under the scope of what Pernicious Deed is destroying.

question: Anson attacks with [Argothian Swine]. Nico blocks with [Blightbeetle]. What is the maximum damage that can be dealt to Nico?
answer_gold: Two. Anson must assign at least one damage to Blightbeetle. The game doesn't take the protection ability into account when determining what "lethal damage" would be, when Anson is assigning damage, so they only has to assign one damage.

question: Ari casts [Jeleva, Nephalia's Scourge] and resolves its trigger. Ari then casts [Personify] targeting Jeleva, Nephalia's Scourge, and on their next turn attacks with it. Are they able to cast a card exiled with the first trigger?
answer_gold: No. The cards that were exiled by the first trigger are linked to the object that exiled them. The Jeleva, Nephalia's Scourge that is currently on the battlefield is a different object with different abilities than the Jeleva, Nephalia's Scourge that exiled the first set of cards.

question: Aylin controls [Stone Haven Outfitter] and [Dromoka Warrior]. Aylin activates [Skullclamp]'s equip ability targeting Dromoka Warrior. What happens when the equip ability resolves?
answer_gold: After Skullclamp's equip ability resolves, the game checks state-based actions. At that point Dromoka Warrior is getting +1/+1 and does not die.

question: Alex controls [Obelisk of Urd] enchanted with [Disruption Aura]. Can Alex tap six creatures instead of paying mana for Disruption Aura's triggered ability?
answer_gold: No. Convoke is an ability that functions while Obelisk of Urd is on the stack that allows Alex to tap creatures instead of paying mana for the Obelisk of Urd. It does not modify the mana cost of the spell in other zones, nor does it allow Alex to tap creatures to pay for Disruption Aura.

question: Alex uses [Lost in Memories] to give [Death Rattle] flashback. Can they delve to pay the flashback cost?
answer_gold: Yes. Flashback is an alternative cost, but delve is simply a different way of paying mana costs. After the total cost of the spell has been determined, Alex can then exile cards from their graveyard instead of paying mana for the spell.

question: Nick controls [True-Name Nemesis] with protection from Ari. Ari casts [Mirrorweave] targeting their [Sewer Nemesis], for which Nick is the chosen player. After Mirrorweave resolves, if Ari casts another spell, will Nick's True-Name Nemesis's third ability trigger?
answer_gold: No. Sewer Nemesis's second and third abilities are each "linked" to its first ability, and only the player named for the first ability is considered when checking to see if it triggers. Since True-Name Nemesis didn't enter the battlefield as a copy of Sewer Nemesis, there is no chosen player for that ability. Since its power and toughness can't be determined, it's a 0/0. If it were to stay alive somehow, it's third ability could never trigger.

question: Austin resolves [Duplicant], and uses [Yarok, the Desecrated] to exile [Murasa Brute] then [Grizzly Bears]. Once all the triggers resolve, what is Duplicant's power and toughness?
answer_gold: Duplicant is a 2/2. Its second ability looks at the last creature card exiled by the first ability, which was Grizzly Bears.

question: Avery controls [Caelorna, Coral Tyrant] and [Darksteel Garrison] that's fortifying [Spire Garden]. Avery casts [Bludgeon Brawl]. After that resolves they activate Darksteel Garrison's equip ability targeting Caelorna, Coral Tyrant. What does the battlefield look like after that ability has resolved and state-based actions have been checked?
answer_gold:
Darksteel Garrison is attached to Caelorna, Coral Tyrant and not to Spire Garden.

Bludgeon Brawl doesn't specify that the permanents it affects keep their original subtypes, so they are overwritten. This means that Darksteel Garrison ceases to be a Fortification as soon as Bludgeon Brawl enters the battlefield. It will become unattached the next time state-based actions are performed. When its equip ability resolves, it becomes attached to Caelorna, Coral Tyrant.

question: Adalynn controls their [Felhide Minotaur] enchanted with [Noble Quarry] and [Flickerform]. What happens when they activate Flickerform's ability?
answer_gold: Flickerform exiles the creature and all the Auras attached to it. In exile Flickerform is no longer attached to Noble Quarry, so it stops being an Aura. ([701.3d], [702.103a], [702.103f]). At the end of the turn, Flickerform's ability will return Noble Quarry and all cards that were attached to it to the battlefield. Flickerform's ability will return Noble Quarry as a creature.

question: Alessandra controls [Essence of the Wild] and casts [Mockingbird]. Can they have the Mockingbird enter the battlefield as a copy of Nicolas's [Primordial Wurm]?
answer_gold: No. Essence of the Wild and Mockingbird both have replacement effects that want to modify how Mockingbird enters the battlefield. Alessandra, as the affected player, may apply them in whatever order they wishes. Unfortunately neither order will result in Mockingbird entering as a copy of Primordial Wurm. If they applies Mockingbird first, that ability will set Mockingbird's copiable values to those of Primordial Wurm. Then Essence of the Wild will set them to its own copiable values. If they applies Essence of the Wild first, that will set Mockingbird's copiable values to Essence of the Wild. This will overwrite Mockingbird's ability, so it will no longer apply.

question: Ali controls [Thalia and The Gitrog Monster] and casts [Show and Tell]. They choose to put in a [Caldera Hellion] and devour their Thalia and The Gitrog Monster. Neriah would like to put [Pillarfield Ox] onto the battlefield with Show and Tell. Will it enter tapped or untapped?
answer_gold: Pillarfield Ox will enter tapped. The game will see that two creatures are entering the battlefield and will check to see if any replacement effects apply to either of them. Thalia and The Gitrog Monster will apply to Pillarfield Ox causing it to enter tapped. Caldera Hellion also has a replacement effect, and at this point Ali will choose which creature to Devour, but will not actually complete the action until the game is ready to progress forward.
submitter: Daniel Kitachewsky and James Do Hung Lee (via JudgingFTW)

question: Nico controls [Compost]. Abdullah controls [Moriok Reaver] and a token that was created as a copy of [Yargle, Glutton of Urborg]. Abdullah casts [Akroma's Vengeance]. How many times does Compost trigger?
answer_gold:
0. Akroma's Vengeance destroys all permanents simultaneously. Compost's trigger checks immediately after the event in question to see if it should trigger. However by that time Compost is in the graveyard, and its ability doesn't function there.

(Compost doesn't fit the "leaves-the-battlefield" trigger exception because it's a "from anywhere" trigger.)

question: Albert is enchanted with [Paradox Haze]. During their first upkeep, they activate the forecast ability of [Writ of Passage]. Can they activate the same forecast ability during their second upkeep?
answer_gold: No. Each forecast ability can only be activated once per turn.

question: Aya controls a [Skullbriar, the Walking Grave] with 3 +1/+1 counters on it. Nico casts [Duplicant] and has it exile Skullbriar, the Walking Grave. What are Duplicant's power and toughness after the imprint ability resolves?
answer_gold: Duplicant is a 1/1. Duplicant has a non-characteristic defining ability that sets its power and toughness. This is applied in layer 7b, at which point Skullbriar, the Walking Grave's power and toughness is still 1/1 because power and toughness changes from counters are not applied until layer 7c.
submitter: Cris Plyler and Minh-Duc Vu (via JudgingFTW)

question: Allen controls [Yixlid Jailer] and casts [Ever After] targeting [Dearly Departed] and [Fresh Volunteers]. Will Fresh Volunteers enter with a +1/+1 counter?
answer_gold: No. Dearly Departed has no abilities while in the graveyard.

question: Addison controls [Hardened Scales], [Primal Vigor], and a face-down [Hooded Hydra]. They turn Hooded Hydra face-up by paying its morph cost. How many +1/+1 counters will be placed on it?
answer_gold:
11 or 12, depending on how Addison applies the effects from Hardened Scales and Primal Vigor.

The replacement effect from Hooded Hydra's ability creates an event that Hardened Scales and Primal Vigor can apply to. Addison is able to order these however they like. Each effect can only be applied once.

By applying Hardened Scales then Primal Vigor, Hooded Hydra will get 12 counters.
By applying Primal Vigor then Hardened Scales, Hooded Hydra will get 11 counters.

question: Nehemiah controls [Tibalt, Rakish Instigator]. Amalia controls [Lich] and casts [Centaur Healer]. What happens when Centaur Healer's trigger resolves?
answer_gold: Nothing. Amalia cannot apply Lich's replacement effect to the life gain event, because that event can't happen.

question: Angela controls [Mirror Gallery] and two [Sakashima the Impostor]s. One is a copy of their [Master of the Hunt]; the other is copying a wolf token created by Master of the Hunt. They attack with all four creatures. What are the possible bands that Angela may declare?
answer_gold: No bands can be declared. The only creature on the battlefield named "Wolves of the Hunt" is the token, so it cannot declare itself as in a band with anything else. The Sakashima the Impostor with "bands with other creatures named Wolves of the Hunt" is not itself named "Wolves of the Hunt", so it cannot declare itself as in a band with the token.

question: Autumn activates [Great Hall of the Biblioplex], then enchants it with [Darksteel Mutation]. Afterwards, they cast [Reality Ripple] on Great Hall of the Biblioplex. What happens?
answer_gold: Great Hall of the Biblioplex's status changes to "phased out". Being attached to Great Hall of the Biblioplex, Darksteel Mutation also phases out indirectly. Before Autumn untaps on their next turn, both permanents will phase back in. By this time, Great Hall of the Biblioplex's effect will have worn off, so it won't be making Great Hall of the Biblioplex a creature anymore. Darksteel Mutation phases in attached to Great Hall of the Biblioplex, so that effect will be making Great Hall of the Biblioplex a creature. In Autumn's upkeep when state-based actions are performed, Darksteel Mutation will be attached to a creature, so it remains on the battlefield.

question: Avery controls a Germ token that's equipped with [Barbed Bloodletter]. Nadia controls two [Teferi's Curse]s, one on the Germ, the other on the Barbed Bloodletter. During Avery's untap step, which permanents will phase out? Which of these will phase back in?
answer_gold: All 4 permanents will phase out and phase back in in Ari's next untap step. Barbed Bloodletter and both Teferi's Curses will still be attached to the permanents they were attached to previously. Phasing doesn't cause tokens to cease to exist or unattach permanents from other permanents.

question: Abel attacks with [Pristine Angel]. While it's tapped, Nico activates [Cephalid Snitch]'s ability targeting Pristine Angel. After that resolves, Abel casts a spell and untaps Pristine Angel. Can Nico now target the Pristine Angel with [Murder]?
answer_gold:
Yes. "Protection from all colors" is shorthand for protection from each color individually. It loses protection from black, and still has protection from all the other colors.

(The timestamp of Pristine Angel's ability does not change when it becomes untapped.)

question: Alex manifests [Uninvited Geist] with [Ugin's Mastery]. Nataly casts [Moonmist] and in response, Alex activates [Imagecrafter] to turn the face-down Uninvited Geist into a Human. Does Uninvited Geist or Imagecrafter transform when Moonmist resolves?
answer_gold:
No. 

Face-down double-faced permanents can't transform. Imagecrafter will not transform because that creature is not double-faced.

question: Alijah controls [Badlands] and [Conversion]. Alijah then casts [Magus of the Moon]. After that resolves, what color(s) of mana can Badlands tap for?
answer_gold: Only {R}. Both Magus of the Moon and Conversion only apply in layer 4. The effects are applied in timestamp order, resulting in Conversion applying first to make Badlands a Plains, then Magus of the Moon applies making it a Mountain.

question: Natasha and Nico are playing Two-Headed Giant, and each controls their own copy of [Bloodbond Vampire]. Ariel controls [Wall of Shards], and on their next upkeep they put the third age counter on it. Can Ariel have Natasha gain one life and Nico gain two? If so, how many triggered abilities of Bloodbond Vampire will be put on the stack?
answer_gold: Paying Wall of Shards' cumulative upkeep involves the choice of an opponent. The choice for each age counter is made individually, then the whole cost is paid at once. This means Ariel can make the stated choice, and the result of this is Natasha gains one life and Nico gains two life. Because of this, each player's Bloodbond Vampire will trigger separately, causing two instances of the triggered ability to be put on the stack. Although the players share a life total, gaining life happens to each player individually.

question: Averie casts [Living Death] while they control [Immortal Coil] and [Prizefighter Construct]. The only card in their graveyard is a [Lathnu Sailback]. Does Averie lose the game? If so, could they avoid this by countering Immortal Coil's trigger with [Stifle]?
answer_gold: Averie will lose the game unless they castStifle. The first step in Living Death's resolution is to exile all creature cards from graveyards. At this point, Immortal Coil will trigger because Averie has no cards in their graveyard. Although sacrificing Prizefighter Construct will ultimately put a creature card there before this trigger is put on the stack, it still will go on the stack and resolve.. Immortal Coil has a state trigger, therefore, there will only be one instance of this triggered ability on the stack. After Living Death resolves, Averie can Stifle Immortal Coil's ability and it won't be put on the stack again because they now have cards in their graveyard.

question: Aimee casts [Animate Dead] targeting [Scalebane's Elite] in their graveyard. What happens?
answer_gold:
Both permanents end up in the graveyard.

Scalebane's Elite's protection ability doesn't function in the graveyard, so it's a legal target for Animate Dead. As Animate Dead's trigger resolves, first Animate Dead's enchant ability changes to "enchant creature put onto the battlefield with Animate Dead". Then Scalebane's Elite is returned to the battlefield. At this point the next instruction is to attach Animate Dead to Scalebane's Elite, but this is illegal to do because now that it's on the battlefield, Scalebane's Elite's protection ability is active.

After the triggered ability from Animate Dead has finished resolving, the game will check state-based actions and see that Animate Dead is an Aura that isn't enchanting anything, so it's put into its owner's graveyard.. This causes Animate Dead's leaves-the-battlefield ability to trigger, sacrificing Scalebane's Elite.

question: Alannah controls [Cloudseeder] equipped with [Spy Kit]. Alannah activates Cloudseeder's ability to create a token. Nathanael casts [Bile Blight] targeting the token. Does Cloudseeder die?
answer_gold: Yes. Tokens aren't cards, but Cloud Sprite is a card, so Cloudseeder has that name and Bile Blight affects it.

question: Aliana controls [Sylvan Library], and Nico controls two [Chains of Mephistopheles]. Aliana begins their turn empty handed and wants to use Sylvan Library's ability. What happens?
answer_gold: Aliana draws a card for their turn, then then they go to draw for Sylvan Library. Chains of Mephistopheles's replacement effect will apply causing Aliana to discard a card, and draw a card. However, at this point the second Chains of Mephistopheles will apply, Aliana doesn't have any cards to discard, so instead they will mill a card. Aliana will then go to draw their second card from Sylvan Library. Chains of Mephistopheles will replace this with they milling another card. Because they haven't actually drawn any cards from Sylvan Library, they won't need to pay four life.

question: Alex controls [Enduring Renewal] and [Keranos, God of Storms]. During their upkeep Alex activates [Sindbad]. What happens?
answer_gold:
During the resolution of Sindbad's ability, Alex draws a card, and Enduring Renewal replaces this draw.

Sindbad's discard effect never happens, as the original event is replaced.

If the first revealed card is a "Creature", that card is put into the graveyard through Enduring Renewal's effect, and that card never enters Alex's hand. Keranos, God of Storms does not trigger, since the card is not drawn.

If the first revealed card is a "Land", Alex draws that card through Enduring Renewal's effect, and triggers Keranos, God of Storms. Alex then will attempt to draw an additional card, but must go through Enduring Renewal's replacement effect again.

If the first revealed card is neither a "Creature" nor a "Land", Alex draws the card and triggers Keranos, God of Storms. When they next gain priority, they put the 3 damage to any target trigger onto the stack.

question: Arielle controls [Cosi's Trickster] and casts [Harvest Fear], targeting Neil. They discard 2 [Blightsteel Colossus]. How many times does Cosi's Trickster trigger?
answer_gold: Twice. Both Blightsteel Colossus are discarded at the same time, so both are shuffled into Neil's library at the same time. However both shuffles still occurred, so Cosi's Trickster triggers twice.

question: Abdiel controls [Ashes of the Fallen] (naming "Human") and casts [Zombify] targeting [Dearly Departed] in their graveyard. Does it enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter?
answer_gold: No. The game state is evaluated immediately before the event in question to determine which replacement effects might apply to that event. Dearly Departed is in the graveyard at that time, so its effect can apply. However, to determine which replacement effects apply as a permanent enters the battlefield, the game looks at the permanent as it would exist on the battlefield. On the battlefield Dearly Departed would not be a Human, so its effect doesn't apply to itself.

question: Armando wants to cast [Fiery Confluence]. They want to choose the second mode 3 times to deal 2 damage to each of the 3 Planeswalkers Nico controls. Can they do that?
answer_gold: No, Fiery Confluence can only deal damage to players, not Planeswalkers. That means that Nico is the only target available. The rules for dealing noncombat damage to planeswalkers have been updated.

question: Amelia controls two [Balduvian Barbarians] and [Omnath, Locus of Mana] and has 6 {G} in their mana pool. Neymar controls [Ghostly Prison] and casts [Master Warcraft]. Which creatures can Neymar legally declare as attackers?
answer_gold: Neymar may choose any of Amelia's creatures as attackers, however after this selection is made it's Amelia's choice whether they want to pay the mana to attack. Neymar only chooses which creatures attack, and those choices must be legal. Then the game checks to see if any creatures have any costs associated with attacking. Amelia doesn't have to pay the cost, in which case that creature can't attack.

question: Adelyn controls [Back from the Brink] and has [Shifting Wall] in their graveyard. Can Adelyn activate Back from the Brink's ability to create a token of Shifting Wall? Can they pay more than {0} to do so? If so, will it enter the battlefield with any +1/+1 counters?
answer_gold: Adelyn may activate the ability of Shifting Wall paying {0}. He does not have the ability to pay more than {0}. The token will not enter the battlefield with any +1/+1 counters.

question: Arianna controls [Qarsi Deceiver] and a face-down [Defender of the Order]. Noah controls [Exiled Doomsayer]. Can Arianna spend mana produced by Qarsi Deceiver to pay part of the cost to turn Defender of the Order face up?
answer_gold: Yes. Exiled Doomsayer doesn't impose an additional cost, it increases the existing morph cost by {2}. (Additional costs only apply to spells and activated abilities, not to special actions like turning a face-down permanent face up.)

question: Anabella casts [False Dawn]. After it resolves, they tap a [Moonring Island] for mana. What color of mana does it produce?
answer_gold: {W}. Moonring Island's ability to add mana is controlled by Anabella.

question: Nathalia controls [Phyrexian Revoker] that named [Channel]. Aden casts Channel. Can Aden pay 1 life to add {C}?
answer_gold: Yes. Channel allows Aden to take a special action to add mana. It is not an activated ability nor a mana ability.

question: Nora casts [Word of Command] targeting Abraham. As it resolves, Nora has Abraham cast [Shahrazad]. Does Nora control Abraham in the subgame?
answer_gold: No. Nora controls Abraham while the Shahrazad is resolving, but only in the main game. That effect does not carry over to the subgame.

question: April controls [Celestial Dawn]. If they exile a [Willow Elf] with [Thief of Sanity], can they cast it by spending {B}?
answer_gold: No. Both "as though" effects apply. April may spend black mana as though it were mana of any color, and also must spend it as though it were colorless.

question: Aiden taps [Undiscovered Paradise] for mana while Natalia controls [Temporal Distortion]. During Aiden's next untap step, will Undiscovered Paradise return to their hand?
answer_gold: Yes. Undiscovered Paradise returns to its owner's hand during the turn-based action of untapping permanents. It doesn't matter if Undiscovered Paradise itself would untap.

question: Ashley controls [Ulrich of the Krallenhorde] enchanted by [Infinite Reflection]. Ashley also controls an [Instigator Gang] which is currently a copy of Ulrich of the Krallenhorde. Ashley casts [Waxing Moon] targeting Instigator Gang. What happens?
answer_gold: Instigator Gang transforms. Instigator Gang's back face remains a copy of Ulrich of the Krallenhorde. Instigator Gang's trigger that triggers "whenever it transforms into Ulrich of the Krallenhorde" triggers.

question: Alvaro controls [Deft Duelist] and a [Banishing Light] that exiled Nora's [Vow of Duty]. Nora casts [Ray of Revelation] targeting Banishing Light. What happens as the Vow of Duty returns to the battlefield?
answer_gold: It enchants Deft Duelist. Auras entering the battlefield from a zone other than the stack must enchant a legal object. It doesn't target anything, so shroud doesn't matter.

question: Aubrey activates [Gliding Licid] targeting Noemi's [Soul Sculptor]. Before that resolves, Noemi activates Soul Sculptor targeting Gliding Licid. When Aubrey next gets priority, they pays {U} to end the effect. What happens?
answer_gold: This can't happen as described, Aubrey cannot pay {U} to end the effect until after Gliding Licid's ability resolves.

question: Avery turns their [Mirage Mirror] into a copy of [Old Man of the Sea] and takes control of Nathan's [Kobolds of Kher Keep]. At the end of the turn when Mirage Mirror stops being a copy of Old Man of the Sea, will Kobolds of Kher Keep return to Nathan's control?
answer_gold: No. Mirage Mirror has no power, so the game uses 0 instead. Kobolds of Kher Keep's power is still less than or equal to 0, so the control-changing effect doesn't end.

question: Annabella controls [Paladin of Atonement] with 3 +1/+1 counters on it. They attacks with it and Nick blocks with [Bonebreaker Giant]. How much life does Annabella gain?
answer_gold: 4. Even though it's a 1/1 in the graveyard, the game cares about its toughness when it was last on the battlefield. Damage from Bonebreaker Giant didn't reduce Paladin of Atonement's toughness, it just caused that much damage to be marked on it, which caused it to die.

question: In a multiplayer game with a default turn order of Aubrey-Bishop-Charlotte, Aubrey casts [Emrakul, the Promised End] and targets Charlotte. After that resolves, Charlotte activates [Mindslaver] and targets Bishop. What is the turn order and who controls whom after Aubrey ends their turn?
answer_gold: The turn order would be Bishop controlled by Charlotte followed by Charlotte's turn controlled by Aubrey, then Charlotte taking their extra turn controlling themselves before returning to Aubrey's turn again.

question: Ashley plays [Dryad Arbor]. Noa controls [Uphill Battle]. Does the Dryad Arbor enter the battlefield tapped?
answer_gold: Yes.

question: Nayeli controls [Authority of the Consuls]. Ainsley's devotion to black is 0 and they cast [Erebos, God of the Dead]. Does it enter the battlefield tapped or untapped?
answer_gold: Untapped. To determine what replacement effects apply to a permanent as it enters the battlefield, the game looks at the permanent as it would exist on the battlefield. On the battlefield Erebos, God of the Dead would not be a creature, so Authority of the Consuls's effect will not apply to it.

question: Ahmed controls [Bronze Sable]. They cast [Genesis Wave], putting [Phylactery Lich] and [Solemnity] onto the battlefield. Does Bronze Sable get a phylactery counter?
answer_gold: Yes. Phylactery Lich and Solemnity enter the battlefield at the same time. Solemnity's effect must exist before Phylactery Lich enters the battlefield in order to prevent Bronze Sable from getting a counter.

question: Audrey controls a [Suncleanser] that targeted [Prizefighter Construct] when it entered the battlefield. Audrey casts [Boneyard Parley], putting [Phylactery Lich] and [Hellkite Hatchling] onto the battlefield. Can they choose to sacrifice Suncleanser to the Hellkite Hatchling and put a phylactery counter on Prizefighter Construct?
answer_gold: No. Phylactery Lich and Hellkite Hatchling enter the battlefield at the same time. Even if Audrey chooses to sacrifice Suncleanser as Hellkite Hatchling enters, its effect existed immediately before the Phylactery Lich entered the battlefield, so Prizefighter Construct can't have the counter placed on it.

question: Ashley controls [Tatterkite]. Ashley casts [Genesis Wave], putting [Phylactery Lich] and [Humility] onto the battlefield. Can they put a phylactery counter on Tatterkite?
answer_gold: No. Phylactery Lich and Humility enter the battlefield at the same time. Tatterkite had the ability that prevents it from getting counters immediately before Phylactery Lich entered the battlefield, which is when it matters.

question: Aspen casts [Path to Exile] targeting Nayeli's [Leonin Arbiter]. Assuming Nayeli can't pay {2}, will they get to search their library?
answer_gold: Yes, Nayeli does get to search their library. Path to Exile will resolve in the order written on the card, so first Leonin Arbiter is removed and its effect stops existing and then Nayeli will search their library for a basic land.

question: Autumn controls [Slimefoot, the Stowaway] and a 1/1 Saproling token. Autumn casts [Deafening Clarion] choosing both modes. How much life does Autumn gain?
answer_gold:
Two.

Deafening Clarion deals three damage to each creature, then gives them lifelink. After the spell has resolved, state-based actions are checked and both creatures die. Slimefoot, the Stowaway's ability is a leave-the-battlefield trigger, so it sees that it existed immediately before Slimefoot, the Stowaway died and therefore triggers. When it resolves, it sees that Slimefoot, the Stowaway had lifelink right before it died, so Autumn gains 1 life from the damage that's dealt to Noor.

question: Amina attacks with a face-down [Blightsteel Colossus] and Nash blocks with [Axegrinder Giant]. Where does Blightsteel Colossus move?
answer_gold: The graveyard. Replacement effects must exist before the event in question in order to affect it. Blightsteel Colossus had no abilities when it was on the battlefield, so there is no replacement effect that would apply to it moving to the graveyard.

question: Ashley controls 6 1/1 white Soldier tokens. Ashley casts [Venerated Loxodon] and would like to tap all of their soldiers to pay for it. Can they do this?
answer_gold: No, Ashley cannot tap more creatures than is necessary to pay for Venerated Loxodon. When casting a spell a player must pay the total cost of the spell, but cannot pay anything that the spell does not ask for. Convoke allows a player to tap creatures rather than pay mana for a spell, and follows the same rules for paying mana.

question: Aspen has no cards in their graveyard or exile and casts [Beacon Bolt], targeting Nathalie's [Alpha Myr]. Is Alpha Myr dealt 1 damage?
answer_gold: No. Spells are on the stack as they resolve. They are only put into the graveyard once they finish.

question: Alondra has 10 life and Nico has 20 life. Alondra attacks Nico with [Kaalia of the Vast] and puts in [Scourge of the Throne]. Will they get an extra combat phase?
answer_gold: No. Scourge of the Throne has a triggered ability that occurs only when it is declared as an attacking creature. It was put onto the battlefield attacking, which doesn't meet its trigger condition.

question: Autumn controls [Volrath's Shapeshifter] and resolves [Seasoned Dungeoneer]. Autumn resolves the explore trigger of Seasoned Dungeoneer choosing to move [Nicanzil, Current Conductor] from the library to the graveyard. Does Volrath's Shapeshifter, now with the text of Nicanzil, Current Conductor, trigger from the exploring of Seasoned Dungeoneer?
answer_gold:
Yes. 

First, as part of resolving the explore trigger, Volrath's Shapeshifter gains the text of Nicanzil, Current Conductor. Then, since a permanent "explores" only after the process for exploring is complete, Volrath's Shapeshifter's new trigger condition from the text of Nicanzil, Current Conductor exists before the trigger condition is met.

question: Alex casts [Undercity Sewers] and puts [Blood Operative] into their graveyard while surveilling. Does Alex have the option to pay 3 life for Blood Operative's ability?
answer_gold: Yes. Objects that exist immediately after an event are checked to see if they match any trigger conditions. Blood Operative was in the graveyard after the surveil event, so the game checks to see if Blood Operative has any trigger conditions relating to surveil at that time.

question: Antonio controls [Gran-Gran]. Nico casts [Merfolk Trickster] targeting Gran-Gran. Does Gran-Gran's triggered ability trigger and resolve?
answer_gold: Yes. Merfolk Trickster's instructions are followed in the order written. Gran-Gran is tapped first and it's trigger triggers. Then Gran-Gran loses all abilities. Merfolk Trickster's ability then finishes resolving and Gran-Gran's triggered ability is placed onto the stack. The trigger doesn't care that the permanent no longer has the ability, as it has already triggered.

question: Ashley controls [Soulfire Grand Master] and has [Kozilek's Return] in their graveyard. Ashley activates Soulfire Grand Master's ability. After that resolves, Ashley casts [Devourer of Destiny]. If Ashley chooses to use Kozilek's Return's ability, how much life will Ashley gain and where will Kozilek's Return be after the damage has been dealt and the stack is empty?
answer_gold: Ashley will gain zero life, and Kozilek's Return will be in exile. The second ability on Kozilek's Return is a triggered ability. Soulfire Grand Master only gives lifelink to instant and sorcery spells on the stack, not in the graveyard. Similarly Kozilek's Return will not return to Ashley's hand as its trigger resolves, since Kozilek's Return was not cast and is not on the stack.

question: Ariel controls [Cryptolith Rite], [Mentor of the Meek] and [Sunstrike Legionnaire]. Ariel casts [Goblin War Party]. Can Ariel use Sunstrike Legionnaire to pay for Mentor of the Meek's triggers all three times?
answer_gold: Yes. When the tokens from Goblin War Party enter the battlefield, six triggers go on the stack, three to untap Sunstrike Legionnaire and three to pay {1} and draw a card from Mentor of the Meek. Ariel will then choose which order these triggers go on the stack. Ariel chooses whether they want to pay {1} when the Mentor of the Meek triggers resolve, not when they are put onto the stack. As long as Ariel chooses to have an untap occur before each of the second two Mentor of the Meek triggers, they will have enough mana available.

question: Allison controls [Vernal Equinox] and casts [Hypothesizzle]. After discarding a card but before Hypothesizzle deals four damage to a creature, Allison casts [Radiant Scrollwielder]. Will Allison gain four life?
answer_gold:
No. Hypothesizzle has a reflexive trigger. Allison chooses to discard a card as part of the resolution of Hypothesizzle, which will cause Hypothesizzle to put a trigger on the stack after it resolves that will deal four damage to a creature. To determine whether Allison would gain life as the trigger resolves, the game checks Hypothesizzle as it last existed on the stack, at which point it did not have lifelink.

(Hypothesizzle in the graveyard also doesn't have lifelink as it's not an instant or a sorcery spell, but this doesn't matter due to the rules above.)

question: Anderson casts [Beast Attack]. In response, Nylah casts [Gather Specimens]. After that resolves, but before Beast Attack resolves, Anderson casts [Crafty Cutpurse]. Who controls the token?
answer_gold: Nylah does. Gather Specimens's effect causes the Crafty Cutpurse to enter the battlefield under Nylah's control. Its effect then causes the token to be created under Nylah's control.

question: Allan has 3 [Redwood Treefolk] in their graveyard and casts [Izoni, Thousand-Eyed]. After it enters the battlefield but before its trigger resolves, Noelle activates [Scavenger Grounds] to exile all cards from Allan's graveyard. When Izoni, Thousand-Eyed's ability resolves, how many tokens will be created?
answer_gold: 0. The number of tokens to create is determined when the ability resolves, by which point the graveyard has no creatures in it.

question: Adam controls [Illusionary Mask]. Can they use it to put [Dryad Arbor] onto the battlefield face down?
answer_gold: No. Dryad Arbor has no mana cost and therefore none of it can be paid by any amount of mana. Attempting to pay an unpayable cost is an illegal action.

question: Aubrey controls [Library of Leng] and is discarding a card due to [Elaborate Firecannon]'s ability. Can they put the discarded card on top of their library? If so, what happens?
answer_gold: Yes. Discarding a cost to the ability is a cost [118.12], but that doesn't stop it from being an effect as well. Library of Leng only changes where the card moves to, not that it was discarded, so the cost was paid and the remainder of Elaborate Firecannon's ability will resolve as normal.

question: Autumn controls [Traveling Chocobo] and casts [Phyrexian Ingester]. Autumn exiles [Scarwood Goblins] and then [Tor Giant] with the triggers. What are Phyrexian Ingester's power and toughness?
answer_gold:
It's an 8/8.

The enter-the-battlefield ability of Phyrexian Ingester is part of a pair of linked abilities. When determining a value for Phyrexian Ingester's second ability, the sum of the powers and toughnesses from Scarwood Goblins and Tor Giant is used. This gives Phyrexian Ingester +5/+5, which makes it an 8/8.

question: Aaden activates [Mindslaver] targeting Norah, who controls a tapped [Time Vault]. Can Norah choose to skip their next turn with Time Vault?
answer_gold: Norah can choose to skip their turn, as skipping the turn is a replacement effect, and the choice to replace the turn with skipping the turn must be made before the turn in question begins. Norah is still in control of themself at that point, since the turn has not ended yet.

question: Abdiel is enchanted with [Wheel of Sun and Moon], and casts [Predict] naming "[Marble Diamond]". As Predict resolves Abdiel reveals Marble Diamond and puts it on the bottom of their library. Will Abdiel get to draw two cards?
answer_gold: Yes. Predict doesn't care what zone the Marble Diamond is in, only whether it's named "Marble Diamond". It's still named "Marble Diamond" in the library.

question: August controls [Essence of the Wild] and casts [Xantcha, Sleeper Agent]. What happens as it enters the battlefield?
answer_gold: It enters under Nico's control and doesn't become a copy of Essence of the Wild. As it enters the battlefield, there are two replacement effects trying to apply to that event. Since Xantcha, Sleeper Agent's effect changes under whose control it would enter, it needs to be applied first. Once it's been applied, it's now entering under Nico's control, and Essence of the Wild's effect doesn't apply to it.

question: Beverly controls [Pandemonium]. Adalynn casts [Knight Errant] and targets Beverly's [Forest Bear] with the Pandemonium trigger. In response Channing casts [Ral's Outburst] targeting Adalynn causing them to lose the game. Will Beverly's creature die?
answer_gold: The triggered ability of Pandemonium includes a choice to be made upon resolution. However the player that is supposed to make that choice is no longer in the game, therefore the controller of the trigger chooses another player to make that choice. In this case Beverly will choose another player to decide whether Pandemonium's trigger will deal damage to Forest Bear. Beverly is the controller of the trigger since they control the enchantment that generated the trigger, even though Adalynn is the player making choices about the trigger.

question: Aspen control [Pulmonic Sliver]. They cast [Dihada's Ploy], discarding [Dregscape Sliver] on resolution. Can Aspen put Dregscape Sliver on top of their library?
answer_gold: No. Pulmonic Sliver's ability affects only Sliver permanents on the battlefield, and not Sliver cards in other zones.

question: Addisyn controls [Medomai the Ageless] and casts [Savor the Moment]. Can Medomai the Ageless attack during the extra turn?
answer_gold: No. An extra turn is any turn created by a spell or ability. Medomai the Ageless cannot attack during any turn that is not a normal game turn, regardless of the source.

question: Nathanael controls [Jhoira's Toolbox]. Ainsley casts [Austere Command] choosing the modes "Destroy all creatures with mana value 3 or less." and "Destroy all artifacts." In response Nathanael activates Jhoira's Toolbox's regenerate ability on itself. What will happen when Austere Command resolves?
answer_gold: Jhoira's Toolbox will be destroyed. Regeneration is a replacement effect that prevents the object from being destroyed the next time it would be this turn. In this case the regeneration shield set up by Nathanael will prevent Jhoira's Toolbox from being destroyed as an artifact. However when Austere Command goes to destroy all creatures with mana value 3 or less, Jhoira's Toolbox is no longer protected by a regeneration shield, as it was used up in the first half of the spell, and will be destroyed at that time.

question: Adriana controls [Venerated Rotpriest] and [Spellskite]. Nelson targets the Spellskite with [Fiery Impulse]. Adriana activates Spellskite's activated ability, targeting Fiery Impulse. How many times will Venerated Rotpriest trigger?
answer_gold: Just once. Since Spellskite is already a target of Fiery Impulse, activating Spellskite's activated ability doesn't do much here. Spellskite isn't becoming a target again, because it already is a target.

question: Amaya controls [Dralnu, Lich Lord], [Furnace of Rath] and six [Snow-Covered Forest]s. Nico casts [Incinerate] targeting Dralnu, Lich Lord. If Amaya chooses to sacrifice Furnace of Rath, how many other permanents will they need to sacrifice?
answer_gold:
Two or five, Amaya's choice.

Both Dralnu, Lich Lord and Furnace of Rath have replacement effects that modify how the game handles damage that is being dealt to Dralnu, Lich Lord. As Amaya is the controller of the affected object, Amaya will choose which order to apply the replacement effects in. If Amaya chooses to apply Dralnu, Lich Lord's effect first, the 3 damage will be converted into sacrificing three permanents, and Furnace of Rath will no longer apply to that event since there's no longer any damage being dealt. If they chooses to apply Furnace of Rath first, then the three damage will be doubled to six damage, and then will be replaced by sacrificing six permanents.

Whether Amaya chooses to sacrifice Furnace of Rath or not is irrelevant, as all replacement effects are applied to the event before anything is actually sacrificed.

question: Amara controls [Colossapede] enchanted with [Metamorphic Alteration], which is making it a copy of their [Village Ironsmith]. They don't cast any spells on their turn. What will the battlefield look like after all triggers have resolved in Nico's upkeep?
answer_gold: Amara will control a transformed Village Ironsmith, and Colossapede copying the front side of Village Ironsmith, enchanted with Metamorphic Alteration. Once Metamorphic Alteration has determined the copiable characteristics of Village Ironsmith, changing Village Ironsmith won't cause Metamorphic Alteration to change Colossapede. Colossapede won't transform because it doesn't have a back face.

question: In a Two-Headed Giant game Arturo controls an [Underrealm Lich]. When Arturo and their partner draw for the draw step, may Arturo look at the partner's drawn card before making the choice from Underrealm Lich?
answer_gold: Yes, the team can decide who draws first. And, thus, Arturo may look at and consider the partner's card before making the choice from Underrealm Lich.

question: Alex casts [Explosion] with X=4 targeting Nevaeh's [Siren Stormtamer] and themselves. Before that resolves, Nevaeh activates Siren Stormtamer's ability targeting Explosion. Will Alex draw 4 cards?
answer_gold: Yes. Siren Stormtamer's ability must target a spell or ability that targets either Nevaeh or a creature they control. When Siren Stormtamer's ability begins to resolve, Explosion is no longer a spell that targets Nevaeh or a permanent that they control, so it doesn't resolve.

question: Abel attacks with [Elvish Archers]. At their first opportunity after it deals damage, they cast [Turn to Frog] targeting Elvish Archers. Will it deal 1 more damage to Nayeli?
answer_gold: No. While it's true that Elvish Archers doesn't have first strike as the second combat damage step begins, that doesn't matter. The creatures that deal damage in the second combat damage step are determined by whether they have first strike in the first combat damage step.

question: Asher casts [Show and Tell]. As it resolves, Asher wants to put [Hall of Triumph] onto the battlefield. Do they know what Noa is putting onto the battlefield while making the choice for Hall of Triumph's replacement effect?
answer_gold: Yes. Show and Tell puts both permanents onto the battlefield at the same time. Before they change zones, both players look at each card.

question: Nevaeh has [Nourishing Shoal] in their graveyard, which has flashback thanks to [Snapcaster Mage]. Can they flash it back without paying any mana?
answer_gold: No. The ability to avoid paying the mana cost is an alternative cost, same as flashback. When casting a spell, only one alternative cost can be chosen.. Since flashback is already chosen in order to allow Nourishing Shoal to be cast from the graveyard, other alternative costs can not be applied.

question: Adriel controls [Wandering Ones] equipped with [Fleetfeather Sandals]. On Nico's turn, they enchant it with [Tightening Coils]. On Adriel's next turn, they activate Fleetfeather Sandals's equip ability, targeting Wandering Ones. After that resolves, does it have flying?
answer_gold: No. Tightening Coils has the most recent timestamp, so its effect is applied last. Activating Fleetfeather Sandals's equip ability targeting Wandering Ones doesn't change its timestamp.

question: Albert and Nico are beginning the game and have just drawn 7 cards. Albert has [Serum Powder] in their hand. Does Albert get to know whether Nico is going to mulligan before deciding whether to use Serum Powder's ability?
answer_gold: No. Albert exiles their hand and draws 7 cards at the time they would normally declare if they are going to take a mulligan, which is before Nico has made that decision.

question: Ashley is beginning a game and has just drawn 7 cards. In their hand are [Leyline of Punishment] and [Serum Powder]. Can they put the Leyline of Punishment onto the battlefield and then use Serum Powder's ability?
answer_gold: No. The mulligan process is completed before opening hand actions like that of Leyline of Punishment are taken.

question: Alayna controls [Wall of Shadows]. Can Nickolas target it with the first mode of [Chaos Charm]?
answer_gold: No. Wall of Shadows's restriction applies while choosing targets for Chaos Charm. At that time, the mode for Chaos Charm has already been chosen, so it can only target Walls.

question: Ariana controls [Sen Triplets], which targeted Nico. Nico's hand contains [Rift Sower]. Can either player suspend it? If so, who will cast it once the last time counter is removed?
answer_gold: Neither player can suspend it. Only a card's owner has the option to suspend it, and only if they have permission to cast it.

question: Ari controls [Bludgeon Brawl] and [Soldevi Digger]. They cast [Titania's Song]. Once it resolves, what are the characteristics of Soldevi Digger?
answer_gold: It's a 2/2 artifact creature with no abilities. Applying Titania's Song would cause Bludgeon Brawl to no longer apply (since Soldevi Digger would be a creature). However, applying Bludgeon Brawl would not change how Titania's Song's effect is applied, so Bludgeon Brawl is dependent on Titania's Song. Titania's Song applies first, and then Bludgeon Brawl won't affect Soldevi Digger since it's a creature.

question: Adelynn controls [Volrath's Shapeshifter]. The top card of their graveyard is [Stinging Licid]. They activate its ability to become an Aura, targeting Nico's [Kalakscion, Hunger Tyrant]. What happens?
answer_gold: Volrath's Shapeshifter becomes attached to Kalakscion, Hunger Tyrant. It has the characteristics of Stinging Licid, except without its activated ability and it's an Aura enchantment with enchant creature and the text "{2}: Discard a card.". If the top card of Adelynn's graveyard changes, the base characteristics of Volrath's Shapeshifter will change to match, but the Licid's continuous effect is still applying to it, so it will still be an Aura with enchant creature.

question: During Ainsley's turn, Nathaly casts [Summoner's Pact]. After it resolves, Ainsley uses [Mindslaver] to take control of Nathaly's next turn. During Nathaly's next upkeep, can Ainsley choose not to pay for Summoner's Pact?
answer_gold: In normal situations, yes. If Nathaly has the mana availablein their mana pool they have to spend it, but if not they can choose not to tap any lands.

question: Alex activates [Horror of the Dim]'s ability. After that resolves, Nathaniel activates [Detection Tower]. After that resolves, Alex activates Horror of the Dims ability again. After that resolves, can Nathaniel target Horror of the Dim?
answer_gold: Yes. Detection Tower doesn't cause Horror of the Dim to lose hexproof, it simply allows Nathaniel to treat creatures that have hexproof as if they did not have hexproof.

question: Aubrey and Amiya are playing a 2HG game against Nico and Nathalie. Nico controls [Crimson Kobolds] and Nathalie controls [Minecart Daredevil]. Aubrey attacks with [Siege Dragon]. Which creatures are dealt two damage?
answer_gold: As Aubrey declares attackers, they choose which opponent Siege Dragon is attacking. Siege Dragon's trigger will deal damage to that player's creatures.

question: Addison casts [Glorious End]. After it has resolved, what zone is it in?
answer_gold: Exile. "Ending the turn" includes exiling all spells that are currently on the stack. Glorious End remains on the stack as it resolves.

question: Alex controls [Gaea's Herald] and casts [Aegis Turtle]. Before that resolves Neil casts [Spell Queller] targeting Aegis Turtle. What happens to Aegis Turtle?
answer_gold: Aegis Turtle will be exiled and will not resolve. Spell Queller does not "counter" Aegis Turtle so the "can't be countered" clause won't do anything.

question: Ari casts [Rockshard Elemental] morphed. Can Nolan counter it with [Disdainful Stroke]?
answer_gold: No. A face-down spell on the stack has mana value 0, no matter how much mana was paid for it or what its face-up mana cost would be.

question: Anahi casts [Incinerate] targeting Nico. Before that resolves, Nico taps their [Taiga] for mana. Can Anahi cast another spell before Incinerate resolves?
answer_gold: Yes. Priority will return to Nico after Taiga's ability resolves. The game will not move forward until all players have passed in succession without any actions taking place in between, even actions that don't use the stack. Therefore after Nico gets priority, if they do nothing with it, priority will return to Anahi.

question: Adalyn casts [Wizard's Lightning] targeting Nico. After that resolves, Adalyn casts [Mind's Desire] and reveals [Raff, Weatherlight Stalwart] with the storm copy. Can Adalyn cast it before the original Mind's Desire resolves?
answer_gold: No. Mind's Desire allows Adalyn to cast the exiled card for free as an alternative cost until the end of the turn.
