However it doesn't allow Adalyn to cast the card at a time when they normally would not be able to cast the card, as Mind's Desire doesn't instruct them to cast the spell upon resolution. Creatures can only be cast during the active players main phase, while the stack is empty.

question: Avery would like to cast [Dream Fracture] targeting itself, can they?
answer_gold: No. A spell on the stack is never a legal target for itself.

question: Ari casts [Memories Returning]. Does Noor have a chance to exile it with [Dawnhand Dissident] before Ari can cast Memories Returning again for its flashback cost?
answer_gold:
No. After Memories Returning resolves, Ari receives priority.. At this point, Memories Returning is in the graveyard, and they can choose to cast it again. When it's cast, it goes from the graveyard to the stack. Noor does not receive priority until after Memories Returning is on the stack, so Memories Returning can't be exiled with Dawnhand Dissident.

(Unless there's something else on the battlefield that would create a triggered ability when Memories Returning resolves. In that case, Ari wouldn't be able to cast Memories Returning until the trigger has left the stack, and Noor could exile it in response to the trigger.)

question: Ariah controls [Wayward Angel] and has 7 cards in their graveyard. Nickolas casts [Turn to Frog], targeting Wayward Angel. What are Wayward Angel's characteristics after Turn to Frog resolves?
answer_gold: It's a 4/4 blue Frog with no abilities. Wayward Angel's last ability begins to apply in layer 5. It's removed by Turn to Frog in layer 6, but since it's already started to apply, it will continue doing so in later layers. Wayward Angel has the earlier timestamp, so it gives itself trample and "At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature" before Turn to Frog removes its abilities in layer 6.

question: Addilynn activates the Unearth ability of their [Extractor Demon], returning it to the battlefield. Before their end step, Addilynn casts [Reality Ripple] targeting Extractor Demon. What happens to it?
answer_gold: Extractor Demon phases out. When the unearth trigger resolves during Addilynn's end step, it won't be exiled. It will phase back in during Addilynn's next untap step, after which point it will be exiled instead of being put anywhere else if it would leave the battlefield.

question: Ariella controls a manifested [Wayward Angel] and has 7 cards in their graveyard. Nathaniel casts [Turn to Frog], targeting Wayward Angel. After that resolves, Ariella turns Wayward Angel face up. What are Wayward Angel's characteristics afterwards?
answer_gold: It's a 4/4 black Frog with trample and "At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature", but no other abilities. Wayward Angel receives a new timestamp when it turns face up, so its ability is applied before Turn to Frog in each layer. Wayward Angel's last ability is removed by Turn to Frog in layer 6, but since it's already started to apply in layer 5 to change its color to black, it will continue doing so in later layers. Turn to Frog has the earlier timestamp, so it makes Wayward Angel blue before it becomes black in layer 5 and removes Wayward Angel's abilities in layer 6 before it gains trample and "At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature".

question: Ahmad controls [Conspiracy] (naming "Ferret"), [Kormus Bell], [Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth], and a [Vastwood Zendikon] enchanting Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth that entered the battlefield in that order. Is Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth a creature? If so, what are its creature types?
answer_gold: It is an Elemental Ferret creature. Conspiracy has the earliest timestamp, but it's dependent on Vastwood Zendikon, and waits to apply until after Vastwood Zendikon is applied. Kormus Bell is dependent on Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth, so Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth is applied first, then Kormus Bell. At this point Conspiracy is no longer be dependent on Vastwood Zendikon, so Conspiracy is applied, and then Vastwood Zendikon. Since Vastwood Zendikon says that Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth is still a land, it retains its prior creature type of "Ferret" when it becomes an Elemental.

question: Andre controls [Raugrin Triome] and [Prismatic Omen]. Nala casts [Blood Moon]. After it resolves, what land types does Raugrin Triome have?
answer_gold: Just Mountain. Blood Moon and Prismatic Omen's effects are not dependent on each other, so they are applied in timestamp order.

question: Ariel controls [Frostboil Snarl] and [Blood Moon]. They cast [Prismatic Omen]. After it resolves, what land types does Frostboil Snarl have?
answer_gold: All 5. Prismatic Omen and Blood Moon's effects are not dependent on each other, so they are are applied in timestamp order.

question: Ariel controls [Hydra Trainer] with no counters on it and activates its adapt ability. Before that resolves Ariel casts [Stony Strength] targeting Hydra Trainer. What will happen when the adapt ability resolves?
answer_gold: The adapt ability will resolve and do nothing. While the adapt ability is resolving it will check to see if the permanent it's resolving on has any counters. If it has counters at this point, the ability will not put additional counters on the creature.

question: Alessandro control [Domri, Chaos Bringer], activates the +1 ability, and uses this mana as part of the casting cost for [Ravager Wurm]. What happens to Ravager Wurm?
answer_gold: If a permanent has multiple instances of riot, each works separately. ([702.136b]) If Alessandro choses haste for each instance of riot, there is no functional game impact but it does "send a message".

question: Aaden, Brenna, and Campbell are playing a multiplayer game. Aaden controls [Extractor Demon] and Brenna controls [Centaur Courser]. Aaden attacks Brenna and they lose the game. Does Extractor Demon trigger?
answer_gold: Yes. The game cares about the game state immediately before Brenna left the game. At that point, Centaur Courser was on the battlefield.

question: Anika attacks with [Thornhide Wolves]. Neymar blocks it with a creature equipped with [Godsend] and chooses to exile Thornhide Wolves. Anika casts [Pull from Eternity] and puts Thornhide Wolves into their graveyard. Can Anika cast another Thornhide Wolves?
answer_gold: Yes. "Exiled" in this context is referring to cards that are currently in the exile zone, regardless of whether they were at one point "exiled".

question: Adelynn controls [Archetype of Imagination] and [Merfolk of the Pearl Trident]. Nico casts [Sagittars' Volley] targeting Archetype of Imagination. Will Merfolk of the Pearl Trident be dealt damage?
answer_gold: No. Sagittars' Volley will carry out its instructions in the order written on the card. First, Sagittars' Volley will destroy Archetype of Imagination, then it will deal one damage to each creature with flying that Adelynn controls. At this time, Adelynn controls no creatures with flying as the continuous effect that was granting Merfolk of the Pearl Trident flying is no longer on the battlefield.

question: Avery controls [Vhal, Candlekeep Researcher] and Natalie controls [Verity Circle] and [Koskun Falls]. Avery attacks Natalie with Vhal, Candlekeep Researcher, and then taps it to pay for the cost required by Koskun Falls. Will Natalie's Verity Circle trigger?
answer_gold: No. Verity Circle triggers only if the creature being tapped is not being declared as an attacker. Declaring an attacker is a multi-step process, some of which involve determining costs, activating mana abilities, and paying for costs. Therefore, tapping Vhal, Candlekeep Researcher to pay for the cost required by Koskun Falls is part of declaring it as an attacker.

question: Neriah controls [Wrenn and Seven] and has nine cards in their hand. During Aydan's turn, they cast [Banishing Light] targeting Wrenn and Seven. When will Neriah have to discard for hand size?
answer_gold: Neriah will have to discard down to their max hand size during their cleanup step.

question: Nehemiah controls [Narwhal] and casts [Impractical Joke]. After that resolves, Aitana casts [Pyroclasm] to deal 2 damage to each creature. Will Narwhal die?
answer_gold: Yes. Protection specifies that any damage dealt by sources that the permanent is protected from will be prevented. However Impractical Joke states that damage can't be prevented. Whenever two cards are instructing a player to do contrary things, the "can't" effect takes precedence.

question: Abby casts [Time Stretch]. Can they choose to skip both extra turns with [Time Vault]?
answer_gold: Yes. As their turn ends, they can apply Time Vault's replacement effect, which means the next turn gets skipped and Time Vault gets untapped as part of the next turn that actually happens. Then, since it's still tapped as Abby's turn is ending, they can choose to skip the next turn again.

question: Aliana controls [Kalakscion, Hunger Tyrant] equipped with [Helm of the Host] and [Mirror Gallery]. When Aliana goes to combat, what will the token look like?
answer_gold: The token created will be a copy of Kalakscion, Hunger Tyrant except it won't be legendary. Mirror Gallery doesn't impact whether Kalakscion, Hunger Tyrant is legendary or not, it simply allows Aliana to control two or more legendary permanents with the same name without Aliana having to put one in their graveyard.

question: Adan restarts the game with [Karn Liberated]. Adan puts [Blood Moon], [Prismatic Omen] and [Winged Temple of Orazca] onto the battlefield with Karn Liberated. What colors of mana can Winged Temple of Orazca tap for?
answer_gold: Adan gets to choose their relative timestamp order as they are put onto the battlefield. Winged Temple of Orazca will either be able to tap for any color or just {R} depending on Adan's choice.

question: In a multiplayer game, Ares casts [Midnight Mayhem] and before it resolves, Blaine casts [Crafty Cutpurse]. Ares creates the tokens and they enter the battlefield under Blaine's control. Ares leaves the game. What happens to the tokens?
answer_gold: The tokens would leave the game. A token is owned by the player who creates it, so even though it entered the battlefield under Blaine's control, it is owned by Ares. When a player leaves the game, all objects owned by that player leave the game as well.

question: Ahmed controls [March of the Machines] and [Mycosynth Lattice] and casts [Arachnoform] targeting their [Phyrexian Walker]. What will happen when Arachnoform resolves?
answer_gold: Arachnoform cannot legally enchant anything, so it will be put directly into its owners graveyard.

question: Alonzo controls [Quicksilver, Speedster]. Can Alonzo play [Darksteel Citadel] during an opponent's turn?
answer_gold: No. Quicksilver, Speedster allows Alonzo to cast spells as though they had flash. Playing a land is not the same as casting a spell.

question: Adeline controls [Trollbred Guardian] with two +1/+1 counters on it. Nico controls [Soul-Scar Mage] and casts [Burst Lightning] targeting Trollbred Guardian. After Burst Lightning resolves, can Trollbred Guardian adapt again?
answer_gold: Yes. If a permanent has both -1/-1 and +1/+1 counters on it, they are removed as a state-based action. Adapt checks the number of +1/+1 counters on Trollbred Guardian as it resolves, it doesn't matter if it's been activated in the past.

question: Amber is playing commander and on their first turn they cast [Serra Ascendant]. What is its power and toughness?
answer_gold: 6/6. The starting life total in commander is 40.

question: Antonio controls [Festering Thicket], two [Island]s, [Snow-Covered Mountain], and [Wastes]. They cast [Exotic Disease]. What is the value of X?
answer_gold: 4. Subtypes are listed on the type line of the card after a long dash, so Snow-Covered Mountain has a basic land type of "Mountain" and Wastes has no basic land types. "Snow" is a supertype, not a type. Exotic Disease is looking for the number of distinct subtypes among all permanents Antonio controls, regardless of how many permanents those subtypes are on.

question: Aspen controls [Soul-Scar Mage] and casts [Soul Burn] with X = 2 targeting Nora's [Cylian Elf]. (Spending {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.) How much life does Aspen gain?
answer_gold: 0. Soul-Scar Mage replaces the damage with -1/-1 counters, so no damage was dealt. Aspen can't gain more than 0 life.

question: Ashley controls a 0/1 red Elemental creature token that was created by [Rekindling Phoenix]. Ashley has no Rekindling Phoenix in their graveyard. What will happen during Ashley's upkeep?
answer_gold: The trigger will go on the stack, however no legal targets can be chosen for it, so it will be immediately removed from the stack. The token will not be sacrificed.

question: Amirah controls [Divine Visitation] and [Legion Warboss]. What are the characteristics of the token after Legion Warboss's trigger has resolved? Does it have to attack this combat?
answer_gold:
A 4/4 Angel with flying, vigilance and haste. It is required to attack this combat if able. 

Divine Visitation creates a replacement effect that replaces Legion Warboss's token with a different token. After it's created as a 4/4 Angel, it gains haste and an effect is created that requires it to attack.

question: Arlo casts [Zoetic Cavern] face-down. In response, Nico casts [Delay] targeting the face-down spell. What happens?
answer_gold: Just like for any other spell, Zoetic Cavern is countered, exiled face-up with three time counters and gains suspend. In Arlo's upkeep three turns later, they can play it as their land for the turn.

question: Amaris controls a 1/1 Saproling token. Nico casts [Chaos Warp] targeting the token, and the token ends up on top of Amaris's library after the shuffle. What happens as Chaos Warp continues resolving?
answer_gold: Amaris reveals the top card of their library. Tokens aren't cards, so this will be the object directly below the Saproling. After Chaos Warp finishes resolving, the token will cease to exist.

question: Ariel controls a token that's a copy of [Golgari Brownscale] due to [Mirrorweave]. They cast  [Slay] targeting Golgari Brownscale. What happens if Ariel tries to replace the card draw with dredging the token?
answer_gold: This can't happen as described. The token ceases to be a copy of Golgari Brownscale as soon as it moves to the graveyard. It doesn't have dredge.

question: Anastasia explores using [Jadelight Ranger]. The first explore reveals [Blightsteel Colossus]. Anastasia chooses to put Blightsteel Colossus into their graveyard. Does Blightsteel Colossus shuffle into the deck before Jadelight Ranger explores a second time?
answer_gold: Yes, Blightsteel Colossus shuffles back into the deck before the second explore happens. Blightsteel Colossus has a replacement effect, which means that if it would go to a graveyard, instead its owner shuffles it into their library.

question: Nico controls [Gaddock Teeg]. Alani has [Conflagrate] in their graveyard. Can they cast it for its flashback cost?
answer_gold: No. Even though Alani is not paying {X} with mana, Conflagrate still has an {X} in its mana cost and is therefore not able to be cast due to Gaddock Teeg's second ability.

question: Adrien controls [Blinkmoth Nexus]. They animate it and then activate its second ability to give it +1/+1 until end of turn. After that resolves Naomi casts [Blur of Blades] targeting Blinkmoth Nexus. What will happen to Blinkmoth Nexus at the end of the turn?
answer_gold: Blinkmoth Nexus stops being a creature at the same time as it stops getting +1/+1. It will simply be a land on the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter. If Adrien animates it again, it will die immediately.

question: Alvin attacks with [Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet] and Nathalia blocks with [Blim, Comedic Genius]. What happens to it?
answer_gold: Blim, Comedic Genius is exiled and Alvin creates a 2/2 Zombie. Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet's ability creates a replacement effect, which applies to future events immediately before they happen. Since Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet and Blim, Comedic Genius are dying at the same time, Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet's effect can apply to that event.

question: Abdullah controls [City of Brass] and is at 1 life. They would like to cast [Stunning Reversal] without losing the game. Can they?
answer_gold:
Yes. The damaging ability of City of Brass is a trigger and as such goes on the stack when City of Brass is activated. However, since the activated ability of City of Brass is a mana ability, it does not go on the stack and instead is resolved instantly. This means that when Abdullah activates the mana ability of City of Brass, they will get one mana, then the triggered ability goes on the stack. With their newfound mana, they can cast Stunning Reversal in response to the trigger. 

If instead Abdullah decided to first cast Stunning Reversal and activates City of Brass during the casting process, they would lose the game as the triggered ability would go on the stack above Stunning Reversal and resolve first.

question: Alex controls [Mox Opal] and [Reconstructed Thopter]. Alex casts another Mox Opal. After it resolves, can they tap it for mana before it's put into their graveyard?
answer_gold: No. Alex is allowed to activate mana abilities any time they have priority or right before the game requires any mana payment. Putting Mox Opal into the graveyard is a state-based action, which is performed before any player receives priority.

question: Nico controls [Russet Wolves] enchanted with [Treefolk Umbra]. Arely casts [Diabolic Edict] to make Nico sacrifice a creature. Does umbra armor save it?
answer_gold: No, umbra armor only replaces destruction. Sacrificing a creature is not the same as destroying it.

question: Nylah controls [Thorn of Amethyst] and [Chalice of the Void] with one charge counter on it. Ayden casts [Shivan Fire], paying the additional {1} for Thorn of Amethyst. Will Chalice of the Void trigger?
answer_gold: Yes. The mana value of a card is derived from what's printed in the upper right-hand corner of the card. The mana value of Shivan Fire is 1, regardless of how much Ayden spent to cast it.

question: Nicholas controls [Meddling Mage], naming "[Ogre Resister]". Can Ariel cast [Sakashima the Impostor], copying an Ogre Resister on the battlefield?
answer_gold: Yes. Sakashima the Impostor is named "Sakashima the Impostor" as it's cast, so Meddling Mage doesn't affect it. It only becomes a copy of Ogre Resister as it enters the battlefield. That isn't casting a spell, so Meddling Mage doesn't affect that either.

question: Nico controls [Wicker Witch] enchanted with [Spider Umbra]. Alexzander casts [Anger of the Gods]. What happens?
answer_gold: Spider Umbra is destroyed and moves to the graveyard. Wicker Witch remains on the battlefield. If it would die later in the turn, it'll be exiled instead. Spider Umbra's effect replaces the "destroy" event while Anger of the Gods's effect replaces the "die" event, so Spider Umbra has to be applied first.

question: Ashley casts [Desperate Ritual] and would like to use the mana it generates to splice another Desperate Ritual onto it. Can they do this?
answer_gold: No. Ashley chooses whether they are splicing anything onto Desperate Ritual and then pays its cost as Desperate Ritual is cast. It only resolves and adds {R}{R}{R} afterwards.

question: Aya controls [Cast Through Time] and casts [Mind Spring] and then [Mystic Retrieval]. On their next turn, can they rebound Mind Spring and Mystic Retrieval, getting back the Mind Spring to their hand?
answer_gold: Yes. Both rebound triggers are put on the stack at the beginning of Aya's upkeep, so Aya may choose in what order to put them onto the stack. If Aya puts the Mind Spring trigger onto the stack second so that it resolves first, it will be in the graveyard by the time the other trigger casts Mystic Retrieval.

question: Ari has controlled [Willow Elf] enchanted with [Nyxborn Hydra] since their last turn. Nathan casts [Nocturnal Hunger] targeting Willow Elf. After Nocturnal Hunger resolves and Willow Elf is put into Ari's graveyard, can Ari attack with Nyxborn Hydra?
answer_gold: Yes. Ari has controlled Nyxborn Hydra continuously since their most recent turn began, so it can attack.

question: Adrien has an instant card and a sorcery card in their graveyard. They attack with [Tarmogoyf], and Nico blocks with [Sigiled Contender] and [Blex, Vexing Pest]. Adrien casts [Lightning Bolt] to kill Sigiled Contender, Nico responds with [Mutagenic Growth] targeting Sigiled Contender, and Adrien counters it with [Electrosiphon]. Does Tarmogoyf survive?
answer_gold: Yes. What doesn't grow, dies. And what dies grows the Tarmogoyf.

question: Alex controls [Baral, Chief of Compliance]. Nicholas casts [Ral's Outburst] and then [Annihilating Fire]. In response to both, Alex casts [Whirlwind Denial], countering both of them. How many times does Baral, Chief of Compliance's second ability trigger?
answer_gold: Twice. Baral, Chief of Compliance's trigger condition is watching for whenever one of Alex's spells or abilities counters a spell, which happens twice upon the resolution of Whirlwind Denial.

question: Andy casts [Purphoros's Emissary] targeting [Ashen Monstrosity]. In response Nylah resolves a [Betrayal of Flesh] destroying Ashen Monstrosity. Can Purphoros's Emissary be countered by a [Silumgar's Command]?
answer_gold: Yes. A bestow card cast with bestow is an Aura enchantment on the stack. ([702.103b])

question: Aarush controls a tapped [Armored Warhorse] enchanted by [Boar Umbra]. They casts [Fumigate]. Do they gain any life?
answer_gold: No. There were no creatures "destroyed this way".

question: Anders casts [Shining Shoal] with X=1, choosing [Sulfurous Springs] as the source of damage and Noa as the target. Anders taps Sulfurous Springs for {R}. Is Noa dealt 1 damage?
answer_gold: Yes. The damage is redirected to Noa. It doesn't matter that it's coming from a source Anders controls.

question: Nathalie controls [Yuna, Hope of Spira], which is their commander, and no other permanents. Alvin casts [Warp World]. Nathalie chooses to put Yuna, Hope of Spira into the command zone instead of their library. How many cards does Nathalie reveal as Warp World continues resolving?
answer_gold: One. The "that many" on Warp World is referring to the number of permanents the player in question owned, not the number that entered the library.

question: Ahmed attacks with [Evil Eye of Urborg]. Nico declares no blocks and then casts [Curtain of Light] targeting Evil Eye of Urborg. Does Evil Eye of Urborg trigger?
answer_gold: No. Evil Eye of Urborg became blocked, but not by any creatures.

question: Nico controls [Leyline of Anticipation] and casts [Show and Tell]. As it resolves, Abdiel wants to put [Throne of Eldraine] onto the battlefield. Do they know what Nico is putting onto the battlefield while making the choice for Throne of Eldraine's replacement effect?
answer_gold: Yes. Show and Tell puts both permanents onto the battlefield at the same time. Before they change zones, both players look at each card.

question: Aliana controls [Hazezon Tamar] and [Bloodline Pretender]. Nikolai casts [Unlicensed Disintegration] targeting Hazezon Tamar. Does Bloodline Pretender get exiled by Hazezon Tamar's trigger?
answer_gold: Yes. It's a Sand and a Warrior.

question: Nico controls [Ironroot Treefolk]. Ansley casts [Raging Swordtooth]. After it resolves, while its triggered ability is on the stack, they cast [Bladebrand] targeting Raging Swordtooth. Does Ironroot Treefolk die when Raging Swordtooth's trigger resolves?
answer_gold: Yes. Ironroot Treefolk is dealt one damage, the source of which is Raging Swordtooth. At the point of dealing the damage, Raging Swordtooth has deathtouch, so Ironroot Treefolk is dealt 1 point of damage from a source with deathtouch. When SBAs are checked, Ironroot Treefolk is destroyed.

question: Aspen casts [Hostage Taker] and exiles Noel's [Bonebreaker Giant]. On Noel's turn, they take control of Hostage Taker with [Traitorous Blood]. Can Noel cast Bonebreaker Giant?
answer_gold: No. The effect that allows Aspen to cast Bonebreaker Giant was created by Hostage Taker's trigger when it resolved. Aspen controlled the trigger when it resolves, so changing control of Hostage Taker won't change who can cast Bonebreaker Giant.

question: Adrien controls 5 artifacts and activates [Tezzeret, Master of the Bridge]'s +2 ability. Noemi casts [Petty Theft] in response, sending one of Adrien's artifacts back to their hand. How much life does Adrien gain?
answer_gold: Adrien will gain 4 life when Tezzeret's ability resolves, because the ability counts the number of artifacts they control on resolution, not on activation.

question: Axl controls [Immolation Shaman]. Nico taps [Jhessian Lookout] to crew [Sleek Schooner]. Does Immolation Shaman trigger?
answer_gold: Yes. Crew is an activated ability of an artifact ([702.122a]), and is not a mana ability. Therefore activating it satisfies the trigger condition on Immolation Shaman.

question: Aspen controls [Pyromancer Ascension] and has [Thirst for Meaning] in their graveyard. Aspen casts a second Thirst for Meaning from their hand. At Nathalie's first opportunity, they activate [Lantern of the Lost] to exile Aspen's graveyard. Will Pyromancer Ascension get a quest counter?
answer_gold: Yes. Pyromancer Ascension triggers when Thirst for Meaning is cast. The trigger doesn't check to see if the trigger state is still true upon resolution.

question: Ashley attacks with [Steadfast Armasaur]. Nicolas blocks with [Giant Cockroach]. Ashley activates Steadfast Armasaur's ability targeting Giant Cockroach. Before that resolves, Nicolas casts [Wrecking Ball] targeting Steadfast Armasaur. What will happen to Giant Cockroach as Steadfast Armasaur's ability resolves?
answer_gold: It will be dealt 3 damage. Since Steadfast Armasaur is no longer on the battlefield when its ability resolves, its last known information is used to determine that it was blocked by Giant Cockroach.

question: Nico controls [Meng Huo's Horde] and Alondra controls no creatures. Alondra casts [Loxodon Convert]. In response to Loxodon Convert, Nico casts [Unified Will] targeting Loxodon Convert. When Unified Will resolves, will Loxodon Convert be countered?
answer_gold: Yes. Loxodon Convert on the stack is not a creature, it's a creature spell. It is not counted towards Unified Will.

question: Annika controls [Pyromancer Ascension] and has no cards in their graveyard. They cast [Sazacap's Brew], discarding another Sazacap's Brew as an additional cost. Will Pyromancer Ascension trigger?
answer_gold: Yes. A spell is only "cast" once all the steps of casting it are concluded. One of the steps is to pay for all the costs, so the discarded Sazacap's Brew is already in the graveyard when Sazacap's Brew counts as having been cast and will trigger Pyromancer Ascension.

question: Aubrey controls [Eruth, Tormented Prophet] and, during their draw step, they attempt to dredge [Shambling Shell]. What happens?
answer_gold: Aubrey can dredge Shambling Shell instead of drawing. There are two replacement effects attempting to replace Aubrey's draw. Since they are the affected player, they choose whether to exile the card with Eruth, Tormented Prophet or dredge with Shambling Shell. Once one of the replacement effects has been applied, the "draw" event no longer exists, and the other replacement effect does not apply.

question: Aubrey and Arely are playing 2HG. Aubrey attacks with [Coral Commando] and Arely casts [Flash Conscription] to gain control of Coral Commando after it's been declared as an attacker in the declare attackers step. Is it still attacking?
answer_gold: No. A creature that changes controllers is removed from combat. Even though Aubrey and Arely are on the same team and are both allowed to be attacking with creatures, they are different players and therefore Arely gaining control of Aubrey's creature still qualifies as a control change.

question: Alonso controls [Serra Zealot] and [Trained Orgg]. Alonso attacks with both creatures, and after Serra Zealot has dealt its damage Nico casts [Thunder Strike] targeting Trained Orgg. Will Trained Orgg deal damage this turn?
answer_gold: Yes. As the combat damage step begins, the game checks to see if there are any creatures in combat that have either first strike or double strike. If there are, it generates an additional combat damage step. In the first one, only creatures with first strike or double strike will deal damage. In the second combat damage step, the creatures that deal damage are the ones that didn't have either first strike or double strike as the first combat damage step began. Trained Orgg gained first strike after the first combat damage step began, and therefore will still deal damage in the second one.

question: Avery controls [Mindlock Orb]. Nora casts [Assassin's Trophy] targeting Mindlock Orb. Can Avery search for a land?
answer_gold: Yes. The text on Assassin's Trophy resolves in the order that it is printed. In this case it means that Mindlock Orb is destroyed, and then Avery searches for a land, because at this point the continuous effect generated by Mindlock Orb is no longer in existence preventing the search.

question: Nasir controls [Authority of the Consuls]. Anabelle controls [Obelisk of Bant] and casts [Clever Impersonator]. If Anabelle chooses to copy Obelisk of Bant with Clever Impersonator, will it enter the battlefield tapped or untapped?
answer_gold: Untapped. As Clever Impersonator resolves, there are two replacement effects trying to apply to it, and its own effect must be applied first. After that effect has been applied, Clever Impersonator would no longer be a creature on the battlefield, so Authority of the Consuls's effect no longer applies to it.

question: Ari controls a [Thespian's Stage] that's a copy of [Glacial Chasm] due to its own ability. During Ari's upkeep, in response to Thespian's Stage's triggered ability, Ari activates Thespian's Stage targeting [Snow-Covered Plains]. Will Ari still have to pay 2 life or sacrifice Thespian's Stage?
answer_gold: Yes. While Thespian's Stage may have changed into a copy of Snow-Covered Plains, it is still the same permanent. When the ability resolves Ari will put an age counter on Thespian's Stage and then choose whether or not to sacrifice it or pay 2 life to keep it on the battlefield.

question: Aubrey casts [Show and Tell]. As it resolves, they plan to put [Griselbrand] onto the battlefield. Naomi is going to put [Pithing Needle] onto the battlefield. Does Naomi get to know that Aubrey has chosen Griselbrand before naming a card with Pithing Needle?
answer_gold: Yes. Choosing cards to put onto the battlefield with Show and Tell is done in secret, but these cards must then be revealed before they are put onto the battlefield so that any replacement effects can be applied to that event.

question: Nico controls [Axebane Stag]. Analia casts [Flickerwisp] and targets Axebane Stag with its triggered ability. At the beginning of Analia's end step, Analia puts Flickerwisp's delayed trigger onto the stack. In response, Nico casts [Trickbind] targeting the trigger. What happens to Axebane Stag?
answer_gold: Axebane Stag will stay in exile indefinitely. When Flickerwisp's ability resolved, it created a delayed trigger to return Axebane Stag to the battlefield at the beginning of the next end step. This delayed trigger only triggers once, regardless of whether it resolves or not.

question: Alex attacks with [Scorch Spitter]. Before Scorch Spitter's trigger resolves, Noah casts [Scour from Existence] targeting Scorch Spitter. Will Noah still take damage when Scorch Spitter's ability resolves?
answer_gold: Yes. Scorch Spitter's trigger will still resolve even if Scorch Spitter is no longer on the battlefield. When the trigger resolves, the game will check the last known information of Scorch Spitter and see that it was attacking Noah.

question: Axel controls [Vastwood Gorger] and attacks Nico's [Teferi, Who Slows the Sunset]. Before damage is dealt, Nico activates [Barrin, Master Wizard], sacrificing Teferi, Who Slows the Sunset. Does Vastwood Gorger deal damage? If so, to what?
answer_gold: No, Vastwood Gorger does not deal any combat damage. When combat damage would be assigned, a creature that is not currently attacking anything does not deal combat damage.

question: Aiden casts [Runed Halo]. Can they use it to gain protection from the Illusion tokens created by Neriah's [Mysterio's Mirage]?
answer_gold: No. The token's name is "Illusion Token", which is not the name of a card.

question: Amari, Braylee, and Charlie are playing a multiplayer game. Braylee controls [Mons's Goblin Raiders] owned by Amari due to a previously cast [Gather Specimens]. Amari attacks Braylee and they loses the game. What happens to Mons's Goblin Raiders?
answer_gold: It's exiled. Gather Specimens doesn't generate any control-changing continuous effects, it simply changes under whose control the Mons's Goblin Raiders enters the battlefield. Therefore Braylee still controls it after control-changing effects end as part of the process in [800.4a], and it's exiled.

question: Anderson controls [Vizzerdrix]. Nico casts [Bleeding Edge] targeting Vizzerdrix. In response Anderson casts [Burnt Offering], sacrificing Vizzerdrix. Will Nico still amass 2?
answer_gold: No, Nico will not amass. While Bleeding Edge does allow Nico to pick zero targets, this choice is made as the spell is being cast. Once Nico has determined that Bleeding Edge is a targeted spell, if all its targets become illegal before it resolves, it will be removed from the stack and none of its instructions will occur.

question: Amari casts [Solitary Confinement]. After that resolves, they cast [Command the Dreadhorde] targeting [Draco] and [Reaper King]. Do they enter the battlefield, and does Amari lose any life?
answer_gold: They enter the battlefield and Amari loses 0 life. Solitary Confinement prevents the damage that Command the Dreadhorde would deal, but the rest of the spell's instructions are still carried out.

question: Nicolas controls [Razorfield Thresher], [Lake of the Dead], and [Veinfire Borderpost]. Aubrey controls [Omniscience] and casts [Casualties of War], choosing Razorfield Thresher as the artifact target and the creature target. Then they cast [Radiate], targeting Casualties of War. What will be destroyed after all spells and abilities have resolved?
answer_gold: Both Razorfield Thresher and Veinfire Borderpost will be destroyed but no other cards will be destroyed. Once Casualties of War is on the stack, it's a spell with modes that have been locked in, so that the only permanents it can target are artifacts and creatures.

question: Ally controls [Leyline of Vitality] and a [Clever Impersonator] that isn't a copy of anything. Ally casts [Spark Double] and chooses to copy Clever Impersonator as it enters the battlefield, then chooses to copy Leyline of Vitality. Does it enter with a +1/+1 counter?
answer_gold: No. Applying Clever Impersonator's effect after applying Spark Double's effect causes the counter from Spark Double's effect to go away.

question: Annabel casts [Genesis Wave], revealing [Bioessence Hydra] and [Jace, the Mind Sculptor]. How many counters will Bioessence Hydra have after everything has resolved?
answer_gold: Three. Bioessence Hydra's first ability is a replacement effect that modifies how it enters the battlefield, and won't take into account other permanents entering the battlefield with it. After it enters the battlefield, the game checks to see if anything has triggered and it sees that three loyalty counters were put on Jace, the Mind Sculptor as it entered the battlefield.

question: Alex controls [Grave Pact] and three [Bogstomper]s. Nico controls three [Ogre Resister]s and casts [Dread Cacodemon]. After that resolves how many creatures will Nico have to sacrifice?
answer_gold: Three. When Dread Cacodemon resolves, it will cause Grave Pact to trigger three times. Even though it was a single event that caused Alex's creatures to die, Grave Pact sees each instance of a creature dying as a separate trigger event.

question: Ariel wants to participate in a sanctioned Magic tournament, but doesn't know where to find one. To which section of the comprehensive rules should they refer?
Abram casts [Lightning Bolt] targeting Nola. As it resolves, can Abram choose to deal the damage to Nola's [Vivien Reid]?
answer_gold: No. Lightning Bolt deals damage to its target, Nola. There is no rule that allows damage dealt to a player to be redirected to a planeswalker.

question: Amare controls [Psychogenic Probe] and casts [Pain], targeting Nico. They discard a [Progenitus]. Does Psychogenic Probe trigger?
answer_gold: Yes. Progenitus's replacement effect changes the effect of Pain from "Nico discards a card, putting it into their graveyard" to "Nico reveals a card and shuffles it into their library". Pain still caused the shuffle, so Psychogenic Probe triggers.

question: Anthony attacks with a face-down [Samurai of the Pale Curtain] and Noemi blocks with [Embereth Shieldbreaker]. Where does Samurai of the Pale Curtain move?
answer_gold: The graveyard. Replacement effects must exist before the event in question in order to affect it. Samurai of the Pale Curtain had no abilities when it was on the battlefield, so there is no replacement effect that would apply to it moving to the graveyard.

question: Alex owns a face-down [Blightsteel Colossus] in exile. Neil uses [Processor Assault] to put Blightsteel Colossus into Alex's graveyard. Where does Blightsteel Colossus move to?
answer_gold: The graveyard. Replacement effects must exist before the event in question in order to affect it. Blightsteel Colossus has no abilities in exile, so there is no replacement effect that would apply to it moving to the graveyard.

question: Avery attacks with a [Guile] that was turned face-down by [Ixidron], and Nelson blocks with [Jerrard of the Closed Fist]. Does Avery shuffle?
answer_gold:
Yes. By default, triggered abilities are checked immediately after the event in question to see if they should trigger. At that point, the Guile is face-up in the graveyard and has that ability.

(Guile's trigger does not fit the exception for "leaves-the-battlefield" triggers because it is a "from anywhere" trigger.)

question: Archer attacks with a [The Scarab God] that was turned face-down by [Ixidron] and Nia blocks with [Scathe Zombies]. Does The Scarab God trigger?
answer_gold: No. By default, triggered abilities are checked immediately after the event in question to see if they should trigger. However, "leaves-the-battlefield" triggers check the game state immediately before the event instead. At that point, The Scarab God had no abilities.

question: Axton controls [Roaming Throne] (naming "Human") and casts [Desperate Plea] targeting [Dearly Departed] in their graveyard. Does it enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter?
answer_gold: Yes. The game state is evaluated immediately before the event in question to determine which replacement effects might apply to that event. Dearly Departed is in the graveyard at that time, so its effect can apply. To determine which replacement effects apply to Dearly Departed as it enters the battlefield, the game looks at it as it would exist on the battlefield. On the battlefield Dearly Departed would be a Human, so its effect does apply to itself.

question: Alaia casts [Biogenic Upgrade] targeting [Michelangelo, Weirdness to 11]. In total how many counters are be placed on Michelangelo, Weirdness to 11?
answer_gold: Nine. Michelangelo, Weirdness to 11's ability is a replacement effect that applies whenever counters are being placed on it When Biogenic Upgrade begins resolving, that replacement effect will add a counter, resulting in Alaia placing four +1/+1 counters. Afterwards, Biogenic Upgrade will then double the amount of counters on Michelangelo, Weirdness to 11. This results in an additional four counters being placed on it, which will then be modified by Michelangelo, Weirdness to 11's replacement effect again, resulting in nine +1/+1 counters in total.

question: Abdiel casts [Molten Birth] and loses the flip. Does Nico's [Chance Encounter] trigger?
answer_gold: No. Only the player who flips the coin wins or loses the flip.

question: Alonso controls [Spark Double] and casts [Clone]. Alonso would like to have Clone copy Spark Double, then they would like to apply the replacement effect Clone inherited from Spark Double and have it copy Spark Double again. If Alonso has Clone copy Spark Double a total of four times, how many +1/+1 counters will Clone enter the battlefield with?
answer_gold: One. Spark Double has a copy effect that includes an exception (entering with a +1/+1 counter). If another copy effect is applied afterwards, the exception from the first effect will not happen.

question: Addison has [Firemane Angel] in their graveyard. With its upkeep trigger on the stack, Addison returns Firemane Angel to the battlefield. Does Addison gain 1 life?
answer_gold: No. Because this trigger has an "intervening if" clause, when the trigger would resolve, it checks if that clause is still true. If it isn't, the trigger does nothing. The trigger is looking for the specific object that caused it to trigger in the first place, but Firemane Angel becomes a new object when it changes zones..

question: Ari controls [Cast Through Time] and casts [Trumpeting Herd]. What will happen as Trumpeting Herd resolves?
answer_gold: Trumpeting Herd will have two instances of Rebound. As it resolves, Ari will choose which instance of Rebound will exile the spell. After applying that effect the Trumpeting Herd is no longer moving to the graveyard, so the other rebound effect is no longer applicable. There will only be one rebound trigger on the following upkeep.

question: Noah controls a [Leyline of Singularity]. Ari casts [Stunt Double] choosing it to enter as a copy of [Raptor Companion]. When Leyline of Singularity leaves the battlefield, will Stunt Double still be legendary?
answer_gold: No. The legendary supertype granted by Leyline of Singularity is a type-changing ability and is thus not a copiable attribute.

question: Addison casts [Ferocious Zheng]. After it resolves, they cast [Elemental Eruption] and reveal [Everdream] from their hand, splicing it onto Elemental Eruption. When Elemental Eruption's Storm trigger resolves, will the copies of Elemental Eruption also have Everdream spliced onto them?
answer_gold: Yes. As Addison is casting Elemental Eruption they choose whether they want to splice as part of the casting process. When the storm trigger resolves it copies all the choices made when casting the original spell, including the choice to splice.

question: Aden casts [Undying Flames], choosing to splice [Everdream] onto it. At the beginning of Aden's next upkeep, will the copy of Undying Flames also have the effects of Everdream?
answer_gold: Yes. As Aden is casting Undying Flames they choose whether they want to splice as part of the casting process. When the epic trigger resolves and creates a copy of Undying Flames it copies all of the choices made when casting the original Undying Flames, including the choice of what to splice onto it.

question: Nico controls a token created by [Ugin, the Ineffable], which is currently enchanted by [Kenrith's Transformation]. Aydan casts [Fatal Push] targeting the token. Will Nico put the exiled card into their hand?
answer_gold: Yes. While Kenrith's Transformation does remove all abilities from the creature it enchants, Ugin, the Ineffable does not grant the ability to the creature; rather it is a delayed triggered ability that triggers when the creature leaves the battlefield.

question: Ada controls [Unbound Flourishing] and activates [Polukranos, World Eater] with X=2. How many +1/+1 counters will be placed on Polukranos, World Eater and how many times will its trigger go on the stack?
answer_gold: Two +1/+1 counters will be placed on Polukranos, World Eater, and its ability will trigger once. While Unbound Flourishing will cause a second instance of Monstrosity to go on the stack, when the second one resolves it won't do anything. Because Polukranos, World Eater doesn't become monstrous a second time, its triggered ability will only trigger once.

question: Nico controls [Fugitive Wizard] and [Falkenrath Reaver]. Alexander casts [Massacre Girl]. In response to Massacre Girl's trigger Nico casts [Village Rites], choosing to sacrifice Fugitive Wizard. After everything has resolved, what does the battlefield look like?
answer_gold:
Falkenrath Reaver and Massacre Girl are still alive. When Massacre Girl's trigger resolves, Falkenrath Reaver will get -1/-1 and won't die.

Massacre Girl's triggered ability consists of two parts: a trigger that gives all creatures -1/-1 when it enters, and a text that sets up a delayed trigger that will cause a -1/-1 trigger to be put onto the stack every time something dies. At the time Fugitive Wizard dies, Massacre Girl's triggered ability hasn't resolved yet, and hasn't set up the delayed trigger, therefore nothing new will be added to the stack.

question: Angelo controls [God-Eternal Kefnet] and reveals [Street Spasm]. Can Angelo cast it for its overload cost?
answer_gold: Yes. God-Eternal Kefnet creates a copy of the card and then allows Angelo to cast that copy. Angelo will still go through all the normal steps for casting a spell, including determining whether they'd like to pay alternative costs.

question: Nylah controls [Alpine Moon] choosing "[Vesuva]". Adrien plays Vesuva choosing [Urban Retreat] as it enters. Does it enter the battlefield tapped or untapped?
answer_gold: This can't happen as described. Adrien cannot choose a land to copy with Vesuva because it loses that ability before it would apply. Vesuva enters untapped, as itself.

question: Ares controls [Mycosynth Lattice] and casts [Glittering Wish]. Are they able to choose a card?
answer_gold: Yes, Ares may choose any multicolored card. Cards outside the game are not affected by Mycosynth Lattice.

question: Arjun controls a [Mirage Mirror] that is a copy of [Rona, Disciple of Gix]. They activate Mirage Mirror's ability to exile the top card of their library, exiling [Great-Horn Krushok]. Arjun then passes the turn and on Nico's upkeep activates Mirage Mirror, making it a copy of Rona, Disciple of Gix again. Will Arjun be able to cast Great-Horn Krushok?
answer_gold: No. Rona, Disciple of Gix has an activated and triggered ability that are both linked to a static ability. When Mirage Mirror becomes a copy of Rona, Disciple of Gix for the second time, it re-acquires Rona, Disciple of Gix's set of linked abilities and those abilities are linked to each other but nothing else (including any abilities it had beforehand).

question: Aspen controls two [Wirewood Symbiote]s and a [Mirage Mirror]. Aspen activates its ability twice, targeting both Wirewood Symbiotes. Before the second one resolves, Aspen activates Wirewood Symbiote's activated ability. After the second one resolves, can Aspen activate Mirage Mirror's ability again?
answer_gold: Yes. Aspen can only activate that particular activated ability once per turn. However after the second copy effect resolves, Mirage Mirror has a new instance of the ability, which hasn't yet been activated this turn.

question: Aryan controls [Seagraf Skaab] enchanted with [Unholy Indenture]. Nayeli casts [Akroma's Vengeance] to destroy both Seagraf Skaab and Unholy Indenture. Will Seagraf Skaab return to the battlefield?
answer_gold: Yes. Unholy Indenture has a triggered ability that occurs when the enchanted permanent dies. For most triggers the game checks to see if they occur right after every event. However for "dies" triggers the game checks what the game state looked like right before they triggered to see if they trigger. In this case, checking right before Akroma's Vengeance resolved results in Unholy Indenture triggering and returning Seagraf Skaab to the battlefield.

question: Nico controls [City of Traitors] and [Muck Rats]. Anders casts [Path to Exile] targeting Muck Rats and Nico finds a basic land. Does City of Traitors need to be sacrificed?
answer_gold: No. "Playing a land" is a special action, and not the same as putting a land onto the battlefield as part of resolving a spell or ability.

question: Aitana controls [Flameblade Adept] and has 8 cards in their hand as their turn ends. Can Niko respond to the trigger after seeing what card was discarded?
answer_gold:
Yes.

Unless something other than turn-based actions happen during the cleanup step, no player gets priority. Since Flameblade Adept triggers due to Aitana discarding a card, all players in the game get a chance to respond before the ability resolves.

question: Does [Gemini Engine]'s token enter the battlefield tapped?
answer_gold: No.

question: Adrian casts [Volrath's Shapeshifter] and has [Cult Conscript] as the top card of their graveyard. How does it enter the battlefield?
answer_gold: Volrath's Shapeshifter will enter tapped. When determining how Volrath's Shapeshifter will enter the battlefield, the game looks ahead to see what Volrath's Shapeshifter looks like when it's on the battlefield, taking into account continuous effects from the permanents own static abilities that would apply to it once it's on the battlefield. When Volrath's Shapeshifter is on the battlefield, it will have the replacement effect of "enters the battlefield tapped" and will enter tapped.

question: Abdullah controls [Arcane Adaptation] naming "Zombie" and casts [Embalmed Brawler]. Can they reveal [Seven-Tail Mentor] from their hand for amplify?
answer_gold: Yes. While normally continuous effects don't apply to cards not on the battlefield, Arcane Adaptation specifically states that it applies to cards that aren't on the battlefield, such as in your hand or library.

question: Arely casts [Biomantic Mastery] targeting Baylor and Charles. Before that resolves Baylor casts [Lightning Helix], which deals lethal damage to Charles and causes them to lose the game. What will happen when Biomantic Mastery resolves?
answer_gold: Arely will draw cards equal to the creatures controlled by Baylor upon the time of resolution. Arely will not draw any cards for Charles as they are now an illegal target.

question: Nico controls [Teferi, Time Raveler]. Can Ameer cast their [Asylum Visitor] for its madness cost during their main phase when they discard it?
answer_gold: No. Casting a card for its madness cost is part of resolving the madness trigger, which is not normally a legal time to cast a sorcery.

question: Neymar controls [Tomik, Distinguished Advokist]. Autumn controls [Ramunap Excavator] and has [Zoetic Cavern] in their graveyard. Can they cast Zoetic Cavern face down with its morph ability?
answer_gold: No. As the first step to determine if Zoetic Cavern can be cast for its morph cost, it is turned face down. A face-down Zoetic Cavern is a creature card, not a land card, so Ramunap Excavator no longer gives Autumn permission to play it. The answer would be the same even if Neymar didn't control Tomik, Distinguished Advokist.

question: Addison removes the last time counter from [Crashing Footfalls] and casts it. Can they attack with the Rhino tokens this turn?
answer_gold: No. Suspend grants creature spells haste, but will not grant haste to the creature tokens created by Crashing Footfalls.

question: Addison controls three [Lavabelly Sliver]s. They cast and resolve the fourth Lavabelly Sliver. How much damage can they deal to Nico?
answer_gold: 4 damage. As soon as Lavabelly Sliver enters the battlefield, it has four instances of "When this creature enters the battlefield, it deals 1 damage to target player or planeswalker and you gain 1 life". The game then checks to see if any abilities triggered, which four did.

question: Alijah controls [Conspiracy] naming "Elf" and their commander, [Nakia, Wakandan Operative]. Alijah taps [Path of Ancestry] to cast [Fyndhorn Druid]. Will Alijah be able to scry?
answer_gold: Yes. Path of Ancestry checks the creature types of Alijah's commander immediately after they cast a creature spell with mana from Path of Ancestry.

question: Avery controls [Corpsejack Menace] and casts [Rescuer Sphinx], choosing to return Corpsejack Menace to their hand. How many +1/+1 counters will Rescuer Sphinx enter the battlefield with?
answer_gold: Two. Both cards have a replacement effect. Avery will choose whether they are returning a permanent, but won't actually complete the action until Rescuer Sphinx enters the battlefield. Therefore Corpsejack Menace will still apply to the +1/+1 counter being from Rescuer Sphinx's ability.

question: Alijah has gained control of Nico's [Scryb Sprites] and attacks with it. Nico chooses not to block. Alijah would like to activate the Ninjutsu ability of the [Biting-Palm Ninja] in their hand by returning Scryb Sprites to the hand. Is this legal? If so, whose hand will Scryb Sprites return to?
answer_gold: This is legal and Scryb Sprites Alijah will return to Nico's hand.

question: Ari controls [Webweaver Changeling] and three [Mountain]s. Ari casts [Skred] targeting Webweaver Changeling. How much damage will it deal?
answer_gold: 0 damage. Changeling is a characteristic-defining ability that grants the permanent it is on every creature type. Snow is a supertype, and is therefore not granted by changeling.

question: Ayden controls [Heartless Summoning] and casts [Watcher for Tomorrow]. What happens as Watcher for Tomorrow resolves?
answer_gold:
When Watcher for Tomorrow enters the battlefield tapped, its hideaway ability triggers, but isn't placed on the stack until Ayden would get priority. Before Ayden gets priority state-based actions are checked and Watcher for Tomorrow is put into the graveyard for having 0 or less toughness. Then, its "leaves" trigger triggers but is not placed onto the stack. Since no more state based actions are completed, Ayden gets priority and has two triggers to place onto the stack in an order of their choice.

If Ayden chooses to have Watcher for Tomorrow's hideaway trigger resolve first they will exile a card face down then put it into their hand. If the triggers resolve in the other order, Watcher for Tomorrow's "leave" trigger will resolve returning nothing, then Ayden will exile a card face down with no way to return it to hand.

question: Amelie has a [Wrenn and Six] emblem and a [Daze] in their graveyard. Amelie would like to return one of the [Island]s they controls to their hand then discard it to cast Daze. Can they do this?
answer_gold: Yes. Retrace is an additional cost. Returning a land to their hand is an alternative cost. Amelie can decide to both pay an alternative cost and an additional cost. When deciding to cast the spell Amelie will announce they decision to pay any alternative or additional costs, then afterwards they will pay those costs in any order.

question: Adeline controls [Fugitive Wizard]. Nico controls [Lumengrid Warden]. Adeline casts [Authority] from their graveyard targeting Lumengrid Warden. Before that resolves, Adeline casts [Domineering Will] to gain control of Lumengrid Warden. Does Fugitive Wizard gain vigilance?
answer_gold: No. Authority will be removed from the stack and will not resolve. While Authority allows Adeline to choose zero targets, once they have made the decision that it will target one creature, it is a targeted spell. If all its targets become illegal before the spell resolves, it will not resolve. Instead of being put into the graveyard after being removed from the stack, Authority will be put into exile. ([702.127a])

question: Arianna controls [Possessed Portal] and [Keranos, God of Storms]. Can Arianna look at the top card of their library during their draw step?
answer_gold: No. During Arianna's draw step, they won't be drawing any cards. Possessed Portal will be replacing that event with not drawing a card. Therefore Arianna will never have any cards to reveal for Keranos, God of Storms.

question: Nico controls [Solemnity]. Allie controls [Vizier of Remedies] and a tapped [Sinking Feeling]. Can Allie untap Sinking Feeling with its own ability?
answer_gold: No. Since Solemnity prevents counters from being put on creatures, Allie can't activate Sinking Feeling's ability, as its cost cannot legally be paid. Vizier of Remedies's replacement effect won't apply as events that can't happen can only be replaced by self-replacement effects.

question: Ahmad is on their second mulligan, down to five cards. When Ahmad goes to put cards on the bottom of their library, how many cards will they be putting on the bottom and in what order?
answer_gold: Ahmad will be putting two cards on the bottom of their library, and they will choose the order.

question: Aislinn casts [Xantcha, Sleeper Agent] and has it enter under Braxtons control. Later on Casey enchants it with [Yavimaya's Embrace]. Braxton then loses the game. Afterwards Aislinn casts [Ray of Distortion] to destroy Yavimaya's Embrace. What will happen to Xantcha, Sleeper Agent?
answer_gold: Xantcha, Sleeper Agent will be exiled. Because it entered the battlefield under Braxton's control, they are considered the default controller of it. When Yavimaya's Embrace leaves the battlefield, the game checks to see if there are any other control-changing effects applying to it, there are not. The game then checks to see who the default controller of Xantcha, Sleeper Agent is, in this case it's a player that has left the game, and therefore Xantcha, Sleeper Agent will be exiled.

question: Apollo controls [Realmwright] naming "Island", [Arcane Adaptation] naming "Saproling", and [Life and Limb], which entered the battlefield in that order. What are the types and subtypes of Realmwright?
answer_gold:
Realmwright is a 1/1 green Land Creature - Vedalken Wizard Saproling Forest.

All three cards have effects in layer 4, the type changing layer. The game first looks at Realmwright's effect since it's first in timestamp order, sees that it's not dependent on Arcane Adaptation nor on Life and Limb, and applies it. Next the game looks at Arcane Adaptation's effect, sees that it's not dependent on Life and Limb, and applies it, followed by Life and Limb last.

Life and Limb lets it keep its original creature types, but not its original colors.

question: Anne controls [Ajani, Mentor of Heroes] and no other creatures. Can Anne activate Ajani, Mentor of Heroes's first +1 ability?
answer_gold: No. Ajani, Mentor of Heroes requires at least one target, Anne cannot activate the ability if they does not have enough legal targets.

question: Blaine controls a phased out [Wormfang Crab] owned by Christina. Christina loses the game due to being attacked by Ayaan. Does the Wormfang Crab trigger and return the card it exiled to the battlefield?
answer_gold: No. Objects that are phased out do not cause zone-change triggers to occur when they leave the game.

question: Ariel casts [Fatal Push] targeting [Insectile Aberration], which is the back face of [Delver of Secrets]. Is it destroyed?
answer_gold: Yes. The mana value of the back face of a transforming double-faced card that isn't a copy of something is equal to the mana value of its front face. Insectile Aberration has mana value 1.

question: Adonis casts [Assassin's Trophy] targeting [Nihil Spellbomb]. Nico searches for a [Snow-Covered Swamp] and wants to tap it to pay for the triggered ability of Nihil Spellbomb. Can they do this?
answer_gold: Yes. Assassin's Trophy will resolve completely before Nihil Spellbomb's trigger is placed onto the stack ([603.3],[117.2a]). The payment of {B} is made as the trigger resolves.

question: Noemi controls [Stranglehold]. Axl sacrifices [Arid Mesa] just to shuffle their library. Afterwards Noemi would like to cast [Archive Trap] for its alternative cost. Can they do this?
answer_gold: No. Axl did not actually search their library, and therefore the condition for paying Archive Trap's alternative cost has not been met.

question: Alexzander controls [Pir, Imaginative Rascal], [Doubling Season], and a face-down [Hooded Hydra]. They turn Hooded Hydra face-up by paying its morph cost. How many +1/+1 counters will be placed on it?
answer_gold:
11 or 12, depending on how Alexzander applies the effects from Pir, Imaginative Rascal and Doubling Season.

The replacement effect from Hooded Hydra's ability creates an event that Pir, Imaginative Rascal and Doubling Season can apply to. Alexzander is able to order these however they like. Each effect can only be applied once.

By applying Pir, Imaginative Rascal then Doubling Season, Hooded Hydra will get 12 counters.
By applying Doubling Season then Pir, Imaginative Rascal, Hooded Hydra will get 11 counters.

question: Nayeli is the monarch and controls [Defiant Khenra]. Augustine casts [Palace Jailer] and targets Defiant Khenra with Palace Jailer's second triggered ability. Nayeli casts [Trickbind] targeting Palace Jailer's first trigger to make Augustine the monarch. After everything has resolved and state-based actions have been checked, where is Defiant Khenra?
answer_gold: In exile. When Palace Jailer's second trigger resolves, it creates a one-shot effect that exiles Defiant Khenra until Nayeli becomes the monarch.

question: Carolyn is the monarch. Alexis cast [Palace Jailer]. When it enters the battlefield, Alexis target Baylor's [Skull Prophet] with the second ability. Carolyn counters the first triggered ability with [Consign to Memory]. After everything resolves, Alexis pass the turn. On Baylor's turn they deal combat damage to Carolyn. Will Skull Prophet return from exile?
answer_gold: Yes. When Palace Jailer's second triggered ability resolves it has a duration that expires when the monarch changes to an opponent.

question: Axel crews their [Spider-Mobile]. Nico activates their [Hissing Quagmire] causing it to become a creature. After that resolves, Nico casts [Mirrorweave] targeting their Hissing Quagmire. What are Spider-Mobile's characteristics after Mirrorweave resolves?
answer_gold:
It's a 0/0 colorless land artifact creature with no subtypes and the abilities of Hissing Quagmire.

When Spider-Mobile becomes a copy of Hissing Quagmire, it copies only the copiable values of the permanent, which does not include continuous effects like the one turning Hissing Quagmire into a creature.

The effect from crew is still making Spider-Mobile an artifact creature ([702.122a]), but it doesn't define a power and toughness, so the game treats it as 0/0.

question: Aspen controls [Unbound Flourishing] and activates [Polukranos, World Eater]'s monstrosity ability with X = 5. How many +1/+1 counters does Polukranos, World Eater get and how much damage can Aspen divide?
answer_gold:
Polukranos, World Eater gets 5 counters and Aspen divides 5 damage. 

Unbound Flourishing copies Polukranos, World Eater's monstrosity ability. The second one to resolve will not do anything, since Polukranos, World Eater is already monstrous.

question: Addison casts [Touch of the Void] targeting Nova's [Orzhov Racketeers]. Does Nova still get spirit tokens?
answer_gold: No. A creature is considered to have "died" if it moves from the battlefield to the graveyard.. Touch of the Void replaces the creature moving to the graveyard with moving the creature to exile instead, which doesn't qualify as the creature dying, and therefore doesn't cause the afterlife. Trigger to go onto the stack. ([702.135a])

question: Adelaide casts [Collected Company] and puts [Eternal Witness] and [Walking Ballista] onto the battlefield. Can Adelaide choose to target Walking Ballista with Eternal Witness's triggered ability?
answer_gold: Yes. Before Eternal Witness's triggered ability is put on the stack, state-based actions are checked, at which point Walking Ballista is put into the graveyard. Afterwards Eternal Witness's trigger is put on the stack, at which point Walking Ballista is in the graveyard and is a valid target for the ability.

question: Ariel controls [Simic Manipulator] with a +1/+1 counter on it and two [Obsidian Giant]s. Ariel then casts [Biogenic Upgrade] and would like to target all of their creatures to double the counters on all of them, but would like to put 2 counters on one of the Obsidian Giants and none on Simic Manipulator. Is this legal?
answer_gold: No. When distributing counters among targets, each target must receive at least one counter.

question: Aubrey controls [Arlinn, Voice of the Pack] and [Opalescence]. Aubrey casts [Conspiracy], naming "Wolf". Does it enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter?
answer_gold: Yes. The choice for Conspiracy is made as it enters the battlefield and will apply when Conspiracy enters. Arlinn, Voice of the Pack's ability is a replacement effect that modifies how a certain subset of creatures enters the battlefield. When checking to see which replacement effects apply to Conspiracy the game will look ahead to see what the permanent will look like on the battlefield, in this case the game will see that Opalescence will make Conspiracy a creature, and that a static ability will make it a wolf.

question: Aubrey casts [Seasoned Pyromancer] and has two other cards in hand, one of which is a land card. Niko controls [Rest in Peace]. How many tokens are created?
answer_gold: One token is created. The cards discarded from hand can still be seen by Seasoned Pyromancer's effect even though going to the graveyard was replaced by going to exile.

question: Annabella casts [Infernal Tutor]. The only other card in their hand is another Infernal Tutor. Can they choose not reveal it to Nico?
answer_gold: No. When Infernal Tutor resolves, Annabella must follow the instructions on the card if possible.

question: Abdullah controls [Liquimetal Coating], [Nicol Bolas, Planeswalker], and [Karn, the Great Creator]. Abdullah uses Liquimetal Coating to make Nicol Bolas, Planeswalker into an artifact, then uses Karn, the Great Creator's first ability to turn Nicol Bolas, Planeswalker into a creature and passes the turn. Natalie then attacks Nicol Bolas, Planeswalker with [Walking Corpse]. Can Abdullah block with Nicol Bolas, Planeswalker? If so, what happens?
answer_gold:
Yes, any creature controlled by the defending player can block an attacker. Nicol Bolas, Planeswalker will be dealt 2 damage, resulting in 2 damage being marked on it and it losing two loyalty counters.

Nicol Bolas, Planeswalker is still a planeswalker. Effects that make a permanent an 'artifact creature' allow that permanent to retain its other types. Damage dealt to Nicol Bolas, Planeswalker will still result in loyalty counters being removed from it.

question: Addison casts [Tormenting Voice]. While casting it, they activate [Chromatic Sphere], discarding the [Blightsteel Colossus] drawn from Chromatic Sphere's mana ability for Tormenting Voice's additional cost. What happens to Blightsteel Colossus?
answer_gold: Blightsteel Colossus had no characteristics while it was in Addison's hand (and Addison couldn't know what card it was) because it was drawn while Tormenting Voice was being cast, and was face down.Its replacement effect therefore won't apply to it being discarded and it will move to the graveyard.

question: Aubrianna attacks with [Rockslide Elemental], which has 4 +1/+1 counters. Nelson blocks with [Tephraderm]. What happens to Rockslide Elemental in the first combat damage step?
answer_gold:
Tephraderm will trigger upon combat damage being dealt, and Rockslide Elemental will trigger as Tephraderm dies after SBAs are checked. Since there are now multiple triggers waiting to be placed on the stack, Aubrianna and Nelson will do so respectively in APNAP order.

Nelson's trigger will resolve first; Tephraderm deals 5 damage to Rockslide Elemental, which dies to lethal damage. Aubrianna's trigger resolves second and does nothing, since Rockslide Elemental is no longer on the battlefield.

question: Noemi controls [Lazav, the Multifarious], which is currently a copy of [Lazav, Dimir Mastermind]. Adan discards [Willow Elf] due to hand size at the end of their turn. Lazav, the Multifarious's ability triggers. After it resolves, what is Lazav, the Multifarious named?
answer_gold: "Lazav, Dimir Mastermind". Lazav, Dimir Mastermind's ability changes the card's name to "Lazav, Dimir Mastermind", regardless of what it was originally named.

question: Ace attacks with [Vaevictis Asmadi, the Dire]. Nico has no permanents on the battlefield. What happens?
answer_gold:
The trigger cannot be put on the stack without legal targets.

(This is not the ability "fizzling" when it tries to resolve; this is the ability never even going on the stack in the first place.)

question: Adan controls [Sylvan Library] and has [Necroplasm] in their graveyard. Natalia controls [Leovold, Emissary of Trest]. If Adan draws a card for their turn, can Adan dredge Necroplasm as Sylvan Library's trigger resolves?
answer_gold: No. Leovold, Emissary of Trest has a static ability that prevents Adan from drawing more than one card per turn. If Adan has already drawn a card, they cannot replace subsequent draws with dredge.

question: Alonso controls [Blood Moon] and a [Gemstone Mine] with zero mining counters. Nylah then casts [Disenchant] targeting Blood Moon. After that resolves, will Alonso have to sacrifice Gemstone Mine?
answer_gold: No. Gemstone Mine only checks if there are no mining counters on it as the activated ability resolves. Since there are no mining counters on Gemstone Mine Alonso will never be able to activate it, and therefore it will never check how many mining counters are on it.

question: Ariel controls [Mycosynth Lattice]. Nora controls [Kaslem's Strider] enchanted with [Spirit Away]. Ariel casts [Opportunistic Dragon] and takes control of Spirit Away. What will happen after Opportunistic Dragon's ability resolves?
answer_gold: Spirit Away will continue to be attached to Kaslem's Strider indefinitely. The "enchant" keyword is a restriction on what an Aura can enchant- without it Spirit Away is legally able to enchant anything.

question: Anabelle controls [Viashino Bey] and [Shifting Wall]. Can they attack with just Viashino Bey?
answer_gold: Yes. When declaring attackers Anabelle must obey the maximum number of requirements while breaking the minimum number of restrictions. However, because Viashino Bey only requires that creatures attack if able, its ability doesn't apply to Shifting Wall because it isn't able to attack.

question: Aarush has [Grabby Giant] in their graveyard. Can they flash back Grabby Giant's Adventure with [Flashback]?
answer_gold: No. An Adventure defines alternative characteristics the card can have when cast as an Adventure. Adventurer cards only have their normal characteristics in every zone other than the stack, so it's not a legal target for Flashback.

question: Adrienne controls [Yargle and Multani]. Adrienne casts [Switcheroo] targeting their Yargle and Multani and Noe's [Nyxborn Marauder]. After that has resolved, can Adrienne attack with Nyxborn Marauder?
answer_gold: No. For Adrienne to be allowed to attack with Nyxborn Marauder they would have had to control it since the beginning of their most recent turn.

question: Adrian casts [Opportunistic Dragon] and uses its triggered ability to take control of Natalia's [Volunteer Militia]. Afterwards Adrian uses [Oko, Thief of Crowns]' +1 ability to make Volunteer Militia a 3/3 Elk with no abilities. Will Adrian then be able to attack with Volunteer Militia?
answer_gold: No. Opportunistic Dragon does not grant an ability to Volunteer Militia that prevents it from attacking. Instead its trigger creates an effect that states that Volunteer Militia cannot attack or block as long as Opportunistic Dragon is on the battlefield.

question: Ariel casts [Scapeshift] sacrificing seven lands. Ariel finds six [Mountain]s and one [Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle]. Ariel would like to have the first trigger deal three damage to Neymar's [Unsettled Mariner], and the rest to deal damage to Neymar. After the first trigger resolves, will Ariel still have to pay for the Unsettled Mariner triggers?
answer_gold: Yes, Ariel chooses targets for Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle's ability as they go on the stack. After Ariel has chosen all the targets for Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle's abilities, Neymar will put an Unsettled Mariner trigger onto the stack for each time they or Unsettled Mariner was targeted. Unsettled Mariner dying won't affect the triggers that are already on the stack, and all of the Unsettled Mariner triggers will resolve before any of the Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle triggers do anyway.

question: Allen controls [Quicksilver Elemental] and [Bane Alley Broker]. Allen also owns a [Hexplate Golem] that was exiled by Bane Alley Broker. Allen activates Quicksilver Elemental's ability targeting Bane Alley Broker. After that resolves, Allen wants to use Quicksilver Elemental's activated ability to return Hexplate Golem to their hand. Can they do so?
answer_gold: No, they can't. When Quicksilver Elemental gains an ability that refers to the object it's on by name, it just means "this object". The second activated ability gained by Quicksilver Elemental can only return cards that were exiled by its first gained activated ability.

question: Autumn has [Prepare // Fight] in their graveyard. Autumn casts [Torrential Gearhulk]. Which side of Prepare // Fight can Autumn cast with its trigger?
answer_gold: Either side. Torrential Gearhulk has a targeting restriction that requires Autumn to select an instant in their graveyard. Split cards have the type of both sides simultaneously. Therefore Prepare // Fight is both an instant and a sorcery card and satisfies the targeting restriction on Torrential Gearhulk. When Autumn goes to cast Prepare // Fight, nothing cares about which half is cast, so either is legal.

question: Aldo casts [Dance of the Manse] (X=6) targeting [Keening Stone]. After Dance of the Manse resolves, Aldo casts [Clone] and chooses to copy the Keening Stone. When Clone resolves, is it a creature?
answer_gold:
No. 

Clone will only receive the copiable characteristics of what it is copying. In this instance, that is only the printed text of Keening Stone.

question: Ashley casts [Cauldron's Gift] spending three black mana while their graveyard has no cards in it. As it resolves, [Ironroot Treefolk] is put into the graveyard from the library. Can Ashley choose to return it to the battlefield with Cauldron's Gift?
answer_gold: Yes. As spells and abilities resolve, the instructions are carried out in the order they are printed on the card. Ashley first takes the top four cards of their library and puts them into their graveyard, then chooses which creature they would like to return. The choice of which creature to return is made upon resolution.

question: Alex controls [Haakon, Stromgald Scourge] and has [Fell Horseman] in their graveyard. Can Alex cast the Adventure portion of Fell Horseman from their graveyard?
answer_gold: No. When determining if it's legal to begin casting a spell by moving it to the stack with Haakon, Stromgald Scourge, the game takes into account any alternative characteristics it would have on the stack. Haakon, Stromgald Scourge does not permit Alex to move an Adventure to the stack, since it's not a Knight.

question: Alonso casts [Blazing Shoal] exiling [Armed // Dangerous]. What will the value of X be?
answer_gold: X will be 6. The mana value of the split card is equal to the combined mana values of its two halves.

question: Nala controls two [Opalescence]s. Avery casts [Anger of the Gods]. After that resolves, Avery casts [Coordinated Maneuver] targeting one of the Opalescences. After that resolves they casts another Coordinated Maneuver targeting the remaining Opalescence. Where will each Opalescence go when Coordinated Maneuver resolves?
answer_gold: The first Opalescence will go to exile, the second one will go to Avery's graveyard. When Anger of the Gods resolves it sets up a replacement effect that watches for creatures going from the battlefield to the graveyard that were also dealt damage by Anger of the Gods. The first Opalescence is a creature before it's destroyed. The second Opalescence isn't a creature when it's destroyed and therefore doesn't fulfill the requirements of the replacement effect and will go to the graveyard.

question: Archer controls [Winding Constrictor] and [Metallic Mimic] naming "Construct". They cast [Hangarback Walker] with X=4. How many counters will it enter the battlefield with?
answer_gold: 6. Both Metallic Mimic and Winding Constrictor have a replacement effects that modifies the amount of counters that Hangarback Walker enters the battlefield with. As Hangarback Walker is entering the battlefield the game will check for replacement effects and see that there are two, either Metallic Mimic or Winding Constrictor will be applied first, then afterwards the game will again check for replacement effects and apply the other one.

question: Ari controls [Oko, Thief of Crowns], [Bog Naughty], and a Food token. Ari uses Oko, Thief of Crowns's +1 ability to make the Food token into a 3/3 Elk. Can Ari then sacrifice it to Bog Naughty?
answer_gold: No. Oko, Thief of Crowns's ability is a type-changing effect which will overwrite any previous types and subtypes the object had. When Bog Naughty asks Ari to sacrifice a Food, it is saying that Ari needs to sacrifice a permanent with the subtype "Food".

question: Addilynn controls a [Fairgrounds Warden] that exiled [Leonin Arbiter]. Nikolas casts [Path to Exile] targeting Fairgrounds Warden. Will Addilynn get to search for a land?
answer_gold: No. Path to Exile will exile Fairgrounds Warden, returning Leonin Arbiter to the battlefield. Then Addilynn will be given the option to search for a land, however they cannot search their library due to Leonin Arbiter's effect. Paying {2} for Leonin Arbiter is a special action, and can be taken when Addilynn has priority. However Addilynn will not receive priority during the resolution of Path to Exile and therefore does not have the option to pay {2}.

question: Ainsley controls [Leyline of Singularity] and [Awoken Demon] equipped with [Helm of the Host]. When the trigger from Helm of the Host resolves, will the created token be legendary?
answer_gold: Yes. When Helm of the Host goes to create the token of Awoken Demon it will see that it is legendary, and create a token that does not have the legendary supertype. However Leyline of Singularity is generating a continuous effect in layer 4, which will overwrite the base characteristics of any object on the battlefield, regardless of when it entered, making it legendary.

question: Ariel controls [Shapers' Sanctuary] and [Spellskite]. Nancy casts [Ghostfire] targeting Ariel. Before it resolves, Ariel uses Spellskite's ability to change the target to Spellskite. Will Ariel draw a card off of Shapers' Sanctuary?
answer_gold: Yes. Shapers' Sanctuary's trigger condition is met when Spellskite becomes the target of Ghostfire, regardless of how it happened.

question: Anson controls Azors Gateway with 4 different CMC cards exiled by it. They targets it with [Karn's Touch]. After that resolves, they activates [Azor's Gateway], and transforms it into [Sanctum of the Sun]. What are the characteristics of the new object after it has transformed?
