answer_gold: Sanctum of the Sun is a 2/2 Legendary artifact creature land with the ability "{T}: Add X mana of any one color, where X is your life total". The requirement that Azor's Gateway be an artifact is part of the targeting restriction of the spell, after the spell resolves, it creates a continuous effect on the permanent that was targeted (in this case Azor's Gateway) that lasts until end of turn. When a double-faced card transforms it doesn't become a new object, and any effects that applied to it before the transformation will continue to apply afterwards.

question: Adonis controls [Tocatli Honor Guard] and [Selvala, Heart of the Wilds]. Adonis casts [Catacomb Slug]. When it enters the battlefield, will Selvala, Heart of the Wilds's ability trigger?
answer_gold: No. The text on Tocatli Honor Guard prevents any 'enter the battlefield' abilities from triggering, even if the permanent that is triggering them is not the permanent that has the ability.

question: Aspen controls [Mana Reflection] and taps [Pyromancer's Goggles] to add {R}{R}. They spend one mana to cast [Invert]. Later in the phase they spend the other mana to cast [Brute Force]. Which one(s) are copied?
answer_gold: Both are copied. Mana Reflection has a replacement effect that changes the amount of mana produced by Pyromancer's Goggles. A separate delayed trigger is created for each mana.

question: Atlas attacks with [Pristine Angel], and Nico targets it with [Cephalid Snitch] before blockers. After combat, Atlas casts a spell, untapping Pristine Angel. Once untapped, can Nico target it with [Mob]?
answer_gold: Yes. "Protection from all colors" means the same thing as an individual protection ability for each color, so Pristine Angel will lose protection from black while still having protection from all other colors and from artifacts.

question: Aminah controls [Shapers' Sanctuary], [Spellskite], and [Feral Krushok]. Nico casts [Pyromatics] targeting Feral Krushok. Aminah activates Spellskite to change the target of Pyromatics to Spellskite. How many times does Shapers' Sanctuary trigger?
answer_gold: Twice. Shapers' Sanctuary will trigger the first time when Pyromatics is initially cast targeting Feral Krushok.. Shapers' Sanctuary will trigger again when Spellskite becomes the target of the spell.

question: In their precombat main phase, Amelie activates [Urza, Lord High Artificer] and reveals [Harbinger of the Tides]. Can they play Harbinger of the Tides during combat?
answer_gold: Yes, but only if Amelie pays {2} more to cast it. Casting it without paying its mana cost with Urza, Lord High Artificer is an alternative cost, whereas paying {2} more is an additional cost. There's no conflict between the two, and Amelie can do both.

question: Anderson plays their land for the turn, then casts a morphed [Zoetic Cavern]. Nataly casts [Delay] targeting Zoetic Cavern on the stack. After that resolves, Anderson casts [Timecrafting] to remove 2 time counters from Zoetic Cavern. After that resolves, Anderson casts Timecrafting to remove the last time counter from Zoetic Cavern. What happens to Zoetic Cavern?
answer_gold: It will remain in exile. Suspend allows Anderson to play it, but does not allow Anderson to play additional lands. Since they has already played their land for the turn, they cannot play Zoetic Cavern.

question: Nehemiah controls [Kinsbaile Borderguard] with 3 +1/+1 counters it. During their main phase, Annalee casts [Black Sun's Zenith] to put 4 -1/-1 counters on Kinsbaile Borderguard. How many tokens will Nehemiah create when Kinsbaile Borderguard's trigger resolves?
answer_gold:
Seven.

After Black Sun's Zenith resolves, Kinsbaile Borderguard has 3 +1/+1 counters and 4 -1/-1 counters when state-based actions are checked. When state-based actions are checked, 3 of each counter are removed from Kinsbaile Borderguard and Kinsbaile Borderguard will die.Then, the trigger from Kinsbaile Borderguard will be put on the stack. When that trigger resolves, it must use the last known information of Kinsbaile Borderguard to determine the number of counters on it, and when Kinsbaile Borderguard was last on the battlefield immediately before it died it had 7 counters on it.

question: Alonso casts [Piracy] and would like to tap all of Nico's lands but not cast any spells. Can Alonso do this?
answer_gold: Yes. Piracy creates a restriction on what Alonso must spend the mana on, but does not prevent them from not spending the mana.

question: Addison casts [Read the Runes] for X=2 and chooses to discard a card and sacrifice [Glint-Horn Buccaneer]. Will Glint-Horn Buccaneer trigger?
answer_gold: No. Addison will first choose whether they are sacrificing permanent, if they don't then they discard a card. Because it happens in this order, Glint-Horn Buccaneer will not be around to when Addison is discarding a card.

question: Adrien casts a creature with [Illusionary Mask], turns it face up with [Ixidor, Reality Sculptor] then back face down with [Ixidron]. If it becomes tapped, does it turn face up?
answer_gold: No. The activated ability of Illusionary Mask specifies that it will turn the creature face up if the conditions are met, one of the conditions is that the creature has not yet been turned face up. In this scenario the creature has been turned face up already, and even though it's now face down again, Illusionary Mask only cares that it's been turned face up in the past, which is true.

question: Neymar controls [Thelon's Chant]. Aleah controls [Dryad of the Ilysian Grove] and no other permanents, and then plays an [Island]. Does Thelon's Chant trigger?
answer_gold: Yes. Dryad of the Ilysian Grove's effect applies to Island before Thelon's Chant's trigger is checked.

question: Abraham casts [Illicit Auction] targeting Nico's [Platinum Emperion] and bids five life as it resolves. Nico doesn't bid. What happens?
answer_gold: Abraham loses 5life and then gains control of Platinum Emperion. When resolving Illicit Auction, Abraham follows the instructions on the spell in the order written.

question: Alex controls [Simic Guildmage] and [Phyrexian Hulk] that's enchanted with [Crystallization]. Naomi casts [Slaying Fire] targeting Phyrexian Hulk. Before that resolves, Alex activates Simic Guildmage's ability to attach Crystallization to Simic Guildmage. Which creature(s) get exiled, if any?
answer_gold: Just Phyrexian Hulk. When Phyrexian Hulk is targeted with Slaying Fire, Crystallization's triggered ability triggers, and is put on the stack. The phrase "that creature" in the last line of the ability refers to the object that was the enchanted creature when the ability triggered.

question: Alisson controls a [Clever Impersonator] that's currently a copy of [Looming Altisaur]. Alisson casts [Spark Double], choosing to copy Clever Impersonator, and then to copy [Porcelain Gallery] with Clever Impersonator's ability. Does Spark Double enter with a +1/+1 counter?
answer_gold: This can't happen as described. When Alisson chooses to copy Clever Impersonator with Spark Double, it copies the current characteristics of Looming Altisaur. If Alisson chooses to copy Clever Impersonator as Spark Double enters, it will simply be a Looming Altisaur with a +1/+1 counter.

question: Aldo controls [Reflecting Pool] and [River of Tears]. They have not played a land this turn. What mana can their Reflecting Pool produce?
answer_gold: Just {U}. Reflecting Pool can only produce mana that Aldo's lands could produce if their abilities resolved right now.

question: Anton plays [Exotic Orchard]. What can it tap for if Nadia controls only [River of Tears]?
answer_gold: Only {U}. Nadia hasn't played a land this turn, so if River of Tears were activated right now it would produce {U}, which is what Exotic Orchard checks for.

question: Abram controls [Thing in the Ice] with one ice counter on it. They cast [Anticipate], triggering Thing in the Ice's triggered ability. With the triggered ability on the stack, Noelle casts [Humble] targeting Thing in the Ice. What happens as everything resolves?
answer_gold:
Thing in the Ice will still transform, but no creatures will be returned to their owners' hands. 

Once Thing in the Ice's triggered ability is on the stack, it exists independently of its source; removing the ability from Thing in the Ice won't "reverse" or "counter" the triggered ability. When the trigger resolves, Thing in the Ice will transform into Awoken Horror. However, since it's still the same object, the effect from Humble persists. Since Awoken Horror has no abilities, its "When ~ transforms" triggered ability doesn't currently exist.

question: Ari casts [Phyrexian Ingester] and uses [Strionic Resonator] to copy its triggered ability. The first trigger targets [Icehide Golem] and the copy targets [Kalonian Tusker]. Afterwards Nickolas activates [Oracle of Dust]'s ability, choosing to take Icehide Golem out of exile and put it into Ari's graveyard. What will Phyrexian Ingester's power and toughness be?
answer_gold: Phyrexian Ingester will be a 6/6. Phyrexian Ingester has a triggered ability that is linked to a static ability. While both Kalonian Tusker and Icehide Golem were in exile Phyrexian Ingester was an 8/8, since the game adds the values of both exiled cards together to produce a result for Phyrexian Ingester. After Icehide Golem is removed, the only valid card remaining in exile is Kalonian Tusker and therefore the new bonus Phyrexian Ingester is receiving will be +3/+3.

question: Nathaniel controls [Hangarback Walker] with three +1/+1 counters on it. Azariah controls [Soul-Scar Mage] and casts [Flame Lash] targeting Nathaniel's Hangarback Walker. When Hangarback Walker dies, how many Thopter tokens will Nathaniel create?
answer_gold:
Three. Two state-based actions need to happen: Hangarback Walker goes to the graveyard because it now has 0 toughness, and the +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters remove one another. These state-based actions happen simultaneously. 

When the trigger resolves, it looks to see how many +1/+1 counters are on Hangarback Walker currently. Since Hangarback Walker isn't on the battlefield anymore, the trigger looks at how it last existed on the battlefield. At that time it had 3 +1/+1 counters (along with 3 -1/-1 counters), so 3 Thopter tokens are created.

question: Nick controls [Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth]. Ashley controls no lands and plays [Dragonskull Summit]. Does it enter tapped or untapped?
answer_gold:
Tapped. The game determines how replacement effects apply before the event in question occurs, and at that time, Ashley controls no Swamps.

([614.12] means that the game considers the Dragonskull Summit to be a Swamp itself for these purposes, but it's not on the battlefield yet, so this doesn't matter.)

question: Alfonso casts [Torrent of Lava] with X = 4. Naomi controls [Gisela, Blade of Goldnight] and taps [Hexplate Golem] to prevent 1 damage from Torrent of Lava. How much damage will be dealt to Hexplate Golem?
answer_gold: One. There are two prevention effects applying to damage from Torrent of Lava, one from Hexplate Golem and one from Gisela, Blade of Goldnight. Naomi chooses which effect to apply first, and afterwards since there's still damage being dealt to Hexplate Golem, they apply the other effect. Regardless of the order they're applied in, in this scenario, Hexplate Golem will be dealt one damage.

question: Nikolai has [Erebos's Titan] in their graveyard. Amelia controls [Maestros Ascendancy] and wants to cast [Entropic Decay] from their graveyard. Can they cast Entropic Decay this way? If so, will Erebos's Titan's triggered ability trigger?
answer_gold:
Yes, Amelia can cast Entropic Decay and Erebos's Titan's ability will trigger.

When determining if an adventurer card can be cast as an Adventure, only the card's alternative characteristics are considered. Since Entropic Decay is an instant or sorcery, Maestros Ascendancy allows it to be cast from the graveyard.

Since it's a creature card while in the graveyard, Erebos's Titan triggers when it leaves the graveyard.

question: Aarav is resolving the triggered ability on [Oath of Druids] and reveals [Sivitri Scarzam]. However, Nico controls [Grafdigger's Cage]. What happens?
answer_gold: Sivitri Scarzam will remain on top of Aarav's library and all the other revealed cards will go to their graveyard.

question: Asa controls [Bloom Tender] and [Old Man of the Sea]. Then, Asa resolves Old Man of the Sea's ability to gain control of Nova's [Dune Beetle]. When Asa activates Bloom Tender's ability, how much mana is produced?
answer_gold:
Three - one of each of the three colors among creatures Asa controls. 

While Nova still owns Dune Beetle, Old Man of the Sea's ability creates a control-changing effect which gives control of Dune Beetle to Asa. When Bloom Tender's ability resolves, it does not care that Nova is the owner Dune Beetle - just that Asa is the controller.

question: Arjun's [Morality Shift] resolves, in what order do they put cards in their graveyard?
answer_gold: In the order of Arjun's choice.

question: Achilles attacks with [Altac Bloodseeker] and [Mai, Scornful Striker]. Noelle blocks Mai, Scornful Striker with [Black Widow, Natasha Romanoff]. How much damage does Altac Bloodseeker deal to Noelle?
answer_gold: In the first combat damage step, Black Widow, Natasha Romanoff dies and Altac Bloodseeker triggers. After the trigger resolves, there's another combat damage step. In the second combat damage step, Altac Bloodseeker will deal 4 damage.

question: Addison controls [Dryad of the Ilysian Grove] and casts [Blood Moon]. What are the characteristics of [Snow-Covered Island], [Study Hall], [Dryad Arbor], and [Mountain] after Blood Moon resolves?
answer_gold:
Snow-Covered Island and Mountain have all basic land subtypes: "Plains", "Island", "Swamp", "Mountain", and "Forest". Dryad of the Ilysian Grove doesn't change supertypes and Blood Moon affects nonbasic lands.

Study Hall has subtype Mountain. There are no dependencies between Dryad of the Ilysian Grove and Blood Moon, so we apply the type-changing effects in timestamp order.

Dryad Arbor is now a Creature Land - Dryad Mountain. Gaining a basic land type doesn't remove other card types or nonland subtypes.

question: Aaron controls [Endrek Sahr, Master Breeder] and [Pontiff of Blight]. They cast [Primeval Shambler]. What is the maximum number of extort triggers they can pay for?
answer_gold: Two. Even though tokens with extort are created before Primeval Shambler resolves, they are created only after Primeval Shambler has already been cast. They are therefore not on the battlefield in time for their extort abilities to trigger. ([702.101a])

question: Adalyn controls [Thryx, the Sudden Storm] and casts [Blue Sun's Zenith] to draw 2 cards. How much mana does Blue Sun's Zenith cost? Can Blue Sun's Zenith be countered?
answer_gold: Blue Sun's Zenith costs {1}{U}{U}{U}, and it cannot be countered. While casting Blue Sun's Zenith, Adalyn declares them intended value of X. Then, several steps later in the spell casting process, any modifications to the spell's total cost are applied. This cost reduction does not affect the spell's mana value. The spell's mana value is based entirely on its printed values and the value chosen for X that Adalyn chose while they was casting the spell.

question: Alden casts [Too Greedily, Too Deep] targeting [Arixmethes, Slumbering Isle], while Nico controls [Containment Priest]. What happens when Too Greedily, Too Deep resolves?
answer_gold: Arixmethes, Slumbering Isle will either enter the battlefield as a land, or it will be exiled, it's Alden's choice.There are two replacement effects applying to Arixmethes, Slumbering Isle as it enters the battlefield, its own ability that has it enter with counters, and Containment Priest's ability. The game takes into account how the permanent will exist on the battlefield for the purposes of determining whether certain replacement effects will apply to it. If Alden chooses to have Containment Priest apply first, Arixmethes, Slumbering Isle will be exiled. If they chooses to apply Arixmethes, Slumbering Isles ability first, it will enter the battlefield as a land, and Containment Priests ability won't apply.

question: Nico controls a [Persistent Nightmare]. (The back face of [Startled Awake].) Ashlyn casts a [Banishing Light] and targets the Persistent Nightmare with its ability. After it resolves, Nico casts [Wear Down], targeting the Banishing Light. What happens when the Banishing Light is destroyed?
answer_gold: Startled Awake tries to return to the battlefield, but sorceries can't enter the battlefield. It remains in exile.

question: Asa attacks with [Tephraderm] and Nia blocks it with [Rockslide Elemental], which has four +1/+1 counters on it. Does Rockslide Elemental survive?
answer_gold:
Yes.

Rockslide Elemental has first strike, and deals 5 damage to Tephraderm in the first combat damage step. 

Tephraderm's ability triggers, but isn't put onto the stack until a player would gain priority next.

State-based actions are checked and Tephraderm dies due to having damage marked on it equal to its toughness. Rockslide Elemental's ability triggers. Both triggers are put onto the stack in APNAP order.

Nia's ability resolves first, as it was added to the stack last. When the stack is empty, Rockslide Elemental will have five +1/+1 counters and 5 damage.

question: Alessandra uses [Thunderheads] to create a token, and then casts [Rootborn Defenses] to populate the token. Will they have to exile the copy at the beginning of their next end step?
answer_gold: No. Populate just creates a copy of the token as it exists on the battlefield. The copiable values of the token are derived from those that would be directly printed on it if it were a card, so the condition that it must be exiled at the beginning of Alessandra's next end step is not copied.

question: Avery controls [Grip of Chaos] and casts [Murderous Cut]. Before that resolves they use [Kitsa, Otterball Elite] to copy Murderous Cut. Will Grip of Chaos trigger?
answer_gold: Yes, it triggers for the original spell and for the copy. When Avery copies Murderous Cut they will put it onto the stack, at which point Grip of Chaos will trigger.

question: Alexis attacks with [Godo, Bandit Warlord], then casts [Camouflage]. In the second combat phase, what will happen?
answer_gold: Alexis will follow Camouflage's instructions in the second combat phase as well. Camouflage states that it applies for Alexis's entire turn.

question: Anika attacks with two different creatures. Nico activates [Forcefield]. When will Nico need to chose which creature Forcefield applies to?
answer_gold: Nico will need to choose a creature when Forcefield's ability resolves.

question: Angelina has seven cards in their hand, controls [Trusted Advisor], and casts [Null Profusion]. After Angelina discards at the end of the turn, how many cards should they have in their hand?
answer_gold: Two. Trusted Advisor adds two to the maximum hand size (making it nine), and Null Profusion then sets the maximum hand to two.

question: Adeline has [Tobias Andrion] and [The Mimeoplasm] in their graveyard. Adeline casts [Rise of the Dark Realms] to return both to the battlefield. Can they have The Mimeoplasm enter the battlefield as a copy of Tobias Andrion?
answer_gold: No. The Mimeoplasm has a replacement effect that modifies how it enters the battlefield. The game checks for any replacement effects that modify how an object will enter the battlefield before the object has changed zones. So Tobias Andrion is still in the graveyard while Adeline is making choices for The Mimeoplasm, however they are not allowed to choose an object that is also changing zones at the same time.

question: Aspen controls [The First Iroan Games] and no creatures. At the beginning of their precombat main phase, Aspen puts the 3rd lore counter on it. Aspen then casts [Chromium, the Mutable] at their first opportunity. Do they draw two cards from The First Iroan Games's ability?
answer_gold:
Yes. The third chapter triggering isn't conditional on Aspen controlling a creature with power four or greater, it simply triggers because the third counter was placed on it.

(The "if you control a creature with power 4 or greater" part isn't an intervening "if" clause because the chapter ability already has its own clause intervening "if" clause built in.)

question: Aspen controls [Chains of Mephistopheles] and has [Shambling Shell] in their hand. During their first main phase they cast [Tezzeret's Ambition]. What is the maximum number of times they can dredge?
answer_gold: Three. Chains of Mephistopheles is creating a replacement effect that applies to the draws from Tezzeret's Ambition. Aspen can discard Shambling Shell to the first replacement effect of Chains of Mephistopheles. They can then replace the draw from Chains of Mephistopheles by dredging. Which will put Shambling Shell back into their hand. Chains of Mephistopheles will apply to each draw from Tezzeret's Ambition, so Aspen can repeat this process and dredge a total of three times.

question: Ari controls [Firesong and Sunspeaker] and casts [Hypothesizzle] choosing to discard a card as it resolves. Before Hypothesizzle deals four damage to a creature, Norah casts [Unholy Hunger] targeting Firesong and Sunspeaker. As the trigger resolves, does Ari gain 4 life?
answer_gold: Yes. Hypothesizzle has a reflexive trigger. Ari chooses to discard a card as part of the resolution of Hypothesizzle which will cause it to put a trigger on the stack after it resolves. At this point Hypothesizzle is in the graveyard so the game will check last-known information to determine whether the spell had lifelink, which it did.

question: Azalea casts [Eject] targeting Nico's [Narset, Parter of Veils]. When it resolves, does Azalea draw?
answer_gold: Yes. The spell's instructions are performed sequentially in the order written, so Narset, Parter of Veils is not on the battlefield anymore to prevent Azalea from drawing.

question: Can Adelina use [Bring to Light] while the Noah controls [Teferi, Time Raveler]?
answer_gold:
Adelina can cast Bring to Light, but Teferi, Time Raveler will prevent the exiled card from being cast.

"Whenever you could cast a sorcery" just means that Adelina must have priority with nothing on the stack during their main phase. Since Adelina doesn't have priority while Bring to Light is resolving and Bring to Light is still on the stack, it's not legal to cast the exiled card and it will remain in exile.

question: August casts [Keranos, God of Storms]. Can Norah counter it with [An Offer You Can't Refuse]?
answer_gold: No. Keranos, God of Storms's ability that stops it from being a creature is only active on the battlefield.

question: Ari uses [They Came from the Pipes] and manifests [Woodripper]. They then decide to pay the manifest cost to flip it face up. Will it get fading counters?
answer_gold: No. Fading is a replacement effect that modifies how Woodripper enters the battlefield. When Ari manifested Woodripper it entered the battlefield as a 2/2 with no abilities.

question: Nico controls [Sewer Nemesis] with "Allan" as the chosen player. Allan exiles every card in their graveyard to pay [Temporal Trespass]'s delve cost. Does the third ability of Sewer Nemesis trigger?
answer_gold:
Yes. 

When Allan finishes casting Temporal Trespass, Sewer Nemesis' trigger condition is met, but the trigger is not put on the stack at this time. Then, state-based actions are checked and Sewer Nemesis dies. Eventually, no state-based actions occur and the trigger is put onto the stack.

question: Aaden has enchanted Neriah's [Durkwood Boars] with [Dreadful Apathy]. Aaden activates Dreadful Apathy. In response, Neriah casts [Return to Nature], targeting Dreadful Apathy. Is Durkwood Boars exiled?
answer_gold:
Yes.

The ability on the stack exists independently of Dreadful Apathy, and destroying Dreadful Apathy won't affect the ability. When it resolves, it uses the last known information of Dreadful Apathy since it's not on the battlefield anymore. When Dreadful Apathy was last on the battlefield, it was enchanting Durkwood Boars

question: Nico control [Future Sight] and [Library of Leng]. Andrew cast [Eriette's Whisper] to have Nico discard two cards. They do so, but choose to put both cards on top of their library. Will Nico have to reveal the second card from the top of their library?
answer_gold: No. Nico discard both cards simultaneously, so they will be putting the cards on top of their library as a single action and there is no opportunity for Andrew to see the second card from the top.

question: Adelaide controls [Bane Alley Blackguard] enchanted with [Candletrap], which is controlled by Nikolas. They activate Candletrap, to which Adelaide responds by granting Bane Alley Blackguard protection from white with [Blessed Breath]. What happens?
answer_gold: Bane Alley Blackguard gains protection from white, causing Candletrap to be put into the graveyard.. When the activated ability of Candletrap resolves, it will still exile Bane Alley Blackguard.

question: Aspen controls [Dark Depths] and [Joiner Adept]. Can Aspen cast [Arcum's Astrolabe]?
answer_gold: Yes. Any mana produced by a snow permanent can be used to pay for a cost requiring {S}, even if the effect that's granting the snow permanent mana abilities doesn't originate from a snow permanent.

question: Alex controls [Quicksilver, Speedster] and casts [Relentless Assault] at the beginning of their end step. Will Alex get an extra combat phase after their end step?
answer_gold: No. Relentless Assault refers to "this main phase" in its text. If it isn't cast during a main phase, "this main phase" doesn't exist. The game cannot insert a combat phase after an undefined point in time.

question: Nico controls [Thespian's Stage] that's currently a copy of [Temple of Triumph]. Alayna casts [Alpine Moon] and names "Temple of Triumph" as it resolves. Alayna then activates a second Thespian's Stage targeting Temple of Triumph. What does each Thespian's Stage look like?
answer_gold: Both Thespian's Stages are lands named "Temple of Triumph" and have "{T}: Add one mana of any color." and no other abilities. Because Thespian's Stage gains its ability as part of the copying process, the ability applies in the copy layer, which is earlier than the adding and removing abilities layer.

question: Alaya controls [Rayami, First of the Fallen] and [Withengar Unbound]. If Withengar Unbound dies, will it get exiled? If so, will Rayami, First of the Fallen have flying and trample?
answer_gold: If Withengar Unbound dies it will get exiled, however it will be Elbrus, the Binding Blade in exile, and therefore Rayami, First of the Fallen will not gain flying and trample. Rayami, First of the Fallen creates a replacement effect that modifies the event of Withengar Unbound dying. However, when Withengar Unbound is moved into exile the game only considers the characteristics of the front face of the card. Therefore it won't be a creature and won't have any abilities to confer to Rayami, First of the Fallen.

question: Noelle controls [Treasure Nabber]. Alden casts [Battle at the Bridge] with X=2 targeting Treasure Nabber, choosing to tap both of their [Claws of Gix]s to pay for improvise. Will Noelle gain control of the Claws of Gixs?
answer_gold: No. To tap a permanent for mana means that Alden is activating a mana ability of a permanent they control. Improvise simply means that Alden can tap an artifact to pay for {1}. ([702.126a])

question: Amiya has 5 devotion to white and declares [Heliod, Sun-Crowned] as an attacking creature. Amiya casts [Momentary Blink] targeting their [Nyxborn Courser]. Is Nico dealt 5 damage?
answer_gold: No. For a brief moment during the resolution of Momentary Blink, Heliod, Sun-Crowned ceased to be a creature and therefore it will be removed from combat.

question: Nora controls [Rest in Peace]. Autumn controls [Karn, Scion of Urza] and has previously exiled [Wizard's Lightning] with a silver counter on it. Autumn uses Karn, Scion of Urza's [-1] ability and casts Wizard's Lightning. After it resolves it returns to exile. Can Autumn return Wizard's Lightning to their hand with Karn, Scion of Urza's [-1] ability next turn?
answer_gold: No. Counters are removed when a card changes zones.

question: Alec controls [Elspeth Conquers Death] and puts the third lore counter it. With the triggered ability, they target [Eternal Witness] in their graveyard. When Eternal Witness returns to the battlefield, can it target Elspeth Conquers Death with its trigger?
answer_gold:
Yes.

When the final chapter ability resolves, Eternal Witness is returned to the battlefield. However, its triggered ability is not put onto the stack until after state based actions are checked. When state based actions are checked, Elspeth Conquers Death is sacrificed because is has a number of lore counters greater than or equal to its final chapter number. After this, triggers are placed onto the stack, and Elspeth Conquers Death is in the graveyard able to be the target of Eternal Witness's triggered ability.

question: Autumn attacks with [Robber of the Rich], exiling [Light Up the Stage] from Nehemiah's library. Can Autumn pay Light Up the Stage's Spectacle cost with only {C}?
answer_gold:
Yes.

Robber of the Rich allows Autumn to cast the card and "may spend mana as though it were mana of any color to cast that spell." This changes how the player may pay a cost, and they can do so with any mana, regardless of color. 

"Spectacle" is an alternative cost ([702.137a]), and can only be used if no other alternative cost is being paid. Luckily, Robber of the Rich does not create an alternative cost, it just changes how mana may be spent.

question: Abdullah casts [One with the Stars] targeting Nico's [Thassa, God of the Sea] while Nico controls no other permanents. Nico then casts [Ghastlord of Fugue]. Does Thassa, God of the Sea become a creature?
answer_gold: No. Thassa, God of the Sea is a creature by default; it has an ability that stops it from being a creature if Nico's devotion is less than 5. In this situation Nico's devotion is not less than 5, so that ability is doing nothing and Thassa, God of the Sea functions the same as a vanilla creature. One with the Stars is creating a type-changing effect that will overwrite Thassa, God of the Sea's type.

question: Nico controls [Barktooth Warbeard] with a [Voidwalk] encoded onto it. Aileen casts [Bloody Betrayal] targeting Barktooth Warbeard and deals combat damage with it to Nico. Which player(s) may cast a copy of Voidwalk?
answer_gold: Just Aileen. Cipher grants an ability to the creature that allows the creature's controller to cast the encoded card.

question: Adelina controls [Leyline of Abundance] and activates [Orochi Leafcaller]. To pay for the activation, they taps [Springleaf Drum] and Orochi Leafcaller. Will Leyline of Abundance produce any extra mana from either activation?
answer_gold: Neither activating Orochi Leafcaller nor Springleaf Drum will produce extra mana from Leyline of Abundance. To "tap a creature for mana" means to activate a mana ability of a creature which includes the "{T}" symbol in its activation cost. The ability of Orochi Leafcaller does not include the {T} symbol, so it does not qualify for Leyline of Abundance's trigger. Activating Springleaf Drum's ability isn't activating the ability of a creature, so it also does not qualify for Leyline of Abundance's triggered ability.

question: Adelaide controls [Rhythm of the Wild], [Grumgully, the Generous], [Renata, Called to the Hunt], and [Hardened Scales]. Adelaide then casts [Kalakscion, Hunger Tyrant]. If they chooses to put a counter on Kalakscion, Hunger Tyrant for Rhythm of the Wild, how many +1/+1 counters will it enter with in total?
answer_gold: Four. Every card on the battlefield has a replacement effect that modifies how Kalakscion, Hunger Tyrant will enter the battlefield. When applying replacement effects, each effect has a chance to apply once and only once, so even though Adelaide can choose which order to apply the effects in, Hardened Scales will only get one chance to modify how many counters Kalakscion, Hunger Tyrant enters the battlefield with, and will only ever add one additional counter.

question: Avery controls [Bolas's Citadel] and has [Evermind] on top of their library, can they cast it?
answer_gold: Yes. Normally because Evermind has no mana cost it can't be cast. However Bolas's Citadel is casting it for an alternative cost, and therefore ignores the actual cost of the spell. When calculating the mana value of a spell with no mana cost it's considered zero.

question: Autumn controls [Bolas's Citadel] and has [Sidisi's Pet] on top of their library, can they cast it for its morph cost? If so, how much life will they pay?
answer_gold: No, they can't cast it. If Autumn uses Bolas's Citadel to cast a spell, they are applying an alternative cost. Morph is also an alternative cost. Only one alternative cost can be applied to a spell when casting it.

question: Ashley controls [Bolas's Citadel] and has [Lovestruck Beast] on top of their library. Can they cast [Heart's Desire]? If so, how much life do they pay?
answer_gold: Yes and it will cost Ashley 1 life. As part of putting Lovestruck Beast on the stack Ashley chooses whether or not they want to cast the Adventure or not. If they casts Heart's Desire they will need to pay life equal to the mana value of the spell they are casting, which in this case is one.

question: Alvin controls [Elemental Bond] and casts [Colossal Dreadmask]. Will the Germ Token from Colossal Dreadmask trigger Elemental Bond?
answer_gold: No. The Germ Token enters the battlefied as a 0/0 creature and then Colossal Dreadmask is attached to it before state-based actions are checked, preventing it from dying. Since it didn't enter the battlefield as a 4/4, it won't trigger Elemental Bond.

question: Angelique has [Copy Enchantment] enter the battlefield as a copy of [Estrid's Invocation], which is a copy of [Hardened-Scale Armor]. At the beginning of their next upkeep, which permanents may Angelique exile?
answer_gold:
Since both cards will have the ability, either Copy Enchantment and Estrid's Invocation may be exiled.

The copy effect of Estrid's Invocation includes the copy gaining an ability as part of the copying process. This is also a copiable value, and Copy Enchantment will also have this ability.

question: Ainsley controls [Spellweaver Volute] that's enchanting [Cruel Truths] in their graveyard. What zone is Spellweaver Volute in?
answer_gold: Spellweaver Volute is on the battlefield. The game doesn't require an Aura to be in the same zone as the object it's attached to.

question: Avery controls [Emeria Shepherd]. They play [Scattered Groves], and target [Kyoshi Warrior Guard] in their graveyard. In response, Nehemiah activates [Emergence Zone]. When that ability resolves, they casts [Magus of the Moon]. When Emeria Shepherd's ability resolves, where is Kyoshi Warrior Guard?
answer_gold:
Avery's hand.

Magus of the Moon changes Scattered Groves's subtypes to "Mountain", and Scattered Groves loses all other subtypes. During the resolution of the ability, Scattered Groves is no longer a Plains and therefore Kyoshi Warrior Guard will not return to the battlefield.

question: Niko controls a [Silvercoat Lion] and a [Cobblebrute]. Allyson casts [Defeat], targeting Silvercoat Lion. In response, Niko casts [Giant Growth] targeting Silvercoat Lion. After Giant Growth resolves, Allyson casts [Ricochet Trap], targeting Defeat. What happens when Ricochet Trap resolves?
answer_gold:
Allyson can not change the target of Defeat during the resolution of Ricochet Trap. 

If an effect allows a player to "change the target(s)" of a spell or ability, each target can be changed only to another legal target. If a target can't be changed to another legal target, the original target is unchanged, even if the original target is itself illegal by then.

question: Albert controls [Doubling Season] and [Pir, Imaginative Rascal] and activates the +1 ability of [Ajani, Mentor of Heroes]. How many loyalty counters does it gain?
answer_gold:
Four.

Activating a planeswalker ability includes paying the loyalty cost, which in this case means adding one loyalty counter. Doubling Season only replaces effects, which are the result of a spell or ability. However Pir, Imaginative Rascal replaces the original one loyalty counter with two, which Doubling Season can then replace with doubling the additional loyalty counters, resulting in a total of four.

question: Ali controls [Hall of Gemstone] with "Green" as the chosen color. Nico controls [Contamination]. Ali taps their [Mountain] for mana. What color(s) of mana will it produce?
answer_gold: Green or black, Ali's choice. When multiple replacement effects would apply, the controller of the object affected or the player affected chooses which one to apply first. Then the other applies.

question: Ariella controls [Seasinger], and has used it to take control of Nico's [Omnath, Locus of Mana]. During Ariella's untap step they have {G}{G}{G} in their mana pool. If Ariella chooses to untap Seasinger, will they still have {G}{G}{G} in their mana pool during their upkeep?
answer_gold: No. Mana empties from a player's mana pool at the end of each step and phase. Therefore Ariella will untap their permanents in their untap step, then at the end of that step the mana will empty if they no longer control Omnath, Locus of Mana.

question: Alianna controls [Karn Liberated], which has exiled an [Anvil of Bogardan]. They activate Karn Liberated's -14 ability, and restarts the game. How many cards will they draw during their first turn?
answer_gold: 0. Their entire draw step is skipped. Alianna will be the starting player in the new game. Because they is the starting player they'll skip their first draw step. Anvil of Bogardan triggers at the beginning of the draw step, but it doesn't get a chance to trigger if that step is skipped.

question: Alonso controls [The Gitrog Monster] and has 8 cards in their hand. At the beginning of their cleanup step, they discard a land card. What happens?
answer_gold: The Gitrog Monster triggers and Alonso draws a card. Afterwards a new cleanup step begins.

question: Aspen casts [Seasons Past], choosing to return [Assault // Battery]. What mana value "slots" does it take up?
answer_gold: The mana value of Assault // Battery is five, so Aspen can't return anything else with mana value five.

question: Nathan activates their [Grim Lavamancer] targeting Amaris. In response Amaris gains control of Grim Lavamancer with [Caught Red-Handed]. When Grim Lavamancer's ability resolves, who decides whether to redirect the damage to Amaris's [Mordenkainen]?
answer_gold: Neither player has a choice, the damage must be dealt to Amaris. Grim Lavamancer targeted Amaris. There is no rule that allows that damage to be redirected anywhere.

question: Ashley animates [Den of the Bugbear] and equips [Stitcher's Graft] to it. What happens at the end of the turn?
answer_gold: Den of the Bugbear will be sacrificed. During the cleanup step the continuous effect that animates Den of the Bugbear will end and it will stop being a creature. At which point the game will check state-based actions and Stitcher's Graft will become unattached. Afterwards Stitcher's Graft's trigger will be put on the stack, and Ashley will sacrifice Den of the Bugbear.

question: Allan controls [Crystalline Nautilus] and [Moss Monster]. Noelle wishes to cast [Volley of Boulders] targeting both Crystalline Nautilus and Moss Monster to deal zero damage to Crystalline Nautilus and the rest to Moss Monster. Is this legal?
answer_gold:
No.

When dividing or distributing a value between targets, each target must receive at least one of the quantity that is being distributed.

question: Avery controls [Omnath, Locus of Mana] and has {G}{G}{G}{G} in their mana pool. Avery then casts [Momentous Fall], using the mana they have floating. How many cards will they draw from Momentous Fall?
answer_gold: Either one or five, Avery's choice. Momentous Fall cares about the power and toughness of the creature on the battlefield immediately before it was sacrificed. When casting Momentous Fall, its costs can be paid in any order. If they pay the mana first, Omnath, Locus of Mana is a 1/1 when it dies. If they sacrifice it first, it'll be a 5/5 when it dies.

question: Alex controls [Guardian Project] and a face down [Bloodstoke Howler]. They then cast another Bloodstoke Howler face down. Will Guardian Project trigger? If so, will Alex draw a card?
answer_gold: Yes. Face down creatures have no name, and two objects with no name don't have the same name as each other.

question:
Aya controls [Fblthp, Lost on the Range] and casts [Shahrazad]. 

In the subgame, they uses a [Vivien, Arkbow Ranger] to take the top card of their library into the subgame. Can Aya look at the new top card of their library while the subgame is still going on?
answer_gold:
This situation cannot happen as described. 

During the resolution of Shahrazad, each player takes all card from their main-game library and move them to their subgame library. Consequently, there are no cards to look at with Fblthp, Lost on the Range and Vivien, Arkbow Ranger cannot find a card that isn't there.

question: Ayden casts [Frozen in Ice] targeting their [Protean Thaumaturge]. Can they choose to have Protean Thaumaturge become a copy of their [Triton Shorethief]?
answer_gold: No. After an event occurs the game checks to see whether any trigger conditions were met. In this scenario, after Frozen in Ice resolves Protean Thaumaturge no longer has a triggered ability, and will not trigger.

question: Aubrey controls [Heliod, Sun-Crowned] and casts [Shamble Back]. Can they choose to put Heliod, Sun-Crowned's +1/+1 counter on one of the tokens created by Shamble Back?
answer_gold: Yes. Aubrey creates the tokens, then gains life as part of the resolution of Shamble Back. After Shamble Back has resolved, Heliod, Sun-Crowned's trigger will be put on the stack. At that point Aubrey can choose a token as their target.

question: Allen controls [Thraben Purebloods] which is enchanted by [Kenrith's Transformation]. Thraben Purebloods then becomes enchanted by [One with the Stars]. What happens?
answer_gold:
Thraben Purebloods becomes an enchantment with no abilities and with the color dictated by Kenrith's Transformation. When state-based actions are checked, Kenrith's Transformation is attached to an illegal target and is put into the graveyard. Thraben Purebloods then regains all characteristics except its type is only enchantment. State-based actions are checked again. Nothing happens, and Allen gets priority.

This is an interaction of continuous effects, so the layers will need to be considered. In this case, no changes occur until layer four. There are two effects occurring in this layer, so timestamps will need to be considered. Since Kenrith's Transformation was attached first, Thraben Purebloods maintains its status as a creature. Then, One with the Stars turns Thraben Purebloods into an enchantment and removes all other types. Thraben Purebloods is changed to the color dictated by Kenrith's Transformation in layer five. Thraben Purebloods loses all abilities in layer six due to Kenrith's Transformation. Lastly, Thraben Purebloods has its power and toughness set to the values stated in Kenrith's Transformation in layer seven. When state-based actions are checked, Kenrith's Transformation is attached to an enchantment and is put into the graveyard. State-based actions are checked again, and nothing happens.

question: Alyson control [Viscera Seer], [Hateful Eidolon], and [Jhessian Lookout] enchanted by [Ethereal Armor]. Alyson activated Viscera Seer's ability sacrificing Jhessian Lookout to do so. This triggers Hateful Eidolon. In what order can Alyson resolve these abilities?
answer_gold:
Alyson must draw then scry 1.

To activate Viscera Seer's ability, Alyson puts that ability on the stack and pays the costs, sacrificing Jhessian Lookout in this case. This triggers the ability of Hateful Eidolon. This triggered ability is then put onto the stack. Since the stack resolves in a first-in-last-out order, Alyson must resolve the triggered ability then the activated ability in that order.

question: Aarush controls [Nightmare Shepherd] and activates [Destiny Spinner]'s ability targeting their [Mountain]. Their animated Mountain dies, and Aarush chooses to exile it to Nightmare Shepherd's ability. Then, Aarush uses Destiny Spinner to animate the token copy of Mountain. What are the characteristics of the token copy of Mountain?
answer_gold:
The token is a 2/2 land creature with the creature type Elemental and the land type with which Mountain was printed. It has trample and haste until end of turn.

When the token is created, it is a land with the land type of the original. It does not retain being a creature nor the creature type Elemental those are not copiable values from layer 1. Note, the token can't have the subtype Nightmare as is it not a creature. When Destiny Spinner animates the Mountain token, the token becomes a creature with the subtype Elemental and has its power and toughness set to 2/2, as Aarush controls two enchantments (Destiny Spinner and Nightmare Shepherd). Lastly, the token gains trample and haste from the ability of Destiny Spinner.

question: Arian controls [Borderland Minotaur] enchanted with [Shade's Form]. Nico casts [Collective Effort] targeting both Shade's Form and Borderland Minotaur. Will Borderland Minotaur be returned to the battlefield?
answer_gold: Yes. Spells and abilities resolve in the order they are printed. In this case Borderland Minotaur will be destroyed and put into Arian's graveyard before Shade's Form is, which will trigger Shade's Form.

question: Ariel casts [Evil's Thrall] targeting Nasir's [Trained Armodon]. At the beginning of their end step, they choose to exile Trained Armodon with their [Conjurer's Closet]. Whose control will Trained Armodon enter the battlefield under?
answer_gold: It returns under Ariel's control, because Conjurer's Closet says it does.

question: Alessandro attacks with [Excruciator] and Nala blocks with [Unbreathing Horde] that has four +1/+1 counters on it. What happens?
answer_gold: Excruciator will deal damage as normal to Unbreathing Horde and it will die. Excruciator states that the damage prevention part of Unbreathing Horde's effect "can't" happen. The rest of the replacement effect will still occur.

question: Ari and Alianna are playing a game of Two-Headed Giant. Ari casts [Warbriar Blessing] targeting Alianna's [Nether Horror] and has it fight itself. Does Nether Horror die?
answer_gold: This can't happen as described. Ari cannot target Nether Horror with Warbriar Blessing as they must enchant a creature they control.

question: Can Nicolas cast [Force of Will] targeting Ariel's [Run for Your Life] that is escaping from their graveyard?
answer_gold: Yes. Escape is an alternative cost ([702.138a]), which means that once paid the escaped spell is on the stack, and can be interacted with as normal. Countering a spell means to remove that spell from the stack before it resolves. Run for Your Life is a legal target for Force of Will.

question: Angeline casts [Rise from the Grave] targeting [Woe Strider]. Will it enter with +1/+1 counters?
answer_gold: No. Woe Strider wasn't cast from the graveyard using its escape ability. ([702.138b])

question: Avery controls two [Orazca Frillback]s and casts [Klothys's Design]. Before that resolves Nick casts [Mob] targeting one of Avery's Orazca Frillbacks. Klothys's Design resolves. Afterwards Avery casts [Ancient Brontodon]. What power and toughness bonus is being conferred to each of Avery's creatures?
answer_gold: Orazca Frillback is getting +1/+1 and Ancient Brontodon is getting no bonus. Klothys's Design checks what Avery's devotion to green is upon resolution. The set of creatures that Klothys's Design applies to is the one that exists at the time it resolves, and creatures Avery casts after it resolves will not be affected.

question: Ainsley activates [Priest of Forgotten Gods]'s ability, but doesn't choose a target for the first part. Can Nickolas respond to the ability?
answer_gold: Yes. One of the qualifications for being a mana ability is that the ability doesn't require a target. Priest of Forgotten Gods's ability is still considered to require targets even if zero targets were chosen for it.

question: Ariel controls [Victor, Valgavoth's Seneschal] and casts [Indomitable Might] targeting their [Mons's Goblin Raiders]. Before that resolves, Nola destroys Mons's Goblin Raiders. Will Indomitable Might trigger Constellation?
answer_gold: No. On the stack an Aura is a targeted spell. If all of its targets are illegal before it resolves, it will be removed from the stack, and will not resolve, nor will it enter the battlefield.

question: In a multiplayer game, Brook is the monarch due to their [Fight for the Throne]. Angelica casts [Jared Carthalion, True Heir]. After it resolves, still during Angelica's turn, Chase kills Brook with [Lightning Bolt]. Who becomes the monarch?
answer_gold: No one. Normally when the monarch loses, the active player becomes the monarch. Jared Carthalion, True Heir's ability makes that impossible, so the monarchy is abolished. Vive la révolution!

question: Antoine controls [Black Widow, Natasha Romanoff] enchanted with [Darksteel Mutation], and activates [Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker] targeting Black Widow, Natasha Romanoff. What are the characteristics of the token?
answer_gold: This can't happen as described. While Darksteel Mutation removes all card types, Legendary is a supertype and is therefore still a property of Black Widow, Natasha Romanoff.

question: Ariel casts [Thoughtseize] targeting Nehemiah. In response, Nehemiah casts their last card, and when Thoughtseize resolves, Nehemiah has zero cards in hand. Does Ariel lose 2 life?
answer_gold:
Yes. 

Although there are no cards to choose from, Nehemiah is still a legal target for Thoughtseize and it will do as much as is possible.

question: Nylah has [Gleeful Arsonist] with a +1/+1 counter on it. Adrien casts [Black Sun's Zenith] with X=6. Does Gleeful Arsonist return to the battlefield?
answer_gold: No. Undying is a triggered ability that will return Gleeful Arsonist to the battlefield if it had no +1/+1 counters on it when it died. The removal of +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters and a creature being put into its owners graveyard are both state-based actions. When state-based actions are checked, Gleeful Arsonist will die at the same time the +1/+1 counters are removed, however the trigger will look at Gleeful Arsonist before any of those state-based actions were performed to determine whether it triggers or not, which in this case it will not.

question: Alessandro controls [Angel's Tomb] and no other creatures. They cast [Mirage Phalanx]. Can they pair it with Angel's Tomb?
answer_gold: No. Soulbond is a triggered ability that will only go on the stack if Alessandro controls another eligible creature when Mirage Phalanx enters the battlefield. However, before Angel's Tomb's ability resolves, Alessandro doesn't control any other eligible creatures.

question: Alexzander activates [Toymaker] to make Nova's [Rosethorn Halberd] an artifact creature, which was equipped to [Silverback Ape]. What happens?
answer_gold: Rosethorn Halberd will become an Equipment artifact creature and will become unattached from Silverback Ape as a state-based action.

question: Autumn controls no nonland, nontoken permanents and has begun their upkeep. Brinley puts their [Doom Foretold] trigger on the stack. Before it resolves Cole activates [Door to Nothingness] causing Brinley to lose the game. What will happen when Brinley's Doom Foretold trigger resolves?
answer_gold: Brinley's Doom Foretold trigger will not resolve. When Brinley leaves the game any triggers they control get removed from the stack.

question: Amiya controls a [Snow-Covered Forest] enchanted with [Utopia Sprawl]. Can they use it to cast two [Arcum's Astrolabe]s?
answer_gold: No. {S} can only be paid with mana generated by a permanent with the "snow" supertype, and Utopia Sprawl is the source of the second mana.

question: Ayaan controls [Eye of the Storm] and casts [Oaken Boon]. After Eye of the Storm's triggered ability resolves, they cast [Puncture Blast]. What happens?
answer_gold: Before Puncture Blast resolves, Eye of the Storm's triggered ability exiles it. However it won't cast Oaken Boon since it isn't an instant or a sorcery card in exile. Eye of the Storm will however exile and then copy Puncture Blast as normal. (Ayaan won't be able to cast the normal half of Oaken Boon from exile, because it didn't resolve and the effect putting it in exile does not allow their to cast it from there.)

question: Aubrey casts [Tempt with Discovery]. Do Aubrey's opponents get to see the land they're getting before deciding whether to get their own land?
answer_gold: Yes. The spell resolves in the order it's written, and on Tempt with Discovery it instructs Aubrey to put a land onto the battlefield, and then gives their opponents the option to do the same.

question: Aspen controls [Protean Thaumaturge]. They cast [Eaten by Piranhas] targeting their [Volunteer Militia]. If they choose to have Protean Thaumaturge's triggered ability also target Volunteer Militia, what will the characteristics of Protean Thaumaturge be?
answer_gold: Protean Thaumaturge will be a copy of Volunteer Militia but will retain its triggered ability. Eaten by Piranhas will enter the battlefield and simultaneously change many of the characteristics of Volunteer Militia. Afterwards Protean Thaumaturge's triggered ability will be put on the stack. When Protean Thaumaturge's triggered ability resolves it will copy the copiable values of Volunteer Militia. The effects of Eaten by Piranhas do not modify the copiable values of Volunteer Militia.

question: Nolan controls [Ancient Den]. At the beginning of Anne's upkeep, [Corrosion] triggers. When it resolves, will Ancient Den be destroyed?
answer_gold: Yes. Corrosion destroys artifacts that have a mana value equal or less than the amount of rust counters on it.

question: Ayden activates [Idol of Oblivion]'s second ability. Before that resolves Nico casts [Gather Specimens]. Whose control will Idol of Oblivion's token enter the battlefield under?
answer_gold: The token will enter the battlefield under Nico's control. Creating a token means that Ayden will put a token onto the battlefield. If that token is a creature token it qualifies as an event that Gather Specimens can replace, and the token will enter the battlefield under Nico's control instead.

question: Alijah controls [Clockwork Beast] which has one +1/+0 counter on it. They want to activate its ability with X = 8. Can they?
answer_gold: Yes, but when it resolves Alijah can't choose to put the full 8 +1/+0 counters on it; only up to 6.

question: Ariel would like to choose colorless for [Uncharted Haven]. Can they?
answer_gold: No. Colorless is not a color.

question: Ainsley casts [Expose to Daylight] targeting Noel's [Razorfield Thresher]. Before that resolves, Noel casts [Mirrorweave] targeting [Triton Wavebreaker]. Will Razorfield Thresher still be destroyed?
answer_gold: Yes. During the resolution of the spell it will check to see if the targets are still legal. While Razorfield Thresher is no longer an artifact, it still satisfies the targeting requirements of Expose to Daylight and will be destroyed.

question: Adonis has 8 cards in their hand. They move to their cleanup step and discard a card. Can Nico cast [Dream Salvage] during Adonis's cleanup step?
answer_gold: No. Players will not get priority in the cleanup step unless an ability has triggered or a state-based action has been performed.

question: Alfredo controls a [Wall of Roots] with a -0/-1 counter on it. They activate [Coral Reef], putting a +0/+1 counter on the Wall of Roots. Are the counters removed?
answer_gold: No. Alfredo now controls a Wall of Roots with a +0/+1 counter as well as a -0/-1 counter on it. While the game has a rule that causes +1/+1 and -1/-1 counters to be removed as a state-based action, it doesn't have a similar rule for other types of counters that offset each other.

question: Noa has [Deep-Sea Kraken] suspended with one suspend counter left. Alvin casts [Dragonlord Silumgar]. Are they able to gain control of Deep-Sea Kraken?
answer_gold: If Noa chooses to cast it, yes. When Alvin casts Dragonlord Silumgar, the triggered ability to remove a suspend counter from Deep-Sea Kraken will resolve and go on the stack above Dragonlord Silumgar. When Dragonlord Silumgar enters the battlefield, Deep-Sea Kraken will be available as a target for its triggered ability, unless Noa chose to leave it in exile forever.

question: Ariyah controls [The Ozolith] and [Putrid Goblin] with a -1/-1 counter on it. What happens if Putrid Goblin dies?
answer_gold: Putrid Goblin will not return to the battlefield. The Ozolith will have a -1/-1 counter put on it. The Ozolith's ability does not remove counters from the creature, it just puts counters on The Ozolith matching the number and types of counters that the creature had on it when it died. Persist will look back in time to determine if Putrid Goblin had a -1/-1 counter on it at the time it died. Since it did, persist will not trigger.

question: Ayla controls [The Ozolith] and [Gideon Jura]. They use Gideon Jura's ability to turn it into a creature. When they pass turn and Gideon Jura stops being a creature, will The Ozolith trigger?
answer_gold: The Ozolith will not trigger. Gideon Jura only stopped being a creature, it did not leave the battlefield.

question: Addison controls [Tayam, Luminous Enigma] and three Eldrazi Scion tokens that have vigilance counters and "Sacrifice this creature: Add {1}". Addison is activating Tayam, Luminous Enigma's ability. Can they remove the counters and sacrifice the tokens to pay for the ability?
answer_gold: No. When activating Tayam, Luminous Enigma's ability, Addison must first activate mana abilities and afterwards pays other costs. They can't remove counters from creatures they have sacrificed.

question: Can Ari use [Sunforger] to find [Order // Chaos]?
answer_gold: No. The mana value of Order // Chaos is more than 4.

question: Ares controls [Majestic Auricorn] merged with [Orochi Eggwatcher] on top. They cause Orochi Eggwatcher to flip. What happens?
answer_gold: The merged permanent will flip. The merged permanent will now use Orochi Eggwatcher's flip-side alternate characteristics. This will not affect any abilities the merged permanent has because of Majestic Auricorn, since that component is not a flip card.

question: Amelie mutates [Vadrok, Apex of Thunder] on top of a face-down [Guardian Shield-Bearer]. What are the characteristics of resulting permanent?
answer_gold: It's a face-up creature with all characteristics of Vadrok, Apex of Thunder. It doesn't have additional abilities since Guardian Shield-Bearer is still considered face-down for the purpose of determining the merged permanent's characteristics. Since it is already face-up, this creature can't be turned face up for Guardian Shield-Bearer's morph cost.

question: Avery manifests the top card of their library with [Soul Summons]. Then, they mutate [Trumpeting Gnarr] targeting the manifested creature. What are the characteristics of the resulting creature if Avery chooses to put the manifested creature on top?
answer_gold: It is a 2/2 colorless face-down creature with no abilities. It is face-down because the topmost object is face-down, and this status defines its characteristics. This notably means that Trumpeting Gnarr's triggered ability won't trigger.

question: Adrian controls [Benalish Infantry] and casts [Domestication] targeting Nico's [Zilortha, Strength Incarnate]. In response, Nico casts [Cinderclasm] to deal 1 damage to Benalish Infantry. What happens to Benalish Infantry?
answer_gold: Benalish Infantry is destroyed after Domestication resolves, before any player gets priority. Damage from Cinderclasm indeed remains marked on Benalish Infantry until end of turn and the game checks to see if it is lethal each time state-based actions are checked.

question: Aydin is attacking with [Iron Tusk Elephant]. Nadia controls [Zilortha, Strength Incarnate] and blocks with [Kraken Hatchling]. What is the maximum amount of damage Aydin can deal to Nadia?
answer_gold: Three. Aydin can choose to assign zero damage to Kraken Hatchling as the amount of damage considered lethal is zero.

question: Alanna controls [Boneyard Lurker] mutated on top of [Magitek Infantry]. They activate the ability of the merged permanent. Can they get a Boneyard Lurker from their library?
answer_gold: No. Boneyard Lurker's ability specifically states that it gets a card named "Magitek Infantry". Usually when a card refers to itself by name in the text box, it's referring to whatever the name of the permanent currently is. However when the game uses the formatting "a card named...", it refers to cards that have that specific name printed on them.

question: Aisha controls a merged permanent that consists of [Boneyard Lurker] and [Gaea's Skyfolk] with Boneyard Lurker being the topmost card. Aisha then casts [Ixidron]. What are the characteristics of the merged permanent after Ixidron enters the battlefield?
answer_gold:
The merged permanent is a 2/2 creature with no abilities that consists of two components, both of which are face down.

As Ixidron enters the battlefield, each component of the merged permanent is turned face down. This makes the merged permanent a 2/2 creature with no abilities.

question: Aubrey controls [Luminous Broodmoth], [Aegis Turtle], and [Tobita, Master of Winds]. Aubrey's Aegis Turtle dies. Does it return to the battlefield with a flying counter?
answer_gold: No. For 'dies' triggers the game will look right before the event to determine if the ability triggered. In this case right before it died, Aegis Turtle had flying, and won't trigger Luminous Broodmoth.

question: April casts [Spontaneous Flight] targeting their [Mist Dragon]. After that resolves April then activates its 'lose flying' ability. They cast another Spontaneous Flight targeting Mist Dragon. After that resolves they then use [Hex Parasite] to remove one flying counter. Does Mist Dragon have flying?
answer_gold: Yes. Keyword counters and ability-removing effects all apply in layer 6 in timestamp order. However when April put the second flying counter on Mist Dragon all flying counters on Mist Dragon had their timestamps updated to match the most recent counter. Meaning that the remaining flying counter on Mist Dragon has a newer timestamp than the activation of the ability that causes it to lose flying.

question: Alessandra controls [Soul Seizer] (back face [Ghastly Haunting])which has been mutated with [Boneyard Lurker]. Boneyard Lurker is the top component. Nolan controls [Redwood Treefolk]. Alessandra then attacks Nolan with the merged permanent. Nolan declared no blockers and the merged permanent deals damage to Nolan. What happens when the transformation trigger resolves if Alessandra elects to transform the merged permanent and targets Redwood Treefolk?
answer_gold:
The component that consists of Soul Seizer is transformed. The merged permanent is still a creature. It is not attached to anything. The merged permanent has the abilities in the text box of the back half of Soul Seizer instead of the front half.

When Alessandra chooses to transform the merged permanent, all double-faced components are transformed. The merged permanent now has the abilities of the back half of Soul Seizer instead of the front half. ([702.140e]) The merged permanent is still a creature as Boneyard Lurker is still the topmost card. When the transformation trigger tries to attach the merged permanent to Redwood Treefolk, it can't attach because the merged permanent is still a creature. It remains on the battlefield because the state-based action that puts auras not attached to anything into the graveyard is looking for the "Aura" subtype, not the "Enchant" keyword.

question: Autumn controls [Illuna, Apex of Wishes] and mutates a second copy of Illuna, Apex of Wishes onto it. Will one of the Illuna, Apex of Wishes's be put into their graveyard?
answer_gold: No. When Illuna, Apex of Wishes mutates onto another card, the combination is considered one permanent. ([702.140c], [704.5j])

question: Avery controls [Teferi, Mage of Zhalfir] and [Minotaur Abomination]. Can Avery mutate [Sawtusk Demolisher] onto Minotaur Abomination during their upkeep?
answer_gold: Yes. Choosing to mutate a creature is an alternative cost and doesn't change when Avery could legally cast the spell, since a mutated creature spell is still a creature spell on the stack. ([702.140a], [118.9]) Having flash allows them to cast the spell at any time they could cast an instant.

question: Averie controls a merged permanent, which consists of [Mischievous Quanar] (the topmost card) and [Regal Leosaur]. Averie then activates the first ability of Mischievous Quanar. What are the characteristics of the merged permanent after the ability resolves? Can it be turned face-up again?
answer_gold:
The merged permanent will be a 2/2 creature with no abilities nor subtypes that consists of two, face-down cards.

When the ability of Mischievous Quanar resolves, each face-up card that makes up the merged permanent is turned face down. This makes the merged permanent a 2/2 creature with no abilities nor subtypes consisting of two, face-down cards.

It can be turned face up, since it would have morph if it were face up.

question: Avery casts [Vulpikeet] for its mutate cost, mutating under a 1/1 red Goblin creature token. They then cast [Rootborn Defenses], choosing to populate the merged permanent. What happens?
answer_gold: They will create a token that is a copy of the 1/1 red Goblin creature token with all abilities from Vulpikeet. To populate means to create a copy of a creature token the player controls. A mutated permanent has the characteristics of its topmost component, along with all abilities of each card and token that represents it, so it will be a token and can therefore be populated. ([702.140e], [729.2d]) This is a copyable effect, so the copy created when Avery populates the merged permanent will also have the characteristics of the Goblin token and the abilities from Vulpikeet.

question: Avery casts [Dirge Bat] targeting [Dutiful Servants] to mutate unto it. Can Nevaeh cast [Withering Boon] to counter Dirge Bat?
answer_gold: Yes, Nevaeh can use Withering Boon to counter Dirge Bat if it was cast for the mutate cost. A spell that was cast for a mutate cost is still a creature spell and, therefore, can be countered by Withering Boon. ([702.140a])

question: Aubrey controls [Otrimi, the Ever-Playful] which is merged with [Isamaru, Hound of Konda]. They cast [Teferi's Protection]. What happens when the merged permanent phases back in?
answer_gold: The merged permanent will phase back in looking exactly as it did when it phased out. Being phased out is a change in status like being tapped or untapped and does not cause a zone change. While the merged permanent is on the battlefield it is treated as a single object.

question: Axton controls [Bloodchief Ascension] with 3 quest counters on it, and Nadia controls [Ironroot Treefolk] merged with two [Dreamtail Heron]s. If the merged permanent dies, how many times will Bloodchief Ascension trigger?
answer_gold: Three. Bloodchief Ascension counts the number of cards entering Axton's graveyard, of which there are three.

question: Alex controls [Surrak Dragonclaw] and attacks with [Torbran, Thane of Red Fell]. Nick blocks with [Cliffhaven Sell-Sword]. What is the maximum amount of damage Alex can deal to Nick?
answer_gold: Three. When assigning combat damage, the game doesn't take into consideration any replacement effects that are modifying the damage. Alex must assign at least one damage to Cliffhaven Sell-Sword and the remaining damage to Nick. Afterwards the game applies Torbran, Thane of Red Fell's replacement effect and both Nick and Cliffhaven Sell-Sword are dealt three damage.

question: Alonzo casts [Finale of Eternity] for X=10, and returns [Golgari Grave-Troll] and no other cards from their graveyard to the battlefield. How many counters does it get?
answer_gold: One. Golgari Grave-Troll has a replacement effect that modifies how it enters the battlefield, and when the game checks to apply that effect, Golgari Grave-Troll is still in the graveyard and therefore counts itself.

question: Alex controls [Mist Leopard] and [Ruination Wurm] which is enchanted by their [All That Glitters]. Alex then casts [Flicker of Fate] targeting All That Glitters. Can Alex attach All That Glitters to Mist Leopard as All That Glitters enters the battlefield?
answer_gold: Yes. Auras that are entering the battlefield from anywhere other than the stack don't have a target. Since Flicker of Fate does not specify a target for All That Glitters, Alex can attach it to Mist Leopard.

question: Aspen controls [Zirda, the Dawnwaker], [Sivitri Scarzam], and [Mobilized District]. How much does Aspen have to pay to activate the second ability of Mobilized District?
answer_gold:
Aspen can either pay {1} or {0}.

There are two effects that are reducing the cost of the second ability of Mobilized District. Because of this, Aspen can choose the order in which they will apply. If Aspen applies the reduction of effect from Mobilized District first then from Zirda, the Dawnwaker, Aspen will pay {1} because Zirda, the Dawnwaker can't reduce a cost to less than one mana. Alternatively, Aspen can apply the reduction from Zirda, the Dawnwaker first then from Mobilized District. This would require Aspen to spend {0} because the effect from Zirda, the Dawnwaker reduces the cost to {2} then the reduction for Mobilized District reduces it to {0}.

question: Ares controls [Blood Moon]. They casts [Hunting Wilds] kicked, searching for two [Hedge Maze]s. What happens?
answer_gold: The Hedge Mazes enter the battlefield tapped. They will not untap or become 3/3 creatures. When Hedge Maze is on the battlefield, it's a Mountain. Which means it isn't a Forest that was put onto the battlefield with Hunting Wilds, and isn't eligible for the additional effects of that spell.

question: Aubrielle has [Alex Wilder, Runaway] and three other cards in their graveyard. Aubrielle announces that they are escaping Alex Wilder, Runaway. Nico has [Fade from Memory] in their hand. Are they able to exile one of the cards in Aubrielle's graveyard to prevent them from casting Alex Wilder, Runaway?
answer_gold: No. Once Aubrielle has announced that they are casting Alex Wilder, Runaway Nico doesn't have an opportunity to cast Fade from Memory. Part of paying the costs to cast Alex Wilder, Runaway include exiling any cards that Fade from Memory could legally target. ([702.138a])

question: Nico controls [Vedalken Orrery]. Axl casts [Warrior's Oath]. After it resolves, Nico casts [Trouble in Pairs]. Axl passes the turn. Who takes the next turn?
answer_gold: Nico will take the next turn. Trouble in Pairs generates a replacement effect that will replace Axl taking an extra turn with them not taking an extra turn. It doesn't matter that Trouble in Pairs was cast after Warrior's Oath was resolved, only that it is on the battlefield at the time the extra turn would begin.

question: Ainsley controls [Blood Moon], [Opalescence], [Akoum Hellhound], and [Conspiracy] naming "Human". They cast [Exchange of Words], targeting Blood Moon and Akoum Hellhound. Will this change their abilities?
answer_gold: Yes, Humans made Landfall on the Moon in 1969.

question: In a four-player game, Annabelle controls [Champion of Arashin] and cast [Chandra's Ignition] targeting Champion of Arashin. After Chandra's Ignition resolves, how many triggers from the lifelink ability on Champion of Arashin will be put on the stack?
answer_gold:
This does not happen as described.

Lifelink is not a triggered ability. Rather, it is a static ability. So, Annabelle will gain life as part of the damage-dealing process.

question: [Gyruda, Doom of Depths] enters the battlefield causing Alice to put the top four cards of their library into their graveyard. What will happen if [Blightsteel Colossus] is in the top four cards of their library?
answer_gold: When Gyruda, Doom of Depths's trigger resolves Alice will take the top four cards of their library and put them into their graveyard. Blightsteel Colossus has a replacement effect that will cause it to be shuffled into Alice's library instead. Because Blightsteel Colossus is no longer in Alice's graveyard and Gyruda, Doom of Depths cannot find it to bring it back to the battlefield.

question: Aspen controls [Glistener Elf]. Aspen attacks Neymar, who controls [Zilortha, Strength Incarnate] and [Imperial Outrider]. Neymar blocks block Glistener Elf with Imperial Outrider. What happens to Imperial Outrider after damage as been dealt?
answer_gold:
Imperial Outrider remains on the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter and no damage marked on it.

When Glistener Elf deals damage to Imperial Outrider, a -1/-1 counter is placed on Imperial Outrider instead of damage being marked. The power of Imperial Outrider is now zero. It does not die due to the effect of Zilortha, Strength Incarnate as there is no damage marked on Imperial Outrider.

question: April controls [Felhide Minotaur] which has [Trumpeting Gnarr] mutated under it. Nico controls [Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet] and casts [Price of Fame] targeting April's Felhide Minotaur. How many Zombie Tokens will Nico create?
answer_gold: Nico will create one Zombie Token. Only one creature would be dying, even though two cards are moving to the graveyard.

question: Adalynn controls [Anax, Hardened in the Forge] and [Runaway Steam-Kin] with three +1/1 counters and one damage marked on it. Adalynn removes three counters to cast [Goblin Hero] and Runaway Steam-Kin dies. How many Satyr tokens does Adalynn get?
answer_gold: One. Adalynn removes the counters from Runaway Steam-Kin and when state-based actions are checked Runaway Steam-Kin has one toughness and one damage marked on it, causing it to die. Anax, Hardened in the Forge's trigger will check to see what Runaway Steam-Kin looked like right before it died, and at that point it had one power.

question: Nathan controls [Archetype of Imagination]. Alex casts [Spontaneous Flight] and puts a flying counter on their [Seagraf Skaab]. Afterwards Archetype of Imagination dies. Does Seagraf Skaab have flying?
answer_gold: Yes. There is nothing preventing it from having flying. Counters and continuous effects are constantly evaluated, the game doesn't "remember" anything about a previous effect once it's gone.

question: Aimee controls [Fiend Artisan] and has four creature cards in their graveyard. Nico enchants it with [Mystic Subdual]. What is the power and toughness of Fiend Artisan?
answer_gold: Fiend Artisan is a -1/1. In layer 6 Mystic Subdual eliminates the abilities of Fiend Artisan. In layer 7 Mystic Subdual gives Fiend Artisan -2/-0, making it a -1/1. Its ability to gain +1/+1 from each creature card in Aimee's graveyard does not apply, as it was removed.

question: Abdiel casts [Thirst for Meaning] and would like to discard two copies of [Bitter Work]. Can they?
answer_gold: Yes. Upon resolution Abdiel will decide whether they would like to discard an enchantment, if not they discard two cards, regardless of what they are.

question: Ariel has [Mind Harness] and [Pitiless Fists] in their graveyard. Can Ariel casts [Replenish] and attach both enchantments to Nylah's [Scathe Zombies]?
answer_gold: No. Both Pitiless Fists and Replenish are entering the battlefield simultaneously, Ariel must choose what they will be enchanting as they enter and that choice must be legal before either of them are on the battlefield.

question: Nala controls [Phyrexian Revoker] naming [Merfolk Looter]. Addison casts [Archipelagore] choosing to mutate it onto Merfolk Looter placing Archipelagore on top. Can Addison activate the ability of the merged permanent?
answer_gold: Yes. When Addison mutates Archipelagore on top of Merfolk Looter the merged permanent will have the name of Archipelagore and will not be affected by Phyrexian Revoker. ([702.140a], [702.140e], [729.2a])

question: Avery controls [Medomai's Prophecy] and [Hex Parasite]. They place the second lore counter on Medomai's Prophecy and name "[Steady Progress]". They activate Hex Parasite to remove a counter. Then they cast Steady Progress and choose to proliferate Medomai's Prophecy, this time naming "[Colossapede]". On Avery's next turn, which card or cards can they cast that will trigger Medomai's Prophecy and allow them to draw two cards?
answer_gold: Both Steady Progress and Colossapede will trigger Medomai's Prophecy and cause Avery to draw two cards. Medomai's Prophecy has two triggered abilities that are linked. When Medomai's Prophecy's ability checks to see what the "chosen names" are, the game will return two values.

question: Alex controls [Anthem of Rakdos] and casts their last card, [Flame Spill], targeting a 1/1 creature that Noel controls. How much damage will Noel take?
answer_gold: Six. First Alex will allocate one damage to the token and three to Noel. Anthem of Rakdos's replacement effect will then double the three damage being dealt to Noel to six.

question: Aisha controls [Mox Tantalite] and [Corrosion]. When Corrosion's upkeep trigger resolves, will Mox Tantalite be destroyed?
answer_gold: Yes. Corrosion destroys artifacts that have a mana value equal or less than the amount of rust counters on it. Mox Tantalite has a mana value of zero, which is equal to the number of rust counters on it.

question: Amani controls [Sphinx's Tutelage] and targets Noe with its ability, whose library has only two cards left. When Sphinx's Tutelage's ability resolves, both milled cards are [Hostility]. What happens next?
answer_gold: Because both Hostility share a color, the milling process is repeated. Their triggered abilities trigger, but are not put onto the stack at this time, since an ability is still resolving. When the process repeats, no cards are milled because Noe's library has no cards left.. Therefore, there are no cards matching color, the process does not repeat anymore, and Sphinx's Tutelage's ability finishes resolving. The triggered abilities from both Hostility are now put onto the stack, and upon resolution, the cards are shuffled into Noe's library.

question: Nylah controls [Volcanic Island]. Augustine casts [Seismic Stomp]. After that resolves, Nylah cast [Hired Blade]. Which creatures can block this turn?
answer_gold: Both Hired Blade and Volcanic Island can't block this turn. The continuous effect generated by Seismic Stomp changes the rules of the game but doesn't change the characteristics of any objects.

question: Angelina controls [Butcher Ghoul] and casts [Phantasmal Image], choosing to copy Butcher Ghoul. When Phantasmal Image dies, what happens?
answer_gold: When Phantasmal Image dies it will trigger undying and will return to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
