For 'dies' triggers the game will look at the permanent before it died to determine if they trigger or not. Phantasmal Image had undying before it went to the graveyard and so it'll trigger. As it enters the battlefield Angelina will have the option to choose what creature it will copy.

question: Addison has four [Rain-Slicked Copse]s and uses two of them to cast [Flash]. They put [Nyxbloom Ancient] onto the battlefield. Can they pay to keep it from being sacrificed?
answer_gold: Yes. Spells resolve in the order they are written. Addison will put Nyxbloom Ancient onto the battlefield and then have the option to pay for it, at this point their lands tap for three mana each, which is more than enough to pay for Nyxbloom Ancient.

question: Can Alijah use mana from [Lupinflower Village] to mutate [Regal Leosaur] onto [Ravenous Robots]?
answer_gold: Yes. A mutating creature spell is a type of creature spell. ([702.140a])

question: Nolan controls [Notion Thief]. Alisha has [Stinkweed Imp] in their graveyard and casts [Research the Deep]. Can Alisha choose to dredge?
answer_gold: Yes. Notion Thief and Stinkweed Imp both have replacement effects that apply when Alisha is drawing a card. Because they are the affected player they can chooses which effect to apply. If they choose to apply Notion Thief then they can't dredge and if they applies Stinkweed Imp, then Nolan won't draw any cards.

question: Avery casts [Wall of Stolen Identity] choosing to copy their [Zacama, Primal Calamity]. Will Avery get to untap their lands?
answer_gold: Yes. Zacama, Primal Calamity only cares that it was cast, not what characteristics had at the time it was cast.

question: Arturo controls [Amarant Coral]. Nicole controls [Collective Restraint] and no land with a basic land type. Does Arturo have to attack with Amarant Coral?
answer_gold: No. Even though the cost to attack is {0}, it is still a cost and Arturo can choose not to pay for it.

question: Ayaan controls [Death's Shadow] and is at 12 life. Nora casts [Flame Spill] targeting Death's Shadow. Does it live?
answer_gold:
Yes. 

As Flame Spill resolves, it deals one damage to Death's Shadow and three damage to Ayaan. This reduces their life total to nine, which increases the power and toughness of Death's Shadow to four. Then, state-based actions are checked, but Death's Shadow does not have lethal damage marked on it.

question: Nixon controls [Zilortha, Strength Incarnate] and [Phyrexian Walker]. Aliza attacks with [Summon: Kujata] and Nixon blocks it with Phyrexian Walker. What is the maximum amount of damage that can be dealt to Nixon?
answer_gold:
Seven. Zilortha, Strength Incarnate's ability means that for damage assignment purposes Phyrexian Walker is treated as if it has zero toughness. It therefore already has lethal damage marked on it, and Summon: Kujata can trample over it for the full 7.

This does mean that Phyrexian Walker will remain alive, since it won't have any damage marked on it. If Aliza wants Phyrexian Walker to die, they will need to assign at least 1 damage to it and only 6 to Nixon.

question: Aarush controls [Willow Elf] merged with [Souvenir Snatcher] on top. They then cast [Naga Fleshcrafter] choosing to copy the merged permanent. Will the mutate trigger occur?
answer_gold: No. A mutate trigger only occurs as a result of a mutating creature spell merging with a creature. ([702.140d])

question: Arielle controls [Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger]. Blaine taps a land for mana. Afterwards Carlos activates [Door to Nothingness] and causes Arielle to lose the game. Will Blaine's land untap?
answer_gold: No. Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger has a triggered ability that occurs whenever one of Arielle's opponent's taps a land for mana. Once that ability has resolved and created the continuous effect that prevents the land from untapping, it will continue to exist until it expires. Effects don't have an owner or a controller, so someone losing the game doesn't make them go away.

question: Aldo casts [Selective Adaptation] and reveals [Seacoast Drake] and no other creatures. Can Aldo choose not to put it onto the battlefield?
answer_gold: No. Aldo isn't searching their library, and therefore they cannot fail to execute the instructions on the card.

question: Amina has four copies of [Yidaro, Wandering Monster] in their hand, and activates the cycling ability of each of them before any of the triggered abilities resolve. How many Yidaro, Wandering Monsters will enter the battlefield?
answer_gold: Four. Yidaro, Wandering Monster's ability checks upon resolution to see how many times Amina has activated the cycling ability of Yidaro, Wandering Monster this game.

question: Adalynn attacks Nico with [Mass of Ghouls]. Nico declares no blockers but casts [Gideon's Sacrifice] to cause their [Stormwild Capridor] to take five damage instead of them. What will happen when the damage occurs?
answer_gold: Stormwild Capridor will take five damage and die. Gideon's Sacrifice doesn't change the type of damage, it just redirects it.

question: Arabella controls [Shirei, Shizo's Caretaker] and [Staunch Shieldmate] dies. Then Shirei, Shizo's Caretaker dies but Arabella plays another Shirei, Shizo's Caretaker from their hand. Will Staunch Shieldmate be returned to the battlefield at the beginning of the next end step?
answer_gold: No. The Shirei, Shizo's Caretaker that the delayed trigger is referring to is the Shirei, Shizo's Caretaker that died. The new Shirei, Shizo's Caretaker is a different object and therefore doesn't satisfy the if clause in the original Shirei, Shizo's Caretaker's trigger.

question: Alex controls [Teshar, Ancestor's Apostle], [Lurrus of the Dream-Den], and [Ashnod's Altar]. Alex casts [Sundial, Dawn Tyrant] from their graveyard with Lurrus of the Dream-Den's ability. Alex sacrifices Lurrus of the Dream-Den to Ashnod's Altar to pay for Sundial, Dawn Tyrant. Would Teshar, Ancestor's Apostle's triggered ability be able to return Lurrus of the Dream-Den from the graveyard to the battlefield?
answer_gold: Yes. The game checks whether a spell is legal to cast in [601.2e], but mana abilities aren't activated until after that point. So Lurrus of the Dream-Den is on the battlefield at the point where the game checks the spell's legality. Finally, because Lurrus of the Dream-Den is in the graveyard when Alex needs to declare targets for Teshar, Ancestor's Apostle's ability, it's a legal choice.

question: Ainsley activates and resolves [Words of War]. Ainsley then activates [Selvala, Explorer Returned]. Is its ability still a mana ability?
answer_gold: Yes. It is a requirement for an activated ability to not have targets in order to be a mana ability. The only target involved here is that of Words of War, which is during its activation. Selvala, Explorer Returned's ability does not have a target.

question: Alaia controls [Rielle, the Everwise] and casts [Kindle the Carnage]. While resolving Kindle the Carnage, Alaia chooses to discard a total of 3 cards, triggering Rielle, the Everwise. How many cards will Alaia draw when the trigger resolves?
answer_gold:
Alaia will draw one card.

Each card that Alaia discards during the resolution of Kindle the Carnage constitutes its own discard event since they happen sequentially rather than all at the same time. Rielle, the Everwise will trigger after the first of these. Since only one card is discarded in that event, Alaia will draw one card from the trigger.

question: Alex controls a tapped [Skyshroud Elf] and [Ashnod's Altar]. Can they cast [Thundersong Trumpeter]?
answer_gold: No. Alex can activate Skyshroud Elf's second ability and use Ashnod's Altar to pay for it, but by the time they have the opportunity to activate its ability an additional time, Skyshroud Elf is no longer on the battlefield.

question: Anson controls [Underworld Breach] and has [Quarrel's End] and two other cards their graveyard. Can they discard a card to its additional cost and then exile that card and the two others to cast it?
answer_gold: Yes. Costs to cast a spell can be paid in any order.

question: Alan has 3 cards left in their library and activates [Jace, Wielder of Mysteries]'s last loyalty ability. In response, Nico casts [Vanish into Eternity] to remove Jace, Wielder of Mysteries. When Jace, Wielder of Mysteries's ability resolves, does Alan win or lose the game?
answer_gold: Alan will win the game. Even though they tried to draw from an empty library, they won't lose until state-based actions are next checked. However, this doesn't happen until after Jace, Wielder of Mysteries's ability is finished resolving. The last sentence of Jace, Wielder of Mysteries's ability will make Alan win during the resolution of the ability.

question: Nico controls [Savannah Lions]. Ace casts [Oubliette] targeting it. Will Savannah Lions phase back in at the beginning of Nico's next untap step?
answer_gold: No. Effects that phase a permanent out until a certain event prevent that permanent from phasing back in normally.

question: Nico controls [Repentant Blacksmith]. Can Apollo cast [Strange Inversion] targeting Repentant Blacksmith with [Evermind] spliced onto it?
answer_gold: No. Evermind has a color indicator making it blue, which is not granted by splice since it's not part of the card's text.

question: Ariel casts [Kathari Remnant] and reveals [Harrow] with the cascade trigger. Can they tap their lands for mana before sacrificing them?
answer_gold: No. Harrow must be cast while the casade trigger is resolving, during which time no player gets priority. And since Harrow doesn't require a mana payment when it's being cast with cascade, Ariel doesn't get a chance to activate mana abilities.

question: Alfonso activates the equip ability of [Sword of the Meek] targeting [Kraken Hatchling]. Before that resolves Nico uses [Aladdin]'s ability to gain control of Sword of the Meek. What will happen when the equip ability resolves?
answer_gold:
The equip ability resolves as normal. Alfonso still controls both the equip ability and the creature Sword of the Meek is being attached to.

Since Nico controls the Equipment, they are the one who can choose to activate the equip ability again to move it elsewhere.

question: Abdullah controls [Glasspool Mimic] that is a copy of [Lambholt Elder] and casts [Moonmist]. What happens?
answer_gold: Glasspool Mimic does not transform since only transforming double-faced cards can transform.

question: Neil controls [Confounding Conundrum]. Averi hasn't played a land this turn and casts [Circuitous Route]. How many lands get returned to Averi's hand?
answer_gold: Two. Since the lands enter at the same time and such will both trigger Confounding Conundrum since triggered abilities check to see if they trigger after the event happens.

question: Alex casts [Thieves' Auction]. They choose [Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle], then five [Archaeological Dig]s, and finally [Blood Moon], in that order. How many times will Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle trigger?
answer_gold: Zero. Each Archaeological Dig will enter the battlefield as itself and not a mountain, since Blood Moon is the last card to enter Alex's battlefield. Therefore, none of them will trigger Thieves' Auction.

question: Agustin uses [Gideon, Ally of Zendikar]'s [+1] ability to turn it into a creature in their precombat main phase and attaches [Helm of the Host] to it. What is the copy that's made by Helm of the Host?
answer_gold: The copy of Gideon, Ally of Zendikar will be a non-legendary planeswalker with haste; it is not a creature.

question: Ari controls [Cactus Preserve] and [Twilight Mire]. What can Cactus Preserve tap for?
answer_gold: Either {B} or {G}. Cactus Preserve looks at the types of mana that Twilight Mire could produce if its abilities resolved right now, regardless of whether they can be activated.

question: Will [Deathrite Shaman]'s first ability trigger [Badgermole Cub]?
answer_gold: No. "Tapping a permanent for mana" only refers to mana abilities. Deathrite Shaman's ability isn't a mana ability since it has a target.

question: Arian controls [Zedruu the Greathearted], [Undead Minotaur], and [Cave Sense] enchanting Undead Minotaur. Arian activates Zedruu the Greathearted's ability targeting Nathalie and Cave Sense. When Zedruu the Greathearted's ability resolves, what happens?
answer_gold: Zedruu the Greathearted's ability changes control of Cave Sense from Arian to Nathalie. If an Aura enchants an object, changing control of the Aura doesn't change control of the object. Thus, Cave Sense becomes an object that is owned by Arian, controlled by Nathalie, and enchanting Undead Minotaur.

question: Can Alex pay {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}{B} to cast [Beseech the Queen] or is Alex limited to only paying {B}{B}{B} to do so?
answer_gold: After the first step of casting a spell, which is announcing it and moving it to the stack, Alex makes choices regarding modes, alternative costs, additional costs, etc. This step includes deciding whether they will be paying {B} or {2} for each hybrid symbol ({2/B}) in Beseech the Queen's mana cost. They may always choose to cast it for {6} instead of {B}{B}{B} (or {2}{B}{B} or {4}{B}). Later on during the casting of the spell, the colorless parts of the mana cost may be paid with any color, including black.

question: Ashley controls [Omnath, Locus of Creation] and [Strionic Resonator]. When they play a land for the turn triggering Omnath, Locus of Creation, they activate Strionic Resonator. What happens?
answer_gold: The copied trigger resolves first and Ashley gains 4 life. Then the original trigger resolves and it is the second time the ability has resolved this turn, so they add {R}{G}{W}{U}.

question: Ally controls [Yixlid Jailer] and casts [Soulflayer] exiling [Oona's Prowler]. Will Soulflayer have flying?
answer_gold: No. Soulflayer looks for a card that "was exiled". "Exiled" in this sense is a verb, not an adjective. Soulflayer therefore checks the qualities of Oona's Prowler immediately before it left the graveyard, at which point it had no abilities.

question: Amare controls [Krark, the Thumbless] and casts [Dogpile] targeting Nico. In response to Krark, the Thumbless' trigger, Nico casts [Cryptic Command], countering Dogpile. What happens when Krark, the Thumbless' trigger resolves?
answer_gold:
Amare flips a coin. If they win, they copy Dogpile and may choose new targets for it. If they lose, nothing happens.

When resolving Krark, the Thumbless' ability, if Amare wins the flip, the ability requires information about Dogpile in order to copy it, but it is no longer on the stack. In this case, the last known information about the spell is used, and the copy is created. However, if Amare loses the flip, Krark, the Thumbless' ability can no longer find the spell on the stack to return it to hand, since it is now a new object in Amare's graveyard.. In this case, since no information about the spell is required to perform the effect, the effect simply does nothing.

question: Aidan controls [Magus of the Future] and the top card of their library is [Agadeem's Awakening]. Can they play [Agadeem, the Undercrypt] as their land for turn?
answer_gold: Yes.

question: Abraham casts [The Shattered States Era] targeting Naomi's [Savage Land Dinosaur] equipped with Naomi's [Sigiled Sword of Valeron]. After it resolves, Abraham attacks Naomi, who has the highest life total, with Savage Land Dinosaur. Who controls the token created with Sigiled Sword of Valeron's ability and who is the token attacking?
answer_gold: Naomi still controls Sigiled Sword of Valeron, so they control the created token. As Naomi is not the attacking player, the token is not attacking any player.

question: Aleah controls [Amorphous Axe] attached to [Ich-Tekik, Salvage Splicer]. How many counters does Ich-Tekik, Salvage Splicer get when an artifact is put into the graveyard from the battlefield?
answer_gold: 2, as it is also a Golem.

question: If Andre casts [Sakashima of a Thousand Faces] to copy [Maelstrom Wanderer], does Andre cascade?
answer_gold: No, cascade is a cast trigger and Sakashima of a Thousand Faces isn't a copy of Maelstrom Wanderer until it's on the battlefield.

question: If Agustin uses [Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker] to make a token of [Sea Gate Banneret], then uses [Brudiclad, Telchor Engineer] to turn the token Sea Gate Banneret into a different token, does Agustin have to sacrifice it still?
answer_gold: Yes, Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker asks Agustin to sacrifice the token it creates, it doesn't give the token an ability that makes Agustin sacrifice it, so turning into something else does nothing.

question: Angelica controls [Court of Grace] and [Vedalken Orrery]. At their first opportunity in their upkeep, they cast [Queen Marchesa]. When Court of Grace's triggered ability resolves, what happens?
answer_gold: Angelica creates a 4/4 white Angel token. Court of Grace's trigger does not have an intervening "if" clause, it just triggers at the beginning of all of Angelica's upkeeps and performs the specified actions when it resolves.

question: Nicolas controls [Crescendo of War] with one strife counter on it and a [Raging Bull]. Abby is attacking with [Questing Beast]. Can it be blocked?
answer_gold: No. During the declare blockers step, Nicolas will choose which creatures they want to blocks with and then checks whether those creatures are legal to be declared as blockers, if Raging Bull doesn't have more than three power at this point it will be an illegal blocker. The ability of Crescendo of War increases a creature's power as soon as it's legally declared as a blocker.

question: Annalee has unlimited blue mana and casts [Ghostly Flicker] targeting [Augur of Bolas] and [Bloodwater Entity]. They put Augur of Bolas's trigger on the stack first, then Bloodwater Entity's afterwards. They have Bloodwater Entity put Ghostly Flicker on top of their library and upon the resolution of Augur of Bolas's ability they'll select Ghostly Flicker out of the top three cards and put the other two on the bottom. Since they can repeat this any number of times, will they be able to sort their deck into any order?
answer_gold: It depends. This loop can eventually sort the deck if it contains an odd number of cards after Augur of Bolas's trigger resolves. If the deck is even, the general deck order must be preserved and cannot be sorted. The deck can be "cut" into two even stacks to any 2-card pair and that card pair can be set in any order. The order or every other 2-card pair can also be relatively set by Annalee.

question: Adrienne cast [Gamble]. Before that resolves Nico cast [Opposition Agent]. When Gamble resolves, can Nico look at Adrienne's hand?
answer_gold: Yes. Players are allowed to review their hands while searching their libraries, so Nico is allowed to look at Adrienne's hand.

question: Alex controls [Angel of Jubilation] and casts [Dash Hopes]. What happens?
answer_gold: Dash Hopes resolves as normal. Players may pay life to counter it because the payment is not to activate an ability or cast a spell.

question: If Atticus uses [Halvar, God of Battle]'s ability to attach [Helm of the Host] to Halvar, God of Battle, will they get a token copy of it?
answer_gold: It depends on the order in which Atticus puts the triggers onto the stack. If they have the Helm of the Host trigger resolve second, they will get a copy. Helm of the Host triggers at the beginning of combat regardless of whether it's attached to anything, and it makes a copy of whatever it's equipping on resolution.

question: Aubrey controls [Archive Haunt] which has been mutated with [Huntmaster Liger]. The mutated permanent is destroyed. Will Huntmaster Liger also be exiled?
answer_gold: Yes. Archive Haunt's ability is a replacement effect. Before the merged permanent is put into Aubrey's graveyard, the game will check to see if any replacement effects will modify the event. In this case Archive Haunt's ability will replace the event of the merged permanent going to the graveyard with being exiled. Since the permanent is being exiled, the same thing is happening to all of its components.

question: Adeline controls [Nature's Will] and deals combat damage to both Beverly and Camilo. Will they get two triggers?
answer_gold: Yes. Nature's Will is looking for the event of one or more creatures dealing combat damage to a single player, which is happening twice in this scenario.

question: Ashley casts [Aminatou's Augury] exiling an artifact and an instant. Afterwards Ashley casts another Aminatou's Augury, which exiles an instant. Can they cast both instants?
answer_gold: Yes. Each Aminatou's Augury creates a separate effect that applies to cards it exiled. Casting an instant off the first Aminatou's Augury doesn't preclude Ashley from casting an instant off the second one.

question: Addison controls [Sarkhan, the Dragonspeaker] and activates its ability, turning it into a creature. They then play a second Sarkhan, the Dragonspeaker. What happens when the second Sarkhan, the Dragonspeaker resolves?
answer_gold: As soon as the spell finishes resolving, state-based actions are checked and Addison will need to choose one Sarkhan, the Dragonspeaker to put into their graveyard. Regardless of what card type they are, both Sarkhan, the Dragonspeaker are legendary permanents with the same name, and therefore the 'legend rule' applies.

question: Axl activates [Ring of Ma'rûf]'s ability in their upkeep. What happens in Axl's draw step if they don't own any cards outside the game?
answer_gold: Axl is required to attempt to find a card from outside the game, if they fail to find one, then when the ability resolves they will put nothing into their hand. Since Ring of Ma'rûf sets up a replacement effect, Axl can't choose to ignore it.

question: Nico controls [Platinum Angel] and [Death's Shadow]. They have 5 life. Abel casts [Ghitu Fire] with X = 10, targeting Nico. What are the power and toughness of Death's Shadow after the spell resolves?
answer_gold: 13/13. Nico's life total is -5, but X can't be less than 0 on Death's Shadow.

question: Atlas controls [Master Biomancer], [Pir, Imaginative Rascal], and [Vorinclex, Monstrous Raider]. They cast [Corpsejack Menace]. How many +1/+1 counters does it enter the battlefield with?
answer_gold: Either 5 or 6, depending on the order of the choices that Atlas makes. Master Biomancer's effect needs to be applied first since none of the other effects apply to Corpsejack Menace entering without counters. Corpsejack Menace has no effect on itself because it needs to be on the battlefield before a creature enters in order to apply to it. So the only choice Atlas has is whether to apply Vorinclex, Monstrous Raider's effect first and end up with 5 counters or to apply Pir, Imaginative Rascal's effect first and end up with 6 counters.

question: Arthur activates a [Mishra's Foundry], then sacrifices it to [Phyrexian Plaguelord]. They choose to imprint it onto [Mimic Vat]. What happens when they activate Mimic Vat?
answer_gold: Arthur creates a copy of Mishra's Foundry which enters unanimated as a token. If the token becomes animated, it will still have haste. The copiable values are the printed characteristics on the card.

question: Addyson restarts the game with [Karn Liberated]'s last ability. They put a [Knight of Meadowgrain] onto the battlefield as it resolves. Can it attack on their first turn?
answer_gold: Yes. Karn's ability finishes resolving just before the first turn's untap step, so the creature has been controlled continuously since the turn began and can attack.

question: Asher controls [Teferi's Ageless Insight] and has 40 cards left in their library. They casts [Enter the Infinite]. What happens?
answer_gold: Asher attempts to draw 80 cards and successfully draws 40, puts a card from their hand on top of their library, and then loses the game.

question: Aleah attacks with a [Cloak and Dagger, Entwined] enchanted with [Lifelink]. How much life will Aleah gain?
answer_gold: Aleah will gain 2 life. Additional occurrences of lifelink are redundant.

question: Abraham controls a tapped [Pack Mastiff] enchanted with Nathalia's [Sleeping Potion]. What happens when Abraham activates Pack Mastiff's activated ability?
answer_gold: Nothing, other than the normal resolution of Pack Mastiff's ability. Pack Mastiff's ability doesn't use the word "target" and so while it has an effect on itself, it won't cause Sleeping Potion's ability to trigger.

question: Ariel attacks with [Survivor of Korlis]. Nevaeh blocks with [Trained Caracal]. What happens after the declare blockers step?
answer_gold: There is a first combat damage step during which Survivor of Korlis deals one (lethal) damage to Trained Caracal. Trained Caracal is destroyed when state-based actions are checked, before having the opportunity to deal damage during the second damage step. Nevaeh therefore does not gain life.

question: Autumn casts [Imoti, Celebrant of Bounty] and exiles [Bonfire of the Damned] for its Cascade ability. Can Autumn cast Bonfire of the Damned, and what would {X} be if they can?
answer_gold: Autumn can cast Bonfire of the Damned with {X}=0.

question: Natalie controls [Spellskite] while Ahmed controls [Lagac Lizard]. Ahmed casts [Merseine] targeting their Lagac Lizard. Natalie pays 2 life to activate Spellskite's abiltiy and targets Merseine. What happens?
answer_gold: Merseine becomes attached to Spellskite. Spellskite is a legal target for Merseine. Auras are targeted spells on the stack.

question: Ainsley controls [Magus of the Moon] and a face-down [Zoetic Cavern]. Can Ainsley turn Zoetic Cavern face-up?
answer_gold: No. Permanents with morph can only be turned face up if they would have a morph cost once they are face up. Magus of the Moon removes Zoetic Cavern's abilities.

question: Andres controls [Angel of Vitality] while Nico controls a tapped [Shire Shirriff] which exiled Andres's [Aerith Gainsborough]. Andres casts [Aerial Assault] targeting Nico's Shire Shirriff. How many +1/+1 counters will Aerith Gainsborough have after all spells and abilities have finished resolving?
answer_gold: One. Aerith Gainsborough is put back onto the battlefield immediately after Shire Shirriff dies but before Aerial Assault goes on resolving. Angel of Vitality is replacing the lifegain event, changing it to be +1, which doesn't matter for the sake of Aerith Gainsborough's ability as it still is one singular lifegain event.

question: Autumn cast [Scholar of the Ages]. In their graveyard are [Slip On the Ring], [Fortifying Draught], and 2 copies of [Poison the Well]. What are their options when it comes to returning cards?
answer_gold: They can either return no cards, one card of their choosing, or any combination of two.

question: Alia controls [Bag of Holding] and activates its first activated ability. When it resolves they draw a card and discard [Distemper of the Blood]. What happens?
answer_gold:
Alia can cast Distemper of the Blood. If they don't, it will either end up in exile or the graveyard, depending on the order in which they put the triggers on the stack.

When Distemper of the Blood is discarded, it's exiled instead of going to the graveyard. Alia can then choose in what order to put the triggers onto the stack. If the madness trigger resolves first and Alia doesn't cast it, it's put into their graveyard and then exiled to Bag of Holding. If the Bag of Holding trigger resolves first, it will do nothing since Distemper of the Blood is in exile. Then when the madness trigger resolves, if Alia doesn't cast it, it'll be moved to their graveyard.

question: Adelina controls [Garruk's Packleader] and casts [Rallying Roar] twice. After they both resolve, they cast [Spiritual Visit]. How many cards will they draw?
answer_gold: Zero. Rallying Roar will only affect creatures that were on the battlefield at the time it resolved.

question: In a game of Two-Headed Giant, both Archer and Avery have no cards left in their library. Archer controls [Laboratory Maniac]. What happens in their draw step?
answer_gold: Their team wins the game. Both players would draw their card at the same time. Laboratory Maniac replaces Archer's draw with winning the game. Since their team has won, Avery doesn't lose, since that doesn't happen until state-based actions are checked.

question: Ari controls [Xathrid Gorgon]. Neriah controls a [Hexavus] and [Stonehewer Giant]. Ari activates Xathrid Gorgon to put a petrification counter on Stonehewer Giant which Neriah removes with Hexavus. Can Neriah activate Stonehewer Giant's activated ability?
answer_gold: No, Neriah cannot activate Stonehewer Giant's ability. This is because the changes made by Xathrid Gorgon's ability are a continuous effect. The petrification counter serves only as a reminder of the changes and is not dependent on the counter. Stonehewer Giant will remain a defender that cannot activate it's abilities for the rest of the game.

question: Alejandra controls [Dictate of Heliod] and [Garruk's Packleader]. They cast [Kami of Old Stone]. Do they get to draw a card?
answer_gold: Yes. Dictate of Heliod generates a continuous effect that will apply to Kami of Old Stone simultaneously with it entering the battlefield, causing it to enter with three power.

question: Alexandra casts [Parting Thoughts] targeting Nico's [Dryad Militant]. In which zone is Parting Thoughts after resolution?
answer_gold: In Alexandra's graveyard. Putting Parting Thoughts into Alexandra's graveyard is the last part of its resolution. It therefore happens after Dryad Militant has already been destroyed and is no longer on the battlefield, its effect does not apply anymore.

question: Alexis casts [Mind Games], paying the additional cost for buyback. They then cast [Fork] targetting Mind Games. Will Fork return to Alexis's hand upon resolution?
answer_gold: No. When Fork resolves, it will create a copy of Mind Games on the stack, but does not itself become a copy of Mind Games. Therefore, it will simply be put into Alexis's graveyard as the final step of resolving.

question: Ashley controls [Mycosynth Lattice]. Nina controls [Knight Errant] enchanted with [Lost in Memories]. Ashley casts [Opportunistic Dragon] and gains control of Lost in Memories. Ashley then casts [Aura Graft] targeting Lost in Memories. What can Ashley attach Lost in Memories to?
answer_gold: Lost in Memories can be attached to any permanent on the battlefield. Enchant abilities are restrictive, not permissive. Without any enchant abilities to restrict what Lost in Memories can be attached to, any permanent on the battlefield is a legal target for it to enchant.

question: Alonzo controls a [Blanchwood Treefolk] enchanted with [White Scarab]. Nico casts [Oubliette] and has Blanchwood Treefolk phase out. After that resolves, Alonzo then destroys Oubliette with [Sundering Vitae]. What happens?
answer_gold:
Blanchwood Treefolk and White Scarab phase in as soon as Oubliette leaves the battlefield, White Scarab will be attached to Blanchwood Treefolk.

When Oubliette causes Blanchwood Treefolk to phase out, any Auras or Equipment attached to it phase out as well. Since Oubliette causes Blanchwood Treefolk to phase out until it leaves the battlefield, Blanchwood Treefolk will phase in as soon as Oubliette is destroyed. When Blanchwood Treefolk phases in again, White Scarab phases in attached to it.

question: Aryanna sacrifices [Drivnod, Carnage Dominus] to [Thelonite Druid]. Will their [Scavenger Drake] trigger twice?
answer_gold: Yes. For dies triggers, the game checks the game state before the event happens to see if any abilities would trigger, at which point Drivnod, Carnage Dominus is on the battlefield, and its effect would apply.

question: Alex controls [Gavi, Nest Warden] and cycles [Viscera Dragger] by paying {0} instead of its Cycling cost. They then cast [Cloudshift] targeting Gavi, Nest Warden, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield under their control. After Gavi, Nest Warden enters the battlefield again, can Alex cycle another card by paying {0} instead of its Cycling cost?
answer_gold: No. Viscera Dragger is the first card Alex cycled during their turn, and Gavi, Nest Warden's ability refers only the the first card cycled each turn. When Alex proposes cycling a new card in the same turn, the game knows it is not the first cycled card of the turn, and Gavi, Nest Warden's ability won't allow them to pay an alternative cost.

question: Nico controls [Humility]. Avalyn controls [Maritime Guard] and wants to cast [Glowstone Recluse] mutating onto the Maritime Guard and putting it on top. What will the resulting creature's P/T be?
answer_gold: 1/1 with no abilities, since mutate impacts the creature in layer 1 and Humility acts in layers 6 and 7. It will also not trigger Glowstone Recluse because Humility applies constantly and it's never on the battlefield without being affected.

question: Adelaide casts [Angel of the Ruins]. Branson passes priority. Carroll passes priority. Dahlia taps a land, floating a mana, then passes priority. What happens next?
answer_gold: Adelaide gets priority again. If Adelaide passes, priority will go around again. If it gets to Carroll without anyone taking an action, Angel of the Ruins resolves.

question: Allan controls [Dying to Serve]. Nico has a [Teferi, Hero of Dominaria] emblem. Allan casts [Dark Deal] with each player discarding 6 cards and drawing 5. Can Nico exile Dying to Serve with the emblem to prevent Allan from getting its effects?
answer_gold: No. When Dark Deal is resolving, Teferi, Hero of Dominaria's emblem will trigger 5 times, and those triggers will wait to be put onto the stack until after Dark Deal resolves, along with the triggers from Dying to Serve. Nico's triggers will resolve first, but that won't prevent Dying to Serve's triggers from resolving.

question: Nathanael controls [Swooping Lookout]. Ainsley casts [Crib Swap] targeting Swooping Lookout. In response, Nathanael casts [Acrobatic Maneuver] targeting Swooping Lookout. After everything has resolved, is Swooping Lookout on the battlefield?
answer_gold: Yes. When Acrobatic Maneuver resolves and returns Swooping Lookout to the battlefield, it becomes a completely new object that's unrelated to the old one. When Crib Swap tries to resolve, its target doesn't exist anymore, so it's just put into the graveyard.

question: Amara controls [Morophon, the Boundless] naming "Eldrazi" and casts [Decimator of the Provinces] for its emerge cost, choosing to sacrifice Morophon, the Boundless. Will Morophon, the Boundless's ability reduce the cost?
answer_gold: Yes. Emerge is an alternative cost, which is still subject to Morophon, the Boundless's reduction. In the steps to casting a spell, costs are determined before they're paid. Morophon, the Boundless is still on the battlefield while costs are being calculated, so it will be able to reduce the colored portion of Decimator of the Provinces's emerge cost.

question: Ayleen cast [Sazh Katzroy] and choose not to search their library. Noe would like to cast [Archive Trap] for its alternative cost. Can they?
answer_gold: No. Ayleen didn't actually search their library, so the qualifications for Archive Trap's alternative cost haven't been met.

question: Alex controls [Magus of the Moon] and [Forgotten Monument]. Neil casts [Lizard, Connors's Curse] targeting Magus of the Moon. After Lizard, Connors's Curse has resolved, what are the characteristics of Forgotten Monument?
answer_gold: A Land - Mountain that can tap for {R} and no other types of mana. It's still named "Forgotten Monument". Magus of the Moon's ability applies in the type changing layer, layer 4. It doesn't lose that ability until layer 6, at which point the ability has already been applied.

question: Asia activates the second ability of [Sensei's Divining Top] and would like to sacrifice it to [Throne of Geth] before putting it on top of their library. Can they do this?
answer_gold: Yes. Asia can activate the second ability of Sensei's Divining Top and then sacrifice it to Throne of Geth in response. When it resolves, Asia will just draw a card.

question: Andy casts [Abrupt Decay] targeting Nancy's 5/5 Horse creature token, then responds by targeting it with [Arcane Denial]. What happens?
answer_gold: Arcane Denial resolves but can't counter Abrupt Decay. During Nancy's upkeep, Andy draws one to three cards, based on their choice.

question: Addison casts [Take Possession] targeting Nola's [Seraphic Steed] equipped with [Gimli's Axe]. After it resolves, who controls Gimli's Axe?
answer_gold: Nola. Take Possession does not change the controller of Gimli's Axe even though it stays equipped to Seraphic Steed. Nola can activate it to attach it to another creature once it's their turn.

question: Alexander has a [Gigapede] in their graveyard and one in their hand. How many times can Alexander trigger [Hashaton, Scarab's Fist]?
answer_gold: Once. Gigapede's triggered ability will go on the stack at the beginning of Alexander's upkeep, and once Alexander discards their second Gigapede it will no longer be the beginning of Alexander's upkeep. The second copy's ability won't trigger.

question: Addison controls [Loam Dweller] and casts [Kodama's Reach]. Can they put both lands they find with Kodama's Reach onto the battlefield?
answer_gold: No. Loam Dweller's triggered ability will go on the stack above Kodama's Reach and will resolve first.

question: Ainsley controls [Mocking Sprite] and casts [Crippling Fatigue] for its Flashback cost. Will Mocking Sprite decrease the cost they have to pay?
answer_gold: Yes. Flashback is an alternative cost to cast a spell. When casting Crippling Fatigue, Ainsley will first determine the base cost, which in this case is the flashback cost. After that, they will apply all cost increases and reductions.

question: Adele foretells [Iron Verdict]. Nico wants to cast [Sublime Epiphany] targeting the foretold card. Can they?
answer_gold: No. Foretell is a special action that doesn't use the stack and can't be responded to. ([702.143a])

question: Alex controls [Old Man of the Sea] that they used [Dwarven Thaumaturgist] on, as well as [Bloom Tender] equipped with [Sword of the Paruns]. Alex taps Old Man of the Sea to gain control of Nehemiah's tapped [Gollum, Scheming Guide]. Then activates Bloom Tender's ability. How much mana is produced?
answer_gold: Bloom Tender will produce {G}{U}. When Bloom Tender becomes tapped, Sword of the Paruns will cause Gollum, Scheming Guide's power to be too great for Old Man of the Sea to retain control of it, and it will return to Nehemiah's control. Bloom Tender's ability checks the permanents Alex controls upon resolution of the ability, at which point they won't control Gollum, Scheming Guide.

question: Angie controls [Joiner Adept] and three [Lumbering Falls]. They play a [Mystic Sanctuary] as their land for turn. Will it enter the battlefield untapped and trigger?
answer_gold: No, while Joiner Adept's static ability gives lands the additional ability to tap for mana of any color, it does not grant basic land types, which Mystic Sanctuary requires in order to enter untapped or to trigger.

question: Noel controls [Judith, the Scourge Diva] and [Ogre Warrior]. Aria attacks with [Obsidian Giant]. Noel blocks Obsidian Giant with Ogre Warrior. At their first opportunity, Aria casts [Recalibrate] to return Judith, the Scourge Diva to Noel's hand. Will Obsidian Giant die?
answer_gold: No. Judith, the Scourge Diva's effect is a continuous effect that only applies while its on the battlefield. Aria has returned Judith, the Scourge Diva to Noel's hand after blockers have been declared but before damage has been dealt, so its ability will not be taken into account when calculating how much damage Ogre Warrior will deal.

question: Nico controls [Kargan Warleader] and [Garenbrig Carver]. Amina attacks with their [Horned Turtle]. Nico blocks Horned Turtle with Garenbrig Carver. Amina casts [Consign to Dream] to return Kargan Warleader to Nico's hand. Will Horned Turtle die?
answer_gold: No. Kargan Warleader's effect is a continuous effect that only applies while it's on the battlefield. Amina has returned Kargan Warleader to Nico's hand after blockers have been declared but before damage has been dealt, so its ability will not be taken into account when calculating how much damage Garenbrig Carver will deal.

question: Athena control [Krark, the Thumbless] and [Spark Double] copying it. They cast [Song of Totentanz], which triggers both Krark, the Thumbless. When the first trigger resolves they lose the flip and return Song of Totentanz to hand. What happens when the second trigger resolves?
answer_gold: If Athena loses the flip, nothing happens. If Athena wins the flip, a copy of Song of Totentanz is created.

question: Avery targets their [Trained Armodon] with [Goldenhide Ox]. Neil controls two 1/1 Human Soldier tokens. How many creatures will Neil have to block with?
answer_gold: One. Goldenhide Ox just states that Trained Armodon must be blocked, but Neil can choose how many and which creatures end up blocking it.

question: Alden cast [Ixidron]. Natalie controls a very cute [Tangled Florahedron]. What happens to it?
answer_gold: Nothing. Tangled Florahedron cannot be turned face down.

question: Ainsley enchants their [Colossus Hammer] with [Rune of Flight]. Then they equip it to [Skeletal Snake]. Does Skeletal Snake have flying?
answer_gold: Yes. The ability granted by Rune of Flight has a later timestamp than the inherent ability of Colossus Hammer and will be applied second causing Skeletal Snake to gain flying after it has lost it. When Colossus Hammer becomes equipped it will gain a new timestamp, but the relative timestamps of both objects will remain the same.

question: Ashley equips [Colossus Hammer] to [Ogre Warrior], then enchants it with [Phantom Wings]. Does Ogre Warrior have flying?
answer_gold: Yes. The effects from Colossus Hammer and Phantom Wings apply in the same layer, and Phantom Wings has the more recent timestamp.

question: Nico controls [Aluren]. Can they cast [Lisette, Dean of the Root] in Aileen's end step? If so, will they have to pay its mana cost?
answer_gold: No, Nico can't cast it. They choose which face they're casting when they begin casting it and only that face is used to determine whether the spell can be cast. Since the chosen face has a mana value greater than 3, Nico can't cast it.

question: Neriah controls [Grafdigger's Cage] and a [Coral Commando] enchanted by [Imprisoned in the Moon]. Ainsley controls [Mole Man, Moloid Master]. Can they play [Vesuva] from their graveyard, copying Coral Commando?
answer_gold: Yes. Grafdigger's Cage prevents creature cards from entering the battlefield from the graveyard or library. Vesuva isn't a creature card in the graveyard, so Grafdigger's Cage won't prevent it from being played.

question: Avery controls [Solemnity] and suspends [Duskrider Peregrine]. Is Avery able to put time counters on Duskrider Peregrine?
answer_gold: Yes. Solemnity only affects artifacts, creatures, enchantments and lands on the battlefield.

question: Aldo controls [Dark Confidant] and has no cards in their library. What happens during their upkeep?
answer_gold: Dark Confidant's ability triggers, but does nothing upon resolution. As the ability does not use the word "draw", its resolution does not cause Aldo to lose the game for attempting to draw a card from an empty library.

question: Anderson has [Turntimber Sower] and a [Dreamscape Artist] on the battlefield. Dreamscape Artist is activated, discarding a land card and sacrificing a land to pay the cost. How many times will Turntimber Sower trigger?
answer_gold: Twice. When activating Dreamscape Artist, Anderson can choose in what order to discard a card and sacrifice a land. Regardless of what order Anderson chooses, the individual costs of "sacrifice a land" and "discard a card" are not happening simultaneously, so Turntimber Sower triggers twice.

question: Amara controls [Tergrid, God of Fright] and [Leyline of the Void]. Nico discards [Spectral Hunt-Caller]. Can Amara put Spectral Hunt-Caller onto the battlefield under their control?
answer_gold: No. Leyline of the Void has a replacement effect that will cause Spectral Hunt-Caller to be exiled. Tergrid, God of Fright's ability will trigger, but since Spectral Hunt-Caller isn't in the graveyard anymore, Amara won't be able to put it onto the battlefield.

question: Ashlyn controls [Volrath's Shapeshifter] and the top card of their graveyard is [Syr Konrad, the Grim]. They cast [Reanimate] targeting Syr Konrad, the Grim. When everything resolves, how many damage is Nathan dealt?
answer_gold: 1. Abilities that trigger when a card leaves a graveyard check the game state immediately before the event happened to see if they trigger. At that point, Volrath's Shapeshifter still has all abilities of Syr Konrad, the Grim, so it will trigger, dealing 1 to Nathan. On the other hand, Syr Konrad, the Grim is still in the graveyard, so its ability does not trigger.

question: Alan activates [Jhoira of the Ghitu] and uses [Rings of Brighthearth] to copy the ability. What happens?
answer_gold: The exiled card ends up with eight time counters. The second ability to resolve can find the card in exile, and gives it another four counters when it resolves. The card is exiled as a cost to activate the ability, so Alan doesn't get to exile a second card.

question: Abdiel controls [Sphere of Resistance] and nine 1/1 green Saproling tokens and has no mana. Can they cast [Khalni Hydra]?
answer_gold: Yes. Khalni Hydra's cost reduction applies to its total cost, including the additional cost of Sphere of Resistance, and a reduction of {G} can apply to a generic cost.

question: Avery has used [Control Magic] to gain control of Nathaniel's [Cosima, God of the Voyage]. Avery chooses to exile it at the beginning of their upkeep. Who controls the triggered ability it gains? And if that player chooses so when that ability resolves, under whose control would Cosima, God of the Voyage return?
answer_gold: The controller of the triggered ability is Cosima, God of the Voyage's owner: Nathaniel. It will trigger when they play a land, and if they choose to return Cosima, God of the Voyage to the battlefield, it will return under their control.

question: Aubrey controls two copies of [Sphinx of the Second Sun]. How many beginning phase(s) do they get after their postcombat main phase?
answer_gold: Two. Each triggered ability creates an additional beginning phase, and the last one created occurs first.

question: Natalee controls [Alquist Proft, Master Sleuth]. Alex targets it with [Weigh Down], and Natalee targets it with [On Alert] at their earliest opportunity. What happens to Alquist Proft, Master Sleuth?
answer_gold:
When each player casts their spell, it's put onto the top of the stack. The top object on the stack resolves first, so On Alert resolves first, giving Alquist Proft, Master Sleuth +2/+2. Then Weigh Down resolves, giving it -3/-3. It ends up as a 2/2.

As the turn ends, both effects simultaneously Cease applying, and it goes back to being a 3/3.

question: Ashley controls [Ashnod's Altar] and has no cards in their graveyard. Assuming they have enough mana, can they activate [Molten-Tail Masticore]'s first activated ability?
answer_gold: Yes. Ashley first puts the ability onto the stack, after which it won't matter if Molten-Tail Masticore is on the battlefield anymore. Ashley then has a chance to activate mana abilities, at which point they can sacrifice Molten-Tail Masticore. Then Ashley pays the cost of the spell, exiling Molten-Tail Masticore from their graveyard.

question: At the beginning of their upkeep, Ashlynn controls [Kels, Fight Fixer], [Opalescence], and [Fall of the First Civilization] with two lore counters on it. What happens at the beginning of their precombat main phase?
answer_gold: A third lore counter is put on Fall of the First Civilization as a turn-based action, triggering its third chapter ability. After it resolves Fall of the First Civilization is sacrificed, triggering Kels, Fight Fixer's ability.

question: Adan controls [Kotis, Sibsig Champion], and has [Selfless Glyphweaver] in their graveyard. Can Adan cast the back side of Selfless Glyphweaver?
answer_gold: No. When a player casts a modal double-faced card, they have to choose which face they are casting before putting it on the stack, and Kotis, Sibsig Champion only gives permission to cast creature spells. Therefore, Adan can cast only the creature side of the card.

question: Natalie blocks Alex's [Headwater Sentries] with [Barktooth Warbeard]. Afterwards, Alex casts [Song of the Dryads], enchanting Barktooth Warbeard. Natalie uses [Cloudchaser Kestrel] to destroy Song of the Dryads. Alex then uses [Chain of Plasma] to deal 3 damage to Barktooth Warbeard. Does it die?
answer_gold: Yes. It stopped being a creature for a short while, but that doesn't cause the damage that was marked on it to go away.

question: Alfonso unmorphes [Gift of Doom]. Can Alfonso attach it to [Melesse Spirit]?
answer_gold: No. Protection means that Melesse Spirit can't be enchanted by Auras with the stated quality, which means it's illegal to attach it.

question: Can Aidan use [Zur the Enchanter]'s ability to attach [Aquitect's Defenses] onto their [Polis Crusher]?
answer_gold: No. When Aidan puts Aquitect's Defenses onto the battlefield they can only attach it to permanents that can legally be enchanted by Aquitect's Defenses. Protection mean that Polis Crusher can't be enchanted by whatever it has protection from.

question: Nico controls [Emrakul, the Aeons Torn] as well as [Felhide Minotaur] enchanted with [Keen Sense]. Can Autumn use [Aura Graft] to move Keen Sense on to Emrakul, the Aeons Torn?
answer_gold: Yes. Aura Graft does not target Emrakul, the Aeons Torn, and it only has protection from colored spells, not colored permanents, so Keen Sense can enchant it.

question: In a game of commander, Nathaly has shuffled their commander into their library. Ari casts [Praetor's Grasp] targeting Nathaly and finds Nathaly's commander. Can Nathaly choose to put it into the command zone?
answer_gold: Yes. Despite being face-down, it's still Nathaly's commander, and they can choose to have it move to the command zone as a state-based action.

question: Amya controls [Streetbreaker Wurm] and cast [Apex Devastator]. The cascade trigger resolves and they exiles [Nethroi, Apex of Death] from the top of their library. Can they mutate it onto Streetbreaker Wurm without paying its mana cost?
answer_gold: No they can't. Not paying the mana cost of the card exiled with Cascade is an alternative cost, Mutate is also an alternative cost. ([702.140a]) When casting a spell they must choose one alternative cost to pay for it.

question: Adrien controls [Rune of Mortality] attached to [Iron Giant], which is attacking. Nico blocks with two copies of [Kavu Runner]. What is the maximum amount of damage Adrien can assign to Nico, and which creature(s) will die in combat?
answer_gold: Adrien can assign up to 4 damage to Nico, and all three creatures will die in combat. Because Iron Giant has deathtouch, 1 damage from it is lethal. Adrien can thus assign 1 damage to each blocker and, because of trample, the rest to Nico. Iron Giant is still dealt 3 damage by each Kavu Runner, which is lethal.

question: Abdiel controls [Virtue of Knowledge] and [Omnath, Locus of Creation] and plays a land. After all triggers have resolved, how much life will they have gained, and will they have any mana in their mana pool?
answer_gold: Abdiel will have gained 4 life and have {W}{U}{R}{G} in their mana pool. Virtue of Knowledge makes Omnath, Locus of Creation's trigger trigger twice, just like if two lands had entered the battlefield at the same time.

question: Antonio controls [Teysa Karlov], a 1/1 Soldier token, and a 3/3 Beast token. If Antonio casts [Massacre Girl], what creatures will die?
answer_gold: Only the 1/1 Solider. Teysa Karlov only applies to triggers that are actually on a permanent, not delayed triggers they create. Massacre Girl doesn't have any "dies" triggers.

question: Can Alana use [Jegantha, the Wellspring] as a companion if they have [Beck // Call] in their deck?
answer_gold: No, the deck construction limitations are not being met. The reason for that is because Beck // Call's mana cost when not on the stack is {4}{W}{U}{U}{G}.

question: Alexandria controls [Uphill Battle] and casts [Lumengrid Warden]. Before that resolves, Nathanael casts [Gather Specimens]. Will Lumengrid Warden enter the battlefield tapped?
answer_gold: No. Lumengrid Warden was not played by Nathanael.

question: Nelson control [Dryad Militant]. Aubree casts [Jaya's Firenado] targeting Dryad Militant. When Jaya's Firenado resolves and is removed from the stack, will it be put into exile?
answer_gold: Yes. Dryad Militant won't die until state-based actions are checked the next time a player would get priority. Jaya's Firenado would already have finished resolving and been exiled at that point.

question: Ari controls [Magus of the Moon] enchanted with [Ichthyomorphosis]. Is Ari's [Dormant Volcano] a Mountain?
answer_gold: Yes. Continuous effects are applied in a specific order, and type-changing effects are applied before ability-removing effects.

question: Alijah controls [Lotus Bloom] and no other permanents. Can they cast [Frogmite]?
answer_gold: Yes. The total cost for Frogmite is determined as {3}, and then afterwards Alijah has a chance to activate mana abilities to pay for it. It doesn't matter if the number of artifacts they control changes while activating mana abilities, since the cost was already locked in at {3} before that.

question: Aminah has no cards in their library and activate [Words of Wind] in their upkeep. Do they lose the game?
answer_gold: No. Even though there are no there are no cards in Aminah's library and therefore no cards could be drawn, Words of Wind's replacement effect will still apply and replace the draw as normal.

question: Can Amina activate [Planebound Accomplice] to put the back face of [Kytheon, Hero of Akros] onto the battlefield?
answer_gold: No. In Amina's hand Kytheon, Hero of Akros is not a planeswalker card.

question: Annalee controls a tapped [Mana Vault] and [Castle Doom]. Mana Vault triggers in their draw step and, with the ability still on the stack, they sacrifice it to Castle Doom. Will they take 1 damage?
answer_gold: Yes. Mana Vault's trigger has an intervening "if" clause, so it checks to see if Mana Vault is tapped both when it triggers and when it resolves. Mana Vault doesn't exist anymore when it resolves, so the game uses its last known information. Since it was tapped when it last existed on the battlefield, it deals the damage.

question: Arielle controls [Zada, Hedron Grinder], [Kaslem's Strider], and [Twinning Staff]. They cast [Antagonize] targeting Zada, Hedron Grinder, then activate Twinning Staff's ability targeting it. How many Antagonizes resolve in total?
answer_gold: Five. When Twinning Staff's activated ability resolves, it creates two copies of Antagonize due to its own replacement effect. Then when Zada, Hedron Grinder's trigger resolves, it also creates two copies of Antagonize. Copying a spell isn't the same as casting it, so creating these copies doesn't trigger Zada, Hedron Grinder again.

question: Amaya has [True-Name Nemesis] in their graveyard, and [Cairn Wanderer] enters the battlefield under their control. Does Cairn Wanderer have protection?
answer_gold:
No. True-Name Nemesis doesn't have protection, it has an ability that grants it protection. That ability only functions on the battlefield, so it does not have protection in the graveyard.

(And even if it did, there wouldn't be any "chosen player" for Cairn Wanderer.)

question: Abdiel casts [Jokulhaups]. In response, Nico activates the ability granted by [Equinox], targeting Jokulhaups. Abdiel responds to this by casting [Deliver] targeting Nico's only land. Will Jokulhaups be countered?
answer_gold: No. Nico controls no lands, so Jokulhaups wouldn't destroy any.

question: Can [Myriad Landscape]'s last ability find two [Wastes]?
answer_gold: No. Wastes has no basic land types, so it can't share a basic land type with anything.

question: Nico controls [Ancient of the Equinox]. Alvin casts [Evil Twin]. Can they have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Ancient of the Equinox?
answer_gold: Yes. Hexproof prevents Ancient of the Equinox from being the target of an opponent's spell or ability, but Evil Twin doesn't target anything.

question: Ashley attacks with [Dual-Sun Adepts] while Nico controls [Archetype of Courage]. Will Dual-Sun Adepts deal combat damage twice?
answer_gold: Yes. While similar to first strike, double strike is a different ability and Archetype of Courage will have not remove it from Dual-Sun Adepts.

question: Alyson declares [Godsire] as an attacker. After blockers are declared, they activate Godsire's ability, tapping it. Does this remove it from combat?
answer_gold: No, tapping a creature that's already been declared as an attacker will not remove it from combat.

question: Alvaro uses [Gideon, Martial Paragon]'s ability to turn it into a creature. They then put a +1/+1 counter on it with [Experiment Kraj] and activate Experiment Kraj's [+2] ability, putting two loyalty counters on it. After passing the turn, what will happen if they block an attacking creature with Experiment Kraj?
answer_gold: Experiment Kraj will be dealt damage as normal, but won't lose any loyalty counters, since it's a creature and not a planeswalker.

question: Adam plays [Exotic Orchard]. What can it tap for if Nora controls only [Throne of Makindi] without any charge counters on it?
answer_gold: Any color of mana. Exotic Orchard is limited by what an opponent's land's abilities could produce if they resolved, not if the opponent could pay the costs required.

question: Alex controls [Mycosynth Lattice], an [Animate Dead] attached to a [Skyshroud Troopers] that it returned to the battlefield, and a [Mizzium Transreliquat] that is currently a copy of [Sakashima of a Thousand Faces] due to its second ability. Alex casts [Copy Artifact], choosing to copy the Mizzium Transreliquat and then choosing to copy the Animate Dead with its new copy ability as it enters the battlefield. They choose to enchant a [Foot Soldiers] in their graveyard. After Copy Artifact's trigger resolves and returns the Foot Soldiers to the battlefield, Alex activates the ability of the Copy Artifact to turn it into a copy of Skyshroud Troopers. What happens?
answer_gold: This can't happen as described. When Copy Artifact enters the battlefield and copies Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, it then hard Sakashima of a Thousand Faces's ability to enter the battlefield as a copy of a creature, but it's attempting to copy an enchantment. This is illegal, since Sakashima of a Thousand Faces can only copy creatures, not enchantments.

question: Ada controls [Karn Liberated], and exiles [Strength of the Harvest] from Nico's hand. Later, Ada activates Karn Liberated's [-14] ability, restarting the game. Can they put Strength of the Harvest onto the battlefield on its back face, [Haven of the Harvest]?
answer_gold: No. Permanents enter the battlefield with their front face up unless otherwise specified. Modal double-faced cards can only be put on their back face when being cast or played as a land.

question: Aarav casts [Neverending Torment] and uses [Insidious Will] to copy it once. How many copies of Neverending Torment will be created during their upkeep?
answer_gold: Two. Insidious Will will copy the full rules text of Neverending Torment, including its epic ability. Upon resolution, both copies create delayed triggers that will trigger at the beginning of Aarav's upkeep.

question: Nehemiah controls [Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet]. Adalyn controls [Luminous Broodmoth] and their [Shatterskull Giant] dies. What happens?
answer_gold: Shatterskull Giant is exiled and Nehemiah gets a 2/2 Zombie. Luminous Broodmoth's trigger never occurs because Shatterskull Giant never died. Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet replaces it going to the graveyard by putting it in exile instead.

question: In a Commander game with 4 players, Ari casts [Kardur, Doomscourge]. Bode controls [Oxidda Finisher], and [Parhelion II], which is not a creature at the time Kardur, Doomscourge's enter the battlefield ability resolves. During Bode's next turn, can they attack Ari with Parhelion II? Can they have the Angel tokens created by Parhelion II attack Ari?
answer_gold:
Bode cannot attack Ari with Parhelion II, but they can choose for the Angel tokens to attack Ari.

Kardur, Doomscourge's enters-the-battlefield ability sets up a rules change that causes any creatures Ari's opponents control to have to attack if able and to have to attack another player if able. Since this is a change in the rules of the game, it affects Parhelion II even if it is not a creature at the time the ability resolves.

The Angel tokens are created attacking, but are never declared as attackers. Because of this, Bode can choose Ari to be the defending player for the tokens.

question: Aspen controls [Frogtosser Banneret]. Will it affect the cost of [Notorious Throng]?
answer_gold: Yes. Notorious Throng is a Rogue.

question: Autumn casts [Ojutai Interceptor] for its morph cost. If Nicole wants to counter it with [Spell Burst], what is the mana value of the Ojutai Interceptor on the stack?
answer_gold: 0. A morphed spell is a 2/2 creature with no mana cost. Since the spell has no mana cost, its mana value is 0.

question: Nathaniel controls [Trinisphere]. Addison casts [Mutagenic Growth], paying 2 life for the Phyrexian mana. What is the total cost of the Mutagenic Growth?
answer_gold: {3} and 2 life. While casting Mutagenic Growth, Addison chooses whether to pay life or mana for each Phyrexian mana symbol in the cost. Trinisphere is applied afterwards and increases the cost up to the minimum of 3 mana.

question: Ashley casts [Cauldron Haze] targeting Nathan's [Major Teroh] and [Barbary Apes]. In response Nathan activates Major Teroh's ability, sacrificing itself. Will Cauldron Haze still affect Barbary Apes?
answer_gold: Yes. As long as at least one of its targets is still legal when it attempts to resolve, it will resolve successfully.

question: Abraham controls [Harmonic Prodigy] and activates [Transluminant] in their main phase. How many tokens will they get?
answer_gold: One. While Transluminant is a Shaman that creates a delayed trigger, Harmonic Prodigy doesn't apply to delayed triggered abilities..

question: In a multiplayer game, can Braxton tap [Spectral Searchlight] to help Addison pay for Chaya's [Propaganda]?
answer_gold: No. When Addison attempts to attack Chaya with a creature, they will need to determine the cost to attack. After this is determined only the active player has the ability to activate mana abilities.

question: Noel controls [Kenrith's Transformation] attached to [Skyspear Cavalry]. Ari enchants Kenrith's Transformation with [Song of the Dryads]. What happens?
answer_gold: Kenrith's Transformation becomes a non-Aura land and unattaches from Skyspear Cavalry. Skyspear Cavalry stops being an Elk and goes back to its normal characteristics.

question: Alvaro controls [Mikaeus, the Unhallowed] and [Bloodsoaked Altar]. They take control of Nola's commander, [Tegwyll, Duke of Splendor], using [Involuntary Employment] and sacrifices it to activate Bloodsoaked Altar's ability. Could Nola choose to return Tegwyll, Duke of Splendor to the command zone before the undying trigger returns it to the battlefield?
answer_gold: Yes. Before the undying trigger is put on the stack, state-based actions are checked. At this point, Nola could choose to put Tegwyll, Duke of Splendor in the command zone as a state-based action.

question: Nico controls [EPF Point Squad]. Aron controls [Doubling Season] and casts [Ezuri's Predation]. What happens?
answer_gold: Aron creates two 4/4 Phyrexian Beast tokens. Since more tokens were created than Nico has creatures, it's not possible for each of them to fight a different one of Nico's creatures, so the spell just does as much as it can and has one Beast fight EPF Point Squad.

question: Agustin uses [As Foretold] to cast [Gaea's Will] from their hand. This triggers their [Harness the Storm] targeting a second copy of Gaea's Will in the graveyard. When that trigger resolves, can Agustin cast it?
answer_gold: No. Gaea's Will has no mana cost, which means the cost can't be paid. Harness the Storm doesn't create an alternative cost the way As Foretold does, it actually requires the player to pay the spell's mana cost. This is impossible since As Foretold was already used this turn and there's no other cost for it that can be legally paid. Using the suspend ability is not an option either since a card can only be suspended from the player's hand.

question: Addison controls [The Sentry, Golden Guardian], which has lethal damage marked on it. Natalie casts [Scar], placing a -1/-1 counter on The Sentry, Golden Guardian. Will The Sentry, Golden Guardian die?
answer_gold: No. Since The Sentry, Golden Guardian has indestructible, it won't die due to having lethal damage marked on it. Having damage marked on it does not change a creature's toughness, so the -1/-1 counter will not cause it to die due to having 0 toughness, as its toughness is still greater than 0.

question: Alex activates [Kethis, the Hidden Hand] while [Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios] is in their graveyard. Can they cast the back face of Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios?
answer_gold: Yes. Kethis, the Hidden Hand grants Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios the ability "You may play this card from your graveyard." To determine whether it's legal to cast Jadzi, Oracle of Arcavios, the game checks the characteristics its back face would have in the graveyard. It would still be the same object in the graveyard, so it still has that ability, and can be cast.

question: Alivia's commander is [Esika, God of the Tree]. Can they use mana produced by [Jeweled Lotus] to cast its other face, [The Prismatic Bridge]?
answer_gold: Yes. The commander designation is a property of the card itself, meaning both sides of the card are considered to be Alivia's commander.

question: [Rionya, Fire Dancer] creates a copy of [Humble Defector], which Arlo activates, giving to Nico. Does the token get exiled at the end of the turn?
answer_gold: Yes. Rionya, Fire Dancer just says "Exile them at the beginning of the next end step." It doesn't care who controls the token at that time.

question: Alex controls [Divine Visitation] and activates [Chandra, Acolyte of Flame] to create two 1/1 red Elemental creature tokens. What are the characteristics of the tokens? Will they be sacrificed at the beginning of the next end step?
answer_gold:
They're 4/4 white Angel creature tokens with flying, vigilance, and haste. They will be sacrificed at the beginning of the next end step.

The instructions of Chandra, Acolyte of Flame's ability are followed in the order written. Divine Visitation's replacement effect will replace creating the 1/1 red Elemental creature tokens with creating 4/4 white Angel creature tokens with flying and vigilance instead. The tokens that were created then gain haste. Divine Visitation has no effect on the rest of Chandra, Acolyte of Flame's ability so the delayed trigger will still trigger at the beginning of the next end step, causing the tokens to be sacrificed when it resolves.

question: Avi casts [Plumb the Forbidden], sacrificing a creature. Nina cast [Discombobulate] targeting Plumb the Forbidden. Will Avi still get a copy of Plumb the Forbidden?
answer_gold: Yes. Plumb the Forbidden has a triggered ability that triggers when Avi sacrifices creatures to pay for its additional cost. This ability triggers while Avi is casting the spell, and is put on the stack above the spell as soon as they are done casting it and before they would get priority again. This ability on the stack is independent of the original Plumb the Forbidden, and will resolve even if the original spell is countered. It uses the last-known information of the spell on the stack in order to make the copy.

question: Aubrey casts [Rescue the Foal] targeting their [Hazezon Tamar] in response to its enters-the-battlefield ability. What happens at the beginning of Aubrey's next upkeep?
answer_gold: Aubrey creates twice as many tokens as the number of lands they control. Hazezon Tamar's enters-the-battlefield ability has resolved twice, creating two instances of the delayed trigger ability creating tokens. One instance of Hazezon Tamar's leaves-the-battlefield ability has resolved, but did not do anything since at that time Aubrey did not control any Sand Warriors.

question: Nathaniel controls [Pithing Needle] naming [Skullsnatcher]. Alex has Skullsnatcher in their hand and declares an attack with [Borderland Minotaur]. Nathaniel declares no blockers. Can Alex use ninjutsu to put Skullsnatcher onto the battlefield?
answer_gold: No. Ninjutsu is an activated ability.

question: Arjun controls [Captain Mar-Vell, Space-Born] and casts [Mass Mutiny] targeting Beverly's and Christine's Soldier tokens. Before it resolves, Arjun casts [Insurrection]. What happens?
answer_gold: Insurrection resolves and Arjun gains control of all the Soldier tokens. Then Mass Mutiny begins to resolve, but its targets are now illegal, so it does not resolve and is removed from the stack.

question: Ariel controls [Yixlid Jailer] and casts [Murderous Cut], targeting Neymar's [Geralf's Messenger]. Does Geralf's Messenger come back? If so, will it be tapped or untapped? Will it have a +1/+1 counter?
answer_gold: Geralf's Messenger will return to the battlefield tapped and with a +1/+1 counter. Undying is a "dies" trigger, meaning it triggers from the battlefield and is not affected by Yixlid Jailer. When entering the battlefield, the game uses the characteristics it would have on the battlefield to determine how it enters, so it enters tapped and with a +1/+1 counter.

question: Albert plays [Tibalt, Cosmic Impostor], creating an emblem. They then gain control of another one from Nico, and choose to put the first one in the graveyard. Can they play cards they exile with the second one?
answer_gold: No. The emblem's ability is linked to the original Tibalt, Cosmic Impostor, and can only cast cards exiled by the original.

question: Adelyn controls [Athreos, Shroud-Veiled] and has 5 devotion to white and black. They cast [Sakashima the Impostor]. Can they copy Athreos, Shroud-Veiled?
answer_gold: No. Adelyn must choose a creature that's on the battlefield immediately before Sakashima the Impostor enters, at which point Athreos, Shroud-Veiled isn't a creature.

question: Aranza controls [Aluren] and has [Charred Graverobber] in their graveyard, as well as 5 other cards. Can they cast Charred Graverobber by paying no mana and exiling 5 cards?
answer_gold: No. Aluren's ability grants Aranza the ability to cast creature cards for an alternative cost, and casting Charred Graverobber for its Escape cost is also an alternative cost. ([702.138a], [118.9]). Players can't apply more than one alternative cost when casting a spell..

question: Alex casts [Finale of Promise] with {X} = 10, targeting [Ignite the Future] in their graveyard. When the copies of Ignite the Future resolve, will Alex be able to cast the exiled cards without paying their mana costs?
answer_gold: No. Ignite the Future only allows the spells to be cast without paying their mana costs if it was cast from a graveyard. The copies weren't cast at all, so they certainly weren't cast from a graveyard.

question: Alan casts [Rescue from the Underworld] sacrificing their commander, [Elektra, Daughter of the Hand], and choosing to return it to the command zone. Will Elektra, Daughter of the Hand return to the battlefield at the beginning of their next upkeep when Rescue from the Underworld's delayed trigger resolves?
answer_gold: No. When Elektra, Daughter of the Hand was sacrificed, it was first put into the graveyard and Alan chose to move it to the command zone from the graveyard as a state-based action. When it returns to the command zone it becomes a new object with no memory of its previous existence, so Rescue from the Underworld's delayed trigger won't be able to find it.

question: Alyson casts [Academic Dispute] targeting Niko's [Tar Pit Warrior]. Does Alyson get to Learn?
answer_gold: No. When Alyson finishes casting Academic Dispute, Tar Pit Warrior's triggered ability will be put on the stack, and will resolve before Academic Dispute does. This means Niko will sacrifice Tar Pit Warrior. When Academic Dispute would start to resolve, the game sees that all of its targets are now illegal. Because of this Academic Dispute doesn't resolve and is instead removed from the stack and put into Alyson's graveyard.

question: Aspen casts [Isochron Scepter]. Can they imprint [Revel in Silence] onto it? If so, which face(s) can Aspen cast?
answer_gold: Aspen cannot imprint Revel in Silence onto Isochron Scepter. Modal double-faced cards only have the characteristics of their front face in any zone other than the stack and the battlefield. The front face of Revel in Silence is a creature so it can't be imprinted on Isochron Scepter.

question: Can Agustin imprint [Legion Leadership] on [Isochron Scepter]? If so, can they play the other side?
answer_gold: They can imprint it, but can't play the back face, since the copy will only have the front face.

question: Azariah controls [Magus of the Moon] and plays [Three Tree City]. Do they make a choice for it as it enters? If not, what happens if Magus of the Moon leaves the battlefield later?
answer_gold:
No. Making a choice for Three Tree City as it enters is a replacement effect. When determining which replacement effects apply to Three Tree City as it's entering the battlefield, the game looks at how it will exist on the battlefield after it enters. On the battlefield Three Tree City is a Mountain, and Mountains don't make choices as they enter.

If the Magus of the Moon leaves the battlefield later on, Three Tree City is not entering the battlefield again, so it will simply have had no choice made for it.

question: Autumn and Nevaeh each control a copy of [Gisela, Blade of Goldnight]. If Autumn attacks with [Gnarled Mass] and it isn't blocked, how much damage would it deal to Nevaeh?
answer_gold:
Gnarled Mass would deal 2 or 3 damage, Nevaeh's choice. Gisela, Blade of Goldnight has a static ability that sets up a prevention effect for damage being dealt. Since both copies of Gisela, Blade of Goldnight are trying to replace the damage dealt to Nevaeh, they get to choose in which order they are applied. 

If Nevaeh chooses to apply their own Gisela, Blade of Goldnight's replacement effect first, the 3 damage would be halved and rounded down to 1. Then Autumn's Gisela, Blade of Goldnight doubles the damage up to 2.

If instead Nevaeh chose to apply Autumn's Gisela, Blade of Goldnight's replacement effect to the damage event first, the 3 damage would first be doubled to 6. Then Nevaeh's own Gisela, Blade of Goldnight would halve the damage down to 3.

question: Amari controls [Jade Statue], activates it in combat and attacks Noor with it. Does Noor have an opportunity to deal damage to it with [Desert]?
answer_gold: Yes. Jade Statue is a creature until the combat phase ends, and as such still a creature in the end of combat phase, where Desert can be activated to damage it.

question: Can Alex choose to find [The Last Ride] with [Urza's Saga]'s third chapter ability?
answer_gold: No. Urza's Saga can only find a card with a mana cost of {0} or {1}, not {B}.

question: Azariah is resolving the last chapter ability of [Urza's Saga]. Can they find [Ancient Den]?
answer_gold: No. Ancient Den has no mana cost, which is not the same thing as having a mana cost of {0}.

question: Aubrey controls [Urza's Saga] and it has two lore counters on it. Can they activate Urza's Saga to tap for {C}?
answer_gold: Yes. The first chapter ability causes Urza's Saga to gain the ability "{T}: Add {C}.", and nothing is causing it to lose that ability.

question: Ashton puts the third lore counter on their [Thunder of Unity], and before the triggered ability resolves, they use [Clockspinning] to remove a lore counter from it. What happens?
answer_gold: The counter will be removed, Thunder of Unity's triggered ability will finish resolving and then it won't be sacrificed, because the number of lore counters on it isn't equal to or greater than the number of chapter abilities it has. On Ashton's next turn, its final chapter ability will trigger again.

question: Autumn controls [Omnath, Locus of Creation] and [Yarok, the Desecrated]. Autumn plays a land. What happens?
answer_gold: Yarok, the Desecrated will cause Omnath, Locus of Creation to trigger twice, so Autumn will gain 4 life and add {R}{G}{W}{U}.

question: Alfredo controls [Veyran, Voice of Duality] and casts [Plumb the Forbidden] choosing to sacrifice their Soldier token as an additional cost. What order will everything resolve in?
answer_gold: Plumb the Forbidden's trigger to create copies of itself will go on the stack at the same time as Veyran, Voice of Duality's trigger, and Alfredo can choose the order they are placed on the stack. Then the original Plumb the Forbidden resolves last.

question: Averie controls [Muraganda Petroglyphs] and [Wayward Angel], and has more than 7 cards in their graveyard. Nathan casts and resolves [Humility]. What are Wayward Angel's characteristics?
answer_gold:
Wayward Angel is a Black, 6/6 creature with no abilities. The rest of its characteristics remain the same as printed on the card. 
Wayward Angel's threshold ability changes both its color, abilities, and P/T. Therefore, it applies in layers 5, 6, and 7 with the appropriate parts applying in their appropriate layers, and the layers are applied in order. Similarly, Humility's effect is applied in layers 6 and 7, as appropriate. 
Applying layers in order:
- In layer 5, Wayward Angel becomes black. 
- In layer 6 there are two contending effects: Wayward Angel's ability giving it trample and an upkeep triggered ability, and Humility's ability removing all abilities from Wayward Angel. There is no dependency between the two, since Wayward Angel's ability has already started applying in a previous layer, and will continue to apply even if removed by Humility's ability. The effects are then applied in timestamp order with Wayward Angel's ability applying first, since it has an earlier timestamp. So in layer 6, Wayward Angel first gains trample and "At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a creature.", and then loses all abilities to Humility.
- In layer 7, P/T setting effects are applied first, so that Humility first turns Wayward Angel into a 1/1. Then effects modifying P/T are applied, of which there are two: Wayward Angel's own ability that, even though removed, continues to apply and gives it +3/+3, and Muraganda Petroglyphs's ability giving Wayward Angel +2/+2 since it now has no abilities. Wayward Angel's P/T is finally 6/6.

question: Aspen controls [Imoti, Celebrant of Bounty] and casts [Apex Devastator]. How many cascade triggers happen?
answer_gold: 5. Apex Devastator has four plus one granted by Imoti, Celebrant of Bounty. Multiple instances of cascade are not redundant.
