question: Annabel controls [Dimir Keyrune] and activates its ability to prevent it from being blocked. They then cast [Dress Down], move on to combat, and attack with Dimir Keyrune. Can Nico block Dimir Keyrune?
answer_gold: No. Dimir Keyrune can't be blocked. The part of Dimir Keyrune's ability stating that it "can't be blocked" is not granting it an ability, but causing a change in the rules of the game.. Since it is not an ability, it is not removed by Dress Down.

question: Anders casts [Hypothesizzle] targeting Norah's [Dryad Militant]. In which zone is Hypothesizzle after resolution?
answer_gold: In exile. Dryad Militant is destroyed only after Hypothesizzle finishes resolving, when state-based actions are checked.. It is therefore still on the battlefield when Hypothesizzle would be put in Anders's graveyard, as the last part of its resolution. Thus, its effect applies and exiles Hypothesizzle.

question: August activates the second ability of [Jarad, Golgari Lich Lord], sacrificing [Plated Wurm]. In response, Nico casts [Sudden Spoiling], targeting August. How much damage is Nico dealt?
answer_gold:
Zero. Jarad, Golgari Lich Lord makes Nico lose life, but it doesn't deal damage to them.

Plated Wurm is sacrificed as a cost to activate Jarad, Golgari Lich Lord's ability and is not on the battlefield when Sudden Spoiling resolves. Jarad, Golgari Lich Lord checks the power of Plated Wurm when it was last on the battlefield, so Nico will lose 4 life.

question: Nikolas controls [Mindcrank]. Amelia casts [Cruel Tutor]. Will the card Amelia put on top of their library get milled?
answer_gold: Yes. Mindcrank triggers during the resolution of Cruel Tutor and will be put onto the stack after Cruel Tutor finishes resolving. (Amelia can cast an instant before the trigger resolves.)

question: In a multiplayer game, Alex controls [Strixhaven Stadium] with 9 counters on it. They attack Braylee and Coen with one creature each, and no blockers are declared. When combat damage is dealt, who loses the game?
answer_gold: Alex chooses whether Braylee or Coen loses. Strixhaven Stadium's ability triggers twice simultaneously. As Alex controls both triggers, they choose in what order they are put on the stack.

question: In a commander game, Addilyn casts [Zurgo Bellstriker] with dash from the command zone, which is the second time it's been cast this game. Do they have to pay an extra {2}? What happens to it at the end of the turn?
answer_gold:
Addilyn does have to pay an additional {2}, since the "commander tax" is an additional cost that applies no matter how the spell is being cast.

When the delayed trigger resolves, Addilyn can choose to return Zurgo Bellstriker to the command zone or to their hand. ([702.109a], [903.9b])

question: Adele has six cards in their graveyard and casts [Epicenter] targeting Nico. In response, Nico casts [Lazotep Plating]. Before it resolves, Adele casts [Brain Freeze] targeting themself. What happens?
answer_gold: Neither player will sacrifice any lands. The text on Epicenter is a self-replacement effect and changes what the spell is doing. However, before the replacement effect would be applied the game checks to see if all the targets for the spell are still legal. Nico is no longer a legal target, therefore the spell won't resolve.

question: Ari controls [Bruvac the Grandiloquent] and casts [Balustrade Spy]. How will Bruvac the Grandiloquent affect Balustrade Spy?
answer_gold: Bruvac the Grandiloquent will not have any effect on Balustrade Spy. Balustrade Spy does not mill any cards, so there is nothing for Bruvac the Grandiloquent to replace.

question: Ayla chooses to put a flood counter from [Quicksilver Fountain] onto their [Knight of New Benalia] which is currently enchanted by [Song of the Dryads]. What will the characteristics of Knight of New Benalia be if Song of the Dryads is destroyed?
answer_gold:
It's just a regular Knight of New Benalia with a flood counter. It's not a land, or an Island. Setting a land subtype does not add the land type, nor does it remove any other non-land types or subtypes from the card. While Knight of New Benalia is not a land, it also doesn't have the Island subtype. Losing all abilities and the ability to tap for {U} is as detailed in [305.7] only happens when setting a land's subtype, so that doesn't occur either.

No man is an Island.

question: Alessandro attacks with [Territorial Kavu]. There are no cards in any player's graveyard. Can Alessandro choose to use the second mode of Territorial Kavu's triggered ability?
answer_gold: Yes. Alessandro can choose 0 or 1 targets for it. If they choose 0 targets, it doesn't require there to be any cards in the graveyard.

question: Nico controls [Urza's Saga] with two lore counters on it. Alexzander uses [Jinx] to change its land type. What happens?
answer_gold:
In layer 4, Urza's Saga will have its land type overwritten as well as lose all of its chapter abilities. It will gain the abilities to tap for {C} and to create Construct tokens in layer 6, as those abilities are granted by a continuous effect that was generated when the previous chapter abilities resolved..

Since Urza's Saga no longer has any chapter abilities, it will remain at 2 lore counters and will not receive any more in future turns. It is not sacrificed.

question: Adriel currently controls Nico's commander. Can Adriel cast [Deadly Rollick] for its alternative cost?
answer_gold: Yes. Deadly Rollick alternative cost works if Adriel controls any commander, not necessarily theirs.

question: Can Alonso activate the ability on their [Dauthi Voidwalker] if there are no cards in exile with void counters on them?
answer_gold: Yes, they can. The choice of card for Dauthi Voidwalker's activated ability is made on resolution of the ability, so it is not required that a legal choice is made in order to activate it. Dauthi Voidwalker's activated ability requires none of these choices to be made in order to activate it, so Alonso is free to do so even if there are no cards with void counters in exile. The choice of a card in exile with a void counter on it is only made during the ability's resolution.

question: Adonis controls [Yedora, Grave Gardener] along with [Cubwarden] that's mutated on top of [Goblin Roughrider]. When that merged permanent dies, what happens to its components?
answer_gold: Adonis may choose to use Yedora, Grave Gardener's ability. If they do, both Goblin Roughrider and Cubwarden will return to the battlefield face-down as Forest Lands.

question: Aaden activates [Inkmoth Nexus], equips [Colossus Hammer] to it, then activates Inkmoth Nexus again. What are the characteristics of Inkmoth Nexus?
answer_gold: It's an 11/11 with infect and flying. The gaining and losing flying effects are applied in timestamp order. Since the most recent one gives Inkmoth Nexus flying, it has flying. Size-setting effects apply before size-modifying effects, so Inkmoth Nexus becomes a 1/1 before getting +10/+10, regardless of timestamps.

question: Is [Umori, the Collector] a legal companion for a deck containing only [Grist, the Hunger Tide], creatures, and lands?
answer_gold: Yes. Grist, the Hunger Tide's ability is in effect even before the game begins..

question: Agustin casts [Dragonlord Atarka], while there are no other creatures on the battlefield. Can they choose 0 targets when Dragonlord Atarka's enters-the-battlefield triggered ability is put onto the stack?
answer_gold: Yes. When instructed to choose any number of targets, zero is a legal choice. Even though Agustin is instructed to divide the damage amongst the chosen number of targets, such division only takes place if there is at least one target chosen.

question: Alex casts [Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury] from their hand, then casts [Choreographed Sparks] targeting it. When the token copy of Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury enters the battlefield, will they have to sacrifice it?
answer_gold: Yes. The copy has the complete rules text of the original card, including the triggered ability that it must be sacrificed if it didn't escape. Since the copy wasn't cast, it didn't escape. ([702.138b])

question: After both players finish taking mulligans, Adrian is going second and has both [Gemstone Caverns] and [Chancellor of the Annex] in their hand. Can they reveal Chancellor of the Annex for its ability and also exile it to begin the game with Gemstone Caverns on the battlefield?
answer_gold: Yes. Adrian can choose to use these two card's effects in either order. Therefore they could use Chancellor of the Annex's effect first and then use Gemstone Caverns's.

question: Abel crews their [Adrestia]. Nathalie activates their [Mobilized District] causing it to become a creature. After that resolves, Nathalie casts [Mirrorweave] targeting their Mobilized District. What are Adrestia's characteristics after Mirrorweave resolves?
answer_gold:
It's a 0/0 colorless land artifact creature with no subtypes and the abilities of Mobilized District.

When Adrestia becomes a copy of Mobilized District, it copies only the copiable values of the permanent, which does not include continuous effects like the one turning Mobilized District into a creature.

The effect from crew is still making Adrestia an artifact creature ([702.122a]), but it doesn't define a power and toughness, so the game treats it as 0/0.

question: Annika crews their [Thunderous Velocipede]. Nico activates their [Hostile Desert] causing it to become a creature. After that resolves, Nico casts [Mirrorweave] targeting their Hostile Desert. What are Thunderous Velocipede's characteristics after Mirrorweave resolves?
answer_gold:
It's a 0/0 colorless Land Artifact Creature - Desert and the abilities of Hostile Desert.

When Thunderous Velocipede becomes a copy of Hostile Desert, it copies only the copiable values of the permanent, which does not include continuous effects like the one turning Hostile Desert into a creature.

The effect from crew is still making Thunderous Velocipede an artifact creature ([702.122a]), but it doesn't define a power and toughness, so the game treats it as 0/0.

When the game checks state-based actions, it will die.

question: Aminah uses [Haunting Voyage] to return both [Breathless Knight] and [Lantern Kami] from their graveyard to the battlefield. How many +1/+1 counters will Breathless Knight get?
answer_gold: Two. Enters-the-battlefield triggered abilities check immediately after the event to see if they should trigger. Breathless Knight enters, then checks to see if anything just entered that should trigger it, and triggers twice.

question: Ariel exiles [Rain-Slicked Copse] with [Brazen Cannonade]. Can they cycle Rain-Slicked Copse?
answer_gold: No. Cycling only functions while the card with cycling is in a player's hand.

question: Neil controls [Crafty Cutpurse] and Amara casts [Trostani Discordant]. At the end of turn Trostani Discordant triggers. After it resolves, who will control the Soldier tokens?
answer_gold: Amara. Tokens are owned by the player that created them. Amara is the one who created the tokens, even if they entered under Neil's control.

question: Aspen controls [Cosima, God of the Voyage] and mutates [Snapdax, Apex of the Hunt] onto it, putting it underneath Cosima, God of the Voyage. At the beginning of their next upkeep, Aspen exiles Cosima, God of the Voyage to its own triggered ability. What happens?
answer_gold:
Cosima, God of the Voyage and Snapdax, Apex of the Hunt both get exiled and gain the corresponding triggered ability. 

The ability on Snapdax, Apex of the Hunt still refers to Cosima, God of the Voyage in exile, so whenever a land enters the battlefield under Aspen's control, they can choose to put up to 2 counters on Cosima, God of the Voyage, and if they chooses not to for both triggers, they'll draw twice that many cards.

question: Ashley attacks Natalie with [Frenzied Raptor] and [Knight Errant]. Can Natalie block Frenzied Raptor with [Ogre Resister], cast [Displace] targeting Ogre Resister, then block Knight Errant with Ogre Resister too?
answer_gold: No. Declaring blockers is a turn-based action at the beginning of the declare blockers step.. All blockers are declared at the same time, and additional blockers can't be declared after this point. By the time Natalie could cast Displace, the opportunity to declare blockers has already passed, so Ogre Resister wouldn't be able to block an additional creature.

question: Ari controls [Chronicle of Victory] and the chosen creature type is Insect. When Ari casts [Grist, the Hunger Tide], will it trigger Chronicle of Victory?
answer_gold: Yes. Grist, the Hunger Tide states that it's an Insect creature when not on the battlefield, which includes the stack.

question: Aiyana casts [Green Sun's Zenith], and in response Neil casts [Hallowed Moonlight]. Aiyana attempts to put [Grist, the Hunger Tide] onto the battlefield. Will it be exiled?
answer_gold: No. Hallowed Moonlight cares about the characteristics of the permanent as it would exist on the battlefield, and Grist, the Hunger Tide isn't a creature on the battlefield.

question: Apollo casts [Price of Fame] targetting Nico's [Frenzied Raptor]. Nico responds to this by casting [Absorb] targetting Price of Fame to which Apollo responds by casting [Incinerate] targetting Frenzied Raptor. Will Absorb still resolve and gain Apollo life?
answer_gold: Yes. When Frenzied Raptor dies, Price of Fame will have no legal targets left, but stays on the stack until it either tries to resolve or is removed some other way. Spells only check for illegal targets once they begin to resolve.

question: Armani controls [Soul Echo] with 0 counters on it and Nico controls [Spirit of the Hearth]. Will Armani have to sacrifice Soul Echo at the beginning of their upkeep?
answer_gold: No. Since the ability has no legal targets, it would trigger at the beginning of the upkeep but would not be put on the stack.

question: Angela attacks with [Mons's Goblin Raiders]. Nico blocks with [Pikemen]. Angela uses [Armored Guardian] to give Mons's Goblin Raiders protection from white. What happens?
answer_gold: Mons's Goblin Raiders will deal combat damage to Pikemen but Pikemen will not deal any damage to Mons's Goblin Raiders. Because Mons's Goblin Raiders gained protection from white, all damage from white sources will be prevented.

question: Alma controls [Cabal Evangel] and sacrifices it to [Relic Vial]. Does Nico lose a life?
answer_gold: Yes. "Dies" triggers check the game state immediately before the event in question occurred to determine whether or not they should trigger, at which point Relic Vial still had the ability.

question: Arya casts [Force of Despair] for its alternative cost, exiling [Gibbering Descent] from their hand. Can they then cast Gibbering Descent for madness?
answer_gold: No. Madness only applies to discarding the card, not exiling it.

question: Addison has cast a sideboard card from [Glittering Wish], which is now in their graveyard. Addison then restarts the game with [Karn Liberated]. What happens?
answer_gold: The sideboard card is shuffled into Addison's library for the restarted game.

question: Ahmed attacks with [Ebony Rhino]. Noemi declares no blocks and then casts [Dazzling Beauty] targeting Ebony Rhino. Is Ahmed able to assign Ebony Rhino's combat damage to Noemi?
answer_gold: Yes.

question: Alex controls a manifested [Erebos, God of the Dead] and no other nonland permanents. Could Alex turn it face up?
answer_gold:
Unclear. While Erebos, God of the Dead is face down, it's a creature and it's a card, therefore it's a creature card. So by the rules as written, it's always legal to turn manifested permanents face up this way.

This is obviously an error, but it's not clearwhat the intention is. If [701.40b] is supposed to say "consider its characteristics if it were face up outside the game" or "consider its characteristics ignoring any continuous effects and status-changes", then the answer would be yes. But if it's supposed to say "consider its characteristics if it were face up on the battlefield", then the answer would be no.

question: Alvin controls [Mycosynth Lattice], a [Dance of the Dead] attached to a [Streetbreaker Wurm] that it returned to the battlefield, and a [Mizzium Transreliquat] that is currently a copy of [Sakashima of a Thousand Faces] due to its second ability. Alvin casts [Eureka], choosing to put [March of the Machines] onto the battlefield, then putting [Copy Artifact] onto the battlefield, which copies the Mizzium Transreliquat and then copies the Dance of the Dead with its new copy ability. (The one from Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.) They choose for it to enchant a [Viashino Warrior] in their graveyard. As Eureka continues resolving, they put [Shimatsu the Bloodcloaked] onto the battlefield and sacrifice March of the Machines. After Copy Artifact's trigger resolves and returns the Viashino Warrior to the battlefield, Alvin activates the ability of the Copy Artifact to turn it into a copy of Streetbreaker Wurm. What happens?
answer_gold: The Copy Artifact becomes unattached from the Viashino Warrior. It still has the ability "enchant creature put onto the battlefield with Dance of the Dead", but it's not an Aura so nothing happens to it if it isn't enchanting a legal object. If Copy Artifact leaves the battlefield later, Alvin will have to sacrifice Viashino Warrior.

question: Autumn uses [Taunting Sliver] to goad [Stone Golem]. After it's been goaded, Nevaeh uses [Teferi's Protection], causing Stone Golem to phase out. On Nevaeh's turn, what are Nevaeh's legal combat choices?
answer_gold: Stone Golem must attack, and since there aren't any other players in the game, it has to attack Autumn. Goaded creatures must attack, and must attack a player other than the one that goaded them if able. Phasing doesn't cause Stone Golem to no longer be goaded, as the duration on the continuous effect hasn't ended when Stone Golem phases back in.

question: Aubrey controls [Valiant Guard] enchanted with [Cloak of Mists] and attacks Neil. Before declaring blockers, Neil casts [Sudden Spoiling] targeting Aubrey. Can Neil block Valiant Guard?
answer_gold: No. Sudden Spoiling causes Valiant Guard to lose all abilities, but Cloak of Mists does not give Valiant Guard an ability, it just states something about it that's true.

question: Aniyah controls two lands and Nico controls [Lavinia, Azorius Renegade]. Can Aniyah cast [Pest Problem]?
answer_gold: No. While on the stack, Pest Problem has only the characteristics of its Adventure, and the game will use those characteristics to determine if it can be cast.

question: Arturo controls [Dryad Militant]. Nico casts [Terminate] targeting Dryad Militant. What happens when Terminate resolves?
answer_gold: Dryad Militant is destroyed during the resolution of Terminate. Then, as the last step in resolving Terminate, it is moved from the stack into Nico's graveyard.. By this time, Dryad Militant is no longer on the battlefield, so there is no replacement effect that would exile Terminate instead.

question: Anderson controls [Voracious Brood], [Corpse Harvester], and a 2/2 Zombie token. They activate Corpse Harvester, sacrificing the Zombie token. Will Voracious Brood trigger?
answer_gold: No. Tokens are not cards.

question: Avery's [Spell Queller] dies, and the exiled card was [Valki, God of Lies]. Can Avery cast [Tibalt, Cosmic Impostor]?
answer_gold: Yes. Spell Queller only requires that the spell have mana value four or less upon the resolution of its first ability. It doesn't continue to check whether it continues to have mana value four or less in exile, nor does it check when Avery decides to cast it upon the resolution of Spell Queller's second ability.

question: Aliza exiles [Canyon Lurkers] from the top of their library with [Wiccan, Young Avenger]. Can they cast it as a face down morph creature?
answer_gold: Yes. Morph works from any zone from which a player may play a card.. Wiccan, Young Avenger simply gives permission to cast the card without imposing an alternative cost, so an alternative cost like morph can be used..

question: Averi reveals [Jegantha, the Wellspring] as their companion at the beginning of the game. Later in the game, they use [Mastermind's Acquisition] to put a card from their sideboard into their hand. Does Nico get to know whether it was the Jegantha, the Wellspring?
answer_gold: No. Averi is only required to reveal their companion at the beginning of the game and when they're putting it into their hand, and not at any other point. ([702.139a], [701.20a])

question: Nico casts [Price of Fame] targeting Ayla's [Moss Monster]. Ayla uses [Bolt Bend] to change the target to Ayla's [Gavony Dawnguard]. Will its ward ability trigger?
answer_gold: Yes. Ward triggers whenever the permanent with the ability becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls. It doesn't matter who chose its target.

question: Arlo controls [Varchild's War-Riders] with one age counter on it. Noemi controls [Adrix and Nev, Twincasters]. During Arlo's upkeep, they resolve the trigger and pay the upkeep cost of Varchild's War-Riders. How many tokens does Noemi create?
answer_gold: Four. To resolve cumulative upkeep, Arlo puts another age counter on Varchild's War-Riders, then creates a token for each age counter on it. Adrix and Nev, Twincasters then replaces those two tokens with four. It doesn't care why the tokens are being created, just that they're being created under Noemi's control.

question: Alejandro controls [Archon of Sun's Grace] and casts [Thassa's Emissary]. Do they make a token?
answer_gold: Yes. Archon of Sun's Grace's ability triggers if any enchantment enters the battlefield. It doesn't matter if that enchantment is also a creature.

question: Nicolas controls [Leonin Arbiter]. Aubree cycles [Cragsmasher Yeti] and targets Leonin Arbiter with the triggered ability from [Astral Slide]. Will Aubree be able to search for a land?
answer_gold: Yes. Astral Slide's ability will resolve before Cragsmasher Yeti's cycling ability will. When Aubree cycles Cragsmasher Yeti, Astral Slide's ability triggers, before Aubree gets priority its ability will be put onto the stack above the cycling ability. Which means Leonin Arbiter will be exiled before Aubree begins searching their library.

question: Nico controls [Solemnity]. Alia casts [Arixmethes, Slumbering Isle]. Will it be a land?
answer_gold: No. Due to Solemnity's static ability, Arixmethes, Slumbering Isle will enter the battlefield with no slumber counters on it and therefore won't be a land.

question: What are Ashton's legal choices for X while casting [Mind Grind] with [Omniscience]?
answer_gold: None. They can't cast Mind Grind with Omniscience's alternative cost. When casting a spell without paying its mana cost, X must be 0. Since 0 isn't a legal choice for Mind Grind, it can't be cast this way.

question: Does [Muraganda Petroglyphs] count [Silverflame Squire] as having no abilities?
answer_gold: Yes. The Adventurer portion of Silverflame Squire is an alternative set of characteristics that are not relevant while it's on the battlefield. They aren't abilities.

question: Addison controls [Carth the Lion] and [Bioessence Hydra]. Addison activates the [+1] ability of [Dovin, Architect of Law]. How many times does Bioessence Hydra trigger?
answer_gold: Once. If a planeswalker's ability has multiple costs to add or remove loyalty counters, those costs are combined into a single cost.

question: Alessandra controls a [Necrotic Ooze] and has a [Grist, the Hunger Tide] in their graveyard. Does Necrotic Ooze have the abilities of Grist, the Hunger Tide and can Alessandra activate them?
answer_gold: Yes and yes. Grist, the Hunger Tide is a creature card in the graveyard, so Necrotic Ooze has its abilities, and nothing prevents them from being activated as normal. (Alessandra still has to pay the cost to activate them of course.)

question: Armani controls [Dream Devourer] and foretells [Ghastly Gloomhunter]. If they cast it, can they pay the kicker? If so, what's the total cost?
answer_gold: Armani can pay kicker because it's an additional cost. Armani must pay a total f {3}{B}{B}, since its foretell cost is {B} and its kicker cost is {3}{B}.

question: Addison controls [The Book of Vile Darkness], and token copies of [Eye of Vecna] and [Hand of Vecna] created by [Saheeli's Artistry]. Addison then activates The Book of Vile Darkness. What abilities will the Vecna token have?
answer_gold: Only indestructible and "At the beginning of your end step, if you lost 2 or more life this turn, create a 2/2 black Zombie creature token.". It won't get the abilities of the exiled tokens, because they're not cards.

question: Adelaide casts [Animate Dead] targeting [Phyrexian Metamorph]. They have Phyrexian Metamorph enter the battlefield as a copy of [Iconic Shield]. What happens?
answer_gold: When Animate Dead's trigger resolves, Phyrexian Metamorph enters the battlefield as a copy of Iconic Shield. Animate Dead can't attach to it, since it's not a creature put onto the battlefield with Animate Dead. The next time state-based actions are checked, Animate Dead is put into the graveyard since it's not enchanting anything. This triggers Animate Dead's delayed trigger and Adelaide will sacrifice Phyrexian Metamorph.

question: Nadia casts [Searing Blaze], targeting [Death's Shadow] and Autumn, who is at 12 life. What happens?
answer_gold: Death's Shadow doesn't die. Death's Shadow's effect updates immediately upon its controller's life total changing, so there's never any point where it has at least as much damage marked on it as its toughness.

question: Nico controls [Authority of the Consuls], and Alma casts [Gilder Bairn]. Can they activate its ability that turn?
answer_gold: No. "Summoning sickness" applies to both the {T} and {Q} symbols.

question: Avery casts [Screamreach Brawler] for its Dash cost, and attacks. Norah casts [Turn Against] to take control of Screamreach Brawler. What happens at the end of Avery's turn?
answer_gold: Screamreach Brawler will be returned to Avery's hand at the beginning of their end step. ([702.109a]) Screamreach Brawler's Dash ability creates a delayed trigger that will go on the stack at the beginning of the next end step, it doesn't matter who controls the creature at that point.

question: Ayaan controls a [Thing in the Ice] with one counter remaining, then casts [Summary Dismissal]. What happens?
answer_gold: Ayaan removes the last counter from Thing in the Ice and it transforms and returns all non-Horror creatures to hand. Thing in the Ice's ability triggers when Ayaan casts Summary Dismissal, so it will go on the stack above it and resolve before Summary Dismissal resolves.

question: Alena has no cards in their graveyard and controls a token that's a copy of [Kozilek, Butcher of Truth], created by [Rite of Replication]. Nicholas casts [Villainous Wrath]. Will Alena shuffle their library?
answer_gold: Yes. The token will be put into Alena's graveyard, triggering its ability, before ceasing to exist as a state-based action. Even though there is no cards in their graveyard, they will still shuffle their library..

question: Aspen casts [Buried Alive] while controlling [Extus, Oriq Overlord]. Can they put [Virulent Sliver] into their graveyard with Buried Alive, and return it with Extus, Oriq Overlord's triggered ability?
answer_gold: No. Extus, Oriq Overlord triggers when Aspen casts Buried Alive, and will go on the stack above it. At this point, a legal target has to be chosen. The ability will then resolve before the spell that caused it to trigger does.

question: Abel casts [Death-Greeter's Champion] using Dash. When is Abel able to cast [Stifle] to interact with Death-Greeter's Champion's dash ability, and what is the result?
answer_gold:
At the beginning of the next end step Abel would be able to cast Stifle, preventing Death-Greeter's Champion from being returned to their hand.

When Death-Greeter's Champion resolves, a delayed triggered ability is set up. At the beginning of the next end step, that delayed triggered ability will trigger, and on resolution would return Death-Greeter's Champion to Abel's hand. ([702.109a]) While that triggered ability is on the stack, Abel can cast Stifle targetting it. On resolution, the triggered ability would be countered, and Death-Greeter's Champion would not be returned to Abel's hand.

question: Ariel crews [Lifecraft Engine], turning it into a creature until end of turn. They then cast [Dreamtail Heron] with mutate, targetting it, choosing to put it underneath as it resolves. When the crew effect later ends, what does Lifecraft Engine look like?
answer_gold: It is an Artifact - Vehicle (not a Creature) with all the abilities granted by Dreamtail Heron. ([729.2a]/[702.140e]).

question: Aiyana casts [Murktide Regent], exiling 5 instants. In response, Nico casts [Dress Down]. How many +1/+1 counters will Murktide Regent enter the battlefield with?
answer_gold: Zero. When determining how to apply Murktide Regent's replacement effect, its characteristics are checked as it would exist on the battlefield. Since Dress Down is on the battlefield, Murktide Regent would have no abilities while on the battlefield, so its replacement effect won't apply.

question: Ashley controls [Nightmare Shepherd] and [Clever Impersonator] which copied [Untethered Express] as it entered the battlefield. Clever Impersonator gets animated and then dies, triggers Nightmare Shepherd and Ashley chooses to use the ability. What happens?
answer_gold: Nightmare Shepherds trigger resolves and creates a token. That token will be an unanimated copy of Untethered Express, except it's a 1/1 and a nightmare. Notably, as it is currently not a creature, it will only be a 1/1 and a nightmare when crewed, since nightmare is a creature type but not an artifact type.

question: Addison controls [Harmonic Prodigy] and [Delver of Secrets], and has a sorcery on top of their library. What will happen during Addison's next upkeep?
answer_gold: Delver of Secrets's trigger will go on the stack twice. When the first trigger resolves, Addison can choose to reveal the top card of their library. If they do Delver of Secrets will transform. When the second trigger resolves, Addison can again reveal the instant or sorcery card, but if they do it won't transform again.

question: Avery controls [Gideon, the Oathsworn] and activates a loyalty ability to make it into a creature. They then enchant it with [Metamorphic Alteration] choosing to copy [Sarkhan the Masterless] which is currently a Dragon due to its [+1] ability. Can they activate another of Gideon, the Oathsworn's loyalty abilities this turn?
answer_gold: No. Loyalty abilities can only be activated if another loyalty ability of that permanent hasn't already been activated this turn.

question: Angelique casts [Poison the Waters] targeting Nico. Can they choose [Grist, the Hunger Tide] from Nico's hand?
answer_gold: Yes. Grist, the Hunger Tide's first ability makes it a creature while in all zones other than the battlefield, including the hand.

question: Ainsley activates the equip ability of [Screaming Shield] targeting [Durkwood Boars]. Nina responds by using [Archmage's Charm] to gain control of Screaming Shield. What happens?
answer_gold: Screaming Shield equips as normal to Durkwood Boars. Ainsley still controls the equip ability on the stack and the creature being equipped, so none of the targeting restrictions are being violated as the ability resolves.

question: Nico activates [Scarwood Bandits] to gain control of Amiyah's [Instrument of the Bards] in response to its first triggered ability in Amiyah's upkeep. What will happen when the trigger resolves?
answer_gold: Amiyah can choose to put a counter on Nico's Instrument of the Bards. Gaining control of Instrument of the Bards does not change the controller of the trigger on the stack.

question: Augustine casts [Energy Tap] targeting their [Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal]. Unfortunately, Aclazotz, Deepest Betrayal dies before Energy Tap resolves. What happens?
answer_gold: Augustine won't get any colorless mana. If a spell lacks targets when it goes to resolve, it won't do anything.

question: Ari attacks with [Dorothea, Vengeful Victim]. As soon as they have priority, Nancy uses [Time Stop] to end the turn. What happens to Dorothea, Vengeful Victim?
answer_gold: Nothing. Its attack trigger did not resolve, so there is no delayed trigger to sacrifice it at the next end of combat step.

question: Natalie controls [Stonecoil Serpent] and Alvaro casts [Solar Blaze]. WIll Stonecoil Serpent die?
answer_gold: Yes. Solar Blaze causes Stonecoil Serpent to deal damage to itself, which isn't prevented by protection. Protection prevents Stonecoil Serpent from being targeted, attached to, dealt damage by, or blocked by anything multicolored. None of those are happening here.

question: Antoine controls [Aang and La, Ocean's Fury] and [Embodiment of Insight]. Does Aang and La, Ocean's Fury have vigilance?
answer_gold: No. "Land creature" refers to a creature that's also a land, not a creature that doesn't have flying.

question: Autumn plays [Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth], then plays [Extraplanar Lens] exiling a basic [Swamp]. What lands can be tapped for additional mana?
answer_gold: Only basic Swamps will produce additional mana. Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth adds the basic land type "Swamp" to all lands on the battlefield, however, it doesn't change the names of those lands. Extraplanar Lens only affects lands with the same name as the exiled land.

question: Nico casts [Ashcoat Bear] before blockers are declared. Can Aron use [Kytheon's Irregulars]'s ability to tap Ashcoat Bear before it can be declared as a blocker?
answer_gold: Yes. If Nico made no indication they were going to declare blockers, then it's likely they were casting Ashcoat Bear in the declare attackers step. After it resolves both players will get priority before the declare blockers step.

question: Alberto controls a tapped [Kalamax, the Stormsire] and casts [Teach by Example]. After that resolves they cast [Soul Partition]. How many +1/+1 counters will Kalamax, the Stormsire get, and how many Soul Partitions will Alberto get?
answer_gold: Alberto will get a total of three Soul Partitions (the original and three copies), and Kalamax, the Stormsire will get three +1/+1 counters. (One for copying Teach by Example, and two for the two copies of Soul Partition.)

question: Angela controls no creatures and casts [Pack's Betrayal] targeting Noel's [Mirror Entity]. Will they get to scry?
answer_gold: Yes. While resolving Pack's Betrayal Angela follows the instructions on the spell in the order written, so first Angela gains control of Mirror Entity then the spell checks to see if they control a Wolf or Werewolf, which they now do.

question: Addison controls [Kess, Dissident Mage] and has [Ferocious Werefox] in the graveyard. Can they cast [Guard Change]?
answer_gold: Yes. When determining whether Addison can cast Guard Change the game will take into account the characteristics of its Adventure part, meaning that it will count as an instant or a sorcery, meaning Addison can cast it.

question: Ari casts [Aeve, Progenitor Ooze], with two spells having been cast before then. Nadia controls [Humility]. What will Ari's battlefield look like once the stack fully resolves and state-based actions are checked?
answer_gold:
It will be two token copies of Aeve, Progenitor Ooze along with the original card, with none of them having counters. 

Due to the layer system, the second ability of Aeve, Progenitor Ooze still applies even with Humility on the battlefield, so the tokens are not legendary. This is because effects that change the type of cards are processed before effects that give or take away abilities.. Type-changing effects apply in layer 4.. Ability adding or removing effects apply in layer 6..

Aeve, Progenitor Ooze will enter without counters because we take into account how the creature would look like on the battlefield to determine what abilities apply to it as it enters. Due to Humility it doesn't have its third ability on the battlefield and will enter without counters because of it.

question: Ari controls [Kaya, Bane of the Dead] and has played a land this turn. They cast [Searing Blaze] targeting Nikolas and their [Enduring Angel] to deal 3 damage to each. Nikolas is at 3 life. What happens?
answer_gold: Enduring Angel replaces Nikolas's life total change with the described actions. So simultaneously, Enduring Angel transforms and is dealt 3 damage. (Nikolas is also dealt 3 damage, but their life total doesn't change.) The next time state-based actions are checked, Enduring Angel will die.

question: If no player has lost life this turn, can Arlo cast [Rafter Demon] for its Spectacle cost if they activate the mana ability of [Cryptolith Fragment] while casting it?
answer_gold:
No. Spectacle is an alternative cost ([702.137a]), which Arlo can only choose to use if they've already lost life. Activating mana abilities doesn't occur until after legality of the alternative cost has been checked.

Arlo could, however, simply tap the Cryptolith Fragment before casting Rafter Demon.

question: Autumn attacks with [Hiveheart Shaman] and resolves its trigger. Can they search for a [Wastes] even though they already control Wastes?
answer_gold: Yes. Wastes has no basic land types, and as such can not share one with other permanents. Autumn can always search for Wastes no matter what is on the battlefield.

question: Anderson controls [The Ozolith] and [Gideon Jura], which has 5 loyalty counters on it. They use Gideon Jura's ability to turn it into creature, and then it dies. What happens?
answer_gold: Anderson will move the loyalty counters from Gideon Jura onto The Ozolith. The Ozolith doesn't have any restrictions on the kind of counters that can be placed on it.

question: Adrien controls a treasure token and has [Sleep of the Dead] in their graveyard. Can they use the treasure token for mana and then exile it for Sleep of the Dead's escape cost?
answer_gold: No. If Adrien activates the treasure token while paying the costs to cast Sleep of the Dead from the graveyard, it'll still be in the graveyard at that time, but Adrien can't exile it for the escape cost because tokens anywhere other than the battlefield can't change zones.

question: Aubrey casts [Volt Charge] targeting Nixon. Nixon responds by casting [Deflecting Palm], to which Aubrey responds by also casting Deflecting Palm. What happens once everything resolves?
answer_gold: The game ends in a draw. Deflecting Palm creates a prevention effect that watches for damage being dealt to its controller, prevents that damage, and creates a new damage event. Because of this, Aubrey's Deflecting Palm will keep preventing damage dealt by Nixon's Deflecting Palm and vice versa. Since the effect is mandatory, the game enters into an infinite loop of prevention effects and so the game ends in a draw.

question: Arthur is at 2 life. Nova controls [Platinum Angel] and is at -1 life. Arthur casts [Psionic Blast], targeting the Platinum Angel. What happens when Psionic Blast resolves?
answer_gold:
Arthur loses the game. Psionic Blast deals 4 damage to Platinum Angel and 2 damage to Arthur, then state-based actions are checked. Platinum Angel has lethal damage marked on it and Arthur has 0 life, so two state-based actions occur at the same time and Arthur loses the game at the same time that Platinum Angel is destroyed.

Nova would have lost the game during the next SBA check, but that doesn't matter, because the game already ended before the second check could happen.

question: Nico controls [Bruvac the Grandiloquent]. Aryan has 3 cards in their library. Can they dredge [Greater Mossdog] during their draw step?
answer_gold: No. When Aryan goes to dredge Greater Mossdog, Bruvac the Grandiloquent's replacement effect modifies dredge to say "if you would draw a card, you may instead mill 6 cards" Aryan can't choose to mill more cards than they have, so they can't dredge Greater Mossdog.

question: Nico controls [Barony Vampire]. Alexandra casts [Mark of Mutiny] to take control of Barony Vampire, and equips it with [Batterskull]. During Nico's next turn, is Barony Vampire considered to be "modified" for the purposes of [Arna Kennerüd, Skycaptain]?
answer_gold: Yes. It's still equipped with Batterskull, since nothing unattached it. And being equipped is sufficient to make a creature "modified".

question: Natalie controls [High Fae Trickster]. Allen activates the crew ability of [Capenna Express]. Before it resolves Natalie casts [One with the Stars] targeting Capenna Express. What happens when the crew ability resolves?
answer_gold: Capenna Express will become an artifact creature as normal. One with the Stars and Capenna Express's abilities both apply in layer 4 and attempt to change its type. Capenna Express's ability will have the newer timestamp, and it resolved most recently. ([613.7], [613.7b], [702.122a])

question: Ariel casts [Forfend], casts [Anhelo, the Painter]. If Ariel then casts another Forfend, will it have casualty 2?
answer_gold: No. It's the second instant or sorcery spell Ariel cast this turn, not the first.

question: Nayeli controls [Alms Collector]. Ariel controls two 1/1 Bird tokens and attempts to use [Slate of Ancestry] to draw cards. How many cards will each player draw?
answer_gold: Ariel and Nayeli will both draw one card. Slate of Ancestry will count up the number of creatures Ariel controls and instruct Ariel to draw that many cards.

question: Ariel controls [Reconnaissance] and attacks Niko with [Sanctuary Cat]. After combat damage is dealt, can Ariel use Reconnaissance's activated ability to untap Sanctuary Cat?
answer_gold: Yes. Sanctuary Cat is considered an attacking creature until the end of the combat phase, and is therefore still a legal target for Reconnaissance's activated ability.

question: Nico controls [Humility]. Aitana casts [Finale of Devastation] with X = 10. Will the creature they find have haste?
answer_gold: Yes. Both effects apply in layer 6, and are applied in timestamp order. Since Finale of Devastation's effect has the most recent timestamp, it's applied last.

question: In a multiplayer game, Achilles uses [Jon Irenicus, Shattered One] to give [Vastwood Gorger] to Brynn. If Brynn dies, what happens to Vastwood Gorger?
answer_gold: Achilles gets their Vastwood Gorger back. When Brynn leaves the game, any effects giving them control of any objects end.

question: Nelson controls [Fumiko the Lowblood] and [Koskun Falls]. Adalyn pays {2} to attack Nelson. Does their [Firkraag, Cunning Instigator] trigger?
answer_gold: Yes. Costs to attack are locked in before the game checks to see if any triggers would happen due to attackers being declared.

question: Ameer controls [Whirler Rogue] and [Phyrexian Missionary]. Nico controls [Power Surge] and [Yurlok of Scorch Thrash]. If Ameer casts [Shatterskull Minotaur], can they choose to only have the cost reduced by {1}?
answer_gold: No. Shatterskull Minotaur's cost is reduced by the number of creatures in Ameer's party, which is determined by the game, and is calculated to be the highest possible amount.

question: Aspen attacks with [Hammers of Moradin]. During the combat damage step, they use [Time Stop] to end the turn. What happens to the tokens created by myriad?
answer_gold: They remain on the battlefield, and will be exiled at the beginning of the next end of combat step. ([702.116a], [511.2], [603.7b])

question: Ayden casts [Sakashima the Impostor] copying their [Unlicensed Hearse], which is currently a 4/4. What is Sakashima the Impostor's power?
answer_gold:
Sakashima the Impostor won't be a creature. Copy effects copy only what is printed on the card (plus other copiable effects), not any other continuous effects that may be affecting it.

If Ayden activates Sakashima the Impostor's crew ability, it will be a 0/0.

question: Amanda and Nixon each control a [Combat Calligrapher]. What happens when Amanda attacks Nixon?
answer_gold: An Inkling is created tapped and attacking Nixon. Combat Calligrapher only prevents the declaration of Inklings as attackers, which the token is not doing.

question: If Avery is going first, they'd like to reveal [Umori, the Collector] as their companion. If they're going second, they don't want to have a companion. Can they do this?
answer_gold: Yes. Starting player is determined before Avery would need to reveal their companion.

question: Avery's [Unlicensed Hearse] has exiled five cards, and they activate its crew ability. After that resolves, Avery casts [Dress Down]. What does Unlicensed Hearse look like?
answer_gold:
It's a 0/0 artifact creature with no abilities. (And will die when state-based actions are checked.)

Unlicensed Hearse becomes a creature in layer 4 ([702.122a], [613.1d]), then loses its abilities in layer 6. Nothing else happens, so its size is */*. "*" is not a number, so it gets set to 0.

question: In a game of Emperor, Nico is an emperor, and Ayaan is a general on the opposing team. During Ayaan's turn, they cast [Approach of the Second Sun] from their hand, for the second time this game. What happens as Approach of the Second Sun resolves?
answer_gold:
The opponent sitting next to Ayaan loses the game. If that's Nico, their whole team loses the game.

The Emperor variant uses the "Limited Range of Influence" option. When playing with this option, when an effect states that a player wins, all of that player's opponents within their range of influence lose the game instead..

question: Avery activates [Ascendant Spirit]'s first ability. Before it resolves Avery casts [Slip Out the Back] targeting Ascendant Spirit. When it phases back in, what will it look like?
answer_gold: It will be a 2/2 and not a Warrior. When Ascendant Spirit's ability resolves it's phased out and won't be affected.

question: Aubrey casts [Oubliette] targeting [Master Pakku]. Will Master Pakku's ability trigger when it phases back in?
answer_gold: No. Triggered abilities check immediately after an event happens, to see if that event triggered any abilities. Master Pakku is being tapped and phasing in simultaneously, so the trigger doesn't see it as having ever been untapped.

question: Avery controls [Magnetic Web] and is attacking with two [Leatherback Baloth]s with magnet counters on them. Nayeli controls one [Imperial Moth] that also has a magnet counter on it. What are Nayeli's legal blocks?
answer_gold: Nayeli can block either Leatherback Baloth with their Magnetic Web. When declaring blockers, Nayeli must fulfill the maximum number of requirements, while not violating any restrictions.

question: Ashley controls [Silent Arbiter], [Magnetic Web] and 2 [Ekundu Cyclops], one of which has a magnet counter. What are their legal attacks?
answer_gold:
Ashley can attack with either Ekundu Cyclops, as they both only have one requirement to fulfill. 
Ashley has to fulfill as many requirements as they can without violating any restrictions. The text on Silent Arbiter is a restriction while Magnetic Web and Ekundu Cyclops both contain requirements.

question: Nia controls [Firkraag, Cunning Instigator] and [Seeker of Slaanesh]. Ariel attacks Nia with [Meng Huo's Horde], which is their only creature, and deals combat damage to them. Will Firkraag, Cunning Instigator's second triggered ability trigger?
answer_gold: No. Firkraag, Cunning Instigator's ability checks to see if there were any requirements to attack applying to that creature at the time attackers were declared to determine if it triggers. It does not trigger if there was a requirement for the creature's controller to attack, but not the creature itself.

question: Ainsley controls [Delver of Secrets] and uses [Ixidron] to try to turn it face down. What happens?
answer_gold: Nothing happens. Double-faced permanents can't be turned face down.

question: Aldo controls [Answered Prayers] and no other creatures. They cast [Wolfir Silverheart]. Can they pair it with Answered Prayers?
answer_gold: No. Soulbond is a triggered ability that will only go on the stack if Aldo controls another eligible creature when Wolfir Silverheart enters the battlefield. However before Answered Prayers's ability resolves, Aldo doesn't control any other eligible creatures.

question: Avery controls a [Mirage Mirror] that last turn become a copy of [Angel of Condemnation] and exiled [Canal Monitor] with its second activated ability. This turn, Avery activates Mirage Mirror targeting [Undiscovered Paradise] and taps it for mana. On Avery's next turn, will the Canal Monitor return to the battlefield? If so, can it attack?
answer_gold:
This can't happen as described. Mirage Mirror was exerted last turn, so it won't untap this turn and cannot be tapped for mana.

If it had instead been exerted two turns ago, the Canal Monitor would return to the battlefield, but can't attack. Any time an object refers to itself by name, it just means "this card", so Mirage Mirror will return to Avery's hand during their untap step, and the Canal Monitor will return to the battlefield. During the combat phase of that turn, Canal Monitor has not been on the battlefield since the turn began, so it will not be able to attack.

question: Aspen casts [Greater Good] sacrificing their [Bane Alley Blackguard] which is enchanted with [Mystic Subdual]. How many cards do they draw?
answer_gold: None. Greater Good checks the power of the creature on the battlefield, not in the graveyard. If a player is instructed to draw a negative number of cards, they draw 0.

question: Annalee attacks with their [Rootbreaker Wurm] equipped with [Gorgon's Head]. Nico blocks with [Hazoret, Godseeker]. What is the maximum amount of damage Annalee can assign to Nico?
answer_gold: 5 damage. Annalee must assign "lethal" damage to Hazoret, Godseeker, however they only have to assign one damage to Hazoret, Godseeker, since any amount of damage dealt by a source with deathtouch is considered "lethal" damage, regardless of whether or not it is lethal.

question: Avery controls a [Gideon, Champion of Justice] with 4 loyalty counters on it. Avery activates its ability to turn into a creature. Can Nick target it with [Karakas]'s ability?
answer_gold: Yes. Gideon, Champion of Justice is legendary and it's a creature.

question: Amiyah controls [Yedora, Grave Gardener] mutated beneath [Everquill Phoenix]. When that merged permanent dies, what happens to its components?
answer_gold: They both go to the graveyard. Yedora, Grave Gardener doesn't trigger on itself dying.

question: Azariah attacks with a [Barrage Tyrant] and Nico blocks with a [Kor Firewalker]. Does the Kor Firewalker die?
answer_gold: Yes. Devoid is a keyword that means "this card has no color". Kor Firewalker doesn't have protection from the Barrage Tyrant.

question: Both Augustus and Nico control a [Thraben Purebloods]. Nico casts [Unholy Hunger] targeting Augustus's Thraben Purebloods and in response Augustus casts [Unified Will] targeting Unholy Hunger. What happens?
answer_gold: Unified Will resolves and does nothing. Unified Will checks on resolution to see if Augustus controls more creatures than Nico, and since a tie isn't "more than" it does not counter Unholy Hunger.

question: Arya controls [The First Iroan Games] and no creatures. At the beginning of their precombat main phase, Arya puts the 3rd lore counter on it. Arya then casts [Mistbind Clique] at their first opportunity. Do they draw two cards from The First Iroan Games's ability?
answer_gold: No. Mistbind Clique must be sacrificed to its champion ability, and will not be on the battlefield when the trigger resolves.

question: Ari controls [Estrid's Invocation] that's a copy of [Vault 101: Birthday Party]. They resolve another copy of Estrid's Invocation, choosing to copy the first Estrid's Invocation. Does the newest Estrid's Invocation have two instances of the upkeep triggered ability?
answer_gold: Yes. The first Estrid's Invocation's upkeep triggered ability is part of its copiable values. The second Estrid's Invocation thus copies it, while still gaining another instance of the same ability.

question: Azariah controls [Demon of Catastrophes] and Nico controls [Cornered Market]. Can Azariah cast another Demon of Catastrophes, sacrificing the first?
answer_gold: No. Azariah can't begin casting the second Demon of Catastrophes while they still control another Demon of Catastrophes.

question: Aubrey controls [Underworld Breach]. Can they dash [Flamerush Rider] from their graveyard?
answer_gold: No. Escape and dash are both alternative costs ([702.138a], [702.109a]), and only one alternative cost can be paid to cast a spell.

question: In a Commander game, how much life does each player begin the game with?
[Mana Vault] triggers in Andrew's draw step, but before it resolves Andrew casts [Bedevil] targeting it. Will they still be dealt damage?
answer_gold: Yes. Mana Vault's trigger has an intervening \"if\" clause, so it checks to see if Mana Vault is tapped both when it triggers and when it resolves. Mana Vault doesn't exist anymore when it resolves, so the game uses its last known information. Since it was tapped when it last existed on the battlefield, it deals the damage.

question: Alonso has controlled [Walking Corpse] since their last turn, and mutates [Otrimi, the Ever-Playful] onto it. Will they be able to attack with the merged creature this turn?
answer_gold:
Yes. Walking Corpse has been under Alonso's control continuously since their most recent turn began, which is what summoning sickness looks for. A merged creature is the same permanent it was before it merged with something else, it's just better now.

("Mutate" is the keyword, and "merged" is the state the permanent is in once it's on the battlefield. ([702.140c]/[729.1]))

question: Annie casts [Druid's Familiar]. Can they soulbond it with their [Answered Prayers]?
answer_gold: No. Soulbond will not trigger unless Annie controls another unpaired creature when Druid's Familiar enters the battlefield, which they does not.

question: Andrew attacks with [Caravan Hurda] that's enchanted with [Spirit Link]. How much life will they gain?
answer_gold: Two life. Andrew will gain one life from Spirit Link's keyword ability, and one life from Caravan Hurda's triggered ability.

question: Aniyah has to choose a card name for [Wood Sage]. Can they choose [Homura's Essence]?
answer_gold: No. The flipped characteristics of a flip card are used to determine the characteristics of its flipped name. Only Homura's Essence's unflipped face is a creature card, Homura's Essence itself is not.

question: Aislinn controls [Mycosynth Lattice], [Glorious Anthem], a [Dance of the Dead] attached to a [Dwarven Trader] that it returned to the battlefield, a [Mizzium Transreliquat] that copied [Clever Impersonator] with its second ability, and a [Skyshroud Troopers] enchanted by an [Ocular Halo]. Aislinn casts [Copy Artifact], choosing to copy the Mizzium Transreliquat and then choosing to copy the Dance of the Dead with its new copy ability as it enters the battlefield. They choose to enchant a [Phyrexian Hulk] in their graveyard. After Copy Artifact's trigger resolves and returns the Phyrexian Hulk to the battlefield, Aislinn activates the ability of the Copy Artifact to turn it into a copy of Ocular Halo. After that resolves, they casts [Aura Finesse] to attach it to the Skyshroud Troopers. What happens?
answer_gold: This can't happen as described. When Aislinn applies Copy Artifact's copy effect from Clever Impersonator to copy Dance of the Dead, it doesn't copy Mizzium Transreliquat's activated ability to become a copy of target artifact.

question: Alex controls a [Gaea's Liege], [Rhonas the Indomitable], and 1 [Forest]. Natalie controls 5 Forest. Can Alex attack with the Gaea's Liege and Rhonas the Indomitable?
answer_gold: No. All creatures are declared as attackers at the same time. Checking to see if any restrictions affect a potentially-attacking creature is done before the creature becomes an "attacking creature".

question: In a game of Two-Headed Giant, Andres and Aubrey each control a [Torsten Von Ursus]. They both attack Nico. Can Nico block with [Flummoxed Cyclops]?
answer_gold:
No, Nico can not block with Flummoxed Cyclops.

A total of two creatures that are controlled by the opponents of Nico have been declared as attackers. This triggers the ability of Flummoxed Cyclops making it unable to block.

question: Alfredo cast [Artificial Evolution] targeting their [Elvish Archdruid], choosing to replace Elf with Saproling as it resolves. What does Elvish Archdruid look like?
answer_gold: Elvish Archdruid will be a Saproling instead of an Elf, will give other Saprolings +1/+1 and will have the ability "{T}: Add {G} to add mana for each Saproling you control."

question: In a two-headed giant game, Nehemiah has 3 cards in hand and Nico has 1 card in hand. Allen controls [Enemy of Enlightenment]. What is Enemy of Enlightenment's power and toughness?
answer_gold:
Enemy of Enlightenment is 1/1.

In multiplayer games a player's opponents are all players not on their team.

question: Norah controls [Harsh Mentor]. Aryan controls [Phyrexian Altar], [Godhead of Awe] and [Heliod, God of the Sun]. Aryan activates Heliod, God of the Sun's ability, sacrificing Godhead of Awe to Phyrexian Altar to help pay the cost. Will Harsh Mentor trigger?
answer_gold: No. The process for activating an ability after it's created on the stack is identical to the process for casting a spell. The final step in the process of casting a spell is for it to become "cast". Heliod, God of the Sun is not a creature at this time, so Harsh Mentor doesn't trigger.

question: Aron has [Shepherd of the Flock] in their graveyard. Aron casts [Mission Briefing], can they choose to cast the adventure of Shepherd of the Flock?
answer_gold: No. Adventurer cards have an alternative set of characteristics, however any time an Adventurer card is anywhere other than the stack it only has the characteristics of the creature portion. Mission Briefing requires Aron to choose an instant or sorcery card in their graveyard, and they cannot choose Shepherd of the Flock.

question: Noa controls a [Lifeline] and 2 [Fresh Volunteers]. Addison casts [March of Souls]. Does Lifeline trigger and return the creatures to the battlefield at the beginning of the next end step?
answer_gold: Yes. Leaves-the-battlefield triggers care about the game state immediately before the event in question occurred when determining whether they trigger. There was another creature on the battlefield at that time, so Lifeline will trigger for both creatures that died. Lifeline's trigger has an intervening "if" clause that checks for that condition again as the trigger begins to resolve. There is another creature on the battlefield at that time, created by the March of Souls, so the ability resolves and will return both Fresh Volunteers to the battlefield.

question: Aspen has an [Erebos, God of the Dead] in their graveyard. They casts [Animate Dead], targeting the Erebos, God of the Dead. What happens?
answer_gold: As the trigger resolves, Erebos, God of the Dead returns to the battlefield. Once on the battlefield it is not a creature, so Animate Dead it is attached to an illegal object and is put into the graveyard. Since Animate Dead left the battlefield, the Erebos, God of the Dead will be sacrificed.

question: Ali controls a [Gideon of the Trials] with 4 loyalty counters on it. Ali activates its ability to turn into a creature. Can Ali target it with [Sword of the Chosen]'s ability?
answer_gold: Yes. Gideon of the Trials is legendary and it's a creature.

question: Ari casts [Show and Tell]. Ari chooses to put [Fusion Elemental] onto the battlefield, and Nash chooses [Stasis Snare]. Can Nash target the Fusion Elemental with the Stasis Snare's abliity?
answer_gold: Yes. Both permanents enter the battlefield at the same time. The trigger triggers immediately afterwards, and is then put onto the stack (and a target is chosen) after state-based actions are checked.

question: Nathanael has 8 poison counters and controls a [Lich's Mirror] that they took control of from Ashlynn with [Memnarch]. Ashlynn attacks with a [Corpse Cur]. What happens?
answer_gold: Nathanael is dealt 2 damage and gains 2 poison counters. When state-based actions are checked, Nathanael would lose the game, but instead they shuffle their hand, their graveyard, and all permanents they own into their library, then they draw seven cards and their life total becomes 20. Nathanael still has 10 poison counters and controls Lich's Mirror, so this would happen indefinitely. The game is a draw.

question: Nico controls [Tsabo's Web]. Alisson controls [Witch Engine] that's a land due to their [Conspiracy] naming "Saproling" and [Life and Limb]. Does Witch Engine untap during Alisson's untap step?
answer_gold: No. It has an activated ability that is not a mana ability.

question: Ariella and Niko both control a [Psychic Battle]. Ariella casts [Sideswipe]. What happens?
answer_gold: Niko's trigger will resolve first, then Ariella's. Whoever reveals the card with the highest mana value each time may change the targets of the spell. Neither Psychic Battle will trigger again.

question: Alex controls [Soul-Scar Mage] and casts [Puncturing Blow] targeting Natalia's [Elvish Ranger]. What zone does it move to?
answer_gold: Exile. Puncturing Blow says to exile the creature if it would die this turn. It doesn't matter if it was dealt the damage or not.

question: Nova controls a [Grafdigger's Cage]. Aspen controls a [Trained Orgg] and has an [Undead Minotaur] in their graveyard. Aspen casts [Stormcaller's Boon], cascading into [Living End]. What happens?
answer_gold: Cascade casts the Living End from exile, so Grafdigger's Cage doesn't prevent it from being cast. The Living End will also resolve normally- Grafdigger's Cage only prevents creature cards from entering the battlefield from the graveyard or library. Living End puts them onto the battlefield from exile.

question: Aryanna controls [Gaea's Liege], [Rhonas the Indomitable], and 5 [Forest]s. Nixon controls 1 Forest. Can Aryanna attack with the Gaea's Liege and Rhonas the Indomitable?
answer_gold: Yes. All creatures are declared as attackers at the same time. Checking to see if any restrictions affect a potentially-attacking creature is done before the creature becomes an "attacking creature".

question: Aubrey mutates [Nethroi, Apex of Death] onto [Sliver Construct], and has [Glowstone Recluse] in their graveyard. Can Aubrey choose to return Glowstone Recluse from their graveyard to the battlefield and pay its mutate cost to merge it with Sliver Construct?
answer_gold: No. Mutate functions while the spell is on the stack, allowing Aubrey to pay an alternate cost for it. ([702.140a]) Since Glowstone Recluse is not being cast, Aubrey cannot choose to pay the alternative cost.

question:
Alison controls [Mycosynth Lattice], an [Animate Dead] attached to a [Great-Horn Krushok] that it returned to the battlefield, a [Mizzium Transreliquat] that copied [Sakashima of a Thousand Faces] with its second ability, and a [Southern Elephant] enchanted by a [Deep Freeze].

Alison casts [Eureka], choosing to put [March of the Machines] onto the battlefield. Alison then puts [Sculpting Steel] onto the battlefield, choosing to copy the Mizzium Transreliquat and then choosing to copy the Animate Dead with its new copy ability. They choose to enchant a [Gigantosaurus] in their graveyard. As Eureka continues resolving, they put [Shimatsu the Bloodcloaked] onto the battlefield and sacrifice March of the Machines.

After Sculpting Steel's trigger resolves and returns the Gigantosaurus to the battlefield, Alison activates the ability of the Sculpting Steel to turn it into a copy of Deep Freeze. After that resolves, they casts [Enchantment Alteration] to attach it to the Southern Elephant. What happens?
answer_gold: Sculpting Steel still has the ability "enchant creature put onto the battlefield with Animate Dead". It does not become attached to Southern Elephant.

question: Alfonso has 20 life and has cast a [Channel] previously this turn. Nancy casts [Word of Command], choosing [Squire] from Alfonso's hand. Can Nancy have Alfonso pay 20 life to add 20 colorless mana while casting the Squire, causing Alfonso to lose the game?
answer_gold: Yes. There is no restriction on how much mana Alfonso can add while casting Squire. While Word of Command does prevent Alfonso from activating mana abilities that aren't used to cast Squire, paying 1 life to add {C} due to Channel is not a mana ability, it is a special action.

question: Nathaniel casts [The Wandering Emperor]. Avery then plays [Teferi, Time Raveler]. After it resolves, can Nathaniel activate The Wandering Emperor's abilities this turn?
answer_gold: Yes. Teferi, Time Raveler only prevents casting spells, not activating abilities.

question: Ariel controls a [Mistvein Borderpost]. Nina controls a [Stony Silence]. Can Ariel tap Mistvein Borderpost for mana?
answer_gold: No. Tapping the Mistvein Borderpost for mana is an activated ability.

question: Aaden controls [Nightshade Peddler] paired with an [Ojutai Monument] that's currently a creature. At the end of the turn, when Ojutai Monument stops being a creature, does it remain paired with Nightshade Peddler?
answer_gold: No. Paired creatures only remain paired for as long as they are both creatures.

question: In a Two-Headed Giant game, how much life does each team begin the game with?
Ariel is at 1 life, controls [City of Brass], and has [Angel's Grace] in their hand. Can they tap City of Brass for {W} and then use that {W} to cast Angel's Grace and not lose the game?
answer_gold: Yes. When Ariel taps City of Brass, the trigger to deal 1 damage is put onto the stack.Ariel may cast Angel's Grace before it resolves.

question: Aaliyah and Aarush are on a team in a game of Two-Headed Giant that is just beginning. Aaliyah wants to mulligan. Can Aarush wait to see what Aaliyah draws in their next hand before deciding whether to mulligan?
answer_gold: No. Both team members must mulligan at the same time.

question: Aimee controls [Opalescence] and a [Sakashima the Impostor] that entered the battlefield as a copy of [Psychic Battle]. Aimee casts [Healing Leaves], targeting Nico What happens?
answer_gold: Each time targets are changed when the trigger resolves, Sakashima the Impostor will trigger again. This cycle will continue until the targets aren't changed. (What happens in a tournament will be determined by the shortcut and loop rules in the MTR.)

question: Audrey casts [Nature's Lore] and puts [Dryad Arbor] onto the battlefield. Nico controls [Uphill Battle]. Does the Dryad Arbor enter the battlefield tapped?
answer_gold: No. Putting a land onto the battlefield is not "playing" it.

question: Aubrey controls a [Hostage Taker] that has exiled [Venerated Loxodon] as well as five [Shadowborn Apostle]. Can Aubrey tap their five Shadowborn Apostles to convoke Venerated Loxodon?
answer_gold: No. Convoke allows Aubrey to tap white creatures to pay the white portion of Venerated Loxodon's mana cost, and any color of creature to pay the generic portion. Hostage Taker allows Aubrey to use mana as though it were mana of any color towards Venerated Loxodon, however this doesn't change Venerated Loxodon's actual mana cost nor does if affect how Convoke works.

question: Ada controls [Ethersworn Canonist]. They want to suspend [Shade of Trokair] and then cast [Divination]. Can they?
answer_gold: Yes. Suspending a card is not casting a spell, so it does not count towards Ethersworn Canonist's restriction.

question: Ari casts [Nyxborn Rollicker] for its bestow cost targeting their [Gorilla Warrior]. In response, Nico casts [Finishing Blow] targeting Gorilla Warrior. What happens to Nyxborn Rollicker?
answer_gold: It will enter the battlefield as a creature. If an Aura with bestow has an illegal target as it begins to resolve, it becomes a creature again. ([702.103e])

question: Ashley casts [Covetous Urge] and chooses the [Picklock Prankster] in Nadia's hand. Can Ashley cast the Adventure half?
answer_gold: Yes. Ashley can choose to cast Picklock Prankster's Adventure portion. If they do then the spell will be exiled as it resolves and only Ashley will have permission to cast it. However they cannot use mana of any color to cast the creature half after casting the Adventure half.

question: Anderson controls a 0/1 red Elemental creature token with "At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice this creature and return target card named [Rekindling Phoenix] from your graveyard to the battlefield. It gains haste until end of turn." and has a Rekindling Phoenix in their graveyard. During Anderson's upkeep with the token's trigger on the stack, Nia casts [Surgical Extraction] targeting Rekindling Phoenix and chooses to exile it as Surgical Extraction resolves. What happens when the Elemental token's trigger resolves?
answer_gold: The token's trigger will be removed from the stack when it tries to resolve as all of its targets are now illegal. The token is not sacrificed.

question: Autumn attacks with [Vicious Battlerager] and [Baneclaw Marauder], which Natalie blocks with [Glass Golem] and [Straw Soldiers], respectively. Autumn then activates [Sorrow's Path] targeting Glass Golem and Straw Soldiers. Do Vicious Battlerager and Baneclaw Marauder trigger again?
answer_gold:
Vicious Battlerager triggers again, Baneclaw Marauder does not.

Vicious Battlerager's trigger is looking to see when a creature starts blocking Vicious Battlerager. Sorrow's Path causes Straw Soldiers to start blocking Vicious Battlerager, so it triggers again.

Baneclaw Marauder's trigger is looking to see when Baneclaw Marauder changes from being an unblocked creature to being a blocked creature. Sorrow's Path doesn't cause Baneclaw Marauder to become unblocked, it just removes its blockers and then assigns it a new one. It remains a blocked creature throughout the resolution of the ability, so it does not trigger again.

question: Ainsley controls [Mycosynth Lattice], an [Animate Dead] attached to an [Ancient Carp] that it returned to the battlefield, and a [Mizzium Transreliquat] that is currently a copy of [Copy Enchantment] due to its second ability. Ainsley casts [Sculpting Steel], choosing to copy the Mizzium Transreliquat and then choosing to copy the Animate Dead with its new copy ability as it enters the battlefield. They choose to enchant an [Agent of Stromgald] in their graveyard. After Sculpting Steel's trigger resolves and returns the Agent of Stromgald to the battlefield, Ainsley activates the ability of the Sculpting Steel to turn it into a copy of Ancient Carp. What happens?
answer_gold: This can't happen as described. When Ainsley applies Sculpting Steel's copy effect from Copy Enchantment to copy Animate Dead, it doesn't copy Mizzium Transreliquat's activated ability to become a copy of target artifact.

question: Nickolas has 8 poison counters and controls a [Lich's Mirror]. Alani attacks with a [Blightwidow]. What happens?
answer_gold: Nickolas is dealt 2 damage and gains 2 poison counters. When state-based actions are checked, Nickolas would lose the game, but instead they shuffle their hand, their graveyard, and all permanents they own into their library, then they draw seven cards and their life total becomes 20. Then Nickolas still has 10 poison counters, so they lose the game.

question: Ariel casts [Tarmogoyf] with a land, sorcery, and creature in their graveyard. Can Nathanael counter it with [Stern Scolding]?
answer_gold: No. Tarmogoyf's ability is a characteristic-defining ability, so it functions in all zones. Tarmogoyf's power on the stack is 3.

question: Autumn controls [Kozilek, Butcher of Truth] which has been mutated with [Everquill Phoenix]. Kozilek, Butcher of Truth dies. Will Everquill Phoenix also be shuffled into their deck?
answer_gold:
Yes, Everquill Phoenix will get shuffled into Autumn's library.

When Kozilek, Butcher of Truth dies, both Kozilek, Butcher of Truth and Everquill Phoenix are put into Autumn's graveyard. Kozilek, Butcher of Truth then triggers. All cards in Autumn's graveyard will be shuffled into their library when the trigger resolves.

question: Autumn controls a [Perilous Landscape] and [Omen Machine], whose trigger reveals [Brink of Disaster]. Nikolai controls [Grand Arbiter Augustin IV]. What will happen as the trigger resolves?
answer_gold: Casting a spell without paying its mana cost is an alternative cost, and the additional cost from Grand Arbiter Augustin IV will still apply to it. Autumn is required to cast Brink of Disaster, but if they're unable to pay the costs of the spell, it remains in its previous zone. Autumn is not required to tap the Perilous Landscape for mana.

question: Amari and Adeline are on a Two-Headed Giant team. Do they each draw a card on their first turn?
answer_gold: No.

question: Adelyn controls [Panharmonicon] and [Mycosynth Lattice] and has [Dwarven Trader] and [Staunch Shieldmate] in their graveyard. They cast [Animate Dead] targeting Dwarven Trader. What happens as it enters the battlefield?
answer_gold: Animate Dead enters the battlefield attached to Dwarven Trader and triggers twice. The first trigger will return Dwarven Trader to the battlefield. The second trigger just does the same things again, so it has no relevant result.

question: Armani controls a [Gaea's Liege] and 3 [Canopy Vista]s. Nico controls a [Reverence] and 1 Canopy Vista. Can Armani attack with the Gaea's Liege?
answer_gold: Yes. Checking to see if any restrictions affect a potentially-attacking creature is done before the creature becomes an "attacking creature".

question: Alex controls [Karametra, God of Harvests], and then casts [Opalescence]. Their devotion to white is 2. Is Karametra, God of Harvests a creature? If so, what is its power and toughness?
answer_gold:
Karametra, God of Harvests is a creature with power and toughness equal to its mana value.

In the type layer, there are 2 effects that impact Karametra, God of Harvests's type. They are applied in timestamp order, so first Karametra, God of Harvests's effect causes Karametra, God of Harvests to not be a creature, then Opalescence's ability causes Karametra, God of Harvests to become a creature.

In the power/toughness setting layer, Opalescence's effect sets Karametra, God of Harvests's power and toughness equal to its mana value.

question: Analia is at 1 life, controls [Scabland], and has [Angel's Grace] in their hand. Can they cast Angel's Grace with Scabland without losing the game?
answer_gold: No. Being dealt 1 damage is part of the effect of the ability to tap for {W}. It happens right after the mana is added, before Analia receives priority. Even if they tap Scabland while casting Angel's Grace, they'll lose the game before Angel's Grace resolves.

question: Ashton controls [Mycosynth Lattice], an [Animate Dead] attached to a [Wu Infantry] that it returned to the battlefield, a [Mizzium Transreliquat] that copied [Sakashima of a Thousand Faces] with its second ability, and a [Hyena Pack] enchanted by a [Caught in the Brights]. Ashton casts [Copy Artifact], choosing to copy the Mizzium Transreliquat and then choosing to copy the Animate Dead with its new copy ability as it enters the battlefield. They choose to enchant an [Obsianus Golem] in their graveyard. After Copy Artifact's trigger resolves and returns the Obsianus Golem to the battlefield, Ashton activates the ability of the Copy Artifact to turn it into a copy of Caught in the Brights. After that resolves, they casts [Enchantment Alteration] to attach it to the Hyena Pack. What happens?
answer_gold: This can't happen as described. Sakashima of a Thousand Faces can only copy creatures, not enchantments.

question: Alex and Neriah are beginning a two-player game of commander. Alex decides to mulligan and then keeps that hand. How many cards do they have to put on the bottom of their library?
answer_gold: 1. Players only get a "free mulligan" in multiplayer games.

question: Alex has to choose a card name for [Voidstone Gargoyle]. Can they choose [Spires of Orazca]?
answer_gold: No. The back face is a land, so its name cannot be chosen as it's not the name of a nonland card.

question: Ariel attacks with [Wildfire Eternal], which isn't blocked. As the trigger resolves, can they choose to suspend [Charnel Serenade]?
answer_gold:
Yes. The suspend special action can be taken whenever Charnel Serenade could be cast from Ariel's hand. Normally that's only when Ariel has priority on their turn with an empty stack, but in this case the effect of Wildfire Eternal is letting that happen while the ability resolves.

(They still have to pay the suspend cost, and afterwards they can choose to cast a different spell from hand without paying its mana cost.)

question: Aubrey casts [Fiery Confluence], choosing the first mode twice and targeting Aubrey's [Sliver Construct] with the third mode. In response, Nathaniel sacrifices their [Pteron Ghost] to regenerate the Sliver Construct. Does the Sliver Construct die?
answer_gold: No. The Fiery Confluence's instructions are carried out in the order that they are written. First it deals 2 damage to the Sliver Construct. (It doesn't die at this point because creatures only die due to lethal damage when state-based actions are checked, which is after spells finish resolving.) Then when Fiery Confluence attempts to destroy the Sliver Construct, it is regenerated, which removes all damage that's marked on it. When state-based actions are checked after the spell resolves, nothing happens.

question: Avery casts [Verdant Command], with both modes targeting Nataly. Will they be able to copy it with [Zevlor, Elturel Exile]?
answer_gold: Yes. When the game checks to see if a spell targets a single permanent or player, it doesn't care how many times that object was targeted, only that it was the only object the spell targeted.

question: Ainsley, Brynn, and Camren started playing a multiplayer game. Camren lost the game, and then Ainsley restarted the game with [Karn Liberated]. Will Camren be in the restarted game?
answer_gold: No. Only the players in the game when it was restarted will be in the restarted game.

question: Anthony casts [Verdant Touch], turning their [Wastes] into a creature. They then cast [Time and Tide], phasing it out. If they cast Time and Tide again on the same turn, will it phase back in?
answer_gold: No. Continuous effects can't effect phased-out permanents, so it's not a creature while phased out.

question: Alivia is at 1 life, controls [Mana Confluence], and has [Angel's Grace] in their hand. Can they tap Mana Confluence for {W} and use that {W} to cast Angel's Grace and not lose the game?
answer_gold: No. Losing 1 life is a cost to activate the ability, it happens before the {W} is added. Alivia could cast Angel's Grace, but would lose the game before it resolves.

question: Adelynn casts [Tortoise Formation]. Afterwards they cast [Rotted Hulk]. Will Rotted Hulk gain shroud until end of turn?
answer_gold: No. The continuous effect generated Tortoise Formation's first triggered ability will only affect the set of objects that were on the battlefield at the time the effect began to apply. Since Rotted Hulk entered the battlefield after the ability resolved, it will not gain shroud.
