question: Ainsley and Natasha are starting a two-player game. Ainsley decides to keep their hand of 7 cards. Natasha decides to mulligan. Can Ainsley now decide to mulligan?
answer_gold: No.

question: Aldo controls [Bubble Matrix] and [Aegar, the Freezing Flame], Nico controls [Toralf, God of Fury]. Aldo casts [Ultimate Magic: Meteor]. What happens?
answer_gold: Nothing. Bubble Matrix's replacement effect prevents the damage Ultimate Magic: Meteor would deal, and so neither of the triggered abilities will happen, because no excess damage is being dealt.

question: Avery attacks Nelson with [Reckless Scholar] and [Kavaron Turbodrone]. Nelson blocks one of Avery's attackers with [Phyrexian Vindicator]. If both players are at 2 life, what happens next?
answer_gold: Because the damage dealing effect on Phyrexian Vindicator is written as the effect of a triggered ability, it won't take place until the ability has been put onto the stack and allowed to resolve. This means that, after combat damage is dealt, only Nelson will be at 0 life the next time a player would receive priority, so they will lose the game and Avery will win before the triggered ability from Phyrexian Vindicator is ever put onto the stack.

question: Alex controls [Isshin, Two Heavens as One] and [Trynn, Champion of Freedom]. If they attack during their turn, how many Soldier tokens will they get?
answer_gold: One. Isshin, Two Heavens as One refers to abilities that trigger when a creature is declared as an attacker. Trynn, Champion of Freedom's ability is a trigger that looks for information about the game that happens to relate to attackers, however unfortunately it won't qualify for Isshin, Two Heavens as One's replacement effect.

question: Ashton activates [Knight of the Reliquary] and puts [Dryad Arbor] onto the battlefield as its ability resolves. Nico controls [Uphill Battle]. Does the Dryad Arbor enter the battlefield tapped?
answer_gold: No. Putting a land onto the battlefield is not "playing" it.

question: Adam controls [Ledger Shredder] and casts their second spell. In response to the connive trigger, Neriah casts [Slip Out the Back] targeting Ledger Shredder. If Adam discards a nonland card, how many +1/+1 counters will Ledger Shredder get?
answer_gold: One. It gets a counter from Slip Out the Back, but not from connive.

question: Alexander casts [Fiery Confluence], choosing the third mode 3 times, targeting Alexander's [Kaslem's Strider] all 3 times. In response, Nora sacrifices their [Herbal Poultice] to activate its ability, targeting the Kaslem's Strider. Does the Kaslem's Strider die?
answer_gold: Yes. If a single mode is chosen multiple times, the individual instances of that mode are carried out sequentially as the spell resolves. The regeneration shield will replace the first instance of destruction, but won't stop the next one.

question: Ariel attacks with [Stoneforge Mystic] that's equipped with [Colossus Hammer]. Nathaniel blocks with [Priest of Ancient Lore]. After combat, Ariel equips Colossus Hammer to another creature. Does Stoneforge Mystic die?
answer_gold: Yes. Damage remains marked on the creature until the end of the turn, so as soon as it has only two toughness, it's destroyed as a state-based action.

question: Aydan has searched their library this turn with [Aang's Journey]. During their end step, Nathaly casts [Mission Briefing]. Can they use it to cast [Archive Trap] from their graveyard for free?
answer_gold: Yes. Mission Briefing allows Nathaly to cast Archive Trap from their graveyard, without any other restrictions on how it's cast. Nathaly can choose to pay the alternative cost of {0}.

question: Arjun casts [Dress Down], and in response Nico activates [Reflection of Kiki-Jiki]. Does the token get sacrificed?
answer_gold: Yes. Sacrificing the token isn't an ability of the token, it's a delayed trigger set up by the resolution of Reflection of Kiki-Jiki's activated ability.

question: Noah controls [Solitary Confinement]. Avery attacks with [Vault Guardsman] and casts [Skullcrack] targeting themselves. Does Noah lose life?
answer_gold: Yes. Skullcrack says that damage can't be prevented, so Solitary Confinement doesn't prevent it.

question: Allan controls [City of Traitors], and Nala casts [Crop Rotation] finding [Birnin Zana Plaza]. Can Nala choose to have the Birnin Zana Plaza enter under Allan's control, making them sacrifice City of Traitors?
answer_gold: No. If a player is instructed to put something onto the battlefield, it enters under their control. And City of Traitors only triggers when Allan takes the turn-based action of playing a land, not just having one enter the battlefield under their control.

question: Nico controls [Orcish Bowmasters] and Anna casts [Day's Undoing]. Does Orcish Bowmasters trigger?
answer_gold: Yes, but the triggers cease to exist when the turn ends, and are never put onto the stack.

question: Anya casts their commander, [Akroma, Angel of Fury], using its morph ability. They tap [Path of Ancestry] for 1 mana to pay its cost. Will they get to scry?
answer_gold: No. To cast a creature using its morph ability, the card is first turned face down before being put on the stack and has no subtypes, so by the time Anya pays its cost, it will have no creature types.

question: Alfonso attacks with [Isshin, Two Heavens as One]. In their second main phase, they cast [Nightsquad Commando]. How many times will Nightsquad Commando's ability trigger?
answer_gold: Once. The trigger event for Nightsquad Commando is it entering the battlefield, not a creature attacking, so Isshin, Two Heavens as One's ability will not cause it to trigger an additional time.

question: Addison controls [Vorinclex, Monstrous Raider] and two [Flensermite]s. If Addison deals combat damage with both Flensermites, how many poison counters will Natasha get?
answer_gold: Two damage will be dealt to Natasha and they will get four poison counters. ([702.164c], [702.90b])

question: Angelique attacks with [Kytheon, Hero of Akros] and [Kaalia of the Vast], putting [Masked Vandal] onto the battlefield tapped and attacking with Kaalia of the Vast's triggered ability. Will Kytheon, Hero of Akros transform into [Gideon, Battle-Forged] at end of combat?
answer_gold: No. A creature that was put onto the battlefield tapped and attacking is not considered to have attacked for the purpose of determining if an ability triggers.

question: Autumn animates [Inkmoth Nexus] and attacks with it. Nayeli then flashes in [Dress Down]. What does Inkmoth Nexus look like?
answer_gold: It's a 1/1 Blinkmoth Land Artifact Creature with no abilities. The ability-changing effects are applied in the order they were created, so since Dress Down is more recent, it's applied last.

question: Antoine attacks with a Germ token equipped with [Kaldra Compleat]. Noor blocks with [Brazen Freebooter]. After combat, does Brazen Freebooter end up in the graveyard or exile?
answer_gold: The graveyard. Brazen Freebooter is destroyed when state-based actions are checked right after combat damage has been dealt. Then Kaldra Compleat's trigger is put onto the stack, and when it resolves, it does nothing.

question: Ace casts [Hour of Promise], finding [Vesuva] and [Accursed Duneyard]. Can Vesuva copy Accursed Duneyard?
answer_gold: No. The choice of what Vesuva can copy is made before it enters the battlefield, and Accursed Duneyard isn't on the battlefield yet at that time.

question: Nataly controls [Urza's Saga] with 2 lore counters on it. Alex casts [Magus of the Moon]. What does Urza's Saga look like?
answer_gold: It's an Enchantment Land - Mountain Saga with "{T} add {R}." and no other abilities. Since Urza's Saga no longer has any chapter abilities, it will remain at 2 lore counters and will not receive any more in future turns. It is not sacrificed.

question: Aubrey controls [Leonin Shikari] and [Mjölnir, Storm Hammer] attached to [Urbis Protector]. They attack with Urbis Protector and [The Ninth Doctor]. After blockers have been declared, can Aubrey reequip Mjölnir, Storm Hammer to The Ninth Doctor?
answer_gold: Yes. Players receive priority in the declare blockers step to cast spells and activate abilities, and Leonin Shikari allows them to activate equip abilities any time they have priority.

question: Can Alex reveal [Jegantha, the Wellspring] as their companion if their deck contains [Dead // Gone]? How about [Fire // Ice]?
answer_gold: No to both. The mana cost of a split card in the deck is the combined mana cost of both halves, so Dead // Gone's mana cost is {R}{2}{R} and Fire // Ice's is {1}{R}{1}{U}.

question: Can Alex attach [Cranial Plating] at instant speed?
answer_gold: Yes, if they pay {B}{B}. Equip is sorcery speed, but Cranial Plating's second ability is a regular activated ability, which can be activated any time Alex has priority.

question: Andres controls two [Ruin Crab]s and plays a land. Can they cast [Extirpate] targeting something in the first three cards milled, before the next three are milled?
answer_gold: Yes. Ruin Crab has a triggered ability, which each resolve one at a time. Players may cast spells in between.

question: Alonzo attacks with a [Kraken Hatchling] that is equipped with [Barrow-Blade], and Nia blocks with an [Oreskos Swiftclaw] enchanted with [Greel's Caress]. After Barrow-Blade's triggered ability resolves, what are the power and toughness of Oreskos Swiftclaw?
answer_gold: 0/1. Oreskos Swiftclaw loses all abilities given by Greel's Caress, but the power-changing effect is still applied since it is part of Greel's Caress's ability.

question: Aaron equips [Skullclamp] onto [Champion of the Flame]. Does Champion of the Flame die?
answer_gold: No, Champion of the Flame will be a 4/2 and not die. All continuous effects are applied instantly before state based actions are checked.

question: Aliza sacrifices [Lembas] to gain life. Can Nasir exile it in response with [Cling to Dust]?
answer_gold: Yes. That ability is a triggered ability which goes onto the stack and can be responded to.

question: Alex plays [Shrapnel Slinger] while controlling [Icingdeath, Frost Tyrant], and Nala doesn't control any artifacts. Can Alex still sacrifice Icingdeath, Frost Tyrant?
answer_gold: Yes. Shrapnel Slinger has one trigger that lets Alex sacrifice a creature, and a reflexive trigger that destroys an artifact. If the reflexive trigger doesn't have a target, it doesn't go on the stack, but the original trigger doesn't require a target.

question: Nina controls [Sanctifier en-Vec]. Aspen casts [Fury], paying its evoke cost. In response to the sacrifice trigger, they cast [Feign Death]. What happens to Fury?
answer_gold: Fury is exiled and will not return to the battlefield. Sanctifier en-Vec's replacement effect will cause Fury to be exiled instead of dying. Since Fury didn't die, the triggered ability granted to it by Feign Death won't trigger.

question: Arian controls [Spiteful Visions] and draws [Redress Fate] for turn. Can they see what they're drawing from Spiteful Visions before deciding whether to cast Redress Fate for miracle?
answer_gold: Yes. Arian must reveal Redress Fate as they draw it, but they don't cast it right away; revealing it puts a trigger onto the stack to cast it later. Spiteful Visions's trigger is put onto the stack at the same time, so Arian can choose which one resolves first. If they don't want to cast Redress Fate when the miracle trigger resolves, they don't have to.

question: Alondra controls an [Invasion of Ixalan] with 1 defense counter on it. They attack it with [Rankle and Torbran]. If they choose the second mode for Rankle and Torbran's triggered ability, could they sacrifice Invasion of Ixalan's back face [Belligerent Regisaur] to it?
answer_gold: Yes. When Rankle and Torbran attacks Invasion of Ixalan and removes the last defense counter from it, both Invasion of Ixalan and Rankle and Torbran's abilities will trigger. Alondra will get to choose the order in which the abilities go on the stack, so they could put Rankle and Torbran's triggered ability on the stack first with Invasion of Ixalan's triggered ability on top. Invasion of Ixalan's triggered ability will resolve first, so Invasion of Ixalan will be exiled and Alondra could choose to cast it transformed. When Rankle and Torbran's triggered ability resolves, Belligerent Regisaur will have resolved and be on the battlefield, so Alondra could choose to sacrifice it.

question: Noah activates [Thespian's Stage] targeting a [Dark Depths] with ten ice counters on it. What happens?
answer_gold: Thespian's Stage becomes a copy of Dark Depths. Thespian's Stage has no ice counters on it, so its state trigger triggers, but doesn't go on the stack yet. Then state-based actions are checked and Noah has to put either Dark Depths or Thespian's Stage into their graveyard. Then Thespian's Stage's trigger goes on the stack, and if Thespian's Stage is still on the battlefield during the resolution of the trigger, Noah sacrifices it and creates a 20/20 Marit Lage token.

question: Addison has 6 cards in their graveyard and controls [Triton Shorethief] that's enchanted by [Disturbing Conversion]. They cast [Tandem Takedown] targeting Triton Shorethief and Neil's [Coral Merfolk]. How much damage is dealt to Coral Merfolk?
answer_gold: Triton Shorethief's power is -5. 0 damage is dealt to Coral Merfolk. It is possible for a creature's power to be less than zero, but if a calculation yields a negative number, 0 is used instead.

question: Niko controls [Metallurgeon] and [Ornithopter of Paradise]. Avery casts [Prismari Command], choosing the "deal 2 damage" and "destroy target artifact" modes, targeting Ornithopter of Paradise with both. In response, Niko activates Metallurgeon's ability targeting Ornithopter of Paradise. What happens?
answer_gold: Ornithopter of Paradise will end up tapped and have no damage marked on it. Metallurgeon's ability will resolve first, regenerating Ornithopter of Paradise. When Prismari Command resolves, the game carries out the instructions in the order written. First, Prismari Command deals 2 damage to Ornithopter of Paradise. The replacement effect generated by the regeneration ability will not apply yet, as even though Ornithopter of Paradise has been dealt lethal damage, it would only be destroyed when state-based actions are checked, and state-based actions are checked when a player would get priority. Next Prismari Command tries to destroy Ornithopter of Paradise and the replacement effect applies, replacing the destruction event with Ornithopter of Paradise being tapped and having all damaged marked on it removed. Lastly Prismari Command finishes resolving and leaves the stack and state-based actions are checked. Since Ornithopter of Paradise no longer has any damage marked on it, it will not be die.

question: Nico controls [Rest in Peace]. Ally casts [Fetch Quest]. What happens?
answer_gold: Ally can put a permanent from among the milled cards into their hand from exile. The game doesn't care where the cards went after they were milled only that Ally attempted to put them from their library into their graveyard.

question: Abraham controls [Old Man Willow] and 4 lands. If they cast [Entish Restoration], how many lands can they find?
answer_gold: Only 2. As Entish Restoration begins to resolve, Old Man Willow's power is only 3. Its power only goes above four after Abraham has completed the action of searching for lands and put them onto the battlefield.

question: Aubrey casts [Necromentia] while Nickolas controls [Leyline of Sanctity]. What happens as it resolves?
answer_gold: This can't happen as described. There are no legal targets for Necromentia, so Aubrey cannot cast it.

question: Ainsley controls [Kaervek, the Spiteful] and casts [White Sun's Twilight] with X=5. What happens?
answer_gold: Kaervek, the Spiteful is destroyed and Ainsley controls five 1/1 Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens. Kaervek, the Spiteful is destroyed and the Mites are created during the resolution of White Sun's Twilight. A creature dying due to having 0 toughness is a state-based action, and state-based actions are checked whenever a player would get priority. Players do not get priority during the resolution of a spell, so by the time state-based actions are checked, Kaervek, the Spiteful is no longer on the battlefield.

question: Arabella casts [Tandem Takedown], granting their two [Zombie Goliath] +1/+0. Can each Zombie Goliath deal damage to a different one of Nickolas's creatures?
answer_gold: No. Tandem Takedown specifies that they each deal damage to another target creature, meaning one single other creature.

question: Ainsley's [Treasure Keeper] dies, and they reveal [Valki, God of Lies] with its trigger. Can Ainsley cast [Tibalt, Cosmic Impostor]?
answer_gold: Yes. Treasure Keeper only requires that the revealed card has a mana value of three or less while it's in the library, which it does. When Ainsley goes to cast it, Treasure Keeper doesn't place any restrictions on its mana value at that point, and they can choose which side they'd like to cast.

question: Alex attacks with [Monastery Swiftspear]. Before combat damage is dealt, they cast [Lightning Bolt] and Nathan counters it with [Counterspell]. Does Monastery Swiftspear deal 1 damage or two?
answer_gold: 2. Casting a spell is a completely separate action from it resolving, and countering a spell doesn't go back in time and un-cast it.

question: Noe controls [Roiling Vortex], and Autumn casts [Chrome Mox]. Does Roiling Vortex deal them 5 damage?
answer_gold: Yes. Chrome Mox costs {0}, which means Autumn doesn't spend any mana to cast it.

question: Can [Blitz Automaton] be part of a [Trelasarra, Moon Dancer] commander deck?
answer_gold: No. The color identity of Blitz Automaton is red, and cannot be put in a nonred commander deck.

question: Allan attacks with [Raiyuu, Storm's Edge], then attacks with it again. Can they activate [Minas Tirith]'s last ability?
answer_gold: No. Raiyuu, Storm's Edge is only one creature, regardless of how many times it attacked.

question: Nico activates [Thespian's Stage] targeting [Dark Depths]. In response, Austin targets Dark Depths with [Ghost Quarter]s. What happens?
answer_gold: Thespian's Stage's ability has no legal targets, so it doesn't resolve. Thespian's Stage doesn't become a copy of Dark Depths.

question: Nico controls [Wastes] and Amber plays [Magus of the Moon]. What color(s) of mana can Wastes tap for?
answer_gold: Only {C}. Wastes is a basic land, so it's not affected by Magus of the Moon.

question: Who would win: Deadpool vs. Spider-Man?
answer_gold: It would be a tie, with a bit of overkill on Spider Man. Deadpool, Trading Card is a 5/3 whereas Superior Spider-Man is only a 3/3.

question: Aislinn activates [The Wandering Emperor]'s [-2] ability, targeting Nico's [Cateran Overlord]. Nico sacrifices the Cateran Overlord in response. Does Aislinn gain 2 life?
answer_gold: No. If a targeted abilities targets have all become illegal when it tries to resolve, it doesn't resolve at all.

question: At the beginning of the game, Alex announced [Kaheera, the Orphanguard] as their companion. During the game, Alex cast [Carrion Grub] from their sideboard with [Wish]. Later, Alex restarts the game with [Karn Liberated]. What happens?
answer_gold: Carrion Grub will be shuffled into Alex's library along with the rest of the cards in the game. Because Carrion Grub violates Kaheera, the Orphanguard's companion restriction, Alex can't announce it as their companion for the restarted game.

question: In a game of Two-Headed Giant, Ashley activates the last loyalty ability of [Chandra, Hope's Beacon] with X=1. Could they target both Nick and Noemi?
answer_gold: Yes. Each member of a team is a separate player and is targeted independently.

question: Nico activates [Thespian's Stage] targeting [Dark Depths]. Alden lets that resolve, then activates [Memorial to War] targeting Thespian's Stage. What happens?
answer_gold: Dark Depths is legendary, so Nico had to choose one to put into the graveyard before Alden activated Memorial to War. Assuming they chose to keep the Thespian's Stage, it will be destroyed. When its trigger resolves, it can't be sacrificed, so no Marit Lage is created.

question: Ainsley deals combat damage to [Invasion of Segovia], removing its last defense counter. Can they use [Stifle] to prevent it from turning into [Caetus, Sea Tyrant of Segovia]? If so, what happens to it?
answer_gold: Yes, they can Stifle the trigger to exile it and return it transformed. Invasion of Segovia will be put into the graveyard as a state-based action.

question: If Aaden casts [Chord of Calling] with X=2 by tapping 5 green creatures, does it trigger Nathaly's [Roiling Vortex]?
answer_gold: Yes. No mana was spent to cast Chord of Calling.

question: Amelie controls [Nissa, Resurgent Animist] and [Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines]. Amelie plays a land, then casts [Urban Evolution] and plays another land. How many Elves/Elementals will they get to look for in total?
answer_gold: Just one. Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines makes Nissa, Resurgent Animist trigger a total of four times, but only one of those triggers can be the second one.

question: Does Nasir have a chance to cast [Surgical Extraction] after Addison has drawn for turn but before they have a chance to cast a sorcery?
answer_gold: Yes. Players receive priority in the draw step after a card has been drawn.

question: Angelo casts [Deny Reality], cascading into [Living End]. Living End brings back Angelo's [God-Eternal Rhonas] and Nico's [The Earth King]. Which enters-the-battlefield trigger resolves first?
answer_gold: The Earth King's. Triggers are put onto the stack in turn order, and the stack resolves from the top down, so the non-active player's triggers resolve first.

question: Abril casts [Blot Out] targeting Nikolas. In response, Nikolas casts [Veil of Summer]. Abril responds with their own Veil of Summer. What happens?
answer_gold:
Abril's Veil of Summer resolves first. Then Nikolas's resolves and draws them a card. Then Blot Out tries to resolve and fails, since it has an illegal target.

(Abril's Veil of Summer didn't accomplish anything useful.)

question: Abril controls [Painter's Servant], naming "blue". Can they exile [Archangel] to cast [Misdirection]?
answer_gold: Yes. Archangel is blue due to Painter's Servant.

question: Alonso attacks with [Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer] and exiles [Rift Bolt]. Can Alonso suspend it? If so, what happens?
answer_gold: Alonso cannot suspend it. A card can only be suspended from the hand, not from exile.

question: On Neymar's last turn, they cast [The One Ring]. On Aubrey's turn, they cast [Stomp], killing Neymar's [Yavimaya Sapherd], then attack with [_____ Goblin]. Does Neymar lose any life?
answer_gold: Yes. Protection prevents damage, and Stomp says that damage can't be prevented, so it isn't.

question: In their first main phase, Alexandra activates [Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance] to create two tokens, and Nehemiah responds with [Dress Down]. What happens with the tokens?
answer_gold:
They're created as 1/1s and then gain haste. They'll be able to attack this turn.

"Haste" is not a part of the token's printed text because Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance says they "gain" haste after having already been created. It's a separate continuous effect, which is applied in timestamp order with Dress Down. Dress Down has the earlier timestamp, so it's applied first, removing all abilities, and then the tokens gain haste.

question: Aubrey controls a [Rotting Mastodon] that, due to [Infinite Reflection], is currently a copy of an [Illusion] token created by [Meloku the Clouded Mirror]. Aubrey casts [Mask of the Mimic], targeting the Rotting Mastodon. Can Aubrey find the Illusion half of the split card [Illusion // Reality]? If so, what happens?
answer_gold: They cannot find it. The token's name is "Illusion Token", which does not have the same name as Illusion.

question: Alessandra controls [Sheoldred, the Apocalypse]. During their main phase, they cast [Day's Undoing]. How much life does each player gain/lose?
answer_gold: None. The players first draw seven cards each, triggering Sheoldred, the Apocalypse fourteen times. Then Alessandra ends the turn, which nullifies those triggers before they're even put onto the stack.

question: Avery has 1 life and controls [Mana Confluence]. Can they cast [Angel's Grace] without losing the game? If so, what will their resulting life total be?
answer_gold: No, Avery would lose the game. Mana Confluence pays the life as a cost to activate the ability. If Avery taps Mana Confluence before casting Angel's Grace, they'll die before they can begin to cast Angel's Grace. If they begin casting Angel's Grace and activate Mana Confluence while casting the spell, they'll lose the game when state-based actions are checked after they're done casting Angel's Grace, before it resolves.

question: Alyssa controls [Sylvan Library] and has three [Golgari Brownscale]s in their graveyard. In their draw step, can they choose to dredge all three? If so, do they have to put any back on top of the library and/or pay any life?
answer_gold:
Alyssa can dredge all three, and won't have to put any back or pay any life.

The instructions on Sylvan Library are followed in order. Alyssa first chooses whether they want to draw two cards, and they're allowed to choose the affirmative even if they're planning to replace the card draws with dredge.

After dredging, Alyssa is instructed to choose two cards in their hand that were drawn this turn. There are no cards in Alyssa's hand that were drawn this turn, so Alyssa can't do that. The "for each" clause then does nothing, because it's referring to 0 cards. (Just like how Killing Wave doesn't make a player pay life if they don't control any creatures.)

question: Ariel casts [Demonlord Belzenlok]. If the first nonland card to revealed is [Revival // Revenge], does Ariel repeat the process?
answer_gold: Yes. Split cards have the mana value of both halves combined while in the library.

question: Anaya controls only two [Lotus Petal]. Can they cast [Emry, Lurker of the Loch]?
answer_gold: Yes. The cost to cast a spell is determined first, then Anaya has a chance to activate mana abilities, at which point they can sacrifice the Lotus Petals without affecting Emry, Lurker of the Loch's cost.

question: Autumn's [Treasure Keeper] dies, and they reveal [Valki, God of Lies]. Can they cast [Tibalt, Cosmic Impostor]?
answer_gold: Yes. Treasure Keeper only requires that the revealed card has a mana value of three or less. When Autumn goes to cast it, Treasure Keeper doesn't place any restrictions on its mana value at that point, and they can choose which side they'd like to cast.

question: It is currently day and Adonis controls [Lazotep Convert] (the back face of [Invasion of Amonkhet]), which is a copy of [Kessig Naturalist]. What happens if it becomes night?
answer_gold: Lazotep Convert will be a copy of Kessig Naturalist. As it becomes night, it will not transform and remain a copy of Kessig Naturalist. Lazotep Convert will only copy the front face of Kessig Naturalist and does not copy its status. When it becomes night, it will not transform because a daybound permanent will only transform as it becomes night if it is front face up. ([702.145b])

question: Natalee controls [Giant Solifuge]. Can Avery cast [Geth's Verdict]? If so, what happens?
answer_gold: Yes, Natalee will have to sacrifice Giant Solifuge. Geth's Verdict only targets Natalee, not Giant Solifuge.

question: Audrina controls [Murktide Regent]. Nickolas casts [Extirpate], exiling two [Weight of Spires] from Audrina's graveyard. Does Murktide Regent trigger?
answer_gold: Yes. Two Instant cards have left Audrina's graveyard.

question: Aubree casts [Blood Moon]. Nikolas activates [Inkmoth Nexus]'s ability in response. What will Inkmoth Nexus look like after everything resolves? What will it look like next turn?
answer_gold: Inkmoth Nexus will be a 1/1 Artifact Land Creature - Mountain Blinkmoth with flying, infect, {T}: Add {R}, and no other abilities. Next turn it will be a Land - Mountain with {T}: Add {R} and no other abilities. Setting a land's subtype to a basic land type causes it to lose all other land types, as well as all abilities granted by its rules text, and gain the appropriate mana ability from its new land type. It will still keep abilities granted to it by other effects as those are gained in layer 6 while Blood Moon's type-changing effect applies in layer 4, so it will still have flying and infect. Removing the activated ability from Inkmoth Nexus does not affect the instance of the ability that has already resolved, so the effect will end as normal and Inkmoth Nexus will not be a creature next turn.

question: Ari controls [Durkwood Boars] and an [Unlicensed Hearse] which has exiled 2 cards. Nixon casts [Fury Charm], destroying Unlicensed Hearse. Ari casts another Unlicensed Hearse and taps Durkwood Boars to crew it. What are its power and toughness?
answer_gold: 0/0. When text on an object refers to itself by name, it is only referring to that specific object, and not other objects with the same name. The second copy of Unlicensed Hearse has not exiled any cards, so it will be 0/0 while crewed. Since it has 0 toughness, it will die as a state-based action.

question: Niko controls [Urza's Saga] on chapter 2. Ainsley casts [Magus of the Moon]. What happens to Urza's Saga?
answer_gold:
It becomes an Enchantment Land - Saga Mountain with an ability to tap for {R}, an ability to tap for {1}, an ability to create Constructs, and no other abilities.

Since it no longer has any chapter abilities, it will remain at 2 lore counters and will not receive any more in future turns. It is not sacrificed.

question: Nylah controls [Thalia, Guardian of Thraben]. If Ali wants to exile it, how much mana do they need to pay for [Prismatic Ending]?
answer_gold: 2 mana, of two different colors. When Ali casts Prismatic Ending they choose what they want the value of {X} to be, and then afterwards Thalia, Guardian of Thraben adds an additional cost to the spell. When Prismatic Ending begins resolving, it only cares what colors of mana were spent to cast it, not what the initial value of {X} was.

question: Ashlynn controls [Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines] and casts [Dress Down]. How many cards do they draw?
answer_gold: One. Dress Down's effect applies as soon as it enters the battlefield, and it's in effect when determining if its ability triggers. Since Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines has lost its abilities, its replacement effect doesn't apply and Dress Down's ability only triggers once.

question: Aspen controls [Thundering Tanadon] equipped with [Barrow-Blade] and attacks. Nikolas blocks with [Talon Trooper]. Which creature loses its abilities?
answer_gold: Talon Trooper. If the intent was for Thundering Tanadon to lose its abilities it would say "equipped creature" rather than "that creature".

question: Augustus controls [Mystic Forge], and Nico controls [Grafdigger's Cage]. Can Augustus still cast spells with Mystic Forge?
answer_gold: No. Grafdigger's Cage says that players can't cast spells from libraries.

question: Aspen cast [Summoner's Pact] last turn and is beginning their upkeep. Do they have a chance to cast [Angel's Grace] before losing the game? What happens if they do?
answer_gold: Summoner's Pact's trigger is put on the stack at the beginning of the upkeep, and Aspen can respond to it with Angel's Grace. When Summoner's Pact's trigger resolves, it does nothing, since Aspen can't lose the game. Aspen will continue playing indefinitely.

question: Nico controls [Ensnaring Bridge] and has 3 cards in hand. Can Aleena deal 4 damage to Nico by attacking with [Servant of Nefarox]?
answer_gold: Yes. Ensnaring Bridge only prevents creatures with power > 3 from being declared as attackers. Exalted triggers after the creature attacks and gives it +1/+1. Nothing would remove it from combat at this point.

question: A player casts [Kayla's Reconstruction] and chooses two copies of [Giada, Font of Hope]. How many counters does each Giada, Font of Hope enter the battlefield with?
answer_gold: None. Giada, Font of Hope has a replacement effect that modifies how creatures enter the battlefield. However this won't apply until Giada, Font of Hope is actually on the battlefield.

question: Avery controls [Frogtosser Banneret]. Will it affect the cost of [Nameless Inversion]?
answer_gold: Yes. Nameless Inversion is a Rogue.

question: Addison reveals [Goremand] with [Emergent Ultimatum]. If they choose to cast it, will they still have to sacrifice a creature?
answer_gold: Yes. Casting a spell without paying its mana cost is an alternative cost. However sacrificing a creature is an additional cost, which is usually paid in addition to the mana cost. In this case, the mana cost has been overwritten with an alternative cost, this won't preclude Addison paying the additional cost.

question: Nico controls [Dress Down], and Aya activates [Inkmoth Nexus]. What does it look like?
answer_gold: It's a 1/1 Blinkmoth Land Artifact Creature with flying and infect, but no ability to tap for mana. The ability-changing effects are applied in the order they were created, so since Inkmoth Nexus's is more recent, it's applied last.

question: Arturo controls [Sanctum of Ugin]. For what values of X, if any, can they cast [Omarthis, Ghostfire Initiate] in order to trigger Sanctum of Ugin?
answer_gold: Any X >= 4. The mana value of a spell takes into account the value of {X} in its mana cost, and 4 + 4 > 7.

question: Ariella casts [Chrome Mox], exiling [Fugitive Droid]. Ariella then uses [Karn, the Great Creator] to put Fugitive Droid into their had. What types of mana can Chrome Mox tap for?
answer_gold: This can't happen as described. Chrome Mox can't exile an artifact, even if it's colored.

question: Armando activates [Baba Lysaga, Night Witch], sacrificing [The Reaver Cleaver], a Food token created by [The Fourth Doctor], and [Snow-Covered Forest]. Does Armando get to gain 3 life and draw three cards?
answer_gold: No. "Legendary", "basic", and "snow" are supertypes, not types. "Equipment", "Food", and "Forest" are subtypes, not types. "Token" is just a kind of object, and is neither a supertype, type, nor subtype. So there were only two card types among the sacrificed permanents: "artifact" and "land".

question: Ainsley casts [Consign to Memory], replicating it twice. Nathaly controls [Chalice of the Void] with 1 charge counter. What happens?
answer_gold: The original Consign to Memory is countered, the two copies resolve as normal. Replicate and Chalice of the Void both trigger when the spell is cast. Since the Chalice of the Void trigger is controlled by the player last in turn order, it will resolve first, countering Consign to Memory. Then Consign to Memory's trigger resolves and creates two copies of Consign to Memory. The copies are not cast, so they don't trigger Chalice of the Void.

question: Avery has no cards left in their library. Nala has 1 life. Avery controls [Samwise the Stouthearted], which is their ring-bearer. Avery has been tempted by the ring twice previously. If Avery attacks Nala, who wins the game?
answer_gold: Nala wins. When Samwise the Stouthearted attacks, Avery must draw a card. This causes Avery to lose the game before the combat damage step is reached.

question: Addilynn casts [Day of Judgment]. Nico activates [Ezuri, Renegade Leader], regenerating [Elvish Visionary]. Will Nico draw a card? Does Addilynn have a chance to activate [Relic of Progenitus] to exile Elvish Visionary?
answer_gold: No and no. Regenerate means to replace the creature being destroyed with tapping it, removing it from combat, removing all damage marked on it, and leaving it on the battlefield. It never enters the graveyard nor reenters the battlefield.

question: Adelina's [Fireblade Charger] dies, and Nasir responds with [Thwart the Enemy]. Is the damage prevented?
answer_gold: Unclear. Fireblade Charger is not currently a creature on the battlefield, but the game uses its last known information to determine how the damage is dealt. If Fireblade Charger only applies to objects that are creatures, like how Biomantic Mastery only counts creatures that actually exist on the battlefield, it won't be prevented. But if Fireblade Charger checks the source of damage to see whether it's a creature, it will be able to identify the damage as coming from a creature. The intention is probably the latter, but Wizards has not clarified.

question: Autumn plays [Spymaster's Vault] as their first land, opponent controls [Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth]. Does the it enter the battlefield untapped?
answer_gold: No. When determining how to apply replacement effects for a permanent entering the battlefield, the game takes into account effects that would apply to it on the battlefield and what it would look like on the battlefield, but it doesn't see itself on the battlefield in any way.

question: Averi casts [Fetch Quest], which Noe exiles with [Ertai's Meddling]. What happens when the last counter is removed?
answer_gold: It's put onto the stack as a copy of Fetch Quest. Being cast as an Adventure is a part of its copyable values, so the new Fetch Quest was cast as an adventure. It will be exiled after resolving, and Averi can cast Bramble Familiar.

question: Ariana controls [Painter's Servant] naming "blue." Nico casts [Dress Down]. What color are Painter's Servant and Dress Down?
answer_gold: They will both be blue. Painter's Servant's color-changing effect is applied in layer 5 and Dress Down's ability-removing effect is applied later in layer 6, so Painter's Servant's ability has already been applied to the game state by the time its removed.

question: Ainsley controls [Omnath, Locus of Creation] and [Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines]. They play [Desert of the Indomitable]. What happens?
answer_gold: Omnath, Locus of Creation's ability triggers twice. The first instance of the ability will cause Ainsley to gain 4 life and the second instance will add {R}{G}{U}{W} to their mana pool. Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines will cause the ability to trigger twice since it triggers as the result of a permanent entering the battlefield. Omnath, Locus of Creation's triggered ability has an effect depending on how many times its resolved this turn, so the second instance that resolves will have the second effect.

question: Ariel casts [An Unearthly Child] while Nash controls [Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines]. What happens?
answer_gold: An Unearthly Child will enter the battlefield with one lore counter as normal. Entering the battlefield with a lore counter is not a triggered ability, so Elesh Norn, Mother of Machines's ability will have no effect on it.

question: Axl casts [Deathbringer Liege]? Does it trigger itself?
answer_gold: No. Deathbringer Liege's abilities only function while it's on the battlefield, and right after Deathbringer Liege has been cast, it's on the stack.

question: Annabelle casts [Shaman of the Pack]. In response to its trigger, Nico kills it with [Deathsprout]. How much life does Nico lose?
answer_gold: 0. When Shaman of the Pack's trigger resolves, Annabelle controls no Elves.

question: Can [Lava Spike] deal damage to [Nissa, Worldwaker]?
answer_gold: Yes. Lava Spike targets any player or planeswalker.

question: Alison controls [Stoneforge Mystic] and uses it to put [Hero's Heirloom] onto the battlefield. Can Noel counter it with [Countermand]?
answer_gold: No. Putting an Equipment onto the battlefield with Stoneforge Mystic is an activated ability, not a spell.

question: Aubrie casts [Bring to Light], spending {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, and finds [Valki, God of Lies]. Can they cast [Tibalt, Cosmic Impostor]?
answer_gold: Yes. Valki, God of Lies has the characteristics of its front face while in the library, so it's legal to find with Bring to Light. Bring to Light then gives Aubrie permission to cast the card from exile, with no restrictions on how it's cast, so Aubrie can cast its back face Tibalt, Cosmic Impostor.

question: Agustin controls [Rest in Peace] and targets Naomi's [Dauthi Voidwalker] with [Lightning Bolt]. What happens to each card?
answer_gold:
Agustin chooses whether Lightning Bolt goes to exile with or without a counter.

There are two replacement effects attempting to replace Lightning Bolt going to the graveyard with it going to exile, so its controller gets to choose which to apply.

Then state-based actions are checked and Dauthi Voidwalker is put into exile.

question: Can [Murder] destroy [Severed Legion]?
answer_gold: Yes. Murder targets creatures, and Severed Legion is a creature.

question: Ari sacrifices [Beast Whisperer] to cast [Natural Order]. Does Ari draw a card?
answer_gold: No. Natural Order is not a creature spell. Even if it were, Beast Whisperer isn't on the battlefield at the time when Natural Order becomes "cast".

question: Anthony controls [Elvish Warmaster] and casts [Shaman of the Pack]. How much life does Nico lose?
answer_gold: Anthony chooses either 2 or 3. Both triggers trigger at the same time, so Anthony can choose which one will resolve first. If Shaman of the Pack resolves first, Elvish Warmaster's trigger sees 3 Elves. Otherwise it only sees 2.

question: Anna activates [Wirewood Symbiote] returning [Primal Forcemage] to their hand, can Nehemiah destroy Primal Forcemage in response?
answer_gold: No Nehemiah cannot destroy Primal Forcemage in response. Returning an Elf is part of the cost and will already be in hand when Nehemiah has priority again.

question: Anson attacks with [Wild Beastmaster] and [Stonework Puma]. Nico casts [Lost in a Labyrinth], targeting the Wild Beastmaster. What happens to the Stonework Puma when the Wild Beastmaster trigger resolves?
answer_gold: Wild Beastmaster has a negative power when the trigger resolves, but the game treats it as 0 for the purpose of modifying the power and toughness of Stonework Puma. Stonework Puma gets +0/+0, and nothing happens to it.

question: Alexia controls [Temple Garden] enchanted with [Utopia Sprawl], choosing "red". Nico controls [Damping Sphere]. If Alexia taps it for {G}, how much mana is produced in total?
answer_gold: {G}{R}. Damping Sphere only modifies the amount of mana produced by the land itself. Utopia Sprawl doesn't change how much mana Temple Garden produces, it just has a triggered ability that triggers when Temple Garden is tapped for mana and causes Utopia Sprawl to produce some mana as well.

question: Aden controls [Bringer of the Blue Dawn] and Nico controls [Leovold, Emissary of Trest]. Can Aden draw a card in their upkeep?
answer_gold: No, Aden cannot choose to draw a card on their upkeep. Leovold, Emissary of Trest's static ability prevents Aden from choosing to draw multiple cards.

question: Autumn controls [Teferi, Time Raveler] and Nathalie flashes in [The Wandering Emperor] on Autumn's turn. Can Nathalie activate its abilities this turn?
answer_gold: This can't happen as described. Nathalie cannot cast The Wandering Emperor on Autumn's turn due to Teferi, Time Raveler's effect.

question: Arthur controls a [Chalice of the Void] with 2 charge counters. Arthur casts [Marketback Walker] with X=1.will Marketback Walker be countered?
answer_gold: Yes Marketback Walker will get countered. Since X=1, the mana value of this spell is 2 which causes of Chalice of the Void's ability to trigger.

question: Ainsley casts [Show and Tell], choosing to put [Griselbrand] onto the battlefield. Can Nasir put in their [Phantasmal Image] copying Griselbrand?
answer_gold: No. The choice of what to copy for Phantasmal Image is made right before it enters the battlefield, at which point Griselbrand is not yet on the battlefield.

question: Arely casts [Replication Technique] targeting their [Death Watch]. They choose to make a copy of it, and Nico also gets a copy. Can Nico chose to have their copy stay targeting Death Watch?
answer_gold: Yes. Demonstrate doesn't require that the target is changed. ([702.144a]) However, when the copy tries to resolve, it will have an illegal target and be removed from the stack without resolving further.

question: Ashley controls [Murktide Regent] and plays [Mystic Sanctuary] untapped, putting [Master Warcraft] on top of their library. Does this trigger Murktide Regent?
answer_gold: Yes.

question: Ariel casts [Embrace the Unknown] and exiles [Scars of the Veteran]. Can they pay the alternate cost instead of paying mana?
answer_gold: Yes. Embrace the Unknown allows Ariel to cast Scars of the Veteran, but doesn't place any restriction on how Ariel should cast it, so they're free to pay the alternative cost.

question: Ari controls [Silverbluff Bridge], [Trinisphere], 5 Thopter tokens, which are 1/1 flying artifact creatures, and nothing else. Can Ari cast [Memory Guardian]?
answer_gold: No. Affinity is not a form of mana payment but a cost reduction ability, so Memory Guardian would cost {2}{U}.

question: Ashley controls [Underworld Breach] and has [Reveillark] in their graveyard. Can they evoke it?
answer_gold: No. Escape and evoke are both alternative costs ([702.138a], [702.74a]), and Ashley may only pay one alternative cost for a spell. Since escape is the only thing that allows Ashley to cast Reveillark from their graveyard, they have to use that cost.

question: Axel controls [Delver of Secrets] and activates [Mishra's Bauble] during Nathalia's end step. On Axel's upkeep, what happens?
answer_gold: Axel can choose the order of the two triggered abilities, since they control both and neither ability triggers off of the other.

question: Aniya is at 29 life and attacks with [Serra Ascendant]. Nehemiah blocks with [Pierce Strider]. Does either creature die? How much life does Aniya gain?
answer_gold:
Neither creature dies, and Aniya gains 1 life.

First the game determines how much damage each creature will deal. Then all combat damage is dealt simultaneously, and Aniya gains that much life. Serra Ascendant's toughness changes at the same time. Then state-based actions are checked, Serra Ascendant will be a 6/6 and neither creature will die.

question: Annalee controls [Raphael, Fiendish Savior] and a 1/1 Devil creature token with "When this creature dies, it deals 1 damage to any target." Nico casts [Blood Curdle] targeting the token. Will Raphael, Fiendish Savior's ability trigger?
answer_gold: No. The ability only triggers if a creature card was put into Annalee's graveyard that turn, and tokens are not cards.

question: Adonis controls [Sigarda's Aid] and is attacking with [Dormant Sliver]. After Nico chooses not to block, is Adonis able to cast [Sword of Light and Shadow] and attach it to Dormant Sliver?
answer_gold: Yes. After blockers are declared Adonis gets priority and has the ability to cast Sword of Light and Shadow before damage is dealt.

question: Avery controls [Skrelv's Hive] and five 1/1 colorless Phyrexian Mite artifact creature tokens with toxic 1 and "This creature can't block." Nicolas currently has no poison counters. They attack Nicolas with all five Phyrexian Mites. Will Avery gain 5 life?
answer_gold: No. Toxic causes Nicolas to gain poison counters when combat damage is dealt. ([702.164c], [120.3g]) Therefore they won't have any poison counters at the time the Mites deal damage and the Mites will not have lifelink.

question: Ainsley casts [Superior Spider-Man] but before it resolves Noelle casts [Humility]. Can Ainsley choose to copy something?
answer_gold: Superior Spider-Man won't enter as a copy of anything. As Superior Spider-Man is entering the battlefield the game checks to see what it would look like on the battlefield to see if any replacement effects would apply to it. Because Humility is on the battlefield, Superior Spider-Man wouldn't have any replacement effects, and therefore Ainsley doesn't get to choose to copy anything.

question: Anabella controls [Blood Moon] and enchants their [Sunlit Marsh] with [Urban Utopia]. What colors can it tap for?
answer_gold: Any color. Blood Moon operates in the type-changing layer which is applied before the ability adding and removing layer. Sunlit Marsh is a Mountain, with the additional ability "{T}: Add one mana of any color.".

question: April controls [General Ferrous Rokiric]. What happens when they cast [Reduce]?
answer_gold: General Ferrous Rokiric won't trigger. While Reduce is a multicolored card elsewhere, on the stack it's a monocolored card.

question: Ariella controls [The One Ring] with no burden counters. They tap it to draw a card, and Nico responds by exiling it with [Banishing Coils]. Does Ariella draw a card?
answer_gold: No. When its ability resolves, no burden counter can be placed on The One Ring. The ability then uses its last known information to determine how many cards to draw, which is 0.

question: Allison casts [Sorcerous Spyglass] naming [Spring-Loaded Sawblades]. Can Nico crew Spring-Loaded Sawblades?
answer_gold: No. Crew is an activated ability. ([702.122a])

question: Avery controls [Goblin Electromancer] and is casting [Storm Reading]. Does it cost {1} less?
answer_gold: Yes. When a player is casting an Adventure, it has the characteristics of its Adventure portion, so it's an instant and Goblin Electromancer can affect its total cost.

question: Aarav attacks with [Dour Port-Mage]. Nico is at -5 life, controls [Phyrexian Unlife] and casts [Angel's Grace]. What happens in the combat damage step?
answer_gold: Nico is dealt 1 damage, and gets that many poison counters. Nico's life total staying the same is not a "reduction", so Angel's Grace's replacement effect does not apply.

question: Alejandro activates [Grindstone] targeting Nevaeh. In response they activate [Goblin Welder], sacrificing Grindstone to return [Painter's Servant] to the battlefield. They choose "black" as the color for Painter's Servant, and still in response to the Grindstone ability, Nevaeh casts [Veil of Summer]. What happens?
answer_gold:
Grindstone's ability will still resolve and mill Nevaeh's library. Hexproof from black cares about color of the source of the ability, and since Grindstone isn't on the battlefield anymore, the game uses its last-known information to check the legality of the ability's target. Since it was colorless when it was last on the battlefield, hexproof from black doesn't affect it.

(The game doesn't care about its color in the graveyard because it's a new object there and has no relation to the permanent as it existed on the battlefield.)

question: Avery casts [Desecration Plague] targeting Neymar's [Leyline of the Void]. Will Desecration Plague go to Avery's graveyard or exile?
answer_gold: Graveyard. Leyline of the Void is destroyed before Desecration Plague goes to the graveyard, since going to the graveyard is the last part of a spell resolving.

question: Amina casts [Ranger's Firebrand] and chooses [Rimebound Dead] as their ring-bearer. Will it still have the snow supertype?
answer_gold: Yes. A creature being a ring-bearer doesn't change any of it's types, it's simply a fact about the permanent, such as being a commander.

question: Ace controls [Soul Warden] and casts [Realmwalker]. Can Natalie kill it before Ace casts a creature from the top of their library?
answer_gold: Yes. When Realmwalker enters the battlefield Soul Warden's trigger will go on the stack, at which point both players will have a chance to respond.

question: Nico has 7 life and controls two [Death's Shadow]s. August uses [Luminate Primordial] to exile one of the Death's Shadows. What happens next?
answer_gold: Death's Shadow is a 6/6 when it gets exiled, so Nico gains 6 life. Before August receives priority again, state-based actions are checked, and the game sees that the remaining Death's Shadow now has 0 toughness, and it will be put into Nico's graveyard.

question: Amelia attacks with an [Armored Cancrix]. Nico casts [Deflecting Palm] choosing Armored Cancrix. Amelia casts Deflecting Palm choosing Nico's Deflecting Palm. What happens in the combat damage step?
answer_gold: Nico takes two damage. First the game starts with the base event: Armored Cancrix dealing two damage to Nico. Then the game checks to see if there are any replacement effects that apply. There is one: Nico's Deflecting Palm would like to modify the event to instead be Amelia takes two damage from Deflecting Palm. Then the game checks to see if any replacement effect apply to this new event, and there is indeed another replacement effect: It's Amelia's Deflecting Palm. The new event is now Nico takes two damage from Amelia's Deflecting Palm.

question: Nico controls [Sphere of Resistance]. If Austin wants to exile [Yavimaya Gnats] with [Prismatic Ending], what will it cost?
answer_gold: Austin will need to pay 3 or more mana for Prismatic Ending, and include at least 3 colors in that payment. X is chosen before Sphere of Resistance modifies the cost, so Austin can choose X = 1 and then Sphere of Resistance brings the total cost up to 3.

question: Ainsley controls [Conspicuous Snoop] and no other permanents. The top two cards of their library are [Skirk Prospector], can they cast one?
answer_gold: Yes. The game doesn't check whether the spell is legal to cast after Ainsley has the opportunity to activate mana abilities and pay costs, therefore they can sacrifice Conspicuous Snoop to pay for Skirk Prospector.

question: Ashley activates [Boseiju, Who Endures] targeting Nikolai's [Skyshroud Forest]. Can Nikolai put a [Wastes] onto the battlefield from their library?
answer_gold: No. Wastes has no basic land types.

question: Ainsley controls [Allosaurus Shepherd] and casts [Gnarlroot Pallbearer]. What happens if Nathaly targets it with [Remand]?
answer_gold: Remand resolves, but can't counter Gnarlroot Pallbearer. Nathaly draws a card, and then Gnarlroot Pallbearer will resolve.

question: Ashley attacks Nayeli with [Gutter Skulk] and [Elvish Warrior]. Nayeli casts [Deflecting Palm], choosing Ashley's Gutter Skulk as it resolves. Both players are at 2 life. What happens?
answer_gold: The game ends in a draw. Deflecting Palm deals damage to Ashley immediately after Elvish Warrior deals damage to Nayeli. The next time state-based actions are checked, both players are at 0 life and lose at the same time, making the game a draw.

question: April casts [Not Dead After All] targeting [Reflection of Kiki-Jiki], what happens?
answer_gold: It will come back as the front side of Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, tapped. The role enchantment will not be created.

question: Aspen casts [Metamorphic Alteration] targeting Niko's [Hulk, Bruce Banner], choosing to copy Niko's [Meishin, the Mind Cage]. What happens?
answer_gold: Hulk, Bruce Banner becomes a copy of Meishin, the Mind Cage. Meishin, the Mind Cage's name is copied and therefore due to the legend rule, Niko will need to choose one to put into their graveyard.

question: Nico controls [Trinisphere]. Alena has [Green Sun's Zenith] in their hand and controls 3 [Forest]s. What mana values can Alena search for, and how much would they have to pay?
answer_gold:
Alena can search for a creature with mana value 0, 1, or 2. In all cases, Alena will have to pay 3 mana for Green Sun's Zenith.

As one of the first steps of casting Green Sun's Zenith, Alena chooses the value of X. Then, later on, Trinisphere checks if the total cost of the spell is less than 3, and increases it to 3 if necessary.

question:
Amani controls a [Founding the Third Path], and its third ability is resolving. Amani chooses to cast a [Fatal Push] from their graveyard. Amani currently does not have Revolt.
Can Amani choose to target [Skyhunter Patrol] with Fatal Push? Will Skyhunter Patrol be destroyed by Fatal Push?
answer_gold:
Yes Amani can target Skyhunter Patrol, and it will be destroyed by Fatal Push.

Fatal Push does not check for the target's mana value when put on the stack, so Amani is allowed to target Skyhunter Patrol.

Amani will put Fatal Push on the stack as part of the resolution of Founding the Third Path's third chapter. Once the ability is done resolving, SBAs are checked and the saga is sacrificed. In particular this means that Amani will have Revolt when Fatal Push resolves, thus Skyhunter Patrol will get destroyed.

question: Autumn activates [Lion's Eye Diamond], discarding [Resentful Revelation]. Can Nicolas remove it with [Relic of Progenitus] before Autumn has a chance to cast it?
answer_gold: No. After a mana ability resolves, the player who activated it gets priority first.

question:
Audrina casts [Threadbind Clique], and Nico answers by casting [Spell Queller], exiling Threadbind Clique with its triggered ability.
When Spell Queller leaves the battlefield, can Audrina choose to cast [Rip the Seams] or do they have to cast Threadbind Clique?
answer_gold: Audrina can choose to cast either Threadbind Clique or Rip the Seams when Spell Queller leaves the battlefield.

question: For the third chapter ability of [Fall of Gil-galad], will the targeted creature fight immediately or when it dies?
answer_gold: The targeted creature will fight immediately. While the text instructing the creature to fight is after the dies trigger, it's not inside the quotation marks, and therefore not part of the dies trigger.

question: Ashley attacks with [Krallenhorde Killer]. Nickolas blocks with an animated [Mishra's Factory]. Can they tap it after blockers are declared to give itself +1/+1?
answer_gold: Yes.

question: Aubriella casts [Archangel of Wrath], paying the kicker. Before its trigger resolves, Nicholas kills it. Will Aubriella still gain life when the trigger resolves?
answer_gold: Yes. The game will use the last known information from Archangel of Wrath while resolving the trigger, and will see that the last time it was on the battlefield, Archangel of Wrath had lifelink.

question: Nasir controls [Phyrexian Revoker] naming "[Lightning Storm]". Can Aspen cast Lightning Storm? If so, can they discard land cards to put charge counters on it?
answer_gold: Aspen can cast Lightning Storm, but cannot discard a land card to put charge counters on it. Discarding a land card is an activated ability, while casting a spell is not.

question: Abby casts [Grist, the Hunger Tide], can Nathan counter it with [Negate]?
answer_gold: No they cannot, since while it is on the stack, Grist, the Hunger Tide is a Creature spell.

question: Autumn casts [Tarmogoyf] with a land and sorcery in their graveyard. Can Noa counter it with [Stern Scolding]?
answer_gold: Yes. Tarmogoyf's ability is a characteristic-defining ability, so it functions in all zones. Tarmogoyf's power on the stack is 2. Stern Scolding is only put into the graveyard after it has finished resolving, which is not in time to grow the Tarmogoyf.

question: Avery controls [The One Ring] and casts [Teferi's Protection] then casts a second The One Ring. What happens at the start of the next turn?
answer_gold: The One Ring will phase back in during the untap step. Then all triggered abilities will go onto the stack, then before Avery gets priority they will have to sacrifice a The One Ring to state-based actions. When the triggers resolve the trigger affiliated with the sacrificed The One Ring will use last known information to determine how many counters were on it, and how much life Avery should lose.

question: Aubrielle casts [King Macar, the Gold-Cursed], then casts [Word of Seizing] at their first opportunity. Does Nico have an opportunity to counter King Macar, the Gold-Cursed with [Ooze Spill]?
answer_gold: Yes. Nico can't cast any spells while Word of Seizing is on the stack, but Nico can wait for it to resolve and then cast a spell before King Macar, the Gold-Cursed resolves.

question: Ari uses [Spectacular Showdown] to goad Nova's [Drownyard Explorers]. Ari also controls [Domri, City Smasher]. On Nova's turn, what are the legal choices of attacks?
answer_gold:
Drownyard Explorers can attack either Ari or Domri, City Smasher, but it must attack something.

A goaded creature must attack each combat is able and must attack any player other than the player that goaded it. The second requirement can't be followed, but the first still must be.

question: Adley has a [Lodestone Golem], a Plains and a Swamp. Can Adley cast [Prismatic Ending] targeting [Talon Sliver]?
answer_gold: Yes Adley can cast Prismatic Ending targeting Talon Sliver. Adley can target Talon Sliver regardless of whether the final spell will exile it or not, as any card is targetable with Prismatic Ending, and it's only exiled if the conditions are met. Then Adley chooses the value of X, in this case they can select 0, then add Lodestone Golem's tax resulting in a required mana payment of two. If Adley chooses to use two different colors of mana, when the spell resolves it will see that two colors were spent and exile the target if it's mana value is two or less.

question: Alma deals combat damage to Nico with their [Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer]. They exile [Deceit] from Nico's library. Can Alma evoke Deceit?
answer_gold: Yes. Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer's trigger creates a continuous effect that lets Alma cast Deceit this turn, with no restrictions on how it's cast. Alma is free to cast Deceit for its alternative cost by evoking it.

question: With a [Trinisphere] on the battlefield, how much mana does Alaia needs to spend to cast [Mental Misstep]?
answer_gold:
Either {2}{U} or 2 life and {3}.

When making choices for the spell, Alaia chooses to pay 2 life or {U} for the {U/P}. Then when the total cost of the spell is being determined, Trinisphere increases the total cost of the spell to include at least 3 mana.

question: Can Autumn evoke [Solitude] by exiling [Myrkul, Lord of Bones]?
answer_gold: Yes. Myrkul, Lord of Bones is white, regardless of what other colors it has.

question: If Amir discard [Blightsteel Colossus] to [Cyclonus, the Saboteur]'s connive ability, will it get a +1/+1 counter?
answer_gold: Cyclonus, the Saboteur will get a +1/+1 counter. Because Blightsteel Colossus is shuffled back into Amir's library after its revealed to all players, the game can determine its characteristics.

question: Amiyah taps their [The One Ring], which currently has no burden counters on it, to draw a card. Before that resolves Nico casts [Soul Partition] targeting The One Ring. How many cards does Amiyah draw when the activated ability resolves?
answer_gold: None. When The One Ring's ability resolves it can't put a burden counter on The One Ring because it's no longer on the battlefield. The game uses its last known information to determine how many burden counters were on The One Ring before it was exiled.

question: Anastasia controls [Uglúk of the White Hand] and their [Mauhúr, Uruk-hai Captain] dies. How many +1/+1 counters does Uglúk of the White Hand get?
answer_gold: Two. Uglúk of the White Hand has a triggered ability, which triggers when Mauhúr, Uruk-hai Captain dies and doesn't resolve until later. Mauhúr, Uruk-hai Captain would need to be on the battlefield while Uglúk of the White Hand's trigger is resolving in order for its replacement effect to apply.

question: Asher has [Empty-Shrine Kannushi] in their graveyard, and controls [Cairn Wanderer]. Does Cairn Wanderer have protection from black?
answer_gold: No. Empty-Shrine Kannushi doesn't have protection, it has an ability that grants it protection. That ability only functions on the battlefield, so it does not have protection in the graveyard.

question: Allen controls [Forge Anew] and [Kaldra Compleat] equipped to a Germ token. They attack Nico with the Germ token and [Eyeless Watcher]. What happens if, after first strike damage is dealt, they equip Kaldra Compleat to Eyeless Watcher?
answer_gold: Nico is dealt 5 damage in the first strike step, and 6 in the regular combat damage step.

question: Nia has 11 life and controls [Death's Shadow]. Apollo attacks with two [Razing Snidd]s, and Nia blocks one of them with Death's Shadow. What is the game state in the second main phase?
answer_gold:
Both Razing Snidds are on the battlefield (one of them has been dealt 2 damage), and Death's Shadow is a 5/5 since Nia has 8 life.

All damage in combat is dealt simultaneously, so there's never any point at which Death's Shadow had lethal damage marked on it. And even if it did, the game doesn't check for lethal damage until later, when state-based actions are checked.

question: Avery controls [Living Plane] and plays [Minas Tirith]. Does it enter tapped or untapped?
answer_gold: Tapped. When applying an enters-the-battlefield replacement effect, the game considers the characteristics of the permanent as it would exist on the battlefield, so it sees that it would be a creature, but it doesn't consider the permanent to actually be on the battlefield yet. Effectively, a legendary creature is entering the battlefield.

question: Nathaniel controls [Rest in Peace] and [Dauthi Voidwalker], and Armani casts [Read the Bones]. What happens to it?
answer_gold: Armani gets to choose which replacement effect applies to it. After applying that effect, it's no longer moving to the graveyard, so the other effect doesn't apply. It'll end up in exile either way, but Armani gets to choose whether it has a void counter on it.

question: Angelo casts [Lightning Storm], targeting Nico's [Spellskite]. Angelo then discards 27 lands to Lightning Storm, changing its target to Nico. Can Nico change its target back to Spellskite?
answer_gold: Yes. There's nothing that would prevent that from happening.

question: Ariel activates the [-2] ability of [Grist, the Hunger Tide], intending to sacrifice their 1/1 Insect token to destroy Nicholas's [Multani's Acolyte]. Can Nicholas kill the Insect in order to save their Multani's Acolyte?
answer_gold: Yes, but only before knowing that Multani's Acolyte is the target. When Ariel activates Grist, the Hunger Tide, Nicholas can respond by killing the Insect. If Ariel doesn't sacrifice a creature when Grist, the Hunger Tide's ability resolves, there won't be any trigger to destroy a creature or planeswalker. But once that trigger is on the stack targeting Multani's Acolyte, the Insect is already in the graveyard.

question: In their main phase, Autumn creates a token copy of [Nylea's Forerunner] with [Reflection of Kiki-Jiki]. After that resolves, Natalee casts [Time Stop]. What happens to the token?
answer_gold: It's exiled at the beginning of the next end step, which will probably be Natalee's end step on their next turn. Ending the turn skips straight to the cleanup step, with no end step.

question: Ayden uses [Cackling Counterpart] to make a copy of card [Mirkwood Bats]. What happens?
answer_gold: Ayden will put two copies of Mirkwood Bats trigger onto the stack. The game checks immediately after an event occurs to see if any abilities triggered, in this case, immediately after the token copy of Mirkwood Bats is created the game will check for triggers and see two things that trigger when tokens are created.

question: Ari casts [Archon of Cruelty], and before it resolves Neil casts [Veil of Summer]. What happens when the Archon resolves?
answer_gold: Archon of Cruelty's ability triggers but is not placed onto the stack, since there are no legal targets for it. Ari will not draw a card or gain life.

question: Ariel cast [Commandeer] targeting Nova's [The One Ring]. Does Ariel get protection from everything?
answer_gold: No. Ariel didn't cast The One Ring.

question: Autumn controls [Reflections of Littjara] naming "Beast" and casts [Lore Drakkis] as a mutate spell targeting [Crawling Chorus]. What happens?
answer_gold: Autumn creates a copy of Lore Drakkis that's a mutating creature spell and is targeting Crawling Chorus. ([702.140a], [707.10]) As it resolves, it turns into a token and merges with Crawling Chorus. ([707.10f]/[608.3f], [702.140c]/[608.3d]) The merged permanent is a token if the token was put on top, and a nontoken otherwise.

question: Ariana casts [Necromancy] from under their [Mosswort Bridge] ability. Will Necromancy be sacrificed at the beginning of the next cleanup step?
answer_gold: No, the "sacrifice in cleanup" is part of the same ability that lets Ariana cast Necromancy as though it had flash, and is therefore only applicable if it was cast it using that ability. It will not apply if Necromancy was cast using Mosswort Bridge's ability.

question: Avery enchants their [Hall] with [Unbridled Growth]. Next turn, Nickolas casts [Blood Moon]. What colors of mana can Hall tap for?
answer_gold: Any color. Blood Moon operates in the type-changing layer which is applied before the ability adding and removing layer. Hall is a Mountain, with the additional ability "{T}: Add one mana of any color.".

question: Ari activates [Teferi, Time Raveler]'s [+1] ability and passes the turn. Could Ari suspend [Inspiring Refrain] in Natalee's upkeep?
answer_gold: Yes. A card with suspend can be suspended any time the player has priority and they could legally begin casting that spell. Teferi, Time Raveler's ability gives Ari permission to cast sorceries as though they had flash, so Ari could legally begin casting Inspiring Refrain, and they could also therefore suspend it.

question: Aliana controls a Wizard and casts [Flame of Anor], choosing to draw 2 cards and deal 5 damage to Nico's [Xyris, the Writhing Storm]. Will Xyris, the Writhing Storm' triggered ability trigger?
answer_gold: Yes. Xyris, the Writhing Storm will not die until state-based actions are checked. This happens whenever a player would get priority, and the next time a player would get priority is after Flame of Anor has finished resolving. Since Xyris, the Writhing Storm was still on the battlefield when Aliana drew 2 cards, its ability will trigger twice.

question: In response to [Urza's Saga]'s third chapter ability, Nico casts [Force of Vigor] targeting Abdullah's Urza's Saga and their Construct token. Force of Vigor resolves and both are destroyed. Will Abdullah still be able to search their library for an artifact?
answer_gold: Yes. Once triggered, a triggered ability exists independent of its source. Therefore Urza's Saga's ability will still resolve even if it is no longer on the battlefield.

question: Andres casts [Blood Feud], can Andres choose Nathalia's [Colorful Feiyi Sparrow] for both targets?
answer_gold: No. The word "another" here retains its normal English meaning, and means that both targets cannot be the same creature.

question: Nicholas controls [Urza's Saga]. Aubrey casts [Tide Shaper] kicked and targets Urza's Saga. In response to the trigger, Nicholas casts [Igneous Inspiration], destroying Tide Shaper. What happens?
answer_gold: Nothing. Urza's Saga doesn't turn into an Island at any point. Tide Shaper's ability has a duration (as long as it's on the battlefield) if that duration ends before the effect even begins to apply, the effect doesn't apply at all. Since Tide Shaper is no longer on the battlefield when the trigger resolves, there's no point when Urza's Saga will become an island.

question: Ariel attacks with [Sporeweb Weaver], and Noah blocks it with [Aegis Turtle]. Can Noah use [Tishana's Tidebinder] to counter Sporeweb Weaver's ability?
answer_gold: Yes. Tishana's Tidebinder's ability targets Sporeweb Weaver's ability, not Sporeweb Weaver itself, so hexproof doesn't matter.

question: Nala controls [Leyline of the Void] and [Dauthi Voidwalker], and Aubrey casts [Seek the Beast]. What happens to it?
answer_gold: Aubrey gets to choose which replacement effect applies to it. After applying that effect, it's no longer moving to the graveyard, so neither other effect can apply. It'll end up in exile either way, but Aubrey gets to choose whether it has a void counter on it, or is castable on its non-Adventure side, or neither.

question: Ainsley uses [Living End] to return both [Breathless Knight] and [Lantern Kami] from their graveyard to the battlefield. How many +1/+1 counters will Breathless Knight get?
answer_gold: Zero. Living End exiles the cards from the graveyard before putting them on the battlefield, and Breathless Knight only gets counters if it entered from a graveyard.

question: Andi casts [Dress Down], and in response Nico activates the ability granted by [Splinter Twin]. Does the token it creates get sacrificed?
answer_gold: Yes. Sacrificing the token isn't an ability of the token, it's a delayed trigger set up by the resolution of Splinter Twin's activated ability.

question: Aspen controls [Whiptail Wurm] enchanted with [Protective Bubble] and attacks Nikolai. Before declaring blockers, Nikolai casts [Dress Down]. Can Nikolai block Whiptail Wurm?
answer_gold: No. Dress Down causes Whiptail Wurm to lose all abilities, but Protective Bubble does not give Whiptail Wurm an ability, it just states something about it that's true.

question: Aryan controls [Frontline Heroism] and casts [Resounding Roar] targeting the token. If they choose to copy Resounding Roar and target the new token that's been created, will Aryan create another token?
answer_gold: No, the event Frontline Heroism's trigger is watching for is Aryan casting a spell that targets one of their creatures, copying a spell does not constitute casting it.

question: Amirah has [Rockalanche] in their graveyard and activates [Lion's Eye Diamond] to pay for it. After Amirah activates their Lion's Eye Diamond does Nehemiah have a chance to cast [Surgical Extraction] on Rockalanche?
answer_gold: No. Nehemiah can only cast a spell when they have priority. Lion's Eye Diamond is a mana ability and as such resolves immediately. Which means priority will not pass to Nehemiah, and Amirah can then cast Rockalanche from their graveyard.

question: Ainsley controls [Bird Maiden] which is enchanted by [Ethereal Armor] and has a +1/+1 counter on it. What happens if Bird Maiden is targeted by [The Eternal Wanderer]'s [+1] loyalty ability?
answer_gold: Bird Maiden will be exiled and Ethereal Armor will be put into the graveyard as a state-based action. The +1/+1 counter stops existing when Bird Maiden goes to exile. When Bird Maiden returns, it will neither be enchanted nor will it have any +1/+1 counters.

question: Aron activates [Inkmoth Nexus]'s second ability, then mutates [Gemrazer] on top of it. What is it?
answer_gold: Inkmoth Nexus will be a 1/1 Phyrexian Blinkmoth artifact creature with flying and infect until end of turn named Gemrazer Aron will get the mutate trigger of Gemrazer. Afterwards it will be a Gemrazer with Inkmoth Nexus's abilities. ([702.140f])

question: Norah controls a [Ugin's Labyrinth] currently exiling a [Sundering Titan]. Achilles casts [Magus of the Moon]. If Magus of the Moon leaves play, will Norah be able to use the Ugin's Labyrinth's ability to return their Sundering Titan to their hand?
answer_gold: Yes. While Ugin's Labyrinth loses its abilities while Magus of the Moon is on the battlefield, neither it or the Sundering Titan become new objects, and as such it will "remember" the Sundering Titan later.

question: Azariah controls [Roaming Throne] naming "Elf", and then casts [Elvish Warmaster], what happens?
answer_gold: Azariah will get one Elf token. When Elvish Warmaster enters the battlefield its ability triggers and Roaming Throne attempts to cause the trigger to happen a second time, however because there's a restriction on the amount of times Elvish Warmaster's ability can trigger, it simply won't happen.

question: Noe controls a [Talas Scout] with two +1/+1 counters on it and blocks Addison's [Oona's Gatewarden]. If Noe equips [Luxior, Giada's Gift] to Talas Scout, what will its power and toughness be?
answer_gold: 1/2 . As a state-based action +1/+1 counters and -1/-1 counters are removed in pairs. So when Noe goes to equip Luxior, Giada's Gift, there will be no counters on Talas Scout.

question: Astrid has the City's Blessing, and controls two [Ocelot Pride]s. This turn they've created one 2/1 Cat Warrior and have gained life. After all their Ocelot Pride triggers resolve, how many tokens will they have?
answer_gold: Ten. As the first trigger resolves, Astrid creates a 1/1 Cat, then creates a copy of it and their 2/1 Cat Warrior. Then as the second trigger resolves, they create a third 1/1 cat and then create copies of their three 1/1 cats and two 2/1 Cats.

question: What layer does [Grand Abolisher]'s "During your turn, your opponents can't cast spells or activate abilities of artifacts, creatures, or enchantments." ability apply in?
answer_gold: Because Grand Abolisher's ability doesn't change the characteristics of any objects, it doesn't apply in any layer. Instead it's a static ability that generates a continuous effect that modifies the rules of the game.

question: Nicholas controls [Titania, Voice of Gaea]. Annie casts [Forbidden Ritual] and chooses to repeat the process two times. Nicholas chooses to sacrifice a land each time. What happens?
answer_gold: Titania, Voice of Gaea will trigger three times. During the resolution of Forbidden Ritual Annie sacrifices a permanent, which causes Nicholas to sacrifice a land, which causes Titania, Voice of Gaea to trigger. Then when the process is repeated this is a new instance of Nicholas sacrificing a land, which will cause a separate instance of Titania, Voice of Gaea triggering.

question: If Abigail controls a Wizard, can they choose to deal five damage to two different creatures with [Flame of Anor]?
answer_gold: No. By default each mode on a modal spell can only be chosen once.

question: Alex is playing a multiplayer game and controls [Rakdos, the Muscle]. Alex triggers its ability by sacrificing a [Panther Warriors] and casts [Bird Maiden] from Beckett's library. While Bird Maiden is on the stack, Cora activates their [Door to Nothingness] to remove Alex from the game. What happens to Bird Maiden?
answer_gold: Bird Maiden will get exiled. Anything Alex controls that isn't under the influence of a control-changing effect that they don't own will be exiled.

question: Annabel controls [Altar of Dementia] and casts [Too Greedily, Too Deep] returning Nolan's [Sepulchral Primordial] to the battlefield. Can Annabel use Altar of Dementia to sacrifice Sepulchral Primordial and return it to the battlefield using its own triggered ability?
answer_gold: No. Annabel must choose a target for Sepulchral Primordial's triggered ability as it is put onto the stack. At this time, Sepulchral Primordial is still on the battlefield.

question: Amari controls [Olivia Voldaren] equipped with [Sword of Kaldra]. If they target Nelson's [Ghirapur Osprey] with Olivia Voldaren's activated ability to deal one damage, what happens?
answer_gold: Ghirapur Osprey will take one damage then be exiled shortly after. Sword of Kaldra doesn't specify what kind of damage needs to be dealt, so any damage dealt by the equipped creature will trigger Sword of Kaldra.
